## src/screens/collection.lua

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/src/screens/collection.lua`

````lua
-- Colección y editor: la consulta no altera el mazo; la edición usa un borrador.
local Screen=require("src.ui.screen")
local W=require("src.ui.widgets")
local P=require("src.ui.palette")
local Data=require("src.data.cards")
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local CardView=require("src.ui.card")
local Controls=require("src.config.controls")
local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
local Collection={}
local contextOrder={"conversation","investigation","magic"}
local contextNames={conversation="conversación",investigation="investigación",magic="magia"}
local stateNames={equipped="EQUIPADA",available="SIN EQUIPAR",locked="BLOQUEADA"}
local groupNames={equipped="EQUIPADAS",available="DESBLOQUEADAS SIN EQUIPAR",locked="BLOQUEADAS"}
local stateColors={equipped=P.teal,available=P.gold,locked=P.muted}
local function signed(n) return (n>=0 and "+" or "")..n end
local function copy(deck) local out={} for i,id in ipairs(deck) do out[i]=id end return out end

function Collection.combatDetail(card)
    if not card.combat then return "Solo encuentros sociales; no se incluye en la mano de combate." end
    local names={damage="daño",shield="escudo",heal="vida",energy="energía"}
    local effects={}
    for _,key in ipairs({"damage","shield","heal","energy"}) do
        local value=(card.combat.effects or {})[key]
        if value and value~=0 then effects[#effects+1]=signed(value).." "..names[key] end
    end
    local e=card.combat.effects or {}
    local rules=require("src.data.combat_cards").rules
    if e.draw then effects[#effects+1]="roba "..e.draw end
    if e.weak then effects[#effects+1]="debilita (-"..rules.weakReduction.." daño en su próximo turno)" end
    if e.vulnerable then effects[#effects+1]="vulnerable (+"..rules.vulnerableBonus.." daño recibido por golpe este turno)" end
    local condition=card.conditions and card.conditions.character
    local companion=condition and (" Requiere a "..Characters.byId[condition].shortName..".") or ""
    return require("src.systems.combat").describe(card)..companion
end

function Collection.canEdit(session)
    if not session then return false,"Inicia o continúa una campaña para editar su mazo." end
    if #session.deck<5 then return false,"Nanahoshi entregará el mazo durante el tutorial." end
    if session.encounter or session.combat then return false,"Termina el encuentro antes de editar el mazo." end
    return true
end

function Collection.replace(deck,slot,id,unlocked)
    if type(slot)~="number" or slot%1~=0 or slot<1 or slot>math.min(10,#deck+1) then return nil,"Elige una posición equipada." end
    if not Data.byId[id] or not unlocked[id] then return nil,"Esta carta está bloqueada." end
    if deck[slot]==id then return nil,"Esa carta ya ocupa la posición seleccionada." end
    for _,equipped in ipairs(deck) do if equipped==id then return nil,"La carta ya está equipada; no se permiten duplicados." end end
    local proposal=copy(deck); proposal[slot]=id
    local ok,err=Cards.validateDeck(proposal,unlocked)
    if not ok then return nil,err end
    return proposal
end

-- La viabilidad se calcula con el mismo motor y sus condiciones/afinidades.
-- No garantiza una mano favorable: comprueba que el mazo contiene una
-- combinación ganadora posible en tres acciones y cuatro puntos de energía.
function Collection.bestSocialScore(deck,context)
    local candidates={}
    for _,id in ipairs(deck) do
        local scratch={finished=false,energy=4,hand={id},context=context}
        if Cards.canPlay(scratch,1) then
            local preview=Cards.preview(scratch,1)
            candidates[#candidates+1]={cost=preview.cost,score=preview.score}
        end
    end
    local best=0
    local function explore(first,actions,energy,score)
        best=math.max(best,score)
        if actions==0 then return end
        for i=first,#candidates do
            local card=candidates[i]
            if card.cost<=energy then explore(i+1,actions-1,energy-card.cost,score+card.score) end
        end
    end
    explore(1,3,4,0)
    return best
end

function Collection.validatePlayableDeck(deck,unlocked,day)
    local valid,err=Cards.validateDeck(deck,unlocked)
    if not valid then return false,err end
    for _,profile in ipairs({
        {character="sylphiette",kind="conversation",sceneId="encounter_sylphiette",name="Sylphiette"},
        {character="roxy",kind="investigation",sceneId="encounter_roxy",name="Roxy"},
        {character="eris",kind="conversation",sceneId="encounter_eris",name="Eris"},
    }) do
        if (day or 2)>=5 then profile.sceneId="day5_mission_"..profile.character end
        local maximum=Collection.bestSocialScore(deck,profile)
        if maximum<5 then
            return false,"Mazo inviable con "..profile.name..": máximo "..maximum.." / meta 5. Añade cartas con avance."
        end
    end
    return true
end

function Collection.groups(session)
    local groups={equipped={},available={},locked={}}
    local equipped={}
    for _,id in ipairs(session.deck or {}) do equipped[id]=true end
    for i,card in ipairs(Data.list) do
        local state=equipped[card.id] and "equipped" or ((session.unlocked or {})[card.id] and "available" or "locked")
        groups[state][#groups[state]+1]={index=i,card=card,state=state}
    end
    return groups
end

-- The panel reads the actual effect records, not a second list of bonuses.
function Collection.details(card,session)
    local state=(session.unlocked or {})[card.id] and "available" or "locked"
    for _,id in ipairs(session.deck or {}) do if id==card.id then state="equipped"; break end end
    local recommended={}
    for _,kind in ipairs(contextOrder) do
        local effects=(card.contexts or {})[kind]
        if effects and ((effects.score or 0)>0 or (effects.trust or 0)>0 or (effects.chemistry or 0)>0) then
            recommended[#recommended+1]=contextNames[kind]
        end
    end
    local affinities={}
    for _,id in ipairs(Characters.romanceIds) do
        if (card.affinities or {})[id] then affinities[#affinities+1]=Characters.byId[id].shortName end
    end
    local condition=card.conditions and card.conditions.character
    local requirement=condition and ("Requiere a "..Characters.byId[condition].shortName..".") or "Sin requisito de compañía."
    local e=card.effects
    return {
        name=card.name,category=Data.categories[card.category],cost="Energía: "..card.cost,
        state=state,stateLabel=stateNames[state],description=card.description,
        base="La frase y los cambios de relación dependen de cada conversación.",
        contexts=#recommended>0 and table.concat(recommended," / ") or "Cualquier contexto; sin bonificación.",
        affinity=#affinities>0 and ("Modificadores: "..table.concat(affinities,", ")..".") or requirement,
        unlock=card.unlockHint,
    }
end

local function badge(state,x,y)
    love.graphics.setColor(stateColors[state])
    if state=="equipped" then
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill",x,y,7,9)
        love.graphics.setColor(P.panel)
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill",x+2,y+2,3,5)
    elseif state=="available" then
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill",x+3,y,2,9)
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill",x,y+3,8,2)
    else
        love.graphics.rectangle("line",x+1,y,6,6)
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill",x,y+4,9,6)
        love.graphics.setColor(P.panel)
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill",x+4,y+6,1,2)
    end
end

function Collection.new(app)
    local s=Screen.new(app)
    s.kind="deck"
    s.selected=1
    s.groups=Collection.groups(app.session)
    s.order={}
    for _,state in ipairs({"equipped","available","locked"}) do
        for _,entry in ipairs(s.groups[state]) do s.order[#s.order+1]=entry.index end
    end
    function s:select(index)
        if self.selected~=index and app.audio then app.audio:effect("card_select") end
        self.selected=index
    end
    function s:refresh()
        self.groups=Collection.groups(app.session); self.order={}
        for _,state in ipairs({"equipped","available","locked"}) do
            for _,entry in ipairs(self.groups[state]) do self.order[#self.order+1]=entry.index end
        end
    end
    function s:startEditing()
        local ok,reason=Collection.canEdit(app.session)
        if not ok then self.message=reason; return false,reason end
        self.editing=true; self.draft=copy(app.session.deck)
        self.slot=1; self.candidate=1; self.candidatePage=1; self.dirty=false
        self.message="Elige una posición y una carta; después pulsa Sustituir."
        self.keyboardFocus=nil; return true
    end
    function s:selectSlot(index)
        if not self.editing or index<1 or index>math.min(10,#self.draft+1) then return false end
        self.slot=index; self.keyboardFocus=nil; return true
    end
    function s:selectCandidate(index)
        if not self.editing or not Data.list[index] then return false end
        self.candidate=index; self.candidatePage=math.floor((index-1)/8)+1
        self.keyboardFocus=nil
        local card=Data.list[index]
        local _,reason=Collection.replace(self.draft,self.slot,card.id,app.session.unlocked)
        self.message=reason or ("Sustituir "..(Data.byId[self.draft[self.slot]] and Data.byId[self.draft[self.slot]].name or "posición libre").." por "..card.name..".")
        return true
    end
    function s:replaceSelected()
        if not self.editing then return false end
        local ok,reason=Collection.canEdit(app.session)
        if not ok then self.message=reason; return false end
        local proposal,err=Collection.replace(self.draft,self.slot,Data.list[self.candidate].id,app.session.unlocked)
        if not proposal then self.message=err; return false end
        self.draft=proposal; self.dirty=true
        self.message="Borrador actualizado. Pulsa Guardar mazo para conservarlo."
        if app.audio then app.audio:effect("card_select") end
        return true
    end
    function s:saveDeck()
        if not self.editing then return false end
        local ok,reason=Collection.canEdit(app.session)
        if not ok then self.message=reason; return false end
        local valid,err=Collection.validatePlayableDeck(self.draft,app.session.unlocked,app.session.day)
        if not valid then self.message=err; return false end
        local old=app.session.deck
        app.session.deck=copy(self.draft)
        if app.save and app:save()==false then
            app.session.deck=old; self.message="No se pudo guardar. El mazo anterior sigue equipado."; return false
        end
        self.editing=false; self.dirty=false; self.keyboardFocus=nil; self:refresh()
        self.message="Mazo guardado: "..#self.draft.." cartas diferentes."
        return true
    end
    function s:cancelEditing()
        self.editing=false; self.draft=nil; self.dirty=false; self.keyboardFocus=nil
        self.message="El borrador se descartó. El mazo equipado se conserva."
    end
    function s:drawEditor()
        self:begin()
        app.resources:background("library")
        love.graphics.setColor(.025,.035,.07,.90); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",0,0,640,360)
        W.panel(8,7,624,30)
        self:text("EDITOR DE MAZO · 5 A 10 CARTAS SIN DUPLICADOS",18,18,592,P.gold)
        W.panel(14,45,296,216); W.panel(320,45,306,216)
        self:text("1. POSICIÓN EQUIPADA",24,56,276,P.teal)
        self:text("2. CARTA DE LA COLECCIÓN",330,56,286,P.teal)
        for i=1,math.min(10,#self.draft+1) do
            local id=self.draft[i]
            self:button(i..". "..(id and Data.byId[id].name or "+ Añadir carta"),24,73+(i-1)*18,276,17,function() self:selectSlot(i) end,false,self.slot==i)
        end
        local equipped={}; for _,id in ipairs(self.draft) do equipped[id]=true end
        for row=1,8 do
            local index=(self.candidatePage-1)*8+row
            local card=Data.list[index]
            if card then
                local marker=equipped[card.id] and "[E] " or (app.session.unlocked[card.id] and "[+] " or "[X] ")
                self:button(marker..card.name,330,73+(row-1)*18,286,17,function() self:selectCandidate(index) end,false,self.candidate==index)
            end
        end
        self:button("<",330,225,30,24,function() self:selectCandidate(((self.candidatePage-2)%math.ceil(#Data.list/8))*8+1) end)
        self:text("[E] equipada [+] libre [X] bloqueada",367,227,210,P.muted)
        self:button(">",586,225,30,24,function() self:selectCandidate((self.candidatePage%math.ceil(#Data.list/8))*8+1) end)
        local candidate=Data.list[self.candidate]
        local detail=Collection.details(candidate,{deck=self.draft,unlocked=app.session.unlocked})
        self:text(candidate.name.." · social: "..candidate.cost.." energía · "..detail.base,18,268,604,P.ink)
        self:text(Collection.combatDetail(candidate),18,292,604,P.teal)
        local proposal=Collection.replace(self.draft,self.slot,candidate.id,app.session.unlocked)
        self:button("Sustituir",14,318,154,25,function() self:replaceSelected() end,not proposal)
        self:button("Guardar mazo",176,318,154,25,function() self:saveDeck() end,not self.dirty)
        self:button("Cancelar borrador",338,318,174,25,function() self:cancelEditing() end)
        self:button("Quitar",520,318,106,25,function()
            if #self.draft>5 and self.draft[self.slot] then
                table.remove(self.draft,self.slot); self.slot=math.min(self.slot,#self.draft); self.dirty=true
                self.message="Carta retirada del borrador. Conserva al menos cinco."
            end
        end,#self.draft<=5 or not self.draft[self.slot])
        self:text(self.message or "Tab/Enter: botones · Izq/Der: colección · Esc: cancelar",14,348,612,P.muted)
    end
    function s:draw()
        if self.editing then self:drawEditor(); return end
        self:begin()
        app.resources:background("library")
        love.graphics.setColor(.025,.035,.07,.78)
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill",0,0,640,360)
        self:header("COLECCIÓN / "..#app.session.deck.." CARTAS EN EL MAZO",true)
        W.panel(14,46,299,296)
        local position=1
        for i,index in ipairs(self.order) do if index==self.selected then position=i; break end end
        local page=math.floor((position-1)/15)+1
        self:text("[E] equipada · [+] libre · [X] bloqueada",24,57,278,P.teal)
        for row=1,15 do
            local index=self.order[(page-1)*15+row]
            if index then
                local card=Data.list[index]
                local equipped=false; for _,id in ipairs(app.session.deck) do if id==card.id then equipped=true end end
                local marker=equipped and "[E] " or (app.session.unlocked[card.id] and "[+] " or "[X] ")
                self:button(marker..card.name,24,76+(row-1)*14,278,14,function() self:select(index) end,false,self.selected==index)
                self.buttons[#self.buttons].cardIndex=index
            end
        end
        local pages=math.ceil(#self.order/15)
        self:button("<",24,308,42,24,function() self:select(self.order[((page-2)%pages)*15+1]) end)
        self:text("Página "..page.."/"..pages,76,316,160,P.muted,1,"center")
        self:button(">",260,308,42,24,function() self:select(self.order[(page%pages)*15+1]) end)
        W.panel(323,46,303,296)
        local card=Data.list[self.selected]
        local detail=Collection.details(card,app.session)
        self:text(detail.name,337,56,275,P.gold)
        CardView.draw(app.resources,card,337,76)
        self:text(detail.category,429,79,183,P.teal)
        self:text(detail.cost,429,107,183,P.ink)
        badge(detail.state,429,132)
        self:text(detail.stateLabel,444,132,168,stateColors[detail.state])
        self:text(detail.affinity,429,155,183,P.muted)
        self:text(detail.description,337,198,275,P.ink)
        self:text(detail.base,337,234,275,P.teal)
        self:text("RECOMENDADA EN",337,261,275,P.gold)
        self:text(detail.contexts,337,274,275,P.ink)
        self:text("OBTENCIÓN: "..detail.unlock,337,299,275,P.muted)
        self:text("Editar [E]: añadir, quitar o sustituir (5–10).",337,328,275,P.muted)
        self:text("Flechas: inspeccionar · Tab: botones · Enter: seleccionar · Esc: volver",18,347,604,P.muted)
        self:button("Social [E]",345,12,94,20,function() self:startEditing() end)
        self:button("Combate",444,12,94,20,function() app:switch(require("src.screens.combat_deck").new(app)) end)
        if self.message then
            W.panel(16,343,608,17)
            self:text(self.message,22,347,596,P.gold)
        end
    end
    function s:keypressed(key)
        if self.editing then
            if key=="escape" then self:cancelEditing(); return end
            if key=="left" or key=="right" then
                self:selectCandidate((self.candidate-1+(key=="right" and 1 or -1))%#Data.list+1); return
            end
            self:navigate(key); return
        end
        if Controls.matches(Controls.back,key) then app:resume(); return end
        if key=="e" then self:startEditing(); return end
        if key=="left" or key=="right" then
            local position=1
            for i,index in ipairs(self.order) do if index==self.selected then position=i; break end end
            self:select(self.order[(position-1+(key=="right" and 1 or -1))%#self.order+1])
            self.keyboardFocus=nil
            return
        end
        self:navigate(key)
    end
    return s
end
return Collection
````

````lua
local Screen=require("src.ui.screen")
local W=require("src.ui.widgets")
local P=require("src.ui.palette")
local Font=require("src.ui.font")
local Combat=require("src.systems.combat")
local Tutorial=require("src.systems.combat_tutorial")
local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")

local CombatScreen={}

local function rect(color,x,y,w,h,alpha)
    love.graphics.setColor(color[1],color[2],color[3],alpha or color[4] or 1)
    love.graphics.rectangle("fill",math.floor(x),math.floor(y),math.floor(w),math.floor(h))
end
local function stateText(actor)
    local parts={}
    if (actor.weak or 0)>0 then parts[#parts+1]="Débil "..actor.weak end
    if (actor.vulnerable or 0)>0 then parts[#parts+1]="Vulnerable "..actor.vulnerable end
    return #parts>0 and table.concat(parts," / ") or "Sin estados"
end
local function sound(app,name) if app.audio then app.audio:effect(name) end end

-- Iconos propios de 24x24; no modifican ni reinterpretan las ilustraciones sociales.
function CombatScreen.icon(id,x,y)
    id=({ice_lance="magic_bolt",mana_spark="magic_bolt",wind_guard="arcane_guard",disrupting_ray="heavy_spell",quick_study="focus"})[id] or id
    local function r(c,a,b,w,h) rect(c,x+a,y+b,w,h) end
    if id=="magic_bolt" then
        r(P.lavender,10,1,8,5);r(P.lavender,6,6,10,5);r(P.white,8,9,10,4)
        r(P.teal,11,13,5,5);r(P.teal,7,18,5,5)
    elseif id=="arcane_guard" then
        r(P.teal,4,3,16,12);r(P.teal,6,15,12,4);r(P.teal,9,19,6,3)
        r(P.panel,7,6,10,8);r(P.white,11,6,2,12)
    elseif id=="heavy_spell" then
        r(P.lavender,5,5,14,14);r(P.rose,2,9,20,6);r(P.gold,9,2,6,20)
        r(P.white,9,9,6,6)
    elseif id=="heal" then
        r(P.green,8,2,8,20);r(P.green,2,8,20,8);r(P.white,10,5,3,14)
    else
        r(P.lavender,3,7,18,10);r(P.panel,6,9,12,6);r(P.gold,10,2,4,20)
        r(P.white,8,10,8,4)
    end
end

-- La Anomalía es una silueta de fragmentos, dibujada sobre una cuadrícula de 2 px.
function CombatScreen.enemySprite(x,y,alpha,impact,shape)
    alpha=alpha or 1
    local function r(c,a,b,w,h) rect(c,x+a,y+b,w,h,alpha) end
    if shape=="beast" then
        r(P.shadow,5,25,52,27);r(P.gold,7,18,45,24);r(P.rose,40,24,7,5)
        r(P.ink,7,46,9,17);r(P.ink,44,46,9,17);r(P.gold,5,9,9,15);r(P.gold,39,9,9,15)
        r(impact and P.white or P.panel,18,23,4,5);r(P.white,44,36,10,3);return
    elseif shape=="guardian" then
        r(P.shadow,10,5,44,58);r(P.muted,17,4,30,15);r(P.lavender,12,24,40,26)
        r(P.teal,24,10,16,4);r(P.muted,0,27,10,26);r(P.muted,54,27,10,26)
        r(P.muted,15,51,12,13);r(P.muted,37,51,12,13);r(impact and P.white or P.gold,29,30,6,12);return
    end
    for row=0,11 do
        local inset=math.abs(5-row)*3
        r(P.shadow,4+inset,7+row*4,56-inset*2,4)
        r(impact and P.ink or P.lavender,8+inset,8+row*4,48-inset*2,2)
    end
    r(P.panel,20,19,24,25);r(P.teal,24,22,16,19)
    r(P.white,28,25,8,8);r(P.panel,31,26,3,8)
    r(P.gold,2,8,6,6);r(P.lavender,55,2,6,8);r(P.teal,56,49,6,6)
    r(P.lavender,8,55,6,5)
end

local function barrier(x,y,alpha)
    for row=0,7 do
        local inset=row>4 and (row-4)*4 or 0
        rect(P.teal,x+inset,y+row*8,3,7,alpha)
        rect(P.teal,x+61-inset,y+row*8,3,7,alpha)
    end
    rect(P.teal,x+2,y-2,60,3,alpha)
end

function CombatScreen.new(app,definition)
    local s=Screen.new(app)
    s.definition=definition or Progression.encounter(app.session,app.session.checkpoint) or {}
    local context={character=s.definition.character,tutorial=s.definition.tutorial,enemyId=s.definition.enemyId,
        day=app.session.day,difficulty=s.definition.difficulty,
        tacticalContext=s.definition.tacticalContext,unlocked=not app.practice and app.session.unlocked or nil,
        combatDeck=app.session.combatDeck,curse=app.session.curse,externalEnergy=app.session.externalEnergy}
    s.enc=Combat.restore(app.session.combat,app.session.deck,context) or Combat.new(app.session.deck,context)
    app.session.combat=s.enc
    s.selected,s.confirmReady,s.age,s.historyPage=1,false,0,1
    s.feedback="Selecciona una carta para inspeccionarla. Confirma con Jugar."
    if #(s.enc.deckAdjustments or {})>0 then
        s.actionSummary="Exclusiva sin compañera: sustituida aquí por una técnica inicial adquirida. Tu mazo guardado se conserva."
    end
    s.displayHp={player=s.enc.player.hp,enemy=s.enc.enemy.hp,mana=s.enc.player.mana}
    s.tutorial=s.definition.tutorial and Tutorial.restore(s.enc.tutorial,s.enc) or nil
    s.enc.tutorial=s.tutorial
    if app.audio then app.audio:setContext(s.enc.finished and s.enc.outcome or s.enc.training and "training" or s.enc.enemy.boss and "boss" or "combat") end
    if not s.enc.finished and s.enc.turn==1 and s.enc.revision==0 then sound(app,"combat_start") end
    app:save()

    function s:busy() return self.motion~=nil end
    function s:canPlay(index)
        local ok,err=Combat.canPlay(self.enc,index)
        if not ok then return ok,err end
        return Tutorial.canPlay(self.tutorial,Combat.card(self.enc.hand[index]))
    end
    function s:select(index)
        if self:busy() or self.enc.finished or not self.enc.hand[index] then return false end
        self.selected=index;self.confirmReady=true;self.armedRevision=self.enc.revision;self.keyboardFocus=nil
        local ok,err=self:canPlay(index)
        self.feedback=ok and "Carta seleccionada. Confirma con Jugar [Enter]." or err
        sound(app,"card_select")
        return true
    end
    function s:startMotion(result,enemyAction)
        self.motion={elapsed=0,duration=app.options.reducedMotion and .18 or 1.05,events=result.events or {},enemyAction=enemyAction,
            startPlayer=self.displayHp.player,startEnemy=self.displayHp.enemy,startMana=self.displayHp.mana,
            companionAction=result.companionAction,element=result.element,playedSounds=false}
        self.feedback=result.text or "Acción resuelta."
        self.actionSummary=result.actionName or (result.cardId and Combat.card(result.cardId).name) or "Acción resuelta"
        local totals={damage=0,blocked=0,lost=0,hits=0}
        local target=enemyAction and "player" or "enemy"
        for _,entry in ipairs(result.events or {}) do
            if entry.kind=="damage" and entry.target==target then
                totals.damage=totals.damage+entry.damage;totals.blocked=totals.blocked+entry.blocked
                totals.lost=totals.lost+entry.hpLost;totals.hits=totals.hits+1
            end
        end
        if totals.hits>0 then
            self.actionSummary=self.actionSummary.."\n"..totals.damage.." daño; "..totals.blocked.." bloqueado.\n"..totals.lost..(self.enc.training and " resistencia perdida." or " vida perdida.")
        else
        for _,event in ipairs(result.events or {}) do
            if event.kind=="shield" or event.kind=="heal" or event.kind=="status" or event.kind=="prepare" or event.kind=="interrupt" or event.kind=="recovery_exhausted" then
                self.actionSummary=self.actionSummary.."\n"..event.text
                break
            end
        end
        end
        self.confirmReady=false;self.keyboardFocus=nil;self.selected=math.min(self.selected,math.max(1,#self.enc.hand))
        if self.enc.finished and self.tutorial then self.tutorial.stage="complete" end
        self.enc.tutorial=self.tutorial
        app:save()
    end
    function s:play()
        if self:busy() or self.enc.finished or not self.confirmReady then return false end
        local ok,err=self:canPlay(self.selected)
        if not ok then self.feedback=err;return false end
        local id=self.enc.hand[self.selected]
        local result,message=Combat.play(self.enc,self.selected,self.armedRevision)
        if not result then self.feedback=message;return false end
        Tutorial.played(self.tutorial,id)
        sound(app,"card_discard")
        self:startMotion(result,false)
        return true
    end
    function s:endTurn()
        if self:busy() or self.enc.finished then return false end
        if not Tutorial.canEndTurn(self.tutorial) then self.feedback="Completa el paso que indica Nanahoshi antes de terminar.";return false end
        local result,err=Combat.endTurn(self.enc,self.enc.revision)
        if not result then self.feedback=err;return false end
        Tutorial.endedTurn(self.tutorial)
        self:startMotion(result,true)
        return true
    end
    function s:tactic(id)
        if self:busy() or self.enc.finished then return false end
        local result,err=Combat.tactic(self.enc,id,self.enc.revision)
        if not result then self.feedback=err;return false end
        self.tacticsOpen=false;self:startMotion(result,false);return true
    end
    function s:basic(id)
        if self:busy() or self.enc.finished then return false end
        if self.tutorial and self.tutorial.stage~="free" and not (self.tutorial.stage=="shield" and id=="defend") then return false end
        local result,err=Combat.basic(self.enc,id,self.enc.revision)
        if not result then self.feedback=err;return false end
        Tutorial.played(self.tutorial,id);self:startMotion(result,false);return true
    end
    function s:breakSeal()
        if self:busy() then return false end
        local result,err=Combat.breakSeal(self.enc,self.enc.revision)
        if not result then self.feedback=err;return false end
        self:startMotion(result,false);return true
    end
    function s:advanceGuide()
        if self:busy() then return end
        if Tutorial.advance(self.tutorial) then
            self.confirmReady=false;self.keyboardFocus=nil;self.enc.tutorial=self.tutorial;app:save()
        end
    end
    function s:retry()
        if self:busy() then return end
        if self.enc.training and self.enc.finished then return self:continue() end
        local restored=Combat.retry(self.enc)
        if not restored then return end
        app.session.combat=restored
        app:save()
        app:switch(CombatScreen.new(app,self.definition),{type="magic",duration=.35})
    end
    function s:leave()
        if app.practice then app:endPractice() else app:combatSafeExit() end
    end
    function s:continue()
        if self:busy() then return end
        if self.enc.training and self.enc.finished then app:resume();return end
        if self.enc.outcome~="victory" then return end
        app:finishCombat(self.enc)
    end
    function s:update(dt)
        self.age=self.age+math.max(0,dt)
        local motion=self.motion
        if not motion then return end
        motion.elapsed=math.min(motion.duration,motion.elapsed+math.max(0,dt))
        local progress=motion.elapsed/motion.duration
        local hpProgress=math.max(0,math.min(1,(progress-.2)/.55))
        self.displayHp.player=motion.startPlayer+(self.enc.player.hp-motion.startPlayer)*hpProgress
        self.displayHp.enemy=motion.startEnemy+(self.enc.enemy.hp-motion.startEnemy)*hpProgress
        self.displayHp.mana=motion.startMana+(self.enc.player.mana-motion.startMana)*hpProgress
        if progress>=.2 and not motion.playedSounds then
            motion.playedSounds=true
            local played={}
            if motion.element=="water" or motion.element=="earth" or motion.element=="sword" then sound(app,motion.element) end
            for _,event in ipairs(motion.events) do
                local effect=event.kind=="damage" and (event.target=="player" and "hurt" or "attack")
                    or event.kind=="shield" and "guard" or event.kind=="heal" and "heal"
                if effect and not played[effect] then sound(app,effect);played[effect]=true end
            end
        end
        if progress>=.8 and motion.enemyAction and not motion.drew then sound(app,"card_draw");motion.drew=true end
        if progress>=1 then
            self.motion=nil;self.displayHp.player=self.enc.player.hp;self.displayHp.enemy=self.enc.enemy.hp;self.displayHp.mana=self.enc.player.mana
            if self.enc.finished then
                if app.audio then app.audio:setContext(self.enc.outcome) end
                sound(app,self.enc.outcome);self.resultAge=0
            end
        end
    end
    function s:drawHud()
        W.panel(8,8,226,78)
        self:text("RUDY",18,14,90,P.gold)
        self:text(self.enc.context.curse.manaBlocked and "MANÁ BLOQUEADO" or "MAGIA LIBRE",100,14,125,P.muted)
        self:text((self.enc.training and "RES " or "PV ")..self.enc.player.hp.."/"..self.enc.player.maxHp.."   Escudo "..self.enc.player.shield,18,29,200,P.ink)
        W.bar(18,41,206,6,self.displayHp.player,self.enc.player.maxHp,P.green)
        local blocked=self.enc.context.curse.manaBlocked
        local energy=blocked and self.enc.player.externalEnergy or self.enc.player.mana
        local maximum=blocked and self.enc.player.maxExternalEnergy or self.enc.player.maxMana

    function s:drawActors()
        local motion=self.motion
        local p=motion and motion.elapsed/motion.duration or 0
        local reduced=app.options.reducedMotion
        local playerX,enemyX=64,510
        local enemyHit,playerHit,companionHit,playerShield,enemyShield,heal=false,false,false,false,false,false
        if motion then
            for _,event in ipairs(motion.events) do
                if event.kind=="damage" then
                    if event.target=="enemy" then enemyHit=true elseif event.target=="companion" then companionHit=true else playerHit=true end
                elseif event.kind=="shield" then
                    if event.target=="enemy" then enemyShield=true else playerShield=true end
                elseif event.kind=="heal" and event.target=="player" then heal=true end
            end
        end
        if not reduced and motion then
            if enemyHit then playerX=playerX+math.floor(math.sin(math.min(1,p*2)*math.pi)*16) end
            if enemyHit and p>.2 and p<.6 then enemyX=enemyX+math.floor(math.sin(p*65)*3) end
            if playerHit and p>.2 and p<.6 then playerX=playerX+math.floor(math.sin(p*65)*3) end
            if playerHit then enemyX=enemyX-math.floor(math.sin(math.min(1,p*2)*math.pi)*16) end
        end
        rect(P.shadow,51,157,94,5,.7);rect(P.shadow,495,157,94,5,.7)
        local weakened=self.enc.outcome=="defeat" and (motion and math.floor(p*7) or 7) or 0
        app.resources:portrait("rudeus",(playerHit or self.enc.outcome=="defeat") and "worried" or "neutral",playerX,94+weakened,1)
        if playerHit and motion and p>.22 and p<.35 then rect(P.rose,playerX+12,110,40,40,.25) end
        local alpha=self.enc.outcome=="victory" and (motion and 1-p or 0) or 1
        if self.enc.enemy.portrait then
            app.resources:portrait(self.enc.enemy.portrait,enemyHit and "worried" or self.enc.enemy.phase=="six_arms" and "angry" or "neutral",enemyX,94,1)
            if alpha<1 and not self.enc.training and self.enc.enemy.id~="badigadi_final" then rect(P.shadow,enemyX,94,64,64,1-alpha) end
        elseif self.enc.enemy.shape=="rudy" then
            love.graphics.setColor(.7,.55,1,alpha)
            app.resources:portrait("rudeus",enemyHit and "worried" or "angry",enemyX,94,1)
            if alpha<1 then rect(P.shadow,enemyX,94,64,64,1-alpha) end
        else
            CombatScreen.enemySprite(enemyX,93,alpha,enemyHit and motion and p>.22 and p<.36,self.enc.enemy.shape)
        end
        if self.enc.player.shield>0 or playerShield then barrier(playerX,92,playerShield and .8 or .35) end
        if self.enc.enemy.shield>0 or enemyShield then barrier(enemyX,92,enemyShield and .8 or .35) end
        self:text("Rudy",43,166,110,P.ink,1,"center")
        self:text(self.enc.enemy.training and "Entrenamiento" or "Amenaza",456,166,170,P.muted,1,"center")
        if self.enc.companion then
            local ally=self.enc.companion
            local attack=motion and motion.companionAction and not reduced and math.sin(math.min(1,p*2)*math.pi)*12 or 0
            local injured=ally.hp<=ally.maxHp/2
            local shake=companionHit and motion and p>.2 and p<.6 and not reduced and math.sin(p*65)*3 or 0
            app.resources:portrait(ally.id,(ally.hp<=0 or companionHit) and "worried" or motion and motion.companionAction and "happy" or "neutral",143+math.floor(attack+shake),94,1)
            if ally.shield>0 then barrier(142,92,.35) end
            W.bar(143,159,64,4,ally.hp,ally.maxHp,P.teal)
            self:text(ally.name,137,166,76,injured and P.rose or P.teal,1,"center")
            self:text("PV "..ally.hp.."/20",137,177,76,P.muted,1,"center")
        end
        if motion and p>.15 then
            local targetRows={player=0,enemy=0}
            for _,event in ipairs(motion.events) do
                local target=event.target
                if target=="player" or target=="enemy" then
                    local label,tint
                    if event.kind=="damage" then label="-"..tostring(event.hpLost or 0)..(self.enc.training and " RES" or " VIDA");tint=P.danger
                    elseif event.kind=="shield" then label="+"..tostring(event.amount or 0).." ESCUDO";tint=P.teal
                    elseif event.kind=="heal" then label="+"..tostring(event.amount or 0)..(self.enc.training and " RES" or " VIDA");tint=P.green end
                    if label then
                        local row=targetRows[target];targetRows[target]=row+1
                        local x=target=="player" and 13 or 463
                        local y=102+row*23-(reduced and 0 or math.floor(p*14))
                        W.panel(x,y,158,20,{shadow=false})
                        self:text(label,x+3,y+4,152,tint,1,"center")
                        if event.kind=="damage" and (event.blocked or 0)>0 then
                            self:text("Bloqueo "..event.blocked,x+3,y+22,152,P.teal,1,"center")
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if heal or self.enc.outcome=="victory" then
                local center=heal and playerX+32 or enemyX+32
                for i=1,12 do
                    local a=i*math.pi/6;local radius=12+p*34
                    rect(heal and P.green or P.gold,center+math.cos(a)*radius,124+math.sin(a)*radius,3,3,1-p*.7)
                end

        if self.enc.outcome=="defeat" and motion then rect(P.shadow,0,87,640,94,p*.65) end
    end

                elseif CardData.byId[card.id] then app.resources:icon(card.id,x+28,y+65,1) else CombatScreen.icon(card.id,x+28,y+65) end
                self:text(card.cost.."A "..(card.manaCost or 0)..(self.enc.context.curse.manaBlocked and "X " or "M ")..(card.hpCost or 0).."PV",x+4,y+95,72,{.17,.14,.21,1},1,"center")
                local available=self:canPlay(i)

    function s:historyLines()
        local lines={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(self.enc.log) do
            local action=entry.cardId and Combat.card(entry.cardId).name or entry.actionName
            local title="T"..tostring(entry.turn or 1).." · "..tostring(action or entry.text or "Acción")
            for _,line in ipairs(Font.wrap(title,550,1)) do lines[#lines+1]=line end
            for _,event in ipairs(entry.events or {}) do
                if event.text and event.text~=entry.text then
                    for _,line in ipairs(Font.wrap("  "..event.text,550,1)) do lines[#lines+1]=line end
                end
            end
            lines[#lines+1]=""
        end
        return lines
    end
    function s:drawHistory()
        -- Superficie modal: todas las hitboxes anteriores dejan de ser activas.
        self:begin();rect(P.shadow,0,0,640,360,.86);W.panel(26,20,588,320)
        self:text("HISTORIAL DEL COMBATE",43,34,400,P.gold,2)
        local lines=self:historyLines();local pages=math.max(1,math.ceil(#lines/20))
        self.historyPage=math.max(1,math.min(pages,self.historyPage))
        local first=(self.historyPage-1)*20+1

        self:button("<",247,302,44,25,function() self.historyPage=math.max(1,self.historyPage-1) end,self.historyPage==1)
        self:button(">",298,302,44,25,function() self.historyPage=math.min(pages,self.historyPage+1) end,self.historyPage==pages)
        self:button("Cerrar [H / Esc]",400,302,197,25,function() self.historyOpen=false;self.keyboardFocus=nil end)
    end
    function s:rewardText()
        if app.practice then return "Práctica completada. Sin cambios en la campaña." end
        if app.session.checkpoint=="day1_tutorial" then return "Primera anomalía contenida. Nanahoshi registra lo aprendido." end
        local reward=self.enc.enemy.reward
        if type(reward)=="string" then return reward end
        if type(reward)=="table" then return reward.text or reward.description or reward.name or "Anomalía contenida; el camino queda despejado." end
        return "Anomalía contenida; el camino queda despejado."
    end
    function s:drawResult()

        end
        self:text(won and "¡VICTORIA!" or "DERROTA",90,48,460,won and P.gold or P.danger,3,"center")

            self:text("RECOMPENSAS",94,178,452,P.gold)
            self:text(self:rewardText(),94,195,452,P.ink)

            if not app.practice and app.session.checkpoint=="day1_tutorial" and not app.session.unlocked.self_joke then unlock={"self_joke"} end
            if unlock and #unlock>0 then
                local names={};for _,id in ipairs(unlock) do names[#names+1]=(CardData.byId[id] or {}).name or id end
                self:text("Cartas: "..table.concat(names,", "),94,230,452,P.teal)
            end
            self:button("Continuar [Enter]",184,272,273,28,function() self:continue() end)
        else
            self:text("Causa: "..(self.enc.cause or self.enc.defeatReason or (self.enc.player.hp<=0 and "Rudy se quedó sin vida." or "La anomalía agotó el tiempo del combate.")),94,132,452,P.rose)
            self:text("Turnos sobrevividos: "..self.enc.turn,94,176,452,P.ink)
            self:text("Tu partida sigue intacta. Reintentar restaura el estado previo y no duplica recompensas.",94,199,452,P.muted)
            self:button("Reintentar [Enter]",94,262,212,28,function() self:retry() end)
            self:button("Regresar al punto seguro",316,262,232,28,function() self:leave() end)
        end
        self:button("Historial [H]",447,306,110,18,function() self.historyOpen=true;self.keyboardFocus=nil end)
    end
    function s:drawPause()
        self:begin();rect(P.shadow,0,0,640,360,.8);W.panel(145,105,350,147)
        self:text("COMBATE EN PAUSA",161,118,318,P.gold,2,"center")
        self:button("Continuar [Esc]",166,158,308,27,function() self.pauseOpen=false;self.keyboardFocus=nil end)
        self:button(app.practice and "Salir de práctica" or "Guardar y volver al menú",166,196,308,27,function()
            if app.practice then app:endPractice() else app:save();app:menu() end
        end)
    end
    function s:drawTactics()
        self:begin();rect(P.shadow,0,0,640,360,.9);W.panel(40,18,560,324)
        self:text("TÁCTICAS CON "..self.enc.companion.name:upper(),55,30,530,P.gold,2)
        local recoveries=self.enc.companion.id=="sylphiette" and (self.enc.balanceVersion==1 and " Curación: una por turno." or
            (" Curaciones restantes: "..(Combat.rules.companionHealUses-self.enc.companionHeals)..".")) or ""
        self:text("Una acción de compañera por turno. Sus decisiones dependen del peligro y las heridas."..recoveries,55,58,530,P.muted)
        for i,t in ipairs(Combat.tactics) do
            local y=92+(i-1)*35
            local ok,why=Combat.canTactic(self.enc,t.id)
            self:button(t.name,55,y,235,28,function() self:tactic(t.id) end,not ok)
            self:text(ok and t.description or why,301,y+3,278,ok and P.ink or P.rose)
        end
        self:button("Volver [Esc / T]",202,309,235,23,function() self.tacticsOpen=false;self.keyboardFocus=nil end)
    end
    function s:draw()
        self:begin();app.resources:background(self.definition.background or "laboratory")
        rect(P.shadow,0,0,640,360,.28)
        self:drawHud();self:drawActors();self:drawGuide();self:drawHand()
        if self.enc.finished and not self:busy() then self:drawResult() end
        if self.pauseOpen then self:drawPause() end
        if self.tacticsOpen and self.enc.companion then self:drawTactics() end
        if self.historyOpen then self:drawHistory() end
    end
    function s:mousepressed(x,y,button) self:click(x,y,button) end
    function s:keypressed(key)
        if self.tacticsOpen then
            if key=="t" or key=="escape" then self.tacticsOpen=false;self.keyboardFocus=nil else self:navigate(key) end
            return
        end
        if self.historyOpen then
            if key=="h" or key=="escape" then self.historyOpen=false;self.keyboardFocus=nil
            elseif key=="left" then self.historyPage=math.max(1,self.historyPage-1)
            elseif key=="right" then self.historyPage=self.historyPage+1
            else self:navigate(key) end
            return
        end
        if key=="h" then self.historyOpen=true;self.historyPage=1;self.keyboardFocus=nil;return end
        if self.pauseOpen then
            if key=="escape" then self.pauseOpen=false;self.keyboardFocus=nil else self:navigate(key) end
            return
        end
        if key=="escape" and not self:busy() and not self.enc.finished then self.pauseOpen=true;self.keyboardFocus=nil;return end
        if self:busy() then return end
        if self:navigate(key) then return end
        local advance=key=="return" or key=="space" or key=="kpenter"
        if self.enc.finished then
            if advance then if self.enc.outcome=="victory" or self.enc.training then self:continue() else self:retry() end end
            return
        end
        if advance and self.tutorial and (self.tutorial.stage=="attack_result" or self.tutorial.stage=="enemy_result") then self:advanceGuide();return end
        local index=tonumber(key)
        if index and index>=1 and index<=3 then self:select(index)
        elseif key=="left" then self:select((self.selected-2)%math.max(1,#self.enc.hand)+1)
        elseif key=="right" then self:select(self.selected%math.max(1,#self.enc.hand)+1)
        elseif advance then self:play()
        elseif key=="e" then self:endTurn()
        elseif key=="d" then self:basic("defend")
        elseif key=="v" then self:basic("dodge")
        elseif key=="c" and self.enc.training then self:basic("counter")
        elseif key=="b" then self:breakSeal()
        elseif key=="t" and self.enc.companion then self.tacticsOpen=true;self.keyboardFocus=nil end
    end
    return s
end

return CombatScreen
````

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/src/screens/combat_deck.lua`

````lua
local Screen=require("src.ui.screen")
local W=require("src.ui.widgets")
local P=require("src.ui.palette")
local Combat=require("src.systems.combat")
local Data=require("src.data.combat_cards")
local Social=require("src.data.cards")
local Editor={}
local function copy(a) local b={} for i,v in ipairs(a or {}) do b[i]=v end return b end
function Editor.new(app,returnTo)
    local s=Screen.new(app)
    s.kind="combat_deck"; s.draft=copy(app.session.combatDeck); s.slot=1; s.selected=1; s.page=1
    s.catalog={}
    for _,c in ipairs(Data.list) do s.catalog[#s.catalog+1]=c.id end
    for _,c in ipairs(Social.list) do if c.combat then s.catalog[#s.catalog+1]=c.id end end
    s.returnTo=returnTo or function() app:overlay("deck") end
    function s:replace()
        if app.session.encounter or app.session.combat then self.message="Termina el encuentro para cambiar el mazo."; return false end
        local id=self.catalog[self.selected]
        if not app.session.unlocked[id] then self.message="Carta bloqueada. Consulta su obtención."; return false end
        for i,c in ipairs(self.draft) do if c==id and i~=self.slot then self.message="No se permiten duplicados."; return false end end
        self.draft[math.min(self.slot,#self.draft+1)]=id; self.message="Borrador actualizado. Guarda para equiparlo."; return true
    end
    function s:saveDeck()
        if app.session.encounter or app.session.combat then self.message="No puedes editar durante el encuentro."; return false end
        local valid,err=Combat.validateDeck(self.draft,app.session.unlocked)
        if not valid then self.message=err; return false end
        local old=app.session.combatDeck; app.session.combatDeck=copy(self.draft)
        if app:save()==false then app.session.combatDeck=old; self.message="Error al guardar."; return false end
        self.message="Mazo de combate guardado: entre cinco y diez cartas, con ofensiva viable."; return true
    end
    function s:draw()
        self:begin(); app.resources:background("library")
        love.graphics.setColor(.025,.035,.07,.9); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",0,0,640,360)
        self:text("MAZO DE COMBATE · 5–10 CARTAS",18,18,490,P.gold)
        self:button("Volver",548,10,76,24,self.returnTo)
        W.panel(14,43,290,204); W.panel(314,43,312,204)
        self:text("POSICIÓN / QUITAR Y SUSTITUIR",24,53,270,P.teal)
        for i=1,10 do
            local c=Combat.card(self.draft[i]); self:button(i..". "..(c and c.name or "Vacía"),24,70+(i-1)*17,270,16,function() self.slot=i end,false,self.slot==i)
        end
        self:text("COLECCIÓN · [+] LIBRE · [X] BLOQUEADA",324,53,290,P.teal)
        for row=1,8 do
            local index=(self.page-1)*8+row; local id=self.catalog[index]
            if id then local c=Combat.card(id)
                self:button((app.session.unlocked[id] and "[+] " or "[X] ")..c.name,324,70+(row-1)*17,290,16,function() self.selected=index end,false,self.selected==index)
            end
        end
        local pages=math.ceil(#self.catalog/8)
        self:button("<",324,213,38,24,function() self.page=(self.page-2)%pages+1; self.selected=(self.page-1)*8+1 end)
        self:text("Página "..self.page.."/"..pages,373,221,178,P.muted)
        self:button(">",576,213,38,24,function() self.page=self.page%pages+1; self.selected=(self.page-1)*8+1 end)
        local c=Combat.card(self.catalog[self.selected]); local old=Combat.card(self.draft[self.slot])
        self:text(c.name..": "..Combat.describe(c),18,254,604,P.gold)
        self:text("Actual: "..(old and (old.name.." · "..Combat.describe(old)) or "Vacía"),18,276,604,P.muted)
        local original=Data.byId[c.id] or Social.byId[c.id]
        self:text("Obtención: "..(original.unlockHint or "Entrega de Nanahoshi durante el tutorial."),18,298,604,P.teal)
        self:button("Sustituir",14,319,144,24,function() self:replace() end)
        self:button("Quitar",166,319,108,24,function() table.remove(self.draft,self.slot); self.message="Carta retirada: conserva al menos cinco y dos ataques." end)
        self:button("Guardar mazo",282,319,160,24,function() self:saveDeck() end)
        self:button("Cancelar borrador",450,319,176,24,self.returnTo)
        self:text(self.message or "Las exclusivas requieren su compañera; se adaptan con técnicas adquiridas.",14,349,612,P.muted)
    end
    function s:keypressed(key)
        if key=="escape" then self.returnTo() else self:navigate(key) end
    end
    return s
end
return Editor
````

## src/screens/dialogue.lua

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/src/screens/dialogue.lua`

````lua
local Screen=require("src.ui.screen")
local W=require("src.ui.widgets")
local P=require("src.ui.palette")
local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
local Dialogue=require("src.systems.dialogue")
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local Controls=require("src.config.controls")
local Chapters=require("src.data.chapters")
local Typewriter=require("src.systems.typewriter")
local Animation=require("src.systems.animation")
local Portraits=require("src.systems.portraits")
local RelationshipBars=require("src.ui.relationship_bars")
local DialogueScreen={}

function DialogueScreen.new(app)
    local s=Screen.new(app)
    s.scene=Progression.scene(app.session,app.session.checkpoint)
    assert(s.scene,"Escena desconocida: "..tostring(app.session.checkpoint))
    s.dialogue=Dialogue.new(s.scene,app.session.dialogueIndex)
    s.clock=0
    s.quads={}
    s.actors={}
    s.relationshipBars={}
    for _,id in ipairs({"eris","roxy","sylphiette","nanahoshi"}) do
        s.relationshipBars[id]=RelationshipBars.new(app.session,id,{reducedMotion=app.options and app.options.reducedMotion})
    end
    function s:relationshipFeedback(key,explanation)
        local changed,negative=false,false
        for _,bars in pairs(self.relationshipBars) do
            if bars:apply(key,app.session,nil,explanation) then
                changed=true; negative=negative or bars:feedback().negative
            end
        end
        if changed and app.audio then app.audio:effect(negative and "negative" or "positive") end
        return changed
    end
    local function animateLine(first,previous)
        local line=s.dialogue:current()
        s.lineTime=0
        if line.stateEffect then
            local applied=require("src.systems.events").apply(app.session,line.stateEffect.id,line.stateEffect)
            if applied then
                app:save()
                s:relationshipFeedback(line.stateEffect.id,line.text)
            end
        end
        if line.effect=="water_fail" or line.effect=="earth_fail" then app.audio:effect("magic_fail")
        elseif line.effect=="flashback" then app.audio:effect("revelation")
        elseif line.delivery=="note" then app.audio:effect("paper")
        elseif line.delivery=="enchanted" then app.audio:effect("card_play") end
        if line.effect=="cure" then app.audio:effect("heal") end
        local old={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(s.presentation and s.presentation.cast or {}) do old[entry.character]=entry end
        s.presentation=Portraits.resolve(s.scene,s.dialogue.index)
        -- En un diálogo de una sola interlocutora, sus barras siguen visibles
        -- mientras Rudy responde. La etiqueta inferior identifica su voz.
        if not s.scene.cast and line.speaker=="rudeus" then
            for index=s.dialogue.index-1,1,-1 do
                local speaker=s.scene.lines[index].speaker
                if s.relationshipBars[speaker] then
                    local previousCast=Portraits.resolve(s.scene,index).cast
                    for _,entry in ipairs(previousCast) do
                        if entry.character==speaker then entry.animation=nil; s.presentation.cast={entry}; break end
                    end
                    break
                elseif speaker~="rudeus" and speaker~="narrator" then break end
            end
        end
        s.staging=0
        local actors={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(s.presentation.cast) do
            local prior=old[entry.character]
            local entering=entry.visible and (not prior or not prior.visible)
            local leaving=not entry.visible and prior and prior.visible
            local declared=entry.animation or (first and s.scene.animation)
            local kind=type(declared)=="table" and declared.type or declared
            if entering then
                if s.scene.cast or not kind then kind=entry.position=="right" and "enter_right" or "enter_left" end
            elseif leaving then kind=entry.position=="right" and "exit_right" or "exit_left"
            elseif not kind then
                if prior and entry.expression~=prior.expression then
                    kind=({happy="happy_bounce",angry="angry_shake",worried="sad_lower"})[entry.expression] or "expression_change"
                elseif entry.character==line.speaker then kind="speaking" end
            end
            if kind or not s.actors[entry.character] then
                local actor=Animation.actor(kind or "expression_change",{reducedMotion=app.options and app.options.reducedMotion})
                actor.delay=entering and s.dialogue.index==entry.enterAt and entry.entranceDelay or 0
                if app.options and app.options.reducedMotion then actor.delay=0 end
                s.actors[entry.character]=actor
                if entering and s.scene.cast and not actor.done then s.staging=math.max(s.staging,actor.delay+actor.duration) end
            end
            actors[entry.character]=s.actors[entry.character]
        end
        s.actors=actors
        -- Alias conservado para las pantallas/pruebas que inspeccionan al hablante.
        s.actor=s.actors[line.speaker] or s.actors[s.presentation.cast[1].character]
        s.writer=Typewriter.new(line.text,app.options)
        s.elapsed,s.visible=s.writer.elapsed,s.writer.visible
    end
    animateLine(true)
    function s:update(dt)
        self.clock=self.clock+dt
        self.lineTime=self.lineTime+dt
        for _,bars in pairs(self.relationshipBars) do bars:sync(app.session); bars:update(dt) end
        for _,entry in ipairs(self.presentation.cast) do
            local actor=self.actors[entry.character]
            local delay=actor.delay or 0
            actor.delay=math.max(0,delay-dt)
            if actor.delay==0 then actor:update(math.max(0,dt-delay)) end
        end
        if self.leaving then
            local done=true
            for _,actor in pairs(self.actors) do if not actor.done then done=false end end
            if done and self.onDeparture then
                local callback=self.onDeparture; self.onDeparture=nil; callback()
            end
            return
        end
        if self.pendingDeparture then
            self.pendingDeparture=self.pendingDeparture-dt
            if self.pendingDeparture<=0 then self.pendingDeparture=nil; self:depart(function() app:next() end) end
            return
        end
        local staging=self.staging
        self.staging=math.max(0,staging-dt)
        dt=math.max(0,dt-staging)
        self.writer.elapsed=self.elapsed
        local before=self.writer.visible
        self.writer:update(dt)
        if self.dialogue:current().delivery~="silence" and math.floor(self.writer.visible/3)>math.floor(before/3) and app.audio then app.audio:effect("text_blip") end
        self.elapsed,self.visible=self.writer.elapsed,self.writer.visible
    end
    function s:fullText() return self.dialogue:current().text end
    function s:ready() return self.visible>=self.writer.length end
    function s:depart(callback)
        if self.leaving or self.pendingDeparture then return end
        self.leaving=true
        self.onDeparture=callback
        local done=true
        for _,entry in ipairs(self.presentation.cast) do
            local actor=Animation.actor(entry.visible and (self.scene.exitAnimation or (entry.position=="right" and "exit_right" or "exit_left")) or "expression_change",
                {duration=.16,reducedMotion=not entry.visible or (app.options and app.options.reducedMotion)})
            self.actors[entry.character]=actor
            if not actor.done then done=false end
        end
        self.actor=self.actors[self.dialogue:current().speaker] or self.actors[self.presentation.cast[1].character]
        if done then local action=self.onDeparture; self.onDeparture=nil; action() end
    end
    function s:advance()
        if self.leaving or self.pendingDeparture then return end
        if self.staging>0 then
            for _,actor in pairs(self.actors) do actor.delay=0; actor:finish() end
            self.staging=0
        end
        if not self:ready() then
            self.writer:showAll()
            self.elapsed,self.visible=self.writer.elapsed,self.writer.visible
            return
        end
        if self.dialogue:isLast() then
            if self.scene.choices and #self.scene.choices>0 then return end
            self:depart(function() app:next() end)
        else
            local previous=self.dialogue:current()
            self.dialogue:advance()
            app.session.dialogueIndex=self.dialogue.index
            animateLine(false,previous)
            app:save()
        end
    end
    function s:drawPortrait(id,expression,actor,x,bars)
        local frame=Characters.expressions[expression or "neutral"] or 0
        self.quads[frame]=self.quads[frame] or love.graphics.newQuad(frame*64,0,64,64,256,64)
        local pose=(actor or self.actor).value
        love.graphics.setColor(1,1,1,pose.alpha)
        local px,py=math.floor((x or 39)+pose.x),math.floor((bars and 94 or 83)+pose.y)
        love.graphics.draw(app.resources:getPortrait(id),self.quads[frame],px,py,0,2,2)
        if bars then bars:draw({x=px,y=py,w=128,h=128,alpha=pose.alpha}) end
    end
    function s:draw()
        self:begin()
        local line=self.dialogue:current()
        app.resources:background(self.presentation.background)
        self:header(self.scene.title)
        local char=Characters.byId[line.speaker]
        local hasBars=false
        for _,entry in ipairs(self.presentation.cast) do
            local actor=self.actors[entry.character]
            if entry.visible or (not actor.done and (actor.kind=="exit_left" or actor.kind=="exit_right")) then
                local x=entry.position=="right" and 473 or 39
                local bars=self.relationshipBars[entry.character]
                hasBars=hasBars or bars~=nil
                self:drawPortrait(entry.portrait,entry.expression,actor,x,bars)
                if not bars and self.scene.cast and actor.value.alpha>0 then
                    local identity=Characters.byId[entry.character]
                    self:text(identity and identity.shortName or entry.character,x,70,128,
                        entry.character==line.speaker and P.gold or P.muted,1,"center")
                end
            end
        end
        if line.effect=="water_fail" or line.effect=="earth_fail" then
            local t=math.min(1,self.lineTime/1.2)
            if t<1 then
                local water=line.effect=="water_fail"
                love.graphics.setColor(water and .4 or .7,water and .75 or .55,water and 1 or .3,1-t)
                for i=1,8 do
                    local angle=i*math.pi/4; local radius=app.options.reducedMotion and 10 or 8+25*t
                    love.graphics.rectangle("fill",math.floor(146+math.cos(angle)*radius),math.floor(143+math.sin(angle)*radius),3,3)
                end
            end
        elseif line.effect=="cure" and self.lineTime<1.5 then
            love.graphics.setColor(.5,1,.8,1-self.lineTime/1.5)
            for i=1,12 do
                local angle=i*math.pi/6; local radius=app.options.reducedMotion and 50 or 30+self.lineTime*35
                love.graphics.rectangle("fill",math.floor(103+math.cos(angle)*radius),math.floor(147+math.sin(angle)*radius),4,4)
            end
        elseif line.effect=="flashback" and self.lineTime<.35 and not app.options.reducedMotion then
            love.graphics.setColor(1,1,1,(1-self.lineTime/.35)*.35); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",0,36,640,180)
        end
        local infoWidth=self.scene.cast and 278 or 435
        W.panel(172,67,infoWidth,49)
        local chapter=Chapters.chapterFor(app.session.checkpoint)
        self:text(chapter.title,185,79,infoWidth-27,P.gold)
        local curse=app.session.curse or {}
        local status=curse.discoveredVoice and (curse.voiceSealed and "VOZ: SELLADA" or "VOZ: RECUPERADA") or "Las decisiones de Rudy son tuyas."
        if curse.discoveredMana then status=status..(curse.manaBlocked and " · MANÁ: BLOQUEADO" or " · MANÁ: LIBRE") end
        self:text(status,185,97,infoWidth-27,P.muted)
        local deliveryLabels={thought="Pensamientos de Rudy",note="Nota de Rudy",enchanted="Rudy · carta parlante",dream="Rudy · voz en el sueño",silence="Rudy · silencio",memory="Recuerdo de Hitogami"}
        local speakerLabel=deliveryLabels[line.delivery] or (char and char.name or "Narración")
        if line.delivery=="enchanted" then
            app.resources:icon("be_honest",181,133,1)
            self:text("Voz reproducida por el encantamiento",214,141,382,P.teal)
        end
        local choices=self.scene.choices
        if self.dialogue:isLast() and self:ready() and choices and not self.leaving and not self.pendingDeparture then
            for i,choice in ipairs(choices) do
                self:button(choice.label,172,126+(i-1)*33,435,29,function()
                    local before={}
                    for id,r in pairs(app.session.relationships) do before[id]={love=r.love,trust=r.trust} end
                    local ok,err=Progression.choose(app.session,app.session.checkpoint,choice.id)
                    if ok then
                        app:save()
                        local visibleChange=false
                        if not (choice.effects and (choice.effects.secret or choice.effects.hidden)) then
                            local changes={}
                            for _,id in ipairs(Characters.romanceIds) do
                                local r=app.session.relationships[id]; local old=before[id]
                                if old and (r.love~=old.love or r.trust~=old.trust) then
                                    local sign=require("src.systems.cards").signed
                                    changes[#changes+1]=Characters.byId[id].shortName..": "..sign(r.love-old.love).." amor, "..sign(r.trust-old.trust).." confianza"
                                end
                            end
                            if #changes>0 then app:notify(table.concat(changes," · ")) end
                            visibleChange=self:relationshipFeedback("choice_"..app.session.checkpoint,choice.label)
                        end
                        if visibleChange then self.pendingDeparture=.7
                        else self:depart(function() app:next() end) end
                    else app:notify(err) end
                end)
            end
        end
        W.panel(18,227,604,116)
        local plateY=hasBars and 227 or 214
        W.panel(30,plateY,math.max(112,math.min(296,#speakerLabel*6+28)),hasBars and 21 or 24)
        self:text(speakerLabel,42,plateY+8,280,P.gold)
        self:text(Typewriter.slice(self:fullText(),self.staging>0 and 0 or self.visible),34,250,572,P.ink)
        local hint=self:ready() and ((choices and self.dialogue:isLast()) and "Elige una respuesta arriba" or "CLIC / ENTER / ESPACIO  >") or "CLIC para mostrar el texto"
        self:text((self.leaving or self.pendingDeparture) and "Continuando..." or hint,34,325,572,P.muted,1,"right")
        if self:ready() and not self.leaving and not (choices and self.dialogue:isLast()) then
            local shift=(app.options and app.options.reducedMotion) and 0 or math.floor(self.clock*2)%2
            love.graphics.setColor(P.gold)
            love.graphics.rectangle("fill",39,319+shift,2,5)
            love.graphics.rectangle("fill",41,320+shift,2,3)
            love.graphics.rectangle("fill",43,321+shift,2,1)
        end
    end
    function s:mousepressed(x,y,b)
        if self.leaving or self.pendingDeparture then return end
        if self:click(x,y,b) then return end
        if b==1 then self:advance() end
    end
    function s:keypressed(key)
        if self.leaving or self.pendingDeparture then return end
        if self:navigate(key) then return end
        if Controls.matches(Controls.advance,key) then self:advance()
        elseif Controls.matches(Controls.back,key) then app:overlay("pause")
        elseif Controls.matches(Controls.journal,key) then app:overlay("journal")
        elseif Controls.matches(Controls.deck,key) then app:overlay("deck") end
    end
    return s
end
return DialogueScreen
````

## src/screens/document.lua

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/src/screens/document.lua`

````lua
-- Animación reutilizable de pistas. Reread usa un callback y nunca concede eventos.
local Screen=require("src.ui.screen")
local W=require("src.ui.widgets")
local P=require("src.ui.palette")
local Font=require("src.ui.font")
local Events=require("src.systems.events")
local Documents=require("src.data.documents")
local Document={}
function Document.new(app,id,returnTo)
 local s=Screen.new(app)
 s.kind="document"; s.document=assert(Documents[id]); s.elapsed=0; s.returnTo=returnTo
 local saved=app.session.documentState
 s.phase=returnTo and "reading" or (saved and saved.id==id and saved.phase or "resting")
 s.elapsed=not returnTo and saved and saved.id==id and saved.elapsed or 0
 s.page=not returnTo and saved and saved.id==id and saved.page or 1; s.lines=Font.wrap(s.document.text,534,1)
 s.pages=math.max(1,math.ceil(#s.lines/20))
 s.page=math.max(1,math.min(s.page,s.pages))
 function s:persist()
  if not self.returnTo then app.session.documentState={id=id,phase=self.phase,elapsed=self.elapsed,page=self.page}; app:save() end
 end
 function s:interact()
  if self.phase=="resting" then
   self.phase="lifting"; self.elapsed=0; app.audio:effect("paper"); self:persist()
  elseif self.phase=="reading" then
   if self.page<self.pages then self.page=self.page+1; app.audio:effect("paper"); self:persist(); return end
   if self.returnTo then self.returnTo(); return end
   self.phase="signature"; self.elapsed=0; app.audio:effect("revelation"); self:persist()
  end
 end
 function s:update(dt)
  self.elapsed=self.elapsed+dt
  if not self.returnTo and app.session.documentState then app.session.documentState.elapsed=self.elapsed end
  local reduced=app.options.reducedMotion
  if self.phase=="lifting" and (reduced or self.elapsed>=.6) then
   self.phase="opening"; self.elapsed=0; app.audio:effect("envelope_open"); self:persist()
  elseif self.phase=="opening" and (reduced or self.elapsed>=.45) then
   self.phase="reading"; self.elapsed=0; self:persist()
  elseif self.phase=="signature" and (reduced or self.elapsed>=.6) then
   self.phase="done"
   Events.apply(app.session,id.."_read",{clue=id,text="Documento leído: "..self.document.title})
   app.session.documentState=nil
   app:next()
  end
 end
 local function envelope(x,y,scale,open)
  love.graphics.push(); love.graphics.translate(math.floor(x),math.floor(y)); love.graphics.scale(scale,scale)
  love.graphics.setColor(.25,.18,.2); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",-1,-1,50,32)
  love.graphics.setColor(.87,.76,.55); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",0,0,48,30)
  love.graphics.setColor(.66,.48,.35)
  love.graphics.polygon("fill",0,0,24,open and -14 or 17,48,0)
  love.graphics.setColor(.8,.67,.45); love.graphics.polygon("fill",0,30,24,13,48,30)
  love.graphics.setColor(.51,.21,.3); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",21,12,7,7)
  love.graphics.pop()
 end
 function s:draw()
  self:begin(); app.resources:background(self.document.background)
  self:header(self.document.title)
  if self.phase=="reading" or self.phase=="signature" then
   W.panel(32,45,576,278)
   for row=1,20 do
    local line=self.lines[(self.page-1)*20+row]
    if line then self:text(line,50,56+(row-1)*11,534,P.ink) end
   end
   if self.page==self.pages then
    self:text(self.document.signature,470,283,110,P.gold,self.phase=="signature" and 3 or 2,"right")
   end
   if self.phase=="reading" then
    if self.page>1 then self:button("< Volver a leer",48,325,172,24,function() self.page=self.page-1; self:persist() end) end
    self:button(self.page<self.pages and "Leer página siguiente" or "Cerrar carta",330,325,268,24,function() self:interact() end)
   else self:text(self.document.signature,80,154,480,P.gold,id=="hitogami_letter" and 3 or 1,"center") end
  else
   local t=math.min(1,self.elapsed/.6); local x,y,scale=394,190,1

    x=394+(248-394)*t; y=190+(110-190)*t-math.sin(t*math.pi)*18; scale=1+math.floor(t*2)

    love.graphics.setColor(1,.85,.48,pulse); love.graphics.rectangle("line",390,186,56,38)

    self:text("El sobre no estaba aquí anoche.",58,278,524,P.ink)
    self:button("Examinar carta",350,233,208,26,function() self:interact() end)
   end
  end
 end
 function s:mousepressed(x,y,b)
  if self:click(x,y,b) then return end
  if b==1 and self.phase=="resting" and x>=388 and x<=450 and y>=180 and y<=228 then self:interact() end
 end
 function s:keypressed(key)
  if self:navigate(key) then return end
  if key=="return" or key=="space" or key=="e" then self:interact()
  elseif key=="escape" then if self.returnTo then self.returnTo() else app:overlay("pause") end
  elseif key=="left" and self.phase=="reading" then self.page=math.max(1,self.page-1); self:persist() end
 end
 return s
````

````lua
            instruction={step=4,title="LA CARTA EN ACCIÓN",text="La carta elegida se eleva y responde al contexto. Espera a que termine el efecto para leer el resultado. No se puede jugar otra durante esta animación."}
        end
        local char=def.character and Characters.byId[def.character]
        local actor=self.actor and self.actor.value or {x=0,y=0}
        local latest=enc.log[#enc.log]
        local responseLine=self.phase=="result" and not self:busy() and self:responseLine()
        local portrait=self.tutorial and "nanahoshi" or def.character or "nanahoshi"
        local portraitX,portraitY=40+math.floor(actor.x),94+math.floor(actor.y)
        app.resources:portrait(portrait,self.portraitExpression,portraitX,portraitY,1)
        if self.relationshipBars then self.relationshipBars:draw({x=portraitX,y=portraitY,w=64,h=64,width=116,alpha=actor.alpha or 1}) end
        if responseLine and latest and latest.tone=="flirty" and responseLine.speaker==def.character then
            love.graphics.setColor(1,.5,.65,.65)
            love.graphics.rectangle("fill",portraitX+15,portraitY+34,4,2); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",portraitX+40,portraitY+34,4,2)
        end
        W.panel(135,48,487,80)
        self:text(instruction and ("GUÍA "..instruction.step.."/8 · "..instruction.title) or ((char and char.shortName or "Nanahoshi").." / "..contexts[def.kind]),147,56,462,P.gold)
        local briefing=instruction and instruction.text or (self.phase=="result" and
            Presentation.reaction(def.character,enc.log[#enc.log]) or def.intro)
        if self.enc.narrativeVersion then
            briefing=instruction and instruction.text or (self.enc.notice or def.intro)
            if not instruction and self.phase=="hand" and latest and latest.nextNode then
                briefing=require("src.data.dialogue").nodes[latest.nextNode].text
            end
        elseif self.phase=="result" and latest and latest.phrase and not self:busy() then
            local delivery=app.session.curse and app.session.curse.voiceSealed and "voz encantada" or "voz de Rudy"
            briefing="Rudy ("..delivery.."): «"..latest.phrase.."»\n"..(char and char.shortName or "Nanahoshi")..": "..latest.reaction
        elseif enc.finished and not instruction then briefing=self:outcomeResponse() end
        self:text(briefing,147,74,462,P.ink)
        if not instruction and self.phase~="result" then self:text("Contexto: "..contexts[def.kind].." · H: historial · M: colección",147,111,462,P.teal) end
        W.panel(18,166,110,157)
        self:text(enc.finished and "COMPLETADO" or "TURNO "..enc.turn.." / 3",28,177,90,P.gold)
        self:text("ENERGÍA SOCIAL\n"..enc.energy.."/4",28,198,90,P.ink)
        for i=1,4 do love.graphics.setColor(i<=enc.energy and P.teal or P.border); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",28+(i-1)*21,220,15,8) end
        self:text("AVANCE\n"..enc.score.." / "..def.targetScore,28,237,90,P.ink)
        W.bar(28,265,90,6,enc.score,def.targetScore,P.gold)
        self:text("Robo "..#enc.drawPile.." / D "..#enc.discard,28,281,90,P.muted)
        if def.character=="nanahoshi" then self:text("Vínculo de\ninvestigación",28,299,90,P.muted) end
        if self.historyOpen then self:drawHistory()
        elseif self.phase=="result" then self:drawResult()
        else
            self:text("MANO / CLIC O 1-3 PARA CONSULTAR",143,148,278,P.muted)
            local mx,my=app:mouse()
            local moved=mx~=self.lastMouseX or my~=self.lastMouseY
            self.lastMouseX,self.lastMouseY=mx,my
            for i,id in ipairs(enc.hand) do
                local x,y=143+(i-1)*94,187+math.floor(self.lifts[i])
                local can=Cards.canPlay(enc,i)
                if not self:busy() and mx and moved and mx>=x and mx<x+80 and my>=y and my<y+112 then
                    if self.selected~=i then self.confirmReady=false; self.armedTurn=nil end
                    self.selected=i; self.keyboardFocus=nil
                end
                CardView.draw(app.resources,Data.byId[id],x,y,{selected=self.selected==i,disabled=not can,
                    status="["..i.."] "..(can and (self.selected==i and "ELEGIDA" or "ELEGIR") or "NO DISP.")})
                self.buttons[#self.buttons+1]={x=x,y=y,w=80,h=112,cardIndex=i,action=function() self:select(i) end}
            end
            self:drawDetails()
        end
        self:button(self.historyOpen and "Cerrar historial [H]" or "Historial [H]",18,331,195,23,function() self:history() end)
        if self.tutorial and (app.options.tutorialCompleted or app.session.events.tutorial_completed) then
            self:button("Omitir guía",219,331,134,23,function() if Tutorial.skip(app.session,app.options) then self.tutorial=nil; app:save() end end,self:busy())
        elseif self.phase=="hand" and self.confirmReady then self:button("Cancelar [Esc]",219,331,134,23,function() self:cancel() end,self:busy())
        elseif not self.tutorial and self.phase=="hand" then self:button("Respiro [P]",219,331,134,23,function() self:act() end,self:busy()) end
        local label,action,disabled
        if self:busy() then label="Resolviendo..."; disabled=true
        elseif self.historyOpen and not self.enc.finished then label="Cerrar historial [H]"; action=function() self:history() end
        elseif self.enc.finished then label="Ver resultado >"; action=function() self:finish() end
        elseif instruction and instruction.button then label=instruction.button; action=function() self:acknowledge() end
        elseif self.phase=="result" then label="Continuar [Enter]"; action=function() self:acknowledge() end
        elseif self.tutorial and self.tutorial.stage=="free" then label="Tomar un respiro [P]"; action=function() self:act() end
        else label=self.confirmReady and "Jugar carta [Enter]" or "Consultar carta [Enter]"; action=function() self:act(self.selected) end end
        self:button(label,359,331,263,23,action or function() end,disabled)
        self:drawAnimation()
    end
    function s:keypressed(key)
        if key=="h" then self:history(); return end
        if Controls.matches(Controls.back,key) then if not self:cancel() then app:overlay("pause") end; return end
        if Controls.matches(Controls.journal,key) then app:overlay("journal"); return end
        if Controls.matches(Controls.deck,key) then app:overlay("deck"); return end
        if self:busy() then return end
        if self.historyOpen and Controls.matches(Controls.advance,key) then self.historyOpen=false; return end
        if self:navigate(key) then return end
        if Controls.matches(Controls.previousCard,key) or Controls.matches(Controls.nextCard,key) then
            if #self.enc.hand>0 then self:select((self.selected-1+(Controls.matches(Controls.nextCard,key) and 1 or -1))%#self.enc.hand+1) end
        elseif Controls.matches(Controls.advance,key) then
            local instruction=self.tutorial and Tutorial.instruction(self.tutorial)
            if self.enc.finished then self:finish()
            elseif instruction and instruction.button then self:acknowledge()
            elseif self.phase=="result" then self:acknowledge()
            elseif self.tutorial and self.tutorial.stage=="free" then self:act()
            else self:act(self.selected) end
        elseif Controls.matches(Controls.freeAction,key) then self:act()
        else for i,k in ipairs(Controls.cards) do if key==k then self:select(i); return end end end
    end
    return s
end
return Encounter
````
