````lua
local Screen=require("src.ui.screen")
local W=require("src.ui.widgets")
local P=require("src.ui.palette")
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local History={}
local labels={daily_commitment="compromiso diario",broken_trust="confianza dañada",mirror_doubt="dudas ante el espejo",
    pending="pendiente",kept="cumplida",broken="incumplida",reconciled="reconciliada",
    first_anomaly="Primera anomalía contenida",starter_gift="Nanahoshi entrega los mazos iniciales",
    seal_memory="Sello de la Memoria obtenido",seal_truth="Sello de la Verdad obtenido",seal_will="Sello de la Voluntad obtenido"}
local function label(id) return labels[id] or tostring(id):gsub("_"," ") end
function History.lines(session)
    local lines={}
    for _,e in ipairs(session.history or session.journal or {}) do
        local char=Characters.byId[e.character]
        local delta=e.changes or e.delta or e
        local description=e.text or e.label
        if not description or description==e.id then
            local node=require("src.data.chapters").get(e.checkpoint)
            description=labels[e.id] or (node and node.definition.title) or "Acontecimiento registrado"
        end
        local text="Día "..tostring(e.day or "?").." · "..(char and char.shortName..": " or "")..description
        if (delta.love or 0)~=0 or (delta.trust or 0)~=0 then text=text.." (amor "..tostring(delta.love or 0)..", confianza "..tostring(delta.trust or 0)..")" end
        lines[#lines+1]=text
    end
    for _,id in ipairs(Characters.romanceIds) do
        local r=session.relationships[id]
        local function append(map,prefix)
            local keys={} for key in pairs(map or {}) do keys[#keys+1]=key end; table.sort(keys)
            for _,key in ipairs(keys) do local v=map[key]
                local status=type(v)=="table" and (v.status or "registrado") or v==true and "registrado" or v
                lines[#lines+1]=Characters.byId[id].shortName.." · "..prefix.." "..label(key)..": "..label(status)
            end
        end
        append(r.promises,"promesa"); append(r.pendingConflicts,"conflicto"); append(r.reconciliations,"reconciliación")
    end
    if #lines==0 then lines[1]="Todavía no has tomado decisiones. Los acontecimientos importantes se anotarán aquí." end
    return lines
end
function History.new(app,returnTo)
    local s=Screen.new(app); s.kind="history"; s.page=1; s.lines=History.lines(app.session)
    s.returnTo=returnTo or function() app:resume() end
    function s:draw()
        self:begin(); app.resources:background("library"); W.panel(14,14,612,330)
        self:text("HISTORIAL / DECISIONES Y COMPROMISOS",30,31,572,P.gold)
        for row=1,6 do self:text(self.lines[(self.page-1)*6+row] or "",30,66+(row-1)*36,572,P.ink) end
        local pages=math.max(1,math.ceil(#self.lines/6))
        self:button("< Anterior",30,306,138,24,function() self.page=(self.page-2)%pages+1 end)
        self:text(self.page.." / "..pages,182,314,120,P.gold)
        self:button("Siguiente >",318,306,138,24,function() self.page=self.page%pages+1 end)
        self:button("Volver",470,306,138,24,self.returnTo)
    end
    function s:keypressed(key) if key=="escape" then self.returnTo() else self:navigate(key) end end
    return s
end
return History
````

````lua
local Screen=require("src.ui.screen")
local W=require("src.ui.widgets")
local P=require("src.ui.palette")
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
local Controls=require("src.config.controls")
local Hub={}
function Hub.new(app)
    local s=Screen.new(app)
    s.definition=assert(Progression.hub(app.session))
    function s:draw()
        self:begin()
        local def=self.definition
        app.resources:background(def.background or "courtyard")
        self:header(def.title)
        W.panel(18,47,604,41)
        local companions=Progression.availableCompanions(app.session)
        local ready=#companions>0
        self:text(ready and (def.readyHeading or def.heading) or def.heading,30,58,578,P.gold)
        self:text(ready and (def.readyDescription or def.description) or def.description,30,74,578,P.ink)
        for i,place in ipairs(def.locations) do
            local id=place.character
            local char=Characters.byId[id]
            local x=18+(i-1)*204
            W.panel(x,99,196,231)
            local visited=place.completedEvent and app.session.events[place.completedEvent]
            app.resources:portrait(id,visited and "happy" or "neutral",x+34,108,2)
            self:text(char.shortName,x+10,241,176,P.gold,1,"center")
            if place.scene then
                self:text(place.title,x+10,258,176,P.muted,1,"center")
                local r=app.session.relationships[id]
                self:text("Conf. "..r.trust.."  /  Amor "..r.chemistry,x+10,276,176,P.ink,1,"center")
            else
                self:text(place.description,x+10,258,176,P.muted,1,"center")
            end
            self:button(ready and "Elegir compañía" or (visited and "Encuentro completo" or "Visitar"),x+8,297,180,24,function()
                local nextId,err
                if ready then nextId,err=Progression.selectCompanion(app.session,id)
                else nextId,err=Progression.visit(app.session,id) end
                if nextId then app:save(); app:resume() else app:notify(err) end
            end,visited and not ready)
        end
        W.panel(18,336,604,20,{shadow=false})
        self:text("Puedes consultar tus vínculos en el diario. Guardado automático activado.",26,343,588,P.ink)
    end
    function s:keypressed(key)
        if self:navigate(key) then return end
        if Controls.matches(Controls.back,key) then app:overlay("pause")
        elseif Controls.matches(Controls.journal,key) then app:overlay("journal")
        elseif Controls.matches(Controls.deck,key) then app:overlay("deck") end
    end
    return s
end
return Hub
````

````lua
local Screen=require("src.ui.screen")
local W=require("src.ui.widgets")
local P=require("src.ui.palette")
local Font=require("src.ui.font")
local Guide=require("src.data.manual")
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local Cards=require("src.data.cards")
local Collection=require("src.screens.collection")
local CardView=require("src.ui.card")
local Save=require("src.systems.save")
local Manual={}

function Manual.pageCount(section)
    return ({#Characters.list,#Cards.list+#require("src.data.combat_cards").list,#Guide.categories,#Guide.scenarios,#Guide.rules,1,1})[section] or 1
end

function Manual.new(app,returnTo)
    local s=Screen.new(app)
    s.kind="manual"; s.section=6; s.page=1
    s.session=app.session or Save.load() or Save.newSession()
    s.returnTo=returnTo or function() if app.session then app:resume() else app:menu() end end
    function s:changeSection(index)
        self.section=math.max(1,math.min(#Guide.sections,index)); self.page=1; self.keyboardFocus=nil
    end
    function s:changePage(delta)
        local pages=self.section==7 and math.max(1,math.ceil(#require("src.screens.history").lines(self.session)/5)) or Manual.pageCount(self.section)
        self.page=(self.page-1+delta)%pages+1; self.keyboardFocus=nil
    end
    function s:draw()
        self:begin()
        app.resources:background("library")
        love.graphics.setColor(.025,.035,.07,.85); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",0,0,640,360)
        W.panel(8,7,624,30)
        self:text("MANUAL DEL AVENTURERO",18,18,492,P.gold)
        self:button("Volver",548,12,76,20,self.returnTo)
        for i,label in ipairs(Guide.sections) do
            self:button(label,14+(i-1)*88,45,85,24,function() self:changeSection(i) end,false,self.section==i)
        end
        W.panel(14,77,612,232)
        if self.section==1 then
            local char=Characters.list[self.page]
            local extra=Guide.characters[char.id]
            app.resources:portrait(char.id,"neutral",34,103,2)
            self:text(char.name,182,91,426,P.gold)
            self:text(char.description,182,118,426,P.ink)
            self:text("PERSONALIDAD",182,161,426,P.teal)
            self:text(extra.personality,182,178,426,P.ink)
            self:text("ROL EN LA HISTORIA",182,222,426,P.teal)
            self:text(extra.role,182,239,426,P.ink)
        elseif self.section==2 then
            local card=Cards.list[self.page]
            if not card then
                card=require("src.data.combat_cards").list[self.page-#Cards.list]
                CardView.draw(app.resources,card,34,110)
                self:text(card.name,132,91,474,P.gold)
                self:text(s.session.unlocked[card.id] and "ADQUIRIDA" or "BLOQUEADA",132,113,474,P.teal)
                self:text("TÉCNICA DE COMBATE",132,144,474,P.gold)
                self:text(require("src.systems.combat").describe(card),132,169,474,P.ink)
                self:text(card.description,132,211,474,P.ink)
                self:text("OBTENCIÓN: "..(card.unlockHint or "Entrega de Nanahoshi."),34,269,572,P.muted)
            else
            local detail=Collection.details(card,s.session)
            CardView.draw(app.resources,card,34,110)
            self:text(card.name,132,91,474,P.gold)
            self:text(detail.category.." · "..detail.stateLabel,132,109,474,P.teal)
            self:text("SOCIAL · "..detail.cost,132,132,474,P.gold)
            self:text(detail.base,132,148,474,P.ink)
            self:text("Bonos: "..detail.contexts.." "..detail.affinity,132,167,474,P.muted)
            self:text("COMBATE MÁGICO",132,201,474,P.gold)
            self:text(Collection.combatDetail(card),132,217,474,P.ink)
            self:text("OBTENCIÓN: "..detail.unlock,34,269,572,P.muted)
            end
        elseif self.section==3 then
            local category=Guide.categories[self.page]
            app.resources:categoryIcon(category.id,43,114,3)
            love.graphics.setColor(category.color); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",34,205,90,9)
            self:text(category.name,148,104,454,category.color)
            self:text(category.text,148,141,454,P.ink)
            self:text("La categoría clasifica el tema de la carta. No es un elemento de daño. Lee sus efectos y contextos para saber dónde funciona.",148,219,454,P.gold)
        elseif self.section==4 then
            local scene=Guide.scenarios[self.page]
            love.graphics.setColor(1,1,1,1)
            love.graphics.draw(app.resources:getBackground(scene.id),24,104)
            self:text(scene.name,24,87,582,P.gold)
            self:text(scene.description,360,119,246,P.ink)
            self:text("Escenario "..self.page.." / "..#Guide.scenarios.."\nPNG original · 320 x 180",360,248,246,P.muted)
        elseif self.section==5 then
            local rule=Guide.rules[self.page]
            self:text(rule.title,30,92,578,P.gold)
            self:text(rule.text,30,121,578,P.ink)
        elseif self.section==6 then
            self:text(Guide.history.title,30,92,578,P.gold)
            self:text(Guide.history.text,30,121,578,P.ink)
        elseif self.section==7 then
            local lines=require("src.screens.history").lines(self.session)
            for row=1,5 do self:text(lines[(self.page-1)*5+row] or "",30,93+(row-1)*40,578,P.ink) end
        end
        self:button("< Anterior",14,318,144,25,function() self:changePage(-1) end)
        local pageCount=self.section==7 and math.max(1,math.ceil(#require("src.screens.history").lines(self.session)/5)) or Manual.pageCount(self.section)
        self:text(Guide.sections[self.section].." · "..self.page.." / "..pageCount,168,325,304,P.gold,1,"center")
        self:button("Siguiente >",482,318,144,25,function() self:changePage(1) end)
        self:text("1-7: sección · Izq/Der: página · Tab/Enter: botones · Esc: volver",14,348,612,P.muted)
    end
    function s:keypressed(key)
        if key=="escape" then self.returnTo(); return end
        local section=tonumber(key)
        if section and section>=1 and section<=7 then self:changeSection(section); return end
        if key=="left" or key=="pageup" then self:changePage(-1); return end
        if key=="right" or key=="pagedown" then self:changePage(1); return end
        self:navigate(key)
    end
    return s
end
return Manual
````

````lua
local Screen=require("src.ui.screen")
local W=require("src.ui.widgets")
local P=require("src.ui.palette")
local Save=require("src.systems.save")
local Options=require("src.systems.options")
local Controls=require("src.config.controls")
local OptionsScreen={}

function OptionsScreen.new(app)
    local s=Screen.new(app)
    s.kind="options"
    app.options=Options.normalize(app.options)
    local function changed()
        app:applyOptions()
        local ok,err=Save.writeOptions(app.options)
        if not ok then app:notify("No se guardaron las opciones: "..tostring(err)) end
        if app.session then app:save() end
    end
    local function volume(key,amount)
        app.options[key]=math.max(0,math.min(1,math.floor((app.options[key]+amount)*100+.5)/100))
        changed()
    end
    function s:draw()
        self:begin()
        app.resources:background("library")
        love.graphics.setColor(.025,.035,.07,.75)
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill",0,0,640,360)
        self:header("OPCIONES / AUDIO Y ACCESIBILIDAD",true)
        W.panel(18,49,300,291)
        W.panel(330,49,292,291)
        self:text("AUDIO",30,60,276,P.gold)
        for i,row in ipairs({{"volume","Volumen maestro"},{"musicVolume","Música"},{"effectsVolume","Efectos"}}) do
            local key,label=row[1],row[2]
            local y=80+(i-1)*55
            self:text(label..": "..math.floor(app.options[key]*100+.5).."%",30,y,276,P.ink)
            self:button("-",30,y+15,32,24,function() volume(key,-.1) end)
            W.bar(74,y+23,180,8,app.options[key],1,P.teal)
            self:button("+",266,y+15,32,24,function() volume(key,.1) end)
        end
        self:button(app.options.muted and "Sonido: silenciado" or "Sonido: activado",30,249,268,27,function()
            app.options.muted=not app.options.muted; changed()
        end)
        self:text("Melodías y efectos originales\nsintetizados por el juego.",30,291,276,P.muted)
        self:text("LECTURA Y MOVIMIENTO",342,60,268,P.gold)
        self:text("Texto: "..math.floor(app.options.textSpeed).." letras / segundo",342,82,268,P.ink)
        self:button("Velocidad: cambiar",342,99,268,27,function()
            local speeds={25,50,75,100}
            local nextSpeed=speeds[1]
            for _,speed in ipairs(speeds) do if speed>app.options.textSpeed then nextSpeed=speed; break end end
            app.options.textSpeed=nextSpeed; changed()
        end)
        self:button("Escritura: "..(app.options.textAnimation and "progresiva" or "instantánea"),342,139,268,27,function()
            app.options.textAnimation=not app.options.textAnimation; changed()
        end)
        self:button("Movimiento reducido: "..(app.options.reducedMotion and "sí" or "no"),342,179,268,27,function()
            app.options.reducedMotion=not app.options.reducedMotion; changed()
        end)
        self:button("Pantalla: "..(app.options.fullscreen and "completa" or "ventana"),342,219,268,27,function()
            app.options.fullscreen=not app.options.fullscreen; changed()
        end)
        self:text("Tab / arriba / abajo: elegir\nEnter: cambiar · Esc: volver\nF11: pantalla completa",342,268,268,P.muted)
        self:text("Los ajustes se guardan al cambiarlos.",342,315,268,P.teal)
    end
    function s:keypressed(key)
        if self:navigate(key) then return end
        if Controls.matches(Controls.back,key) then app:resume() end
    end
    return s
end

return OptionsScreen
````

````lua
local Screen=require("src.ui.screen")
local W=require("src.ui.widgets")

local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local Controls=require("src.config.controls")
local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
local Overlays={}

-- El diario sólo muestra lo que Rudy ya ha descubierto en pantalla.
function Overlays.curseStatus(curse)
    curse=curse or {}
    local status={}
    if curse.discoveredVoice then status[#status+1]=curse.voiceSealed and "VOZ SELLADA" or "VOZ RECUPERADA" end
    if curse.discoveredMana then status[#status+1]=curse.manaBlocked and "MANÁ BLOQUEADO" or "MAGIA RECUPERADA" end
    return #status>0 and table.concat(status," · ") or "Sin diagnóstico"
end

function Overlays.new(app,kind)
    if kind=="deck" then return require("src.screens.collection").new(app) end
    if kind=="options" then return require("src.screens.options").new(app) end
    local s=Screen.new(app)
    s.kind=kind
    s.selected=1
    s.page=1
    function s:draw()
        self:begin()
        app.resources:background("library")
        love.graphics.setColor(.025,.035,.07,.7)
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill",0,0,640,360)
        if kind=="pause" then
            self:header("PARTIDA EN PAUSA",true)
            W.panel(132,67,376,249)
            self:text("UN MOMENTO PARA RESPIRAR",151,88,338,P.gold)
            self:button("Volver a la historia",153,118,334,29,function() app:resume() end)
            self:button("Guardar partida [F5]",153,154,334,29,function() if app:save() then app:notify("Partida guardada.") end end)
            self:button("Opciones",153,190,334,29,function() app:overlay("options") end)
            self:button("Menú principal",153,226,334,29,function() app:save(); app.session=nil; app:menu() end)
            self:button("Salir",153,262,334,29,function() love.event.quit() end)
        elseif kind=="journal" then
            self:header("DIARIO / PERSONAJES Y RECUERDOS",true)
            if app.session.clues and app.session.clues.hitogami_letter then
                self:button("Carta —H",330,12,104,20,function()
                    app:switch(require("src.screens.document").new(app,"hitogami_letter",function() app:switch(self) end))
                end)
            end
            self:button("Historial",440,12,100,20,function() app:switch(require("src.screens.history").new(app,function() app:overlay("journal") end)) end)
            for i,id in ipairs(Characters.romanceIds) do
                local char=Characters.byId[id]
                local r=app.session.relationships[id]
                local x=18+(i-1)*204
                W.panel(x,49,196,215)
                self:text(char.shortName,x+10,61,176,P.gold)
                self:text(char.theme,x+10,79,176,P.muted)
                self:text("Confianza "..r.trust.." / 100",x+10,113,176,P.ink)
                W.bar(x+10,129,176,7,r.trust,100,P.teal)
                self:text("Amor "..r.love.." / 100",x+10,150,176,P.ink)
                W.bar(x+10,166,176,7,r.love,100,P.rose)
                local conflicts,broken=0,0
                for _,value in pairs(r.pendingConflicts or {}) do if value then conflicts=conflicts+1 end end
                for _,value in pairs(r.promises or {}) do if value=="broken" or (type(value)=="table" and value.status=="broken") then broken=broken+1 end end
                self:text("Evento personal: "..(r.events.personal_resolution and "sí" or "pendiente").."\nConflictos: "..conflicts.."\nPromesas rotas: "..broken,x+10,183,176,P.ink)
                local states={married="casados",stable="estable",strained="en tensión",reconciled="reconciliados",separated="separados",committed="comprometidos"}
                self:text("Matrimonio: "..(states[r.marriageState] or "en curso"),x+10,241,176,P.muted)
            end
            W.panel(18,275,604,67)
            local companion=Progression.companion(app.session)
            self:text("Día "..app.session.day.." / 7 · "..Overlays.curseStatus(app.session.curse),30,287,578,P.gold)
            self:text("Compañía: "..(companion and Characters.byId[companion].shortName or "por elegir")..". Los compromisos y conflictos persisten entre días.",30,305,578,P.ink)
            self:text("Un matrimonio necesita confianza, amor y hechos; consulta el historial.",30,328,578,P.muted)
        end
    end
    function s:keypressed(key)
        if self:navigate(key) then return end
        if Controls.matches(Controls.back,key) then app:resume() end
    end
    return s
end
return Overlays
````

````lua
-- Los premios ya se concedieron mediante Events; esta pantalla sólo los presenta.
local Screen=require("src.ui.screen")
local W=require("src.ui.widgets")
local P=require("src.ui.palette")
local CardView=require("src.ui.card")
local Cards=require("src.data.cards")
local Techniques=require("src.data.combat_cards")
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local Reward={}
function Reward.new(app)
    local s=Screen.new(app)
    s.kind="reward"; s.reward=assert(app.session.rewardQueue[1]); s.age=0
    s.cards=s.reward.cards or {}; s.page=math.min(#s.cards,s.reward.presentationPage or 1)
    s.starter=s.reward.eventId=="starter_gift" or s.reward.eventId=="practice_starter"
    if app.audio then app.audio:effect("card_gift") end
    function s:update(dt)
        local before=self.age; self.age=self.age+dt
        if before<.6 and self.age>=.6 and app.audio then app.audio:effect("unlock") end
    end
    function s:continue()
        if self.closing then return end
        if self.age<.7 and not app.options.reducedMotion then self.age=.7; return end
        if self.page<#self.cards then
            self.page=self.page+1; self.age=0; self.reward.presentationPage=self.page
            app:save(); return
        end
        self.closing=true
        table.remove(app.session.rewardQueue,1)
        app:save(); app:resume()
    end
    function s:draw()
        self:begin(); app.resources:background("laboratory")
        love.graphics.setColor(.025,.035,.07,.8); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",0,0,640,360)
        W.panel(16,14,608,332)
        self:text(self.starter and "¡HAS OBTENIDO TU PRIMER MAZO!" or "¡NUEVA CARTA OBTENIDA!",36,30,568,P.gold,2)
        local giver=self.reward.presenter or "nanahoshi"
        local char=Characters.byId[giver]
        app.resources:portrait(giver,"happy",38,105,1)
        app.resources:portrait("rudeus","happy",534,105,1)
        self:text(char and char.shortName or "Recompensa",28,177,100,P.teal,1,"center")
        self:text("Rudy",530,177,74,P.teal,1,"center")
        -- Cofre pixel art y desplazamiento entero; no se deforma la ilustración.
        love.graphics.setColor(.30,.18,.10,1); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",58,220,50,30)
        love.graphics.setColor(.72,.51,.23,1); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",56,215,54,8)
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill",79,220,8,15)
        local id=self.cards[self.page]; local card=Cards.byId[id] or Techniques.byId[id]
        local t=app.options.reducedMotion and 1 or math.min(1,self.age/.6)
        if card then
            local x=math.floor(74+(278-74)*t); local y=math.floor(215+(81-215)*t-18*math.sin(t*math.pi))
            CardView.draw(app.resources,card,x,y)
            local social=Cards.byId[id]~=nil
            self:text((social and "SOCIAL" or "COMBATE").." · "..self.page.." / "..#self.cards,140,64,360,P.teal,1,"center")
            self:text(card.name,138,203,364,P.gold,1,"center")
            self:text(card.description,138,222,364,P.ink)
            local category=Cards.categories[card.category] or "Física"
            local condition=card.conditions and card.conditions.character
            self:text(category.." · Coste: "..(card.cost or 1).." acción/energía"..(condition and (" · Requiere "..condition) or ""),138,263,364,P.teal)
        end
        self:text(self.starter and "Orsted → Nanahoshi → Rudy. Cinco sociales y cinco físicas." or "Guardada en tu colección. Consulta sus efectos en Mazo.",42,287,556,P.muted,1,"center")
        self:button(self.page<#self.cards and "Siguiente carta" or "Continuar",226,309,188,25,function() self:continue() end)
    end
    function s:keypressed(key)
        if key=="return" or key=="space" or key=="escape" then self:continue() else self:navigate(key) end
    end
    return s
end
return Reward
````

````lua
local Screen=require("src.ui.screen")
local W=require("src.ui.widgets")
local P=require("src.ui.palette")
local Bars=require("src.ui.relationship_bars")
local Animation=require("src.systems.animation")
local Result=require("src.systems.training_result")
local Dialogue=require("src.data.training_dialogue")
local TrainingScreen={}
local function signed(n) return (n>=0 and "+" or "")..tostring(n) end
function TrainingScreen.new(app)
 local s=Screen.new(app);s.kind="training_result";s.enc=app.session.combat
 app.audio:setContext("training")
 s.result=assert(Result.current(app.session,s.enc),"Resultado de entrenamiento inválido")
 s.data=Dialogue[s.result.id]
 app.session.trainingReview=app.session.trainingReview or {line=1}
 s.page=math.max(1,math.min(#s.data.lines,app.session.trainingReview.line or 1))
 s.bars=Bars.new(app.session,"eris",{reducedMotion=app.options.reducedMotion,audio=app.audio})
 function s:showLine()
  self.line=self.data.lines[self.page]
  self.actor=Animation.actor(self.line.animation or "speaking",{reducedMotion=app.options.reducedMotion})
  if self.line.apply then
   local record,applied=Result.commit(app.session,self.enc)
   if record and applied then
    self.bars:apply(Result.key(app.session.checkpoint),app.session,{love=record.actualLove,trust=record.actualTrust},self.result.reason)
   end
  end
  app.session.trainingReview.line=self.page
  app:save()
 end
 function s:advance()
  if app.session.combat~=self.enc then return false end
  if self.page<#self.data.lines then self.page=self.page+1;self:showLine();return true end
  return app:finishCombat(self.enc)
 end
 function s:update(dt)
  self.bars:update(dt);if self.actor then self.actor:update(dt) end
 end
 function s:draw()
  self:begin();app.resources:background("training")
  love.graphics.setColor(.04,.05,.10,.6);love.graphics.rectangle("fill",0,0,640,360)
  W.panel(8,7,624,39)
  self:text(self.data.title,18,18,604,self.result.winner=="rudeus" and P.gold or P.ink,1,"center")
  W.panel(14,55,314,160)
  local m=self.result.metrics
  local rows={"Ganador: "..(self.result.winner=="rudeus" and "Rudy" or "Eris").." · Turnos: "..m.turns,
   "Ataques: "..m.attacksHit.." acertados / "..m.attacksAttempted.." intentados",
   "Puntos causados: "..m.damageDealt.." · Recibidos: "..m.damageReceived,
   "Bloqueos: "..m.blockedAttacks.." · Puntos evitados: "..(m.blockedDamage or 0),
   "Esquivas efectivas: "..m.successfulDodges.." · Tácticas: "..m.tacticalActions,
   "Turnos sin actuar: "..m.idleTurns,
   "Aperturas desaprovechadas: "..m.missedOpportunities}
  for i,text in ipairs(rows) do self:text(text,24,65+(i-1)*16,294,P.ink) end
  self:text(self.result.reason,24,178,294,P.muted)
  local pose=self.actor and self.actor.value or {x=0,y=0,alpha=1,scale=1}
  local erisActive=self.line.speaker=="eris"
  local ex,ey=470+(erisActive and math.floor(pose.x or 0) or 0),112+(erisActive and math.floor(pose.y or 0) or 0)
  local erisExpression=erisActive and self.line.expression or (self.result.winner=="rudeus" and "worried" or "happy")
  app.resources:portrait("eris",erisExpression,ex,ey,1)
  app.resources:portrait("rudeus",self.line.speaker=="rudeus" and self.line.expression or "neutral",365,112,1)
  self.bars:draw({x=ex,y=ey,w=64,h=64,width=148})
  self:text("Rudy",366,180,62,P.ink,1,"center")
  self:text(self.data.effort.."\nSin heridas letales",346,188,270,P.muted,1,"center")
  W.panel(14,223,612,101)
  self:text(self.line.speaker=="rudeus" and "Pensamientos de Rudy" or "Eris",24,232,580,P.gold)
  self:text(self.line.text,24,249,580,P.ink)
  local record=(app.session.trainingResults or {})[app.session.checkpoint]
  self:text(record and ("Aplicado: "..signed(record.actualLove).." AMOR / "..signed(record.actualTrust).." CONFIANZA")
   or "La relación se actualizará al terminar la reacción de Eris.",24,306,580,record and P.teal or P.muted)
  self:button("Guardar y menú",14,331,161,23,function() app:save();app:menu() end)
  self:text(self.page.." / "..#self.data.lines,194,338,110,P.muted)
  self:button(self.page<#self.data.lines and "Escuchar [Enter]" or "Continuar historia [Enter]",360,331,266,23,function() self:advance() end)
 end
 function s:keypressed(key)
  if self:navigate(key) then return end
  if key=="return" or key=="space" or key=="kpenter" then self:advance()
  elseif key=="escape" then app:overlay("pause") end
 end
 s:showLine()
 return s
end
return TrainingScreen
````

## src/systems/affinity.lua

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/src/systems/affinity.lua`

````lua
-- Vínculos no matrimoniales. No escribe en relationships, romanceIds o finales.
local Data=require("src.data.cards")
local Config=require("src.data.relationships.nanahoshi")
local Affinity={config={nanahoshi=Config}}
local function finite(value,default)
 if type(value)~="number" or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return default or 0 end
 return value
end
local function clamp(value) return math.max(0,math.min(100,value)) end
local function flags(value)
 local out,count={},0
 for key,item in pairs(type(value)=="table" and value or {}) do
  if type(key)=="string" and #key<=200 and item==true and count<2048 then out[key]=true;count=count+1 end
 end
 return out
end
function Affinity.normalize(value)
 local out={}
 for id,config in pairs(Affinity.config) do
  local entry=type(value)=="table" and value[id]
  entry=type(entry)=="table" and entry or {}
  local current={trust=clamp(finite(entry.trust,config.defaults.trust)),interest=clamp(finite(entry.interest,config.defaults.interest)),
   awarded=flags(entry.awarded),applied=flags(entry.applied),history={}}
  for _,item in ipairs(type(entry.history)=="table" and entry.history or {}) do
   if #current.history>=512 then break end
   if type(item)=="table" and type(item.id)=="string" and #item.id<=200 then
    current.history[#current.history+1]={id=item.id,cardId=type(item.cardId)=="string" and item.cardId or nil,
     conversationId=type(item.conversationId)=="string" and item.conversationId or nil,
     trust=math.max(-100,math.min(100,finite(item.trust))),interest=math.max(-100,math.min(100,finite(item.interest)))}
   end
  end
  out[id]=current
 end
 return out
end
function Affinity.new() return Affinity.normalize() end
function Affinity.get(session,id)
 if not Affinity.config[id] then return nil end
 return Affinity.normalize(session and session.affinities)[id]
end
function Affinity.canInterest(character,cardId)
 local config=Affinity.config[character]
 local card=Data.byId[cardId]
 return config~=nil and card~=nil and card.encounterTypes~=nil and card.encounterTypes.social==true and not card.combat and config.positiveCards[cardId]~=nil
end
function Affinity.sanitize(character,effect)
 effect=type(effect)=="table" and effect or {}; local config=Affinity.config[character]
 local card=Data.byId[effect.cardId]
 if not config or not card or not card.encounterTypes or not card.encounterTypes.social
  or (card.conditions and card.conditions.character and card.conditions.character~=character) then return {trust=0,interest=0,eligible=false} end
 local interest=finite(effect.interest)
 if interest>0 then
  local positive=config.positiveCards[effect.cardId]
  interest=Affinity.canInterest(character,effect.cardId) and math.min(interest,positive.maxInterest) or 0
 end
 return {trust=finite(effect.trust),interest=interest,eligible=true}
end
local function rewardKey(effect)
 local conversation=type(effect.conversationId)=="string" and effect.conversationId or "unscoped"
 return conversation..":"..tostring(effect.cardId)
end
function Affinity.preview(session,id,effect)
 local current=Affinity.get(session,id)
 if not current then return {trust=0,interest=0,eligible=false} end
 effect=type(effect)=="table" and effect or {}
 local requested=Affinity.sanitize(id,effect)
 local key=rewardKey(effect)
 if current.awarded[key] then requested.trust=math.min(0,requested.trust);requested.interest=math.min(0,requested.interest) end
 return {trust=clamp(current.trust+requested.trust)-current.trust,
  interest=clamp(current.interest+requested.interest)-current.interest,eligible=requested.eligible,
  rewardKey=key,alreadyAwarded=current.awarded[key]==true,
  before={trust=current.trust,interest=current.interest},
  after={trust=clamp(current.trust+requested.trust),interest=clamp(current.interest+requested.interest)}}
end
function Affinity.apply(session,id,effect,eventId)
 if not session or not Affinity.config[id] or type(eventId)~="string" or #eventId>200 then return false,{trust=0,interest=0} end
 effect=type(effect)=="table" and effect or {}
 session.affinities=Affinity.normalize(session.affinities)
 local current=session.affinities[id]
 if current.applied[eventId] then return false,{trust=0,interest=0} end
 local delta=Affinity.preview(session,id,effect)
 current.applied[eventId]=true
 current.trust=current.trust+delta.trust;current.interest=current.interest+delta.interest
 local requested=Affinity.sanitize(id,effect)
 if requested.eligible and (requested.trust>0 or requested.interest>0) then current.awarded[delta.rewardKey]=true end
 current.history[#current.history+1]={id=eventId,cardId=effect.cardId,conversationId=effect.conversationId,trust=delta.trust,interest=delta.interest}
 return true,delta
end
return Affinity
````

````lua
-- Animaciones finitas. La lógica del juego no depende de posiciones ni fotogramas.
local Animation={}
local Tween={}
Tween.__index=Tween
local easing={
    linear=function(t) return t end,
    outQuad=function(t) return 1-(1-t)*(1-t) end,
    inOut=function(t) return t<.5 and 2*t*t or 1-(-2*t+2)^2/2 end,
}

local function complete(self)
    if self.done then return end
    self.done=true
    if self.onComplete then local callback=self.onComplete; self.onComplete=nil; callback() end
end

function Animation.tween(from,to,duration,options)
    options=options or {}
    local self=setmetatable({from={},to={},value={},elapsed=0,duration=math.max(0,duration or 0),
        done=false,ease=easing[options.easing or "outQuad"] or easing.outQuad,
        onComplete=options.onComplete},Tween)
    for key,value in pairs(from) do self.from[key]=value; self.value[key]=value end
    for key,value in pairs(to) do self.to[key]=value; self.from[key]=self.from[key] or value end
    if options.reducedMotion then self.duration=0 end
    return self
end

function Tween:update(dt)
    if self.done then return self.value,true end
    self.elapsed=math.min(self.duration,self.elapsed+math.max(0,dt or 0))
    local t=self.duration==0 and 1 or self.elapsed/self.duration
    local factor=self.ease(t)
    for key,value in pairs(self.to) do self.value[key]=self.from[key]+(value-self.from[key])*factor end
    if t>=1 then complete(self) end
    return self.value,self.done
end

function Tween:finish() return self:update(self.duration) end

Animation.actorNames={enter_left=true,enter_right=true,happy_bounce=true,shake=true,
    small_shake=true,surprised_jump=true,sad_lower=true,angry_shake=true,
    expression_change=true,exit_left=true,exit_right=true,speaking=true}
local Actor={}
Actor.__index=Actor

function Animation.actor(kind,options)
    options=options or {}
    kind=Animation.actorNames[kind] and kind or "expression_change"
    local self=setmetatable({kind=kind,elapsed=0,duration=options.duration or
        ((kind=="happy_bounce" or kind=="shake") and .32 or .28),
        reducedMotion=options.reducedMotion==true,done=false,value={x=0,y=0,alpha=1},
        onComplete=options.onComplete},Actor)
    self:update(0)
    return self
end

function Actor:update(dt)
    if self.done then return self.value,true end
    self.elapsed=math.min(self.duration,self.elapsed+math.max(0,dt or 0))
    local t=self.duration<=0 and 1 or self.elapsed/self.duration
    if self.reducedMotion then t=1 end
    local value,kind=self.value,self.kind
    value.x,value.y,value.alpha=0,0,1
    if kind=="enter_left" or kind=="enter_right" then
        value.x=(kind=="enter_left" and -48 or 48)*(1-t)^2; value.alpha=t
    elseif kind=="exit_left" or kind=="exit_right" then
        value.x=(kind=="exit_left" and -48 or 48)*t*t; value.alpha=1-t
    elseif kind=="happy_bounce" then value.y=-math.sin(t*math.pi)*6
    elseif kind=="shake" or kind=="small_shake" or kind=="angry_shake" then value.x=math.sin(t*math.pi*6)*(1-t)*(kind=="angry_shake" and 5 or 3)
    elseif kind=="surprised_jump" then value.y=-math.sin(t*math.pi)*10
    elseif kind=="sad_lower" then value.y=math.sin(t*math.pi)*5
    elseif kind=="speaking" then value.y=-math.sin(t*math.pi)*2 end
    if self.reducedMotion then
        value.x,value.y=0,0
        value.alpha=(kind=="exit_left" or kind=="exit_right") and 0 or 1
    end
    if t>=1 then
        value.x,value.y=0,0
        if kind=="exit_left" then value.x=self.reducedMotion and 0 or -48
        elseif kind=="exit_right" then value.x=self.reducedMotion and 0 or 48 end
        complete(self)
    end
    return value,self.done
end

function Actor:finish() return self:update(self.duration) end
return Animation
````

````lua
local Manifest=require("src.data.audio")
local Options=require("src.systems.options")
local Audio={}
Audio.__index=Audio

local function frequency(note) return 440*2^((note-69)/12) end
local function wave(phase)
    -- Fundamental y armónico suaves: no hay muestras externas ni ruido aleatorio.
    return math.sin(phase)*.82+math.sin(phase*2)*.18
end

-- Se expone para comprobar muestras y exportarlas si se desea. Generación local
-- diferida: una fuente se sintetiza una vez, al usar por primera vez su contexto.
function Audio.synthesize(spec,music,newSoundData)
    local rate=22050
    local notes=spec.notes or {60,64,67,72}
    local beat=spec.beat or .7
    local duration=music and (#notes*beat) or (spec.duration or .12)
    local count=math.floor(duration*rate)
    local data=newSoundData(count,rate,16,1)
    local gain=music and .12 or (spec.gain or .16)
    local noteLength=music and beat or duration/#notes
    for i=0,count-1 do
        local time=i/rate
        local slot=math.min(#notes,math.floor(time/noteLength)+1)
        local elapsed=time-(slot-1)*noteLength
        local envelope=math.min(1,elapsed/.012)*math.max(0,1-elapsed/noteLength)^2
        local fundamental=frequency(notes[slot])
        local sample=wave(2*math.pi*fundamental*elapsed)*envelope
        if music then
            -- Bajo armónico discreto de la misma secuencia, también con envolvente.
            sample=sample*.75+math.sin(2*math.pi*fundamental*.5*elapsed)*envelope*.25
        end
        data:setSample(i,sample*gain)
    end
    return data
end

local function backend()
    return {
        getInfo=function(path) return love.filesystem.getInfo(path,"file") end,
        newSource=function(value,kind) return love.audio.newSource(value,kind) end,
        newSoundData=function(...) return love.sound.newSoundData(...) end,
    }
end

function Audio.new(options,config)
    config=config or {}
    return setmetatable({options=Options.normalize(options),manifest=config.manifest or Manifest,
        backend=config.backend or backend(),musicCache={},effectCache={},warnings={},warned={},
        time=0,lastEffects={},effectVoices={},context=nil,current=nil,outgoing=nil},Audio)
end

function Audio:warn(key,message)
    if self.warned[key] then return end
    self.warned[key]=true
    self.warnings[#self.warnings+1]=message
    print("[audio] "..message)
end

function Audio:volume(kind,gain)
    if self.options.muted then return 0 end
    return self.options.volume*(kind=="music" and self.options.musicVolume or self.options.effectsVolume)*(gain or 1)
end

function Audio:setOptions(options)
    self.options=Options.normalize(options)
    self:applyVolumes()
end

function Audio:applyVolumes()
    for _,voice in pairs({current=self.current,outgoing=self.outgoing}) do
        voice.source:setVolume(self:volume("music",voice.gain))
    end
    for _,voice in ipairs(self.effectVoices) do voice.source:setVolume(self:volume("effects")) end
end

function Audio:source(id,spec,music)
    local cache=music and self.musicCache or self.effectCache
    if cache[id]~=nil then return cache[id] or nil end
    local source
    if type(spec)=="table" and spec.path then
        local ok,info=pcall(self.backend.getInfo,spec.path)
        if ok and info then
            local success,value=pcall(self.backend.newSource,spec.path,music and "stream" or "static")
            if success then source=value else self:warn(id,"Audio inválido: "..spec.path.." ("..tostring(value)..")") end
        else self:warn(id,"No se encontró audio local: "..tostring(spec.path)) end
    end
    local synth=type(spec)=="table" and (music and spec.synth or (not spec.path and spec))
    if not source and synth then
        local ok,value=pcall(function()
            local data=Audio.synthesize(synth,music,self.backend.newSoundData)
            return self.backend.newSource(data,"static")
        end)
        if ok then source=value else self:warn(id,"Síntesis no disponible para "..id..": "..tostring(value)) end
    end
    if not source and not spec then self:warn(id,"Contexto o efecto sin audio: "..tostring(id)) end
    cache[id]=source or false
    return source
end

function Audio:setContext(context)
    if context==self.context then return false end
    self.context=context
    -- Un cambio rápido cancela la salida anterior: jamás hay más de dos pistas.
    if self.outgoing then self.outgoing.source:stop(); self.outgoing=nil end
    if self.current then
        self.outgoing={source=self.current.source,gain=self.current.gain,startGain=self.current.gain,age=0}
        self.current=nil
    end
    local source=context and self:source(context,self.manifest.music[context],true)
    if source then
        source:stop()
        source:setLooping(self.manifest.music[context].loop~=false)
        source:setVolume(0)
        source:play()
        self.current={source=source,gain=0,age=0}
    end
    return true
end

function Audio:effect(id)
    local spec=self.manifest.effects[id]
    if not spec then self:warn("effect:"..tostring(id),"Efecto desconocido: "..tostring(id)); return false end
    if self.options.muted or self:volume("effects")==0 then return false end
    if self.time-(self.lastEffects[id] or -math.huge)<(spec.cooldown or .09) then return false end
    -- El grupo de navegación comparte límite, aunque alterne ratón/teclado.
    if (id=="menu" or id=="card_select") and self.time-(self.lastNavigation or -math.huge)<.085 then return false end
    local prototype=self:source("effect:"..id,spec,false)
    if not prototype then return false end
    local ok,source=pcall(prototype.clone,prototype)
    if not ok or not source then self:warn("clone:"..id,"No se pudo reproducir "..id); return false end
    if #self.effectVoices>=4 then table.remove(self.effectVoices,1).source:stop() end
    source:setVolume(self:volume("effects"))
    source:play()
    self.effectVoices[#self.effectVoices+1]={source=source,remaining=spec.duration or .5}
    self.lastEffects[id]=self.time
    if id=="menu" or id=="card_select" then self.lastNavigation=self.time end
    return true
end

function Audio:update(dt)
    dt=math.max(0,dt or 0)
    self.time=self.time+dt
    local duration=math.max(.01,self.manifest.fadeDuration or .45)
    if self.current then
        self.current.age=self.current.age+dt
        self.current.gain=math.min(1,self.current.age/duration)
    end
    if self.outgoing then
        self.outgoing.age=self.outgoing.age+dt
        self.outgoing.gain=self.outgoing.startGain*math.max(0,1-self.outgoing.age/duration)
        if self.outgoing.age>=duration then self.outgoing.source:stop(); self.outgoing=nil end
    end
    for i=#self.effectVoices,1,-1 do
        local voice=self.effectVoices[i]
        voice.remaining=voice.remaining-dt
        if voice.remaining<=0 then voice.source:stop(); table.remove(self.effectVoices,i) end
    end
    self:applyVolumes()
end

function Audio:stop()
    if self.current then self.current.source:stop() end
    if self.outgoing then self.outgoing.source:stop() end
    for _,voice in ipairs(self.effectVoices) do voice.source:stop() end
    self.current,self.outgoing,self.context=nil,nil,nil
    self.effectVoices={}
end

return Audio
````

````lua
local Data = require("src.data.cards")
local Cards = {}
local metrics={"score","trust","chemistry"}
local function delta(layer)
    local out={}
    for _,key in ipairs(metrics) do out[key]=(layer or {})[key] or 0 end
    return out
end
function Cards.signed(value) return (value>=0 and "+" or "")..tostring(value) end
function Cards.describe(value)
    local trust=value.actualTrust or value.projectedTrust or value.trust or 0
    if value.affinityTarget then
        local interest=value.actualInterest or value.projectedInterest or value.interest or 0
        return Cards.signed(value.score or 0).." avance / "..Cards.signed(trust).." conf. / "..Cards.signed(interest).." interés"
    end
    local love=value.actualLove or value.projectedLove or value.chemistry or 0
    return Cards.signed(value.score or 0).." avance / "..Cards.signed(trust).." conf. / "..Cards.signed(love).." amor"
end

local function copy(list)
    local out={}
    for i,v in ipairs(list) do out[i]=v end
    return out
end

function Cards.validateDeck(deck,unlocked)
    if type(deck)~="table" or #deck<5 or #deck>10 then return false,"El mazo debe tener entre 5 y 10 cartas." end
    local seen={}
    for _,id in ipairs(deck) do
        if not Data.byId[id] then return false,"El mazo contiene una carta desconocida." end
        if seen[id] then return false,"Este mazo no permite cartas repetidas." end
        if unlocked and not unlocked[id] then return false,"El mazo contiene una carta bloqueada." end
        seen[id]=true
    end
    return true
end

function Cards.new(deck,context,rng)
    local ok,err=Cards.validateDeck(deck)
    assert(ok,err)
    local pile=copy(deck)
    rng=rng or (love and love.math and love.math.random) or math.random
    -- Fisher-Yates, each permutation equally likely with a uniform RNG.
    for i=#pile,2,-1 do
        local j=rng(i)
        pile[i],pile[j]=pile[j],pile[i]
    end
    local encounter={hand={},drawPile=pile,discard={},energy=4,turn=1,maxTurns=3,
                     score=0,finished=false,log={},context=context or {kind="conversation"}}
    for _=1,3 do encounter.hand[#encounter.hand+1]=table.remove(pile) end
    return encounter
end

function Cards.canPlay(enc,index)
    if enc.finished then return false,"El encuentro ya terminó." end
    if type(index)~="number" or index%1~=0 then return false,"Selecciona una carta de la mano." end
    local card=Data.byId[enc.hand[index]]
    if not card then return false,"Selecciona una carta de la mano." end
    if enc.energy<card.cost then return false,"No hay energía suficiente." end
    if card.revealsSecret and enc.context.curse and enc.context.curse.active
        and require("src.data.characters").byId[enc.context.character]
        and require("src.data.characters").byId[enc.context.character].romance then
        return false,"El encantamiento bloquea revelar deliberadamente el secreto mientras siga la maldición."
    end
    local conditions=card.conditions or {}
    if conditions.character and enc.context.character~=conditions.character then
        return false,"Esta carta necesita a "..conditions.character.." como acompañante."
    end
    if conditions.kind and enc.context.kind~=conditions.kind then
        return false,"Esta carta no se puede usar en este contexto."
    end
    return true
end

function Cards.preview(enc,index)
    local card=Data.byId[enc.hand[index]]
    if not card then return nil end
    local result={cardId=card.id,cost=card.cost,contextKind=enc.context.kind,score=0,trust=0,chemistry=0,
        base=delta(card.effects),contextBonus=delta(card.contexts[enc.context.kind]),
        affinityBonus=delta(card.affinities[enc.context.character]),targetAdjustment=delta()}
    local layers={result.base,result.contextBonus,result.affinityBonus}
    for _,layer in ipairs(layers) do
        for _,key in ipairs({"score","trust","chemistry"}) do result[key]=result[key]+(layer[key] or 0) end
    end
    result.phrase=Cards.phrase(card,enc.context)
    result.tone=card.tone
    result.expression=(result.trust<0 or result.chemistry<0) and "angry"
        or ((result.score>0 or result.chemistry>0) and "happy" or "worried")
    local reactions={
        roxy={happy="Gracias por tomar mi opinión en serio. Comparemos las ideas.",angry="Preferiría que atendieras a lo que intento explicarte.",worried="Todavía no has respondido a mi duda. Pensemos un momento."},
        sylphiette={happy="Así siento que compartimos la responsabilidad, Rudy.",angry="No quiero quedarme sola con lo que habíamos acordado.",worried="Me preocupa lo que estás dejando de lado. Necesito un acuerdo claro."},
        eris={happy="¡Eso quería oír! Cuenta conmigo y respeta mi parte.",angry="¡No decidas por mí! Puedo elegir cómo ayudarte.",worried="Dímelo con claridad. No quiero tener que adivinarlo."},
    }
    local response=reactions[enc.context.character]
    result.reaction=response and response[result.expression] or "La respuesta queda registrada. Sigamos con la prueba."
    if enc.context.character=="nanahoshi" then
        result.reaction=card.id=="subtle_flirt" and "Concéntrate, Rudeus. Estamos probando un artefacto, no en una cita."
            or "La voz se reproduce. El coste y la intención son correctos; recuerda que el contexto cambia la respuesta."
    end
    if not enc.context.character or not require("src.data.characters").byId[enc.context.character]
        or not require("src.data.characters").byId[enc.context.character].romance then
        result.targetAdjustment.trust=-result.trust; result.targetAdjustment.chemistry=-result.chemistry
        result.trust=0; result.chemistry=0
    end
    result.text=card.name..": "..Cards.signed(result.score).." avance"
    if enc.context.character and (result.trust~=0 or result.chemistry~=0) then
        result.text=result.text..", "..Cards.signed(result.trust).." confianza, "..Cards.signed(result.chemistry).." amor"
    end
    return result
end

function Cards.phrase(card,context)
    local phrases=card.phrases or {}
    return phrases[context.sceneId] or phrases[(context.character or "").."_"..(context.kind or "")]
        or phrases[context.character] or phrases[context.kind] or phrases.default or "Estoy aquí para escucharte."
end

local function finishAction(enc,result)
    enc.score=enc.score+result.score
    enc.log[#enc.log+1]=result
    enc.turn=enc.turn+1
    enc.finished=enc.turn>enc.maxTurns
    return result
end

function Cards.play(enc,index,expectedTurn)
    if expectedTurn and expectedTurn~=enc.turn then return nil,"Esta acción ya fue procesada." end
    local ok,err=Cards.canPlay(enc,index)
    if not ok then return nil,err end
    local result=Cards.preview(enc,index)
    local id=table.remove(enc.hand,index)
    enc.energy=enc.energy-Data.byId[id].cost
    enc.discard[#enc.discard+1]=id
    if #enc.drawPile>0 then result.drawnCard=table.remove(enc.drawPile); enc.hand[#enc.hand+1]=result.drawnCard end
    return finishAction(enc,result)
end

local function freeAction()
    return {cardId="pass",cost=0,score=0,trust=0,chemistry=0,
        text="Tomar un respiro: Rudy escucha sin interrumpir. Sin coste."}
end

function Cards.pass(enc,expectedTurn)
    if expectedTurn and expectedTurn~=enc.turn then return nil,"Esta acción ya fue procesada." end
    if enc.finished then return nil,"El encuentro ya terminó." end
    return finishAction(enc,freeAction())
end

-- A saved encounter must conserve the exact cards and action history. Invalid
-- snapshots are rejected rather than granting energy or duplicating cards.
-- El registro anterior se reproduce con las reglas que aceptaron sus cartas.
-- Capturarlas aquí evita que el filtro narrativo posterior invalide una acción
-- ya jugada; las acciones nuevas siguen pasando por Cards.canPlay/preview.
local replayLegacyCanPlay,replayLegacyPreview=Cards.canPlay,Cards.preview
function Cards.restore(snapshot,deck,context)
    if type(snapshot)~="table" then return nil end
    if not Cards.validateDeck(deck) then return nil end
    local counts={}
    for _,id in ipairs(deck) do counts[id]=1 end
    local enc={context=context or snapshot.context,hand={},drawPile={},discard={},log={}}
    if type(enc.context)~="table" then return nil end
    local total=0
    for _,zone in ipairs({"hand","drawPile","discard"}) do
        if type(snapshot[zone])~="table" then return nil end
        for _,id in ipairs(snapshot[zone]) do
            if counts[id]~=1 then return nil end
            counts[id]=0; total=total+1; enc[zone][#enc[zone]+1]=id
        end
    end
    if total~=#deck or #enc.hand<2 or #enc.hand>3 or #enc.discard>3 then return nil end
    if #enc.hand~=math.min(3,#deck-#enc.discard) then return nil end
    if type(snapshot.log)~="table" or #snapshot.log>3 then return nil end
    local energy,score,played=4,0,0
    for _,entry in ipairs(snapshot.log) do
        if type(entry)~="table" then return nil end
        local result
        if entry.cardId=="pass" then
            result=freeAction()
        else
            played=played+1
            if enc.discard[played]~=entry.cardId then return nil end
            local card=Data.byId[entry.cardId]
            if not card or energy<card.cost then return nil end
            local scratch={hand={entry.cardId},context=enc.context,finished=false,energy=energy}
            if not replayLegacyCanPlay(scratch,1) then return nil end
            result=replayLegacyPreview(scratch,1)
            energy=energy-card.cost
        end
        score=score+result.score
        enc.log[#enc.log+1]=result
    end
    if played~=#enc.discard then return nil end
    enc.energy=energy; enc.score=score; enc.turn=#enc.log+1
    enc.maxTurns=3; enc.finished=enc.turn>3
    return enc
end

-- La compatibilidad numérica anterior se conserva para herramientas y snapshots
-- v3 previos. Todos los encuentros jugables están cubiertos por el catálogo.
local legacyNew,legacyPreview,legacyCanPlay=Cards.new,Cards.preview,Cards.canPlay
local legacyPlay,legacyPass,legacyRestore=Cards.play,Cards.pass,Cards.restore
local Resolver=require("src.systems.dialogue_resolver")
local Memory=require("src.systems.dialogue_memory")
local Relationships=require("src.systems.relationships")
local Affinity=require("src.systems.affinity")
local function filtered(deck,context)
    local allowed,reserve={},{}
    for _,id in ipairs(deck) do
        local target=Resolver.compatible(Data.byId[id],context) and allowed or reserve
        target[#target+1]=id
    end
    return allowed,reserve
end
local function fromOrder(deck,context,order)
    local allowed,reserve=filtered(deck,context)
    local present={}; for _,id in ipairs(allowed) do present[id]=true end
    if #allowed~=#order then return nil end
    for _,id in ipairs(order) do if not present[id] then return nil end; present[id]=nil end
    local enc={narrativeVersion=1,affinityVersion=context.affinityDisabled and 0 or 1,context=context,initialMemory=Memory.capture(context.memory),
        memory=Memory.capture(context.memory),initialOrder=copy(order),reserve=reserve,
        hand={},drawPile=copy(order),discard={},energy=4,turn=1,maxTurns=3,score=0,finished=false,log={},reactionIndex=1}
    for _=1,math.min(3,#enc.drawPile) do enc.hand[#enc.hand+1]=table.remove(enc.drawPile) end
    enc.notice=#allowed<3 and "Tu mazo tiene menos de tres respuestas compatibles. Puedes escuchar sin gastar energía; prepara el mazo antes de otra conversación." or nil
    return enc
end
function Cards.new(deck,context,rng)
    if not Resolver.node(context) then return legacyNew(deck,context,rng) end
    local valid,err=Cards.validateDeck(deck,context.unlocked); assert(valid,err)
    local order=filtered(deck,context)
    rng=rng or (love and love.math and love.math.random) or math.random
    for i=#order,2,-1 do local j=rng(i); order[i],order[j]=order[j],order[i] end
    return assert(fromOrder(deck,context,order))
end
function Cards.canPlay(enc,index)
    if Resolver.node(enc.context) then
        local valid,reason=Resolver.compatible(Data.byId[enc.hand[index]],enc.context)
        if not valid then return false,reason end
    end
    return legacyCanPlay(enc,index)
end
function Cards.preview(enc,index)
    if not Resolver.node(enc.context) then return legacyPreview(enc,index) end
    local card=Data.byId[enc.hand[index]]
    if not card then return nil end
    local result=Resolver.resolve(enc.context,card.id,enc.memory)
    if not result then return nil end
    if enc.context.legacyEffects then
        local previous=legacyPreview(enc,index)
        previous.phrase,previous.reaction,previous.expression=result.phrase,result.reaction,result.expression
        return previous
    end
    result.cost=card.cost; result.contextKind=enc.context.kind
    result.base={score=result.score,trust=result.trust,chemistry=result.chemistry}
    result.contextBonus=delta(); result.affinityBonus=delta(); result.targetAdjustment=delta()
    local state=enc.memory or enc.context.memory or {}
    local actual=result.affinityTarget and Affinity.preview(state,result.character,result)
        or Relationships.preview(state.relationships or {},result.character,result)
    result.projectedLove,result.projectedTrust=actual.love or 0,actual.trust
    result.projectedInterest=actual.interest or 0

    if enc.finished then return nil,"El encuentro ya terminó." end
    local result=assert(Resolver.resolve(enc.context,"pass",enc.memory))
    result.cost=0; result.actionTurn=enc.turn; result.applied=false
    local actual=result.affinityTarget and Affinity.preview(enc.memory,result.character,result)
        or Relationships.preview(enc.memory.relationships,result.character,result)
    result.projectedLove,result.projectedTrust=actual.love or 0,actual.trust
    result.projectedInterest=actual.interest or 0
    if result.affinityTarget then result.affinityBefore,result.affinityAfter=actual.before,actual.after end

    enc.reactionIndex=1

end
local function sameList(a,b)
    if type(a)~="table" or #a~=#b then return false end
    for i,id in ipairs(b) do if a[i]~=id then return false end end
    return true
end
function Cards.restore(snapshot,deck,context)
    if type(snapshot)~="table" then return nil end
    if not snapshot.narrativeVersion then
        -- Replay histórico con sus deltas originales. Las nuevas frases se
        -- mostrarán al siguiente encuentro; no se conceden premios retroactivos.
        local compatible=Memory.copy(context or snapshot.context)
        if Resolver.node(compatible) then compatible.legacyEffects=true end
        return legacyRestore(snapshot,deck,compatible)
    end
    if snapshot.narrativeVersion~=1 or not Cards.validateDeck(deck,context and context.unlocked) or not Resolver.node(context) then return nil end
    if type(snapshot.initialOrder)~="table" or type(snapshot.initialMemory)~="table" or type(snapshot.log)~="table" or #snapshot.log>3 then return nil end
    local replayContext=Memory.copy(context)
    -- Los snapshots anteriores a la afinidad conservan sus deltas originales.
    -- La siguiente conversación nueva sí usa el sistema de confianza e interés.
    if snapshot.affinityVersion~=1 then replayContext.affinityDisabled=true end
    replayContext.memory=Memory.capture(snapshot.initialMemory)
    local enc=fromOrder(deck,replayContext,snapshot.initialOrder)
    if not enc then return nil end
    for turn,entry in ipairs(snapshot.log) do
        if type(entry)~="table" then return nil end
        local result
        if entry.cardId=="pass" then result=Cards.pass(enc)
        else
            local index; for i,id in ipairs(enc.hand) do if id==entry.cardId then index=i;break end end
            if not index or not Cards.canPlay(enc,index) then return nil end
            result=Cards.play(enc,index)
        end
        if not result or result.responseId~=entry.responseId then return nil end
        local applied=(context.memory.events or {})[Memory.key(context.sceneId,turn)]==true
        result.applied=applied
        if applied then
            -- El replay local conserva los deltas efectivos, incluso en 0/100.
            result.actualLove=result.projectedLove or 0
            result.actualTrust=result.projectedTrust or 0
            result.actualInterest=result.projectedInterest or 0
        end
    end
    for _,zone in ipairs({"hand","drawPile","discard","reserve"}) do if not sameList(snapshot[zone],enc[zone]) then return nil end end
    if snapshot.energy~=enc.energy or snapshot.score~=enc.score or snapshot.turn~=enc.turn then return nil end
    local sequence=enc.log[#enc.log] and enc.log[#enc.log].sequence or {}
    local index=tonumber(snapshot.reactionIndex) or 1
    enc.reactionIndex=math.max(1,math.min(math.max(1,#sequence),math.floor(index)))
    return enc
end
return Cards
````

````lua
local function integer(value,min,max)

local function same(a,b)

    if type(a)~="table" then return a==b end

function Combat.card(id)
    local base=Techniques.byId[id]

    view.socialCost=original.cost

    view.resource=original.combat.resource or "artifact"
    view.effects=copy(original.combat.effects)

    local e=card.effects or {}; local parts={}

    if e.shield then parts[#parts+1]="+"..e.shield.." escudo" end
    if e.heal then parts[#parts+1]="+"..e.heal.." vida (máx. "..R.playerHp..")" end
    if e.mana then parts[#parts+1]="+"..e.mana.." maná" end
    if e.energy then parts[#parts+1]="+"..e.energy.." energía" end

    if e.vulnerable then parts[#parts+1]="vulnerable (+2 daño recibido, este turno)" end
    if card.perTurn then parts[#parts+1]="máx. "..card.perTurn.."/turno" end
    if card.perBattle and not (enc and enc.balanceVersion==1) then parts[#parts+1]="máx. "..card.perBattle.."/combate" end
    return table.concat(parts,"; ")..". Coste: "..card.cost.." A / "..(card.manaCost or 0).." M / "..(card.hpCost or 0).." PV."
end

function Combat.validateDeck(deck,unlocked)
    if type(deck)~="table" or #deck<5 or #deck>10 then return false,"El mazo de combate necesita entre cinco y diez cartas." end
    local seen,offense={},0
    for _,id in ipairs(deck) do
        local c=Combat.card(id)

        if seen[id] then return false,"El mazo contiene una carta repetida." end

        seen[id]=true

    return true

function Combat.adaptDeck(deck,context)
    context=context or {}

    if not ok then return nil,err end
    local adapted,seen,adjustments={},{},{}
    for _,id in ipairs(selected) do

local function random(enc,n)

end

function Combat.new(deck,context,rng)
````
