````lua
    if card.perTurn and (enc.perTurn[card.id] or 0)>=card.perTurn then return false,"Esta carta ya alcanzó su límite por turno." end
    if enc.balanceVersion~=1 and card.perBattle and (enc.perBattle[card.id] or 0)>=card.perBattle then return false,"Esta carta agotó sus "..card.perBattle.." usos por combate." end
    if enc.balanceVersion~=1 and card.effects.heal and not card.effects.damage and enc.player.hp>=enc.player.maxHp then return false,"Rudy ya tiene la vida máxima." end
    if enc.energy<card.cost then return false,"Necesita "..card.cost.." energía; tienes "..enc.energy.."." end
    local field=resourceField(enc,card)
    if not field then return false,"MANÁ: BLOQUEADO. La magia natural no funciona hasta usar el antídoto." end
    if enc.player[field]<(card.manaCost or 0) then return false,"Necesita "..card.manaCost.." "..resourceName(field).."; tienes "..enc.player[field].."." end
    if enc.player.hp<=(card.hpCost or 0) then return false,"El esfuerzo de espada debe dejar a Rudy al menos 1 PV." end
    return true
end

function Combat.preview(enc,index)
    local card=Combat.card(enc.hand[index]); if not card then return nil end
    local preview={cardId=card.id,cost=card.cost,manaCost=card.manaCost or 0,hpCost=card.hpCost or 0,effects=copy(card.effects),text=Combat.describe(card,enc)}
    if card.perBattle and enc.balanceVersion~=1 then
        preview.usesLeft=math.max(0,card.perBattle-(enc.perBattle[card.id] or 0))
        preview.text=preview.text.." Usos restantes: "..preview.usesLeft.."."
    end
    if card.effects.damage then
        local base,bonus,reduction=elementalDamage(enc,card)
        preview.elementBonus=bonus
        if reduction>0 then preview.trainingSwordReduction=reduction end
        preview.damage=damageAmount(enc.player,enc.enemy,base)
        preview.blocked=math.min(enc.enemy.shield,preview.damage)
        preview.hpLost=math.min(enc.enemy.hp,preview.damage-preview.blocked)
        preview.text=preview.text.." Ahora: "..preview.damage.." daño / "..preview.blocked.." bloqueo / "..preview.hpLost.." vida."
    end
    return preview
end

function Combat.play(enc,index,expectedRevision)
    if expectedRevision~=nil and expectedRevision~=enc.revision then return nil,"Esta acción ya fue procesada." end
    local ok,err=Combat.canPlay(enc,index); if not ok then return nil,err end
    local card=Combat.card(enc.hand[index]); local e=card.effects
    local result={cardId=card.id,cost=card.cost,manaCost=card.manaCost or 0,hpCost=card.hpCost or 0,element=card.element,events={}}
    enc.energy=enc.energy-card.cost
    local field=resourceField(enc,card)
    enc.player[field]=enc.player[field]-(card.manaCost or 0)
    enc.player.hp=enc.player.hp-(card.hpCost or 0)
    enc.perTurn[card.id]=(enc.perTurn[card.id] or 0)+1
    enc.perBattle[card.id]=(enc.perBattle[card.id] or 0)+1
    table.remove(enc.hand,index); enc.discard[#enc.discard+1]=card.id
    event(result,"play","player",card.name..": paga "..card.cost.." acción, "..(card.manaCost or 0).." "..resourceName(field).." y "..(card.hpCost or 0).." PV de esfuerzo.",{element=card.element})
    if e.damage then
        local base,bonus,reduction=elementalDamage(enc,card)
        if bonus>0 then event(result,"elemental","enemy","Debilidad elemental aprovechada: +"..bonus.." daño antes de escudo.",{amount=bonus,element=card.element}) end
        if reduction>0 then event(result,"training_guard","enemy","Eris reconoce la técnica de espada y desvía "..reduction.." puntos. Busca otra distancia o un recurso táctico.",{amount=reduction}) end
        damage(enc,"enemy",base,result)
    end
    if e.shield then
        enc.player.shield=enc.player.shield+e.shield
        local shieldKind=(card.manaCost or 0)>0 and "magicShield" or "physicalShield"
        enc.player[shieldKind]=enc.player[shieldKind]+e.shield
        event(result,"shield","player","Rudy gana "..e.shield.." escudo.",{amount=e.shield})
    end
    if e.heal then
        local amount=math.min(e.heal,enc.player.maxHp-enc.player.hp)
        enc.player.hp=math.min(enc.player.maxHp,enc.player.hp+amount)
        event(result,"heal","player","Rudy recupera "..amount.." vida.",{amount=amount})
    end
    if e.energy then
        enc.energy=enc.energy+e.energy
        event(result,"energy","player","Rudy gana "..e.energy.." energía.",{amount=e.energy})
    end
    if e.mana then
        local pool=enc.context.curse.manaBlocked and "externalEnergy" or "mana"
        local maximum=pool=="mana" and enc.player.maxMana or enc.player.maxExternalEnergy
        local amount=math.min(e.mana,maximum-enc.player[pool])
        enc.player[pool]=enc.player[pool]+amount
        event(result,"mana","player","El artefacto recupera "..amount.." "..resourceName(pool)..".",{amount=amount})
    end
    if e.weak then
        enc.enemy.weak=math.max(enc.enemy.weak,e.weak)
        event(result,"status","enemy","Enemigo debilitado: -2 daño durante "..e.weak.." turno(s).",{status="weak",amount=e.weak})
    end
    if e.vulnerable then
        enc.enemy.vulnerable=math.max(enc.enemy.vulnerable,e.vulnerable)
        event(result,"status","enemy","Enemigo vulnerable: +2 daño recibido por golpe hasta terminar tu turno.",{status="vulnerable",amount=e.vulnerable})
    end
    if e.draw then draw(enc,e.draw,result) end
    event(result,"discard","player",card.name.." va al descarte.",{amount=1})
    updateIntent(enc,result)
    checkOutcome(enc,result)
    return record(enc,result,{kind="play",cardId=card.id,index=index})
end

local tactics={
    {id="together",name="Atacar juntos",manaCost=0,description="Golpe físico y ataque aliado. 1 acción, sin maná."},
    {id="protect",name="Defender a la compañera",manaCost=0,description="6 escudo para ella, 3 para Rudy. 1 acción, sin maná."},
    {id="assist",name="Dejar que ella ataque",manaCost=0,description="Actúa según su especialidad. 1 acción, sin maná de Rudy."},
    {id="coordinate",name="Coordinar magia y espada",manaCost=3,description="Combinación ofensiva o curación. 1 acción, 3 maná."},
    {id="retreat",name="Retroceder juntos",manaCost=0,description="4 escudo para ambos y 2 maná. 1 acción."},
    {id="group",name="Proteger al grupo",manaCost=3,description="8 escudo para Rudy y compañera. 1 acción, 3 maná."},
}
Combat.tactics=tactics
local function tacticalDefinition(id)
    for _,value in ipairs(tactics) do if value.id==id then return value end end
end
function Combat.canTactic(enc,id)
    local t=tacticalDefinition(id)
    if not enc or enc.finished then return false,"El combate ya terminó." end
    if not t then return false,"Táctica desconocida." end
    if not enc.companion then return false,"No hay compañera en esta misión." end
    if enc.companion.hp<=0 then return false,"La compañera necesita recuperarse en el punto seguro." end
    if enc.perTurn.companion then return false,"Tu compañera ya actuó este turno." end
    if enc.energy<1 then return false,"La coordinación consume una acción de Rudy." end
    local field=resourceField(enc,t)
    if not field or enc.player[field]<t.manaCost then return false,"Energía mágica insuficiente. Puedes dejarla actuar sin maná." end
    return true
end
local function relationshipTactic(enc,id,result)
    -- Una decisión contextual por encuentro. Jugar ataques nunca entrega amor.
    if #enc.relationshipEvents>0 then return end
    local ally=enc.companion
    local hits=enc.balanceVersion==1 and 1 or (enc.enemy.intent.hits or 1)
    local threat=enc.enemy.intent.kind=="attack" and (enc.enemy.intent.damage*hits>=8 or (enc.enemy.intent.companionDamage or 0)>=3)
    local injured=ally.hp<=ally.maxHp/2 or enc.context.tacticalContext.companionInjured==true
    local danger=threat or enc.context.tacticalContext.danger==true
    local love,trust,reason=1,2,"Coordinación responsable ante una amenaza compartida."
    if id=="protect" then
        if injured or danger then love,trust,reason=3,4,"La protección respondió a una herida o peligro real."
        elseif ally.id=="eris" then love,trust,reason=-2,-3,"Eris tenía el combate controlado; Rudy le impidió actuar."
        else love,trust,reason=0,0,"Una precaución innecesaria; conversarán sobre ella al volver." end
    elseif id=="assist" and injured then love,trust,reason=-3,-4,"Rudy exigió atacar a una compañera que necesitaba descanso."
    elseif id=="coordinate" and ally.id=="roxy" then love,trust,reason=3,4,"Rudy escuchó el análisis de Roxy y conjugó con ella como igual."
    elseif id=="together" and ally.id=="eris" then love,trust,reason=3,4,"Eris y Rudy respetaron sus capacidades y lucharon juntos."
    elseif id=="group" and ally.id=="sylphiette" and danger then love,trust,reason=3,4,"Sylphiette coordinó una defensa necesaria de todo el grupo."
    elseif id=="retreat" then
        love,trust,reason=injured and 2 or 0,injured and 3 or 0,injured and "La retirada permitió cuidar una herida real." or "Retrocedieron para reorganizarse, sin premio sentimental automático."
    end
    enc.relationshipEvents[1]={id="combat_tactic_"..enc.enemy.id.."_"..ally.id,character=ally.id,love=love,trust=trust,
        context="combat",choice=id,reason=reason,sharedMoment="battle_"..enc.enemy.id}
    event(result,"relationship_pending","companion",reason.." La interpretación se confirmará al resolver la batalla.")
end
function Combat.tactic(enc,id,expectedRevision)
    if expectedRevision~=nil and expectedRevision~=enc.revision then return nil,"Esta acción ya fue procesada." end
    local ok,err=Combat.canTactic(enc,id);if not ok then return nil,err end
    local t=tacticalDefinition(id);local ally=enc.companion
    local result={events={},actionName=t.name,companionAction=id,companionId=ally.id}
    local field=resourceField(enc,t)
    enc.energy=enc.energy-1;enc.player[field]=enc.player[field]-t.manaCost;enc.perTurn.companion=true
    enc.tacticalDecisions[#enc.tacticalDecisions+1]={id=id,turn=enc.turn,companionHp=ally.hp}
    relationshipTactic(enc,id,result)
    event(result,"companion_action","companion",ally.name..": "..t.name..". Coste: 1 acción, "..t.manaCost.." "..resourceName(field)..".")
    local function guard(target,amount)
        enc[target].shield=enc[target].shield+amount
        if target=="player" then enc.player.physicalShield=enc.player.physicalShield+amount end
        event(result,"shield",target,label(target).." gana "..amount.." escudo.",{amount=amount})
    end
    local function heal(amount)
        if enc.balanceVersion~=1 and enc.companionHeals>=R.companionHealUses then
            event(result,"recovery_exhausted","companion",ally.name.." agotó sus "..R.companionHealUses.." curaciones; aún puede atacar y proteger.")
            return
        end
        local gained=math.min(amount,enc.player.maxHp-enc.player.hp);enc.player.hp=enc.player.hp+gained
        if gained>0 then enc.companionHeals=enc.companionHeals+1 end
        local remaining=enc.balanceVersion==1 and "" or (" Quedan "..(R.companionHealUses-enc.companionHeals).." curaciones.")
        event(result,"heal","player",ally.name.." cura "..gained.." vida a Rudy."..remaining,{amount=gained})
    end
    if id=="protect" then guard("companion",6);guard("player",3)
    elseif id=="group" then guard("companion",8);guard("player",8)
    elseif id=="retreat" then guard("companion",4);guard("player",4);local pool=enc.context.curse.manaBlocked and "externalEnergy" or "mana"
        enc.player[pool]=math.min(pool=="mana" and enc.player.maxMana or enc.player.maxExternalEnergy,enc.player[pool]+2)
    else
        local power=ally.id=="eris" and 10 or ally.id=="roxy" and 8 or 4
        if id=="together" then power=power+3 end
        if id=="coordinate" then power=power+4 end
        damage(enc,"enemy",power,result)
        if ally.id=="sylphiette" then heal(id=="coordinate" and 5 or 3);guard("player",3)
        elseif ally.id=="roxy" then
            enc.enemy.weak=math.max(1,enc.enemy.weak)
            local element=({water="de agua",earth="de tierra"})[enc.enemy.weakness] or enc.enemy.weakness
            event(result,"status","enemy","Roxy analiza la respuesta "..element.." del enemigo y reduce su siguiente ataque.",{status="weak",amount=1})
        elseif ally.id=="eris" and id=="coordinate" then
            enc.enemy.weak=math.max(1,enc.enemy.weak)
            event(result,"status","enemy","Eris interrumpe el avance enemigo: su próximo golpe pierde 2 de daño.",{status="weak",amount=1})
        end
    end
    updateIntent(enc,result);checkOutcome(enc,result)
    return record(enc,result,{kind="tactic",id=id})
end

function Combat.endTurn(enc,expectedRevision)
    if expectedRevision~=nil and expectedRevision~=enc.revision then return nil,"Esta acción ya fue procesada." end
    if enc.finished then return nil,"El combate ya terminó." end
    if enc.training then
        local available=Combat.canBasic(enc,"counter")==true
        for index,id in ipairs(enc.hand) do
            local card=Combat.card(id)
            if card and (card.effects.damage or 0)>0 and Combat.canPlay(enc,index) then available=true;break end
        end
        Training.beforeEndTurn(enc,available)
    end
    local result={events={},turn=enc.turn,enemyAction=enc.enemy.intent.id,actionName=enc.enemy.intent.name}
    local amount=#enc.hand
    for _,id in ipairs(enc.hand) do enc.discard[#enc.discard+1]=id end
    enc.hand={}
    if amount>0 then event(result,"discard","player","Fin de turno: se descartan "..amount.." cartas de la mano.",{amount=amount}) end
    -- Los estados de Rudy duran su turno completo. Los de la anomalía se
    -- consumen durante su propia acción; vulnerabilidad dura el turno de Rudy.
    enc.player.weak=math.max(0,enc.player.weak-1)
    enc.player.vulnerable=math.max(0,enc.player.vulnerable-1)
    enc.enemy.vulnerable=math.max(0,enc.enemy.vulnerable-1)
    if enc.enemy.shield>0 then
        event(result,"shield_expire","enemy","El escudo anterior de la anomalía desaparece.",{amount=enc.enemy.shield})
        enc.enemy.shield=0
    end
    local action=activeAction(enc)
    enc.enemy.actionUses[action.id]=(enc.enemy.actionUses[action.id] or 0)+1
    event(result,"enemy_action","enemy",enc.enemy.name.." utiliza "..action.name..".")
    if action.kind=="attack" then
        for _=1,(action.hits or 1) do if enc.player.hp>0 then damage(enc,"player",action.damage,result) end end
        if enc.companion and enc.companion.hp>0 and action.companionDamage then damage(enc,"companion",action.companionDamage,result) end
    elseif action.kind=="shield" then
        enc.enemy.shield=action.shield
        event(result,"shield","enemy","La anomalía gana "..action.shield.." escudo.",{amount=action.shield})
    elseif action.kind=="prepare" then
        event(result,"prepare","enemy","Acumula maná: su siguiente acción será un ataque de "..action.nextDamage.." daño.",{amount=action.nextDamage})
    elseif action.kind=="status" then
        enc.player[action.status]=action.duration
        event(result,"status","player","Rudy recibe debilitamiento: -2 daño por golpe durante su próximo turno.",{status=action.status,amount=action.duration})
    elseif action.kind=="interrupt" then
        event(result,"interrupt","player","Rudy pierde "..action.actionLoss.." acción en su próximo turno. Puede seguir usando defensa o cartas.",{amount=action.actionLoss})
    elseif action.kind=="recover" then
        event(result,"recovery_exhausted","enemy","El enemigo agotó sus recuperaciones de escudo.")
    end
    enc.enemy.weak=math.max(0,enc.enemy.weak-1)
    if not checkOutcome(enc,result) then
        if enc.turn>=enc.maxTurns then
            enc.player.hp=0
            finish(enc,"defeat",result,"La amenaza te supera tras "..enc.maxTurns.." turnos. Regresa al punto seguro o reintenta.")
        else
            if enc.player.shield>0 then
                event(result,"shield_expire","player","El escudo normal de Rudy desaparece al comenzar su turno.",{amount=enc.player.shield})
            end
            enc.player.shield=0;enc.player.physicalShield=0;enc.player.magicShield=0; enc.turn=enc.turn+1
            enc.energy=math.max(1,R.energy-(action.kind=="interrupt" and action.actionLoss or 0)); enc.perTurn={}
            local pool=enc.context.curse.manaBlocked and "externalEnergy" or "mana"
            local maximum=pool=="mana" and enc.player.maxMana or enc.player.maxExternalEnergy
            local manaGain=math.min(R.manaRegen,maximum-enc.player[pool])
            enc.player[pool]=enc.player[pool]+manaGain
            if enc.companion then enc.companion.shield=0 end
            event(result,"mana","player","Recarga de turno: +"..manaGain.." "..resourceName(pool)..".",{amount=manaGain})
            draw(enc,math.max(0,R.handSize-#enc.hand),result)
            enc.enemy.actionIndex=enc.enemy.actionIndex%#enc.enemy.actions+1
            intent(enc)
            event(result,"intent","enemy","Próxima intención: "..enc.enemy.intent.text)
        end
    end
    return record(enc,result,{kind="endTurn"})
end

function Combat.canBasic(enc,id)
    if not enc or enc.finished then return false,"El combate ya terminó." end
    if id~="defend" and id~="dodge" and id~="counter" then return false,"Acción básica desconocida." end
    if id=="counter" and (not enc.training or not enc.training.counterReady) then
        return false,"Bloquea o esquiva un ataque real para abrir un contraataque en el turno siguiente."
    end
    if enc.energy<1 then return false,"Necesita una acción." end
    if enc.perTurn[id] then return false,"Una vez por turno." end
    return true
end
function Combat.basic(enc,id,expectedRevision)
    if expectedRevision and expectedRevision~=enc.revision then return nil,"Esta acción ya fue procesada." end
    local ok,err=Combat.canBasic(enc,id);if not ok then return nil,err end
    enc.energy=enc.energy-1;enc.perTurn[id]=true
    if id=="counter" then
        enc.training.counterReady=false
        local result={events={},actionName="Contraataque de entrenamiento"}
        event(result,"counter","player","Rudy aprovecha la apertura defensiva con su bastón. Coste: 1 acción, sin maná.")
        damage(enc,"enemy",Training.config(enc).counter.damage,result)
        updateIntent(enc,result);checkOutcome(enc,result)
        return record(enc,result,{kind="basic",id=id})
    end
    local amount=id=="defend" and 5 or 3
    enc.player.shield=enc.player.shield+amount;enc.player.physicalShield=enc.player.physicalShield+amount
    local result={events={},actionName=id=="defend" and "Defensa básica" or "Esquiva"}
    event(result,"shield","player",result.actionName..": +"..amount.." escudo físico sin maná ni carta.",{amount=amount})
    return record(enc,result,{kind="basic",id=id})
end
function Combat.canBreakSeal(enc)
    return enc and not enc.finished and enc.enemy.phase=="seal" and not enc.enemy.sealBroken and enc.energy>=1
end
function Combat.breakSeal(enc,expectedRevision)
    if expectedRevision and expectedRevision~=enc.revision then return nil,"Esta acción ya fue procesada." end
    if not Combat.canBreakSeal(enc) then return nil,"Agota la resistencia de Badigadi y reserva una acción para el sello." end
    enc.energy=enc.energy-1;enc.enemy.seal=math.max(0,enc.enemy.seal-6)
    local result={events={},actionName="Neutralizar el sello"}
    event(result,"seal","enemy","Rudy golpea los anclajes expuestos del sello: "..enc.enemy.seal.." resistencia restante.",{amount=6})
    if enc.enemy.seal==0 then enc.enemy.sealBroken=true;enc.enemy.phase="victory" end
    checkOutcome(enc,result)
    return record(enc,result,{kind="breakSeal"})
end
function Combat.retry(enc)
    return start(enc.deck,enc.context,enc.initial,enc.balanceVersion==1)
end

-- Reproduce el combate desde la apertura y compara todos los campos de reglas.
-- No confía en vida/energía/resultados escritos en JSON, ni aplica recompensas.
function Combat.restore(snapshot,deck,context)
    if type(snapshot)~="table" or snapshot.type~="combat" or snapshot.version~=2 then return nil end
    local adapted,_,adjustments=Combat.adaptDeck(deck,context); if not adapted then return nil end
    context=contextFor(context)
    -- Los combates v3 de campaña anteriores no tenían versión de balance ni
    -- presupuestos. Se reproducen con sus reglas originales hasta finalizarlos;
    -- nunca se sortea otra mano ni se cambia el enemigo a mitad de la batalla.
    local oldSnapshot=snapshot.balanceVersion==nil and snapshot.perBattle==nil and snapshot.companionHeals==nil
        and type(snapshot.enemy)=="table" and snapshot.enemy.actionUses==nil
        and type(snapshot.context)=="table" and snapshot.context.day==nil and snapshot.context.difficulty==nil
    local legacyBalance=oldSnapshot or snapshot.balanceVersion==1
    if snapshot.balanceVersion~=nil and snapshot.balanceVersion~=1 and snapshot.balanceVersion~=2 then return nil end
    if legacyBalance then context.day=nil;context.difficulty=nil end
    if not same(snapshot.context,context) or not same(snapshot.deck,adapted) then return nil end
    local initial=snapshot.initial
    if type(initial)~="table" or not integer(initial.seed,1,2147483646) or type(initial.pile)~="table" or #initial.pile~=#adapted then return nil end
    local expected={}; for _,id in ipairs(adapted) do expected[id]=true end
    for _,id in ipairs(initial.pile) do if not expected[id] then return nil end; expected[id]=nil end
    if next(expected) then return nil end
    if type(snapshot.commands)~="table" or #snapshot.commands>1000 then return nil end
    local restored=start(adapted,context,initial,legacyBalance)
    for _,command in ipairs(snapshot.commands) do
        if type(command)~="table" or restored.finished then return nil end
        if command.kind=="play" then
            if not integer(command.index,1,#restored.hand) or restored.hand[command.index]~=command.cardId then return nil end
            if not Combat.play(restored,command.index,restored.revision) then return nil end
        elseif command.kind=="endTurn" then
            if not Combat.endTurn(restored,restored.revision) then return nil end
        elseif command.kind=="basic" then
            if not Combat.basic(restored,command.id,restored.revision) then return nil end
        elseif command.kind=="breakSeal" then
            if not Combat.breakSeal(restored,restored.revision) then return nil end
        elseif command.kind=="tactic" then
            if not Combat.tactic(restored,command.id,restored.revision) then return nil end
        else return nil end
    end
    for _,key in ipairs({"player","enemy","hand","drawPile","discard","energy","turn","maxTurns","revision",
        "finished","outcome","cause","perTurn","perBattle","companionHeals","randomState","commands","log","resultEvents","companion","relationshipEvents","tacticalDecisions","training","trainingResult"}) do
        local expected=restored[key]
        if oldSnapshot and key=="enemy" then expected=copy(expected);expected.actionUses=nil end
        if not (oldSnapshot and (key=="perBattle" or key=="companionHeals")) and not same(expected,snapshot[key]) then return nil end
    end
    restored.deckAdjustments=adjustments
    if type(snapshot.tutorial)=="table" then
        restored.tutorial={}
        for key,value in pairs(snapshot.tutorial) do
            if type(key)=="string" and #key<64 and (type(value)=="boolean" or (type(value)=="string" and #value<128)
                or integer(value,0,1000)) then restored.tutorial[key]=value end
        end
    end
    return restored
end

return Combat
````

````lua
-- La guía observa acciones reales del motor. No aplica daño ni concede energía.
local Tutorial={}
local stages={attack=true,attack_result=true,shield=true,end_turn=true,enemy_result=true,free=true,complete=true}

function Tutorial.restore(value,enc)
    if type(value)~="table" or not stages[value.stage] then value={stage="attack"} end
    local cards={};for _,id in ipairs(enc.deck) do cards[id]=true end
    -- Un mazo editado sigue siendo legal; la guía no exige una carta retirada.
    if not cards.staff_strike then value.stage="free" end
    if enc.finished then value.stage="complete" end
    return {stage=value.stage}
end

function Tutorial.canPlay(tutorial,card)
    if not tutorial or tutorial.stage=="free" then return true end
    if tutorial.stage=="attack" and card and card.id=="staff_strike" then return true end
    if tutorial.stage=="shield" then return false,"Pulsa Defensa [D]: siempre disponible sin carta ni magia." end
    if tutorial.stage=="attack" then return false,"Primero selecciona Golpe de bastón y confirma Jugar." end
    if tutorial.stage=="end_turn" then return false,"Pulsa Terminar turno para observar al enemigo." end
    return false,"Lee la demostración y pulsa Entendido."
end

function Tutorial.canEndTurn(tutorial)
    return not tutorial or tutorial.stage=="end_turn" or tutorial.stage=="free"
end

function Tutorial.played(tutorial,cardId)
    if not tutorial then return end
    if tutorial.stage=="attack" and cardId=="staff_strike" then tutorial.stage="attack_result"
    elseif tutorial.stage=="shield" and cardId=="defend" then tutorial.stage="end_turn" end
end

function Tutorial.endedTurn(tutorial)
    if tutorial and tutorial.stage=="end_turn" then tutorial.stage="enemy_result" end
end

function Tutorial.advance(tutorial)
    if not tutorial then return false end
    if tutorial.stage=="attack_result" then tutorial.stage="shield"; return true end
    if tutorial.stage=="enemy_result" then tutorial.stage="free"; return true end
    return false
end

function Tutorial.message(tutorial,enc)
    if not tutorial then return nil end
    local stage=tutorial.stage
    if stage=="attack" then
        return "NANAHOSHI · 1/6: ATACAR","Golpe de bastón [1]: 1 acción y 0 maná; causa 4 daño. Seleccionar inspecciona; Jugar [Enter] confirma."
    elseif stage=="attack_result" then
        return "2/6: VIDA E INTENCIÓN","Enemigo: 22 > "..enc.enemy.hp.." PV. La intención anuncia 4 daño. No gastaste maná: la maldición sigue activa.",true
    elseif stage=="shield" then
        return "3/6: PROTEGERSE","Defensa básica [D]: 1 acción, sin magia ni carta. Ganarás 5 escudo, suficiente para el ataque anunciado."
    elseif stage=="end_turn" then
        return "4/6: TURNO ENEMIGO","Tienes 5 escudo. Terminar turno [E] ejecuta el ataque de 4 daño y descarta la mano restante."
    elseif stage=="enemy_result" then
        return "5/6: DAÑO Y BLOQUEO","El escudo absorbió el golpe. Rudy: "..enc.player.hp.."/30. Nueva mano, 3 acciones y maná natural bloqueado. El escudo caduca.",true
    elseif stage=="free" then
        return "6/6: DERROTA A LA ANOMALÍA","Usa tus ataques hasta llevar su vida a 0. Puedes jugar varias cartas por turno. Revisa la intención antes de terminar."
    end
end

return Tutorial
````

````lua
-- Lenguaje cerrado de requisitos narrativos: solo tablas y valores, nunca código.
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local Conditions={}
local function scalar(value)
    local kind=type(value)
    return kind=="string" or kind=="boolean" or (kind=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge)
end
local function identifier(value) return type(value)=="string" and value:match("^[%w_]+$")~=nil end
local function list(value)
    if type(value)~="table" or #value==0 then return false end
    for key in pairs(value) do if type(key)~="number" or key%1~=0 or key<1 or key>#value then return false end end
    return true
end

function Conditions.validate(condition)
    local seen={}
    local function validate(node,depth)
        if node==nil then return true end
        if type(node)~="table" or depth>24 or seen[node] then return false,"Condición inválida o demasiado profunda." end
        seen[node]=true
        local kind,allowed
        for _,candidate in ipairs({"all","any","not","event","decision","relationship","affinity","route","marriage","familyReady"}) do
            if node[candidate]~=nil then
                if kind then return false,"Una condición debe declarar un solo operador." end
                kind=candidate
            end
        end
        if not kind then return false,"Operador de condición desconocido." end
        if kind=="all" or kind=="any" then
            allowed={[kind]=true}
            if not list(node[kind]) then return false,"all/any requiere una lista no vacía." end
            for _,child in ipairs(node[kind]) do
                local ok,err=validate(child,depth+1)
                if not ok then return false,err end
            end
        elseif kind=="not" then
            allowed={['not']=true}
            local ok,err=validate(node['not'],depth+1)
            if not ok then return false,err end
        elseif kind=="event" then
            allowed={event=true,equals=true}
            if not identifier(node.event) or (node.equals~=nil and type(node.equals)~="boolean") then
                return false,"Evento o comparación de evento inválidos."
            end
        elseif kind=="decision" then
            allowed={decision=true,equals=true,oneOf=true}
            if not identifier(node.decision) or (node.equals~=nil)==(node.oneOf~=nil) then
                return false,"Una decisión requiere equals o oneOf."
            end
            if node.oneOf~=nil then
                if not list(node.oneOf) then return false,"oneOf requiere una lista no vacía." end
                for _,value in ipairs(node.oneOf) do if not scalar(value) then return false,"Valor inválido en oneOf." end end
            elseif not scalar(node.equals) then return false,"Valor inválido en equals." end
        elseif kind=="relationship" then
            allowed={relationship=true,trust=true,chemistry=true,love=true,personalEvent=true,commitment=true}
            local character=Characters.byId[node.relationship]
            if node.relationship~="companion" and not (character and character.romance) then return false,"Relación desconocida." end
            if node.trust==nil and node.chemistry==nil and node.love==nil and node.personalEvent==nil and node.commitment==nil then return false,"La relación necesita un umbral." end
            if node.personalEvent~=nil and not identifier(node.personalEvent) then return false,"Evento personal inválido." end
            if node.commitment~=nil and type(node.commitment)~="boolean" then return false,"Compromiso inválido." end
            for _,field in ipairs({"trust","chemistry","love"}) do
                local value=node[field]
                if value~=nil and (type(value)~="number" or value~=value or value<0 or value>100) then
                    return false,"Umbral de relación fuera de 0 a 100."
                end
            end
        elseif kind=="affinity" then
            allowed={affinity=true,trust=true,interest=true}
            if type(node.affinity)~="string" or not require("src.systems.affinity").config[node.affinity] then return false,"Afinidad desconocida." end
            if node.trust==nil and node.interest==nil then return false,"La afinidad necesita un umbral." end
            for _,field in ipairs({"trust","interest"}) do
                local value=node[field]
                if value~=nil and (type(value)~="number" or value~=value or value<0 or value>100) then return false,"Umbral de afinidad fuera de 0 a 100." end
            end
        elseif kind=="marriage" then
            allowed={marriage=true,viable=true}
            if not (Characters.byId[node.marriage] and Characters.byId[node.marriage].romance) or type(node.viable)~="boolean" then return false,"Estado matrimonial inválido." end
        elseif kind=="familyReady" then
            allowed={familyReady=true}
            if type(node.familyReady)~="boolean" then return false,"Estado familiar inválido." end
        elseif kind=="route" then
            allowed={route=true}
            if not (Characters.byId[node.route] and Characters.byId[node.route].romance) then return false,"Ruta desconocida." end
        end
        for key in pairs(node) do if not allowed[key] then return false,"Campo de condición desconocido: "..tostring(key) end end
        seen[node]=nil
        return true
    end
    return validate(condition,1)
end

function Conditions.evaluate(session,condition,context)
    if not Conditions.validate(condition) then return false end
    session,context=session or {},context or {}
    local function evaluate(node)
        if node==nil then return true end
        if node.all then
            for _,child in ipairs(node.all) do if not evaluate(child) then return false end end
            return true
        elseif node.any then
            for _,child in ipairs(node.any) do if evaluate(child) then return true end end
            return false
        elseif node['not'] then return not evaluate(node['not'])
        elseif node.event then
            local expected=node.equals~=false
            return ((session.events or {})[node.event]==true)==expected
        elseif node.decision then
            local value=(session.decisions or {})[node.decision]
            if node.oneOf then
                for _,candidate in ipairs(node.oneOf) do if value==candidate then return true end end
                return false
            end
            return value==node.equals
        elseif node.relationship then
            local character=node.relationship=="companion" and context.companion or node.relationship
            local value=(session.relationships or {})[character]
            return value~=nil and (value.trust or 0)>=(node.trust or 0) and (value.chemistry or value.love or 0)>=(node.chemistry or 0)
                and (value.love or value.chemistry or 0)>=(node.love or 0)
                and (not node.personalEvent or (value.events or {})[node.personalEvent]==true)
                and (node.commitment==nil or ((value.criticalDecisions or {}).commitment==true)==node.commitment)
        elseif node.affinity then
            local value=require("src.systems.affinity").get(session,node.affinity)
            return value~=nil and value.trust>=(node.trust or 0) and value.interest>=(node.interest or 0)
        elseif node.marriage then return (require("src.systems.relationships").canMaintain(session.relationships,node.marriage)==true)==node.viable
        elseif node.familyReady~=nil then return (require("src.systems.relationships").canUnite(session.relationships)==true)==node.familyReady
        elseif node.route then return session.route==node.route end
        return false
    end
    return evaluate(condition)
end

return Conditions
````

````lua
-- Avance explícito: una llamada mueve exactamente una línea.
local Dialogue = {}
Dialogue.__index = Dialogue

function Dialogue.new(scene, index)
    assert(type(scene) == "table" and type(scene.lines) == "table" and #scene.lines > 0,
        "La escena necesita al menos una línea")
    local first = tonumber(index) or 1
    first = math.max(1, math.min(#scene.lines, math.floor(first)))
    return setmetatable({scene=scene, index=first, ended=false}, Dialogue)
end

function Dialogue:current()
    return self.scene.lines[self.index]
end

function Dialogue:isLast()
    return self.index == #self.scene.lines
end

function Dialogue:advance()
    if self.ended then return true end
    if self.index < #self.scene.lines then
        self.index = self.index + 1
        return false
    end
    self.ended = true
    return true
end

return Dialogue
````

````lua
local Relationships=require("src.systems.relationships")
local Events=require("src.systems.events")
local Affinity=require("src.systems.affinity")
local Memory={}
local function copy(value)
    if type(value)~="table" then return value end
    local out={}; for k,v in pairs(value) do out[k]=copy(v) end; return out
end
Memory.copy=copy
local function map(value)
    local out={}
    for key,v in pairs(type(value)=="table" and value or {}) do
        if type(key)=="string" and #key<=150 and (type(v)=="boolean" or type(v)=="string" or (type(v)=="number" and v==v and math.abs(v)<100000)) then out[key]=v end
    end
    return out
end
function Memory.capture(session)
    session=session or {}
    local out={day=session.day or 1,checkpoint=session.checkpoint,relationships=Relationships.new(),affinities=Affinity.normalize(session.affinities),
        events=map(session.events),decisions=map(session.decisions),unlocked=map(session.unlocked),
        curse=copy(session.curse or {}),selectedCompanion=session.selectedCompanion,
        dialogueMemory={used=map(session.dialogueMemory and session.dialogueMemory.used)}}
    for id,r in pairs(out.relationships) do
        local value=(session.relationships or {})[id] or r
        for _,key in ipairs({"love","trust"}) do
            local n=value[key]; if type(n)=="number" and n==n then r[key]=math.max(0,math.min(100,n)) end
        end
        for _,key in ipairs({"events","decisions","criticalDecisions","promises","brokenPromises","sharedMoments","pendingConflicts","reconciliations"}) do r[key]=map(value[key]) end
        r.personalEvents=r.events
        if value.marriageState=="separated" then r.marriageState="separated" end
        Relationships.refresh(r)
    end
    return out
end
function Memory.key(scene,turn) return "social_"..scene.."_"..turn end
function Memory.commit(session,result,scene,turn)
    local key=Memory.key(scene,turn)
    session.events=session.events or {}
    if session.events[key] then return false end
    local effect=copy(result.narrativeEffects or {})
    effect.character=result.character
    effect.love=result.chemistry or 0; effect.trust=result.trust or 0
    local affinity=Affinity.config[result.character]~=nil
    if affinity then effect.love,effect.trust=0,0 end
    effect.decision="dialogue_"..scene; effect.value=result.nextNode or result.responseId or "pause"
    effect.context="social_card"; effect.text=(result.phrase~="" and result.phrase) or "Rudy escucha en silencio."
    -- Las flags de conversación son eventos consultables, no nuevas identidades.
    effect.batch={}
    for _,flag in ipairs(result.flags or {}) do
        effect.batch[#effect.batch+1]={decision=flag,value=true,text=effect.text}
    end
    local delta=affinity and Affinity.preview(session,result.character,result) or Relationships.preview(session.relationships,result.character,effect)
    local applied,err=Events.apply(session,key,effect)
    if not applied then return false,err end
    if affinity then
        local _,actual=Affinity.apply(session,result.character,result,key)
        delta=actual
        result.affinityTarget=result.character
        result.actualInterest=delta.interest or 0
        result.affinityBefore,result.affinityAfter=delta.before,delta.after
    end
    for _,flag in ipairs(result.flags or {}) do session.events[flag]=true end
    session.decisions[key]=result.cardId
    session.dialogueMemory=session.dialogueMemory or {used={}}
    local used=session.dialogueMemory.used
    if result.responseId then used[result.responseId]=(tonumber(used[result.responseId]) or 0)+1 end
    result.actualLove,result.actualTrust=delta.love or 0,delta.trust or 0
    result.applied=true
    return true
end
return Memory
````

## src/systems/dialogue_resolver.lua

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/src/systems/dialogue_resolver.lua`

````lua
local Catalog=require("src.data.dialogue")
local Conditions=require("src.systems.conditions")
local Memory=require("src.systems.dialogue_memory")
local Data=require("src.data.cards")
local Affinity=require("src.systems.affinity")
local Resolver={}
function Resolver.node(context)
    local id=context and Catalog.encounters[context.sceneId]
    return id and Catalog.nodes[id]
end
function Resolver.compatible(card,context)
    local node=Resolver.node(context)
    if not node then return false,"Esta escena no tiene una conversación escrita." end
    if not card or not node.cards[card.id] then return false,"Esta carta no tiene una respuesta escrita para esta conversación." end
    if context.unlocked and not context.unlocked[card.id] then return false,"La carta todavía está bloqueada." end
    local c=card.conditions or {}
    if c.character and c.character~=node.character then return false,"Esta carta necesita a otra compañera." end
    if c.kind and c.kind~=context.kind then return false,"La intención no es compatible con este encuentro." end
    return true
end
local function chosen(base,state)
    local best,priority,uses=nil,-math.huge,math.huge
    for _,variant in ipairs(base.variants or {}) do
        if Conditions.evaluate(state,variant.requires,{companion=state.selectedCompanion}) then
            local p=variant.priority or 0
            local n=tonumber(((state.dialogueMemory or {}).used or {})[variant.id]) or 0
            if p>priority or (p==priority and n<uses) then best,priority,uses=variant,p,n end
        end
    end
    local out=Memory.copy(base)
    for key,value in pairs(best or {}) do if key~="requires" and key~="priority" then out[key]=Memory.copy(value) end end
    return out
end
function Resolver.resolve(context,cardId,state)
    local node=Resolver.node(context)
    if not node then return nil end
    local base=cardId=="pass" and node.fallback or node.cards[cardId]
    if not base then return nil end
    state=state or context.memory or Memory.capture()
    local response=chosen(base,state)
    local effect=response.effects or {}
    local result={cardId=cardId,character=node.character,conversationId=node.id,responseId=response.id,
        phrase=response.rudy,reaction=response.response,expression=response.expression or "neutral",animation=response.animation,
        score=effect.score or 0,trust=effect.trust or 0,chemistry=effect.love or 0,interest=effect.interest or 0,
        nextNode=response.next,flags=Memory.copy(response.flags or {}),narrativeEffects={},sequence={},tone=Data.byId[cardId] and Data.byId[cardId].tone}
    if Affinity.config[node.character] then
        local sanitized=Affinity.sanitize(node.character,result)
        result.trust,result.interest,result.chemistry=sanitized.trust,sanitized.interest,0
        if context.affinityDisabled then result.trust,result.interest=0,0; result.affinitySuppressed=true end
        result.affinityTarget=node.character
    else result.interest=0 end
    for _,key in ipairs({"promise","conflict","reconcile","sharedMoment","critical","relationshipEvent"}) do result.narrativeEffects[key]=Memory.copy(response[key]) end
    if response.rudy and response.rudy~="" then
        result.sequence[#result.sequence+1]={speaker="rudeus",delivery=cardId=="pass" and "note" or "enchanted",expression="neutral",text=response.rudy}
    end
    result.sequence[#result.sequence+1]={speaker=node.character,expression=result.expression,animation=result.animation,text=response.response,apply=true}
    local visited={}; local nextId=response.next
    while nextId do
        assert(not visited[nextId],"Ciclo de continuación: "..nextId); visited[nextId]=true
        local nextNode=assert(Catalog.nodes[nextId],"Continuación desconocida: "..nextId)
        result.sequence[#result.sequence+1]={speaker=nextNode.character,expression=nextNode.expression or "neutral",text=nextNode.text}
        for _,line in ipairs(nextNode.lines or {}) do result.sequence[#result.sequence+1]=Memory.copy(line) end
        nextId=nextNode.next
    end
    return result
end
function Resolver.context(session,definition,sceneId)
    return {kind=definition.kind,character=definition.character,sceneId=sceneId or session.checkpoint,
        curse=Memory.copy(session.curse),unlocked=Memory.copy(session.unlocked),memory=Memory.capture(session)}
end
return Resolver
````

````lua
-- Validador y reporte del contenido escrito; no modifica partidas ni diálogos.
local Cards=require("src.data.cards")
local CombatCards=require("src.data.combat_cards")
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local Conditions=require("src.systems.conditions")
local Assets=require("src.data.assets")
local Animation=require("src.systems.animation")
local Affinity=require("src.systems.affinity")
local Validator={}
local function identifier(value) return type(value)=="string" and value:match("^[%w_]+$")~=nil end
local function finite(value) return type(value)=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge end
local function occurrences(text,part)
 local count,start=0,1
 while true do local first,last=text:find(part,start,true); if not first then return count end; count=count+1; start=last+1 end
end
local function merged(base,variant)
 local out={}; for key,value in pairs(base) do out[key]=value end
 for key,value in pairs(variant or {}) do out[key]=value end; return out
end
local function eligible(card,node,kind)
 local condition=card.conditions or {}
 return card.encounterTypes and card.encounterTypes.social and (card.unlockedAt or 1)<=node.day
  and (not condition.character or condition.character==node.character)
  and (not condition.kind or condition.kind==kind)
end
local function sequences(ids,maxTurns,energy)
 local used,counts={},{}
 local function visit(depth,left)
  if depth>=maxTurns then return end
  for _,id in ipairs(ids) do
   local cost=Cards.byId[id].cost
   if not used[id] and cost<=left then
    counts[depth+1]=(counts[depth+1] or 0)+1
    used[id]=true; visit(depth+1,left-cost); used[id]=nil
   end
  end
 end
 visit(0,energy)
 local total=0; for _,count in pairs(counts) do total=total+count end
 return {byLength=counts,total=total,maxTurns=maxTurns,energy=energy}
end

local function validate(catalog,options)
 catalog=catalog or require("src.data.dialogue"); options=options or {}
 local chapters=options.chapters or require("src.data.chapters")
 local errors,ids,graph,conditionChecks={},{},{},{}
 local report={nodes=0,conversations=0,responses=0,variants=0,fallbacks=0,branches=0,
  classifications={social=0,hybrid=0,combat=0,narrative=0},storyObjects={},coverage={},sequenceCounts={},totalSequences=0}
 local function fail(where,message) errors[#errors+1]=tostring(where)..": "..message end
 local function register(id,where)
  if not identifier(id) then fail(where,"identificador inválido")
  elseif ids[id] then fail(where,"identificador duplicado: "..id)
  else ids[id]=true end
 end
 local function data(value,where,seen)
  if type(value)=="table" then
   if seen[value] then fail(where,"tabla circular"); return false end
   seen[value]=true; local ok=true
   for key,item in pairs(value) do
    if type(key)~="string" and type(key)~="number" then fail(where,"clave no declarativa"); ok=false end
    if not data(item,where.."."..tostring(key),seen) then ok=false end
   end
   seen[value]=nil; return ok
  end
  if type(value)=="function" or type(value)=="userdata" or type(value)=="thread" then fail(where,"contenido ejecutable"); return false end
  return true
 end
 if type(catalog)~="table" or type(catalog.nodes)~="table" or type(catalog.encounters)~="table" then
  return false,{"Catálogo de conversaciones inválido."},report
 end
 if not data(catalog,"conversaciones",{}) then return false,errors,report end
 local affinityCards=0
 for cardId in pairs(Affinity.config.nanahoshi.positiveCards) do
  affinityCards=affinityCards+1
  if not Affinity.canInterest("nanahoshi",cardId) then fail("afinidad/"..cardId,"el interés requiere una carta social real, no híbrida") end
 end
 if affinityCards~=5 then fail("afinidad/nanahoshi","deben existir exactamente cinco cartas con interés positivo") end
 for _,message in ipairs(catalog.buildErrors or {}) do errors[#errors+1]=message end
 local function text(value,where,allowEmpty)
  if type(value)~="string" or (not allowEmpty and not value:find("%S")) then fail(where,"texto escrito vacío o inválido"); return end
  if occurrences(value,"¿")~=occurrences(value,"?") or occurrences(value,"¡")~=occurrences(value,"!") then fail(where,"signos de interrogación o exclamación sin pareja") end
  for _,mark in ipairs({"?.","!.","??","!!","¿¿","¡¡","...."}) do
   if value:find(mark,1,true) then fail(where,"puntuación mal formada: "..mark) end
  end
 end
 local function expression(value,where)
  if type(value)~="string" or Characters.expressions[value]==nil then fail(where,"expresión desconocida") end
 end
 local function character(value,where)
  if type(value)~="string" or not Characters.byId[value] then fail(where,"personaje desconocido") end
 end

  for _,line in ipairs(value.lines or {}) do if type(line)=="table" then effect(line.stateEffect) end end

 for sceneId,node in pairs(chapters.checkpoints or {}) do
  definition(node.definition,sceneId)
  if node.kind=="encounter" then knownEvents["resolved_"..sceneId]=true; knownDecisions["outcome_"..sceneId]=true end
  if node.definition.training then
   for _,id in ipairs({"eris_training_rudy_victory","eris_training_honorable_defeat","eris_training_suspected_throw","eris_training_honest_defeat","eris_training_reconciled"}) do knownEvents[id]=true end
   knownDecisions.eris_training_result=true;knownDecisions.eris_training_last_result=true

    if type(key)~="number" or key%1~=0 or key<1 or key>#value.flags or not identifier(flag) then fail(where,"flag inválida")
    elseif flags[flag] then fail(where,"flag repetida")
    else flags[flag]=true; knownEvents[flag]=true; knownDecisions[flag]=true end

  end
  if value.promise~=nil then
   local promise=value.promise

  end

   or (type(value.critical.value)~="boolean" and type(value.critical.value)~="string")) then fail(where,"decisión crítica inválida") end
 end

 local function response(value,nodeId,where,fallback,isVariant,cardId)
  if type(value)~="table" then fail(where,"respuesta inválida"); return end
  register(value.id,where)
  text(value.rudy,where..".rudy",fallback)
  text(value.response,where..".response")
  expression(value.expression,where); animation(value.animation,where)
  if value.effects==nil and fallback then
   -- La pausa es gratuita y no recompensa; el resolver usa cero por defecto.
  elseif type(value.effects)~="table" then fail(where,"efectos ausentes o inválidos")
  else
   for _,field in ipairs({"score","love","trust"}) do
    if not finite(value.effects[field]) or math.abs(value.effects[field])>100 then fail(where,"efecto numérico inválido: "..field) end
    if fallback and value.effects[field]~=0 then fail(where,"la pausa no concede efectos") end
   end
   local interest=value.effects.interest
   if interest~=nil and (not finite(interest) or math.abs(interest)>100) then fail(where,"efecto numérico inválido: interest") end
   local participant=catalog.nodes[nodeId].character
   if Affinity.config[participant] then
    if value.effects.love~=0 then fail(where,"un vínculo no matrimonial no concede amor") end
    if finite(interest) and interest>0 then
     local config=Affinity.config[participant].positiveCards[cardId]
     if not Affinity.canInterest(participant,cardId) or not config or interest>config.maxInterest then fail(where,"carta sin permiso para conceder ese interés") end
    end
   elseif interest~=nil and interest~=0 then fail(where,"interés reservado a afinidad no matrimonial") end
   if fallback and interest~=nil and interest~=0 then fail(where,"la pausa no concede interés") end
   for key in pairs(value.effects) do if key~="score" and key~="love" and key~="trust" and key~="interest" then fail(where,"efecto desconocido: "..tostring(key)) end end
  end
  consequence(value,where)

  if isVariant then
   if value.requires==nil then fail(where,"variante sin condición") end
   local ok,err=Conditions.validate(value.requires)
   if not ok then fail(where,err) else conditionChecks[#conditionChecks+1]={value=value.requires,where=where} end
   if value.priority~=nil and not finite(value.priority) then fail(where,"prioridad no finita") end
  end
 end
 for id,node in pairs(catalog.nodes) do
  report.nodes=report.nodes+1
  if type(node)~="table" then fail(id,"nodo inválido")
  else
   register(node.id,id); if id~=node.id then fail(id,"clave distinta del ID del nodo") end
   character(node.character,id); text(node.text,id..".text")
   if node.cards~=nil then
    report.conversations=report.conversations+1
    if not finite(node.day) or node.day%1~=0 or node.day<1 or node.day>7 then fail(id,"día inválido") end
    if type(node.background)~="string" or not Assets.backgrounds[node.background] then fail(id,"fondo desconocido") end
    if type(node.emotion)~="string" or node.emotion=="" then fail(id,"contexto emocional ausente") end
    if type(node.cards)~="table" then fail(id,"cartas del nodo inválidas")
    else
     local phrases={}
     for cardId,base in pairs(node.cards) do
      local where=id.."/"..tostring(cardId)
      report.responses=report.responses+1
      local card=Cards.byId[cardId]
      if not card then fail(where,"carta social desconocida")
      elseif card.conditions.character and card.conditions.character~=node.character then fail(where,"carta exclusiva de otro personaje") end
      response(base,id,where,false,false,cardId)
      if type(base)=="table" then
       if type(base.rudy)=="string" and phrases[base.rudy] then fail(where,"dos cartas comparten la misma frase inicial") end
       if type(base.rudy)=="string" then phrases[base.rudy]=true end
       if base.variants~=nil and type(base.variants)~="table" then fail(where,"variantes inválidas")
       else for _,variant in ipairs(base.variants or {}) do
        report.variants=report.variants+1
        if type(variant)~="table" then fail(where,"variante inválida")
        else
         if not identifier(variant.id) then fail(where,"variante sin ID propio") end
         response(merged(base,variant),id,where.."/"..tostring(variant.id),false,true,cardId)
        end
       end end
      end
     end
    end
    report.fallbacks=report.fallbacks+1; response(node.fallback,id,id.."/pause",true,false)
   else
    expression(node.expression,id)
    if node.next~=nil then edge(id,node.next,id) end
   end
   if node.lines~=nil and type(node.lines)~="table" then fail(id,"secuencia de líneas inválida")
   else for index,line in ipairs(node.lines or {}) do
    local where=id..".lines."..index
    if type(line)~="table" then fail(where,"línea inválida")
    else
     if line.speaker~="narrator" then character(line.speaker,where) end
     expression(line.expression,where); text(line.text,where); animation(line.animation,where)
     if line.speaker=="rudeus" and not ({enchanted=true,thought=true,note=true,silence=true})[line.delivery] then fail(where,"Rudy necesita un canal de comunicación permitido") end
    end
   end end
  end
 end
 local mapped={}
 for sceneId,nodeId in pairs(catalog.encounters) do
  local node=catalog.nodes[nodeId]
  local checkpoint=(chapters.checkpoints or {})[sceneId=="nanahoshi_test" and "day1_tutorial" or sceneId]
  if not checkpoint or checkpoint.kind~="encounter" then fail(sceneId,"encuentro de campaña desconocido")
  elseif type(node)~="table" or type(node.cards)~="table" then fail(sceneId,"raíz de conversación inexistente")
  else
   mapped[nodeId]=true
   local kind=sceneId=="nanahoshi_test" and "conversation" or checkpoint.definition.kind
   local participant=sceneId=="nanahoshi_test" and "nanahoshi" or checkpoint.definition.character
   if node.character~=participant or node.day~=checkpoint.day then fail(sceneId,"personaje o día no coincide con el encuentro") end
   local row={scene=sceneId,node=nodeId,character=node.character,day=node.day,required={},extra={},missing={},written=0}
   for _,card in ipairs(Cards.list) do
    if eligible(card,node,kind) then
     row.required[#row.required+1]=card.id
     if not node.cards[card.id] then row.missing[#row.missing+1]=card.id; fail(sceneId,"sin respuesta para carta compatible: "..card.id) end
    elseif node.cards[card.id] then row.extra[#row.extra+1]=card.id end
   end
   for _ in pairs(node.cards) do row.written=row.written+1 end
   local maxTurns=math.min(3,math.max(1,tonumber(node.maxTurns) or 3))
   local count=sequences(row.required,maxTurns,4)
   row.sequences=count.total; report.sequenceCounts[sceneId]=count; report.totalSequences=report.totalSequences+count.total
   report.coverage[#report.coverage+1]=row
   knownDecisions["dialogue_"..sceneId]=true
   for turn=1,maxTurns do knownEvents["social_"..sceneId.."_"..turn]=true; knownDecisions["social_"..sceneId.."_"..turn]=true end
  end
 end
 for sceneId,node in pairs(chapters.checkpoints or {}) do
  if node.kind=="encounter" and node.definition.kind~="magic" and not catalog.encounters[sceneId] then fail(sceneId,"encuentro social sin catálogo escrito") end
 end
 local function references(condition,where)
  if not condition then return end
  if condition.event and not knownEvents[condition.event] then fail(where,"evento sin productor: "..condition.event) end
  if condition.decision and not knownDecisions[condition.decision] then fail(where,"decisión sin productor: "..condition.decision) end
  if condition.personalEvent and not personalEvents[condition.personalEvent] then fail(where,"evento personal sin productor: "..condition.personalEvent) end
  for _,child in ipairs(condition.all or condition.any or {}) do references(child,where) end
  if condition['not'] then references(condition['not'],where) end
 end
 for _,check in ipairs(conditionChecks) do references(check.value,check.where) end
 local visited,active,reachable={},{},{}
 local function visit(id)
  if active[id] then fail(id,"ciclo de continuaciones"); return end
  if visited[id] then return end
  active[id]=true
  for target in pairs(graph[id] or {}) do visit(target) end
  active[id]=nil; visited[id]=true
 end
 for id in pairs(catalog.nodes) do visit(id) end
 local function reach(id)
  if reachable[id] then return end; reachable[id]=true
  for target in pairs(graph[id] or {}) do reach(target) end
 end
 for id in pairs(mapped) do reach(id) end
 for id in pairs(catalog.nodes) do if not reachable[id] then fail(id,"nodo sin camino desde un encuentro") end end
 for _,card in ipairs(Cards.list) do
  local kind=card.combat and "hybrid" or "social"
  report.classifications[kind]=report.classifications[kind]+1
 end
 for _,card in ipairs(CombatCards.list) do
  if Cards.byId[card.id] then fail(card.id,"ID duplicado entre inventarios social y de combate") end
  report.classifications.combat=report.classifications.combat+1
 end
 for _ in pairs(require("src.data.documents")) do report.classifications.narrative=report.classifications.narrative+1 end
 for _,id in ipairs({"silence_potion","antidote"}) do
  if Assets.cardIcons[id] and not Cards.byId[id] and not CombatCards.byId[id] then report.storyObjects[#report.storyObjects+1]=id end
 end
 table.sort(report.coverage,function(a,b) return a.day==b.day and a.scene<b.scene or a.day<b.day end)
 return #errors==0,errors,report
end

function Validator.validate(catalog,options)
 local ok,valid,errors,report=pcall(validate,catalog,options)
 if not ok then return false,{"Estructura de conversaciones inválida: "..tostring(valid)},{} end
 return valid,errors,report
end
function Validator.assertValid(catalog,options)
 local ok,errors,report=Validator.validate(catalog,options)
 assert(ok,"Conversaciones inválidas:\n"..table.concat(errors,"\n")); return report
end
function Validator.report(catalog,options)
 catalog=catalog or require("src.data.dialogue")
 local valid,errors,report=Validator.validate(catalog,options)
 if not report.classifications then return "# Cobertura narrativa\n\nValidación fallida:\n\n- "..table.concat(errors,"\n- ").."\n" end
 local c=report.classifications
 local lines={"# Cobertura de conversaciones escritas","",
  string.format("Inventario real: **%d cartas sociales, %d híbridas y %d de combate** (%d cartas jugables). Además hay **%d documentos/pistas narrativos**, que no entran en los mazos.",c.social,c.hybrid,c.combat,c.social+c.hybrid+c.combat,c.narrative),"",
  "La poción del silencio (`silence_potion`) y el antídoto (`antidote`) son objetos de trama con iconos propios, fuera de ambos catálogos de cartas jugables. Tampoco se mezclan ni se roban como cartas sociales o de combate.","",
  string.format("**%d conversaciones de entrada, %d nodos totales, %d respuestas base, %d variantes escritas, %d pausas y %d conexiones distintas entre nodos.**",report.conversations,report.nodes,report.responses,report.variants,report.fallbacks,report.branches),"",
  "Las variantes consultan condiciones declaradas y tienen prioridad; no se construyen frases mezclando fragmentos. Las pausas no conceden puntos ni voz gratis.","",
  "## Cobertura por encuentro","","| Encuentro | Día | Respuestas escritas | Cartas disponibles por día | Extras importables | Secuencias posibles |","| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |"}
 for _,row in ipairs(report.coverage) do lines[#lines+1]=string.format("| `%s` | %d | %d | %d | %d | %d |",row.scene,row.day,row.written,#row.required,#row.extra,row.sequences) end
 lines[#lines+1]=""; lines[#lines+1]="`nanahoshi_test` es la fase social del checkpoint `day1_tutorial`, no una segunda campaña. Los extras tienen texto escrito para colecciones importadas; escribirlos no desbloquea sus cartas."
 lines[#lines+1]=""; lines[#lines+1]="## Matriz de cartas y respuestas"; lines[#lines+1]=""
 local header={"Carta"}; for _,row in ipairs(report.coverage) do header[#header+1]="`"..row.node.."`" end
 lines[#lines+1]="| "..table.concat(header," | ").." |"
 local separators={}; for _=1,#header do separators[#separators+1]="---" end
 lines[#lines+1]="| "..table.concat(separators," | ").." |"
 for _,card in ipairs(Cards.list) do
  local cells={"`"..card.id.."`"}
  for _,row in ipairs(report.coverage) do
   local required=false; for _,id in ipairs(row.required) do if id==card.id then required=true end end
   local written=catalog.nodes[row.node].cards[card.id]~=nil
   cells[#cells+1]=written and (required and "Sí" or "Importada") or (required and "FALTA" or "—")
  end
  lines[#lines+1]="| "..table.concat(cells," | ").." |"
 end
 lines[#lines+1]=""; lines[#lines+1]="Sí = respuesta compatible por día/personaje; Importada = cobertura adicional; — = fuera del conjunto normal de ese día o de esa esposa. Una combinación sin contenido no es jugable."
 lines[#lines+1]=""; lines[#lines+1]="## Alcance del cálculo"; lines[#lines+1]=""
 lines[#lines+1]=string.format("**%d secuencias locales posibles** sumadas entre encuentros: permutaciones de una a tres cartas distintas, coste social total máximo de cuatro, sobre toda la colección compatible disponible por día. No se cuentan pausas, cartas futuras importadas ni multiplicaciones por variantes.",report.totalSequences)
 lines[#lines+1]=""
 lines[#lines+1]="Es un espacio teórico de elecciones entre mazos y repartos posibles: cada partida usa solo su mazo equipado de cinco a diez cartas y su mano real. No son ese número de textos únicos ni una estimación de campañas completas; las condiciones, los costes de energía y el orden robado limitan cada recorrido."
 lines[#lines+1]=""; lines[#lines+1]=valid and "Validación: **correcta**." or "Validación: **fallida**."
 for _,message in ipairs(errors) do lines[#lines+1]="- "..message end
 return table.concat(lines,"\n").."\n"
end
return Validator
````

````lua
local Relationships=require("src.systems.relationships")
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local CardData=require("src.data.cards")
local Events={}
local states={pending=true,kept=true,broken=true}
local function knownCard(id)
    return CardData.byId[id] or require("src.data.combat_cards").byId[id]
end
local function validate(effect,depth)
    if type(effect)~="table" or (depth or 0)>4 then return false,"Efecto narrativo inválido." end
    if effect.character and not Characters.byId[effect.character] then return false,"Personaje desconocido." end
    if effect.clue and not require("src.data.documents")[effect.clue] then return false,"Documento desconocido." end
    if effect.promise and (type(effect.promise)~="table" or type(effect.promise.id)~="string"
        or not states[effect.promise.status]) then return false,"Promesa inválida." end
    if effect.critical and (type(effect.critical)~="table" or type(effect.critical.id)~="string"
        or (type(effect.critical.value)~="boolean" and type(effect.critical.value)~="string")) then return false,"Decisión crítica inválida." end
    for _,field in ipairs({"conflict","reconcile","sharedMoment","relationshipEvent"}) do
        if effect[field]~=nil and type(effect[field])~="string" then return false,"Identificador narrativo inválido." end
    end
    for _,id in ipairs(effect.unlock or {}) do if not knownCard(id) then return false,"Carta desconocida: "..tostring(id) end end
    for _,child in ipairs(effect.batch or {}) do
        local ok,err=validate(child,(depth or 0)+1); if not ok then return false,err end
    end
    return true
end

-- A batch is validated before mutation. The parent event is the transaction
-- key; loading, revisiting or retrying cannot grant a reward twice.
function Events.apply(session,id,effects)
    assert(type(id)=="string","El evento necesita identificador")
    if session.events and session.events[id] then return false end
    effects=effects or {}
    local valid,err=validate(effects,0)
    if not valid then return false,err end
    local function permitted(effect)
        if effect.revealSecret and not require("src.systems.curse").canReveal(session,effect.character) then return false end
        if effect.cure and not (session.inventory and session.inventory.antidote) then return false end
        for _,child in ipairs(effect.batch or {}) do if not permitted(child) then return false end end
        return true
    end
    if not permitted(effects) then return false,"La maldición impide esta acción; necesitas el antídoto." end
    session.events=session.events or {}; session.decisions=session.decisions or {}
    session.unlocked=session.unlocked or {}; session.rewardQueue=session.rewardQueue or {}
    session.journal=session.journal or {}; session.rewards=session.rewards or {}
    local newlyUnlocked={}
    local function unlock(cardId)
        if not session.unlocked[cardId] then session.unlocked[cardId]=true; newlyUnlocked[#newlyUnlocked+1]=cardId end
    end
    local function apply(effect,path,inheritedText,inheritedHidden)
        local delta={love=0,trust=0}
        if effect.character and session.relationships[effect.character] then
            delta=Relationships.preview(session.relationships,effect.character,effect)
            Relationships.record(session.relationships,effect.character,effect,path,session.day)
        end
        if effect.decision then session.decisions[effect.decision]=effect.value end
        session.curse=session.curse or require("src.systems.curse").new()
        session.clues=session.clues or {}; session.inventory=session.inventory or {}
        if effect.clue then session.clues[effect.clue]=true end
        if effect.discoverVoice then session.curse.discoveredVoice=true end
        if effect.discoverMana then session.curse.discoveredMana=true end
        if effect.externalEnergy then session.externalEnergy=math.min(30,(session.externalEnergy or 0)+effect.externalEnergy) end
        if effect.antidote then session.inventory.antidote=true end
        if effect.cure then
            session.inventory.antidote=false; session.inventory.antidoteUsed=true
            session.curse.active=false; session.curse.voiceSealed=false; session.curse.manaBlocked=false
        end
        if effect.route and session.day>=5 and session.relationships[effect.route] then session.route=effect.route end
        for _,cardId in ipairs(effect.unlock or {}) do unlock(cardId) end
        if effect.starter or effect.equipStarter then
            if #session.deck==0 then
                for i,cardId in ipairs(CardData.starterDeck) do unlock(cardId); session.deck[i]=cardId end
            end
            session.combatDeck=session.combatDeck or {}
            if #session.combatDeck==0 then
                for i,cardId in ipairs(require("src.data.combat_cards").starterDeck or {}) do unlock(cardId); session.combatDeck[i]=cardId end
            end
        end
        for _,field in ipairs({"mission","enemyDefeated","familyEvent"}) do
            if effect[field] then
                local dest=({mission="missions",enemyDefeated="defeatedEnemies",familyEvent="familyEvents"})[field]
                session[dest]=session[dest] or {}; session[dest][effect[field]]=true
            end
        end
        local text=effect.text or effect.label or inheritedText
        if not text then
            if effect.starter or effect.equipStarter then text="Nanahoshi entrega el mazo inicial."
            elseif effect.character and Characters.byId[effect.character] then text="Decisión compartida con "..Characters.byId[effect.character].shortName
            else text=(id:gsub("_"," ")) end
        end
        local hidden=effect.hidden==true or inheritedHidden==true
        session.journal[#session.journal+1]={id=path,eventId=id,day=session.day,checkpoint=session.checkpoint,
            character=effect.character,context=effect.context or effects.context or "story",text=text,
            decision=effect.decision,value=effect.value,love=delta.love,trust=delta.trust,hidden=hidden,
            conflict=effect.conflict,reconcile=effect.reconcile,promise=effect.promise and effect.promise.id,
            promiseStatus=effect.promise and effect.promise.status,critical=effect.critical and effect.critical.id}
        for i,child in ipairs(effect.batch or {}) do apply(child,path..":"..i,text,hidden) end
    end
    apply(effects,id)
    session.events[id]=true
    if #newlyUnlocked>0 then
        local presenter=effects.presenter or effects.character or "nanahoshi"
        if not Characters.byId[presenter] then presenter="nanahoshi" end
        session.rewardQueue[#session.rewardQueue+1]={id="reward_"..id,eventId=id,cards=newlyUnlocked,presenter=presenter}
        session.rewards[id]=true
    end
    return true
end

return Events
````

````lua
-- Small strict JSON codec. Never evaluates Lua from a save file.
local Json = {}
Json.null = {}
local escapes={['"']='\\"',['\\']='\\\\',['\b']='\\b',['\f']='\\f',['\n']='\\n',['\r']='\\r',['\t']='\\t'}
local function quote(s)
    return '"'..s:gsub('[%z\1-\31\\"]',function(c)
        return escapes[c] or string.format('\\u%04x',c:byte())
    end)..'"'
end
local function finite(n) return n==n and n~=math.huge and n~=-math.huge end

function Json.encode(value)
    local seen={}
    local function encode(v,depth)
        if depth>32 then error("JSON demasiado profundo") end
        if v==Json.null or v==nil then return "null" end
        local kind=type(v)
        if kind=="boolean" then return v and "true" or "false" end
        if kind=="number" then
            assert(finite(v),"Número JSON inválido")
            return string.format("%.17g",v)
        end
        if kind=="string" then return quote(v) end
        assert(kind=="table","Tipo JSON no compatible")
        assert(not seen[v],"Ciclo en tabla JSON")
        seen[v]=true
        local count,max=0,0
        local array=true
        for k in pairs(v) do
            count=count+1
            if type(k)~="number" or k%1~=0 or k<1 then array=false
            elseif k>max then max=k end
        end
        array=array and count>0 and count==max
        local parts={}
        if array then
            for i=1,max do parts[#parts+1]=encode(v[i],depth+1) end
        else
            local keys={}
            for k in pairs(v) do assert(type(k)=="string","Clave JSON inválida"); keys[#keys+1]=k end
            table.sort(keys)
            for _,k in ipairs(keys) do parts[#parts+1]=quote(k)..":"..encode(v[k],depth+1) end
        end
        seen[v]=nil
        return (array and "[" or "{")..table.concat(parts,",")..(array and "]" or "}")
    end
    local ok,result=pcall(encode,value,0)
    if not ok then return nil,result end
    return result
end

local function utf8(code)
    if code<=0x7f then return string.char(code) end
    if code<=0x7ff then return string.char(0xc0+math.floor(code/64),0x80+code%64) end
    if code<=0xffff then return string.char(0xe0+math.floor(code/4096),0x80+math.floor(code/64)%64,0x80+code%64) end
    return string.char(0xf0+math.floor(code/262144),0x80+math.floor(code/4096)%64,0x80+math.floor(code/64)%64,0x80+code%64)
end

function Json.decode(source)
    if type(source)~="string" then return nil,"Se esperaba texto JSON" end
    local pos,length=1,#source
    local function fail(message) error(message.." (posición "..pos..")",0) end
    local function skip()
        while pos<=length and source:sub(pos,pos):match("[ \t\n\r]") do pos=pos+1 end
    end
    local function readString()
        pos=pos+1
        local parts={}
        while pos<=length do
            local c=source:sub(pos,pos); pos=pos+1
            if c=='"' then return table.concat(parts) end
            if c=='\\' then
                local e=source:sub(pos,pos); pos=pos+1
                local map={['"']='"',['\\']='\\',['/']='/',b='\b',f='\f',n='\n',r='\r',t='\t'}
                if map[e] then parts[#parts+1]=map[e]
                elseif e=='u' then
                    local hex=source:sub(pos,pos+3)
                    if #hex~=4 or not hex:match('^%x%x%x%x$') then fail("Escape Unicode inválido") end
                    local code=tonumber(hex,16); pos=pos+4
                    if code>=0xd800 and code<=0xdbff then
                        if source:sub(pos,pos+1)~='\\u' then fail("Par Unicode incompleto") end
                        local low=tonumber(source:sub(pos+2,pos+5),16)
                        if not low or low<0xdc00 or low>0xdfff then fail("Par Unicode inválido") end
                        code=0x10000+(code-0xd800)*1024+(low-0xdc00); pos=pos+6
                    elseif code>=0xdc00 and code<=0xdfff then fail("Unicode inválido") end
                    parts[#parts+1]=utf8(code)
                else fail("Escape JSON inválido") end
            else
                if c:byte()<32 then fail("Control dentro de cadena JSON") end
                parts[#parts+1]=c
            end
        end
        fail("Cadena JSON sin cerrar")
    end
    local parse
    parse=function(depth)
        if depth>32 then fail("JSON demasiado profundo") end
        skip()
        local c=source:sub(pos,pos)
        if c=='"' then return readString() end
        if c=='{' or c=='[' then
            local object=c=='{'; local close=object and '}' or ']'
            pos=pos+1; skip()
            local out={}; local count=0
            if source:sub(pos,pos)==close then pos=pos+1; return out end
            while true do
                count=count+1
                if count>4096 then fail("Demasiados elementos JSON") end
                local key=count
                if object then
                    if source:sub(pos,pos)~='"' then fail("Clave JSON inválida") end
                    key=readString(); skip()
                    if out[key]~=nil then fail("Clave JSON repetida") end
                    if source:sub(pos,pos)~=':' then fail("Falta separador JSON") end
                    pos=pos+1
                end
                out[key]=parse(depth+1); skip()
                c=source:sub(pos,pos); pos=pos+1
                if c==close then return out end
                if c~=',' then fail("Falta coma JSON") end
                skip()
            end
        end
        for _,literal in ipairs({"true","false","null"}) do
            if source:sub(pos,pos+#literal-1)==literal then
                pos=pos+#literal
                if literal=="null" then return Json.null end
                return literal=="true"
            end
        end
        local rest=source:sub(pos)
        local token=rest:match('^-?%d+%.?%d*[eE][+-]?%d+') or rest:match('^-?%d+%.%d+') or rest:match('^-?%d+')
        if not token then fail("Valor JSON inválido") end
        if token:match('^-?0%d') or token:match('%.e') or token:match('%.E') then fail("Número JSON inválido") end
        local n=tonumber(token)
        if not n or not finite(n) then fail("Número JSON fuera de rango") end
        pos=pos+#token
        return n
    end
    local ok,result=pcall(parse,0)
    if not ok then return nil,result end
    skip()
    if pos<=length then return nil,"Contenido extra después del JSON" end
    return result
end
return Json
````
