````lua
-- Validación estática conservadora. Los caminos condicionales necesitan una
-- salida de reserva o cubrir todas las respuestas/resultados del nodo.
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local Cards=require("src.data.cards")
local Assets=require("src.data.assets")
local Conditions=require("src.systems.conditions")
local Presentation=require("src.data.presentation")
local Appearances=require("src.data.appearances")
local Audio=require("src.data.audio")
local Validator={}
local function identifier(value) return type(value)=="string" and value:match("^[%w_]+$")~=nil end
local function merged(base,variant)
    local out={}; for key,value in pairs(base) do out[key]=value end
    for key,value in pairs(variant or {}) do out[key]=value end
    return out
end

local function validate(catalog,options)
    catalog=catalog or require("src.data.chapters")
    options=options or {}
    local errors,events,decisions,requirements,graph,terminal={},{},{},{},{},{}
    local producers,guardedSelections={},{}
    local nodes=catalog.checkpoints or {}
    local function fail(where,message) errors[#errors+1]=where..": "..message end
    for _,message in ipairs(catalog.buildErrors or {}) do errors[#errors+1]=message end
    local function pure(value,path,seen)
        local kind=type(value)
        if kind=="function" or kind=="userdata" or kind=="thread" then fail(path,"los datos no pueden contener código ejecutable")
        elseif kind=="table" then
            if seen[value] then fail(path,"referencia circular en datos"); return end
            seen[value]=true
            for key,item in pairs(value) do pure(item,path.."."..tostring(key),seen) end
            seen[value]=nil
        end
    end
    for _,chapter in ipairs(catalog.list or {}) do pure(chapter,tostring(chapter.id),{}) end
    local function character(id,where,optional)
        if id==nil and optional then return end
        if id~="companion" and id~="narrator" and not Characters.byId[id] then fail(where,"personaje desconocido: "..tostring(id)) end
    end
    local function background(id,where)
        local path=Assets.backgrounds[id]
        if not path then fail(where,"fondo desconocido: "..tostring(id))
        elseif options.checkFiles~=false and love and love.filesystem and not love.filesystem.getInfo(path,"file") then fail(where,"PNG de fondo inexistente: "..path) end
    end
    local function animation(value,where)
        if value==nil then return end
        local kind=type(value)=="table" and value.type or value
        if type(kind)~="string" or not Presentation.animations[kind] then fail(where,"animación desconocida") end
        if type(value)=="table" then
            for key in pairs(value) do if key~="type" and key~="expression" then fail(where,"campo de animación desconocido") end end
            if value.expression and not Characters.expressions[value.expression] then fail(where,"expresión de animación desconocida") end
        end
    end
    -- La identidad narrativa y el recurso visual tienen registros distintos.
    -- Un retrato alternativo nunca habilita un nuevo hablante o vínculo.
    local function portrait(value,where)
        if value==nil then return end
        local path=type(value)=="string" and Assets.characters[value]
        if not path then fail(where,"retrato desconocido: "..tostring(value))
        elseif options.checkFiles~=false and love and love.filesystem and not love.filesystem.getInfo(path,"file") then
            fail(where,"PNG de retrato inexistente: "..path)
        end
    end
    local function visualCharacter(id,where)
        if type(id)~="string" or not Characters.byId[id] then
            fail(where,"identidad visual desconocida: "..tostring(id))
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    local function expression(value,where)
        if value~=nil and (type(value)~="string" or Characters.expressions[value]==nil) then
            fail(where,"expresión visual desconocida")
        end
    end
    local function portraitMap(value,where)
        if value==nil then return end
        if type(value)~="table" then fail(where,"mapa de retratos inválido"); return end
        for id,resource in pairs(value) do
            visualCharacter(id,where)
            portrait(resource,where)
        end
    end
    local function appearanceContext(value,where)
        if value.context==nil then return end
        local context=type(value.context)=="string" and Appearances.contexts[value.context]
        if type(context)~="table" then fail(where,"contexto de apariencia desconocido: "..tostring(value.context)); return end
        if context.background~=nil then background(context.background,where) end
        portraitMap(context.portraits,where)

    end
    local function sceneBackground(value,where)
        local context=type(value.context)=="string" and Appearances.contexts[value.context]

    end
    local function cast(value,where)
        local seen,positions={},{}
        if value.cast==nil then return seen end
        if type(value.cast)~="table" then fail(where,"reparto visual inválido"); return seen end
        local count=0
        for key,actor in pairs(value.cast) do
            count=count+1

            if type(actor)~="table" then fail(where,"actor visual inválido")

            if type(change)~="table" then fail(where,"cambio visual inválido")
            else
                portrait(change.portrait,where)
                expression(change.expression,where)
                animation(change.animation,where)
                if change.visible~=nil and type(change.visible)~="boolean" then fail(where,"visibilidad de personaje inválida") end

                    if key~="portrait" and key~="expression" and key~="visible" and key~="animation" then fail(where,"campo de dirección visual desconocido: "..tostring(key)) end

        for _,variant in pairs(node.definition.variants or {}) do for _,choice in ipairs(variant.choices or {}) do required[#required+1]=choice.id end end

    local days={}
    for _,chapter in ipairs(catalog.list or {}) do

        if type(chapter.day)~="number" or chapter.day%1~=0 or chapter.day<1 or chapter.day>7 or days[chapter.day] then fail(where,"día inválido o duplicado") end

                sceneBackground(value,id)

            end
            if node.kind=="hub" then
                for _,location in ipairs(raw.locations or chapter.locations or {}) do
                    character(location.character,id); background(location.background,id); condition(location.requires,id)
                    if location.scene then edge(id,location.scene,id) end
                    if location.completedEvent then requirements[#requirements+1]={value={event=location.completedEvent},where=id} end
                end
                local selection=raw.companion
                if selection then
                    condition(selection.requires,id); edge(id,selection.to,id)
                    effect({id=selection.event,decision=selection.decision},id,node.day,nil,selection.to)
                    if selection.requires then guardedSelections[#guardedSelections+1]={from=id,to=selection.to,requires=selection.requires} end
                    if #(selection.options or {})==0 then fail(id,"selector sin opciones") end
                    for _,characterId in ipairs(selection.options or {}) do character(characterId,id) end
                end
                if not graph[id] or not next(graph[id]) then fail(id,"lugar sin salida") end
            elseif raw.terminal then
                if node.kind~="summary" then fail(id,"solo un resumen puede cerrar el contenido") end
                terminal[id]=true
                if #(chapter.transitions[id] or {})>0 then fail(id,"resumen terminal con transición jugable") end
            else
                local transitions=(chapter.transitions or {})[id] or {}
                if #transitions==0 then fail(id,"escena sin salida válida")
                elseif not covered(node,transitions) then fail(id,"transiciones sin salida segura; añade una reserva incondicional") end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Las decisiones de cartas se producen en el motor declarativo, dentro del
    -- checkpoint del encuentro, y son requisitos válidos de capítulos futuros.
    local dialogue=require("src.data.dialogue")
    for sceneId,nodeId in pairs(dialogue.encounters) do
        local checkpoint=sceneId=="nanahoshi_test" and "day1_tutorial" or sceneId
        decisions["dialogue_"..sceneId]=true
        local function response(record)
            for _,flag in ipairs(record.flags or {}) do events[flag]=true;decisions[flag]=true;produced(flag,checkpoint,checkpoint) end
            for _,variant in ipairs(record.variants or {}) do response(variant) end
        end
        for _,record in pairs(dialogue.nodes[nodeId].cards) do response(record) end
    end
    local function references(value,where)
        if value.event and not events[value.event] then fail(where,"evento requerido sin productor: "..value.event) end
        if value.decision and not decisions[value.decision] then fail(where,"decisión requerida desconocida: "..value.decision) end
        for _,child in ipairs(value.all or value.any or {}) do references(child,where) end
        if value['not'] then references(value['not'],where) end
    end
    for _,requirement in ipairs(requirements) do references(requirement.value,requirement.where) end
    -- Cada punto debe ser alcanzable desde el inicio y poder llegar al cierre.
    local reachable={}
    local function visit(id)
        if reachable[id] or not nodes[id] then return end
        reachable[id]=true
        for target in pairs(graph[id] or {}) do visit(target) end
    end
    local first=catalog.first or (catalog.list or {})[1]
    if first then visit(first.initial) else fail("catálogo","no contiene capítulos") end
    -- Los eventos obligatorios para una expedición deben poder obtenerse sin
    -- cruzar su propia salida: evita pedir el sello futuro para salir a buscarlo.
    local function mandatory(conditionData,negated)
        local out={}
        if type(conditionData)~="table" then return out end
        if conditionData.event then
            local positive=conditionData.equals~=false
            if negated then positive=not positive end
            if positive then out[conditionData.event]=true end
        elseif conditionData['not'] then return mandatory(conditionData['not'],not negated)
        elseif conditionData.all or conditionData.any then
            local children=conditionData.all or conditionData.any
            local union=(conditionData.all~=nil)~=(not not negated)
            for index,child in ipairs(children) do
                local required=mandatory(child,negated)
                if union then for eventId in pairs(required) do out[eventId]=true end
                elseif index==1 then out=required
                else for eventId in pairs(out) do if not required[eventId] then out[eventId]=nil end end end
            end
        end
        return out
    end
    for _,selection in ipairs(guardedSelections) do
        local before={}
        local function beforeSelection(id)
            if before[id] or not nodes[id] then return end
            before[id]=true
            for target in pairs(graph[id] or {}) do
                if id~=selection.from or target~=selection.to then beforeSelection(target) end
            end
        end
        if first then beforeSelection(first.initial) end
        for eventId in pairs(mandatory(selection.requires,false)) do
            local possible=false
            for _,producer in ipairs(producers[eventId] or {}) do
                if before[producer.from] and (producer.from~=selection.from or producer.to~=selection.to) then possible=true end
            end
            if not possible then fail(selection.from,"selección bloqueada por evento posterior o inaccesible: "..eventId) end
        end
    end
    local exits={}; for id in pairs(terminal) do exits[id]=true end
    local changed=true
    while changed do
        changed=false
        for id,targets in pairs(graph) do
            for target in pairs(targets) do
                if exits[target] and not exits[id] then exits[id]=true; changed=true end
            end
        end
    end
    for id in pairs(nodes) do
        if not reachable[id] then fail(id,"checkpoint inalcanzable desde el inicio") end
        if not exits[id] then fail(id,"ruta bloqueada o ciclo sin un resumen terminal") end
    end
    return #errors==0,errors
end

-- Un error de forma también es un diagnóstico de autoría, no una excepción
-- sin contexto al recorrer una tabla parcialmente escrita.
function Validator.validate(catalog,options)
    local ok,valid,errors=pcall(validate,catalog,options)
    if not ok then return false,{"Estructura narrativa inválida: "..tostring(valid)} end
    return valid,errors
end

function Validator.assertValid(catalog,options)
    local ok,errors=Validator.validate(catalog,options)
    assert(ok,"Narrativa inválida:\n"..table.concat(errors,"\n"))
    return true
end

return Validator
````

````lua
-- Preferencias globales, independientes de los eventos de una partida.
-- `volume` conserva el nombre usado por los guardados de la Fase 1.
local Options = {}
Options.defaults = {
    volume=.6, musicVolume=.45, effectsVolume=.55, muted=false,
    textSpeed=50, textAnimation=true, reducedMotion=false, fullscreen=false, tutorialCompleted=false,
}

local function number(value, fallback, minimum, maximum)
    if type(value)~="number" or value~=value or value==math.huge or value==-math.huge then return fallback end
    return math.max(minimum,math.min(maximum,value))
end

function Options.normalize(value)
    value=type(value)=="table" and value or {}
    local d=Options.defaults
    return {
        volume=number(value.volume,d.volume,0,1),
        musicVolume=number(value.musicVolume,d.musicVolume,0,1),
        effectsVolume=number(value.effectsVolume,d.effectsVolume,0,1),
        muted=value.muted==true,
        textSpeed=number(value.textSpeed,d.textSpeed,15,100),
        textAnimation=value.textAnimation~=false,
        reducedMotion=value.reducedMotion==true,
        fullscreen=value.fullscreen==true,
        tutorialCompleted=value.tutorialCompleted==true,
    }
end

return Options
````

````lua
-- Reconstrucción visual pura a partir de la escena y la línea guardadas.
-- No se conserva estado entre escenas ni se ejecutan efectos narrativos.
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local Appearances=require("src.data.appearances")
local Portraits={}

function Portraits.resolve(scene,index)
    local context=Appearances.contexts[scene.context] or {}
    local function appearance(character)
        return (scene.portraits or {})[character] or (context.portraits or {})[character] or character
    end
    index=math.max(1,math.min(#scene.lines,math.floor(tonumber(index) or 1)))
    local line=scene.lines[index]
    local result={background=scene.background or context.background or "courtyard",cast={}}
    if not scene.cast then
        local character=Characters.byId[line.speaker] and line.speaker or "rudeus"
        result.cast[1]={character=character,portrait=line.portrait or appearance(character),
            expression=(type(line.animation)=="table" and line.animation.expression) or line.expression or "neutral",
            position="left",visible=true,animation=line.animation}
        return result
    end
    local byId={}
    for _,entry in ipairs(scene.cast) do
        local actor={character=entry.character,portrait=appearance(entry.character),
            expression=entry.expression or "neutral",position=entry.position or "left",visible=false,
            enterAt=entry.enterAt or 1,entranceDelay=entry.entranceDelay or 0}
        result.cast[#result.cast+1]=actor; byId[actor.character]=actor
    end
    for current=1,index do
        for _,actor in ipairs(result.cast) do
            actor.animation=nil
            if current==actor.enterAt then actor.visible=true end
        end
        local item=scene.lines[current]
        local speaker=byId[item.speaker]
        if speaker then
            speaker.expression=(type(item.animation)=="table" and item.animation.expression) or item.expression or speaker.expression
            speaker.portrait=item.portrait or speaker.portrait
            speaker.animation=item.animation
        end
        for character,change in pairs(item.stage or {}) do
            local actor=byId[character]
            if actor then
                actor.portrait=change.portrait or actor.portrait
                actor.expression=(type(change.animation)=="table" and change.animation.expression) or change.expression or actor.expression
                if change.visible~=nil then actor.visible=change.visible end
                actor.animation=change.animation or actor.animation
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end

return Portraits
````

## src/systems/progression.lua

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/src/systems/progression.lua`

````lua
local Story=require("src.data.story")
local Chapters=require("src.data.chapters")
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local Events=require("src.systems.events")
local Conditions=require("src.systems.conditions")
local Progression={}

local function copy(value)
    local out={}; for key,item in pairs(value or {}) do out[key]=item end; return out
end
local function chapterFor(checkpoint)
    local node=Chapters.checkpoints[checkpoint]
    return node and Chapters.byId[node.chapterId]
end
function Progression.companion(session,checkpoint)
    local chapter=chapterFor(checkpoint or session.checkpoint)
    local key=chapter and chapter.companion and chapter.companion.decisionKey
    local id=key and (session.decisions or {})[key]
    if id and Characters.byId[id] and Characters.byId[id].romance then return id end
end
local function context(session,checkpoint) return {companion=Progression.companion(session,checkpoint)} end
local function meets(session,condition,checkpoint) return Conditions.evaluate(session,condition,context(session,checkpoint)) end
local function resolveText(text,session,checkpoint)
    if type(text)~="string" then return text end
    local id=Progression.companion(session,checkpoint) or "sylphiette"
    local replacements={companion=Story.companionNames[id] or "tu acompañante",
        companionAdvice=Story.companionAdvice[id] or "Lo resolveremos juntos.",
        companionMemory=Story.companionMemory[id] or "Compartimos un recuerdo verdadero."}
    return (text:gsub("{(%w+)}",function(key) return replacements[key] or "{"..key.."}" end))
end
local function definition(session,checkpoint)
    local node=Chapters.checkpoints[checkpoint]
    if not node then return nil end
    local raw=copy(node.definition)
    local selected=Progression.companion(session,checkpoint) or "sylphiette"
    for key,value in pairs((raw.variants or {})[selected] or {}) do raw[key]=value end
    return raw
end
function Progression.choices(session,sceneId)
    local scene=definition(session,sceneId)
    return scene and scene.choices or {}
end
local function savedChoice(session,sceneId)
    local selected=(session.decisions or {})["choice_"..sceneId]
    for _,choice in ipairs(Progression.choices(session,sceneId)) do if choice.id==selected then return choice end end
end
local function move(session,checkpoint)
    local node=Chapters.checkpoints[checkpoint]
    if not node then return nil,"Destino narrativo desconocido: "..tostring(checkpoint) end
    session.checkpoint,session.day=checkpoint,node.day
    session.dialogueIndex,session.encounter=1,nil
    session.encounterReview,session.tutorial=nil,nil
    session.combat,session.combatPreparation,session.trainingReview=nil,nil,nil
    return checkpoint
end
local function applyEffect(session,effect,checkpoint)
    if not meets(session,effect.requires,checkpoint) then return false end
    local resolved=copy(effect)
    if resolved.character=="companion" then resolved.character=Progression.companion(session,checkpoint) end
    if resolved.presenter=="companion" then resolved.presenter=Progression.companion(session,checkpoint) end
    return Events.apply(session,effect.id,resolved)
end
local function applyEffects(session,effects,checkpoint)
    for _,effect in ipairs(effects or {}) do applyEffect(session,effect,checkpoint) end
end

function Progression.hub(session)
    local node=Chapters.checkpoints[session.checkpoint]
    if not node or node.kind~="hub" then return nil end
    local hub=copy(node.definition)
    hub.locations=hub.locations or chapterFor(session.checkpoint).locations or {}
    return hub
end
function Progression.availableCompanions(session)
    local hub=Progression.hub(session)
    local selection=hub and hub.companion
    local available={}
    if selection and meets(session,selection.requires,session.checkpoint) then
        for _,id in ipairs(selection.options or {}) do available[#available+1]=id end
    end
    return available
end
function Progression.visit(session,character)
    local hub=Progression.hub(session)
    if not hub then return nil,"No estás en un lugar de preparación." end
    for _,location in ipairs(hub.locations) do
        if location.character==character and location.scene then
            if location.completedEvent and session.events[location.completedEvent] then return nil,"Este encuentro ya está completado." end
            if not meets(session,location.requires,session.checkpoint) then return nil,"Esta visita todavía no está disponible." end
            return move(session,location.scene)
        end
    end
    return nil,"Visita desconocida."
end
function Progression.selectCompanion(session,character)
    local hub=Progression.hub(session)
    local selection=hub and hub.companion
    if not selection then return nil,"No puedes elegir compañía en esta pantalla." end
    local available=false
    for _,id in ipairs(Progression.availableCompanions(session)) do if id==character then available=true end end
    if not available then return nil,"Completa los requisitos y elige un acompañante disponible." end
    if not Chapters.checkpoints[selection.to] then return nil,"El destino de la expedición no está disponible." end
    Events.apply(session,selection.event,{decision=selection.decision,value=character})
    -- Recupera una elección perdida de un guardado parcial sin volver a premiar.
    session.decisions[selection.decision]=character
    return move(session,selection.to)
end
function Progression.choose(session,sceneId,choiceId)
    if session.checkpoint~=sceneId then return false,"Esta escena ya no está activa." end
    local node=Chapters.checkpoints[sceneId]
    if not node or node.kind~="scene" then return false,"La escena no contiene decisiones." end
    local previous=savedChoice(session,sceneId)
    if previous then
        if previous.id==choiceId then return true end
        return false,"Esta decisión ya quedó guardada."
    end
    for _,choice in ipairs(Progression.choices(session,sceneId)) do
        if choice.id==choiceId then
            if not meets(session,choice.requires,sceneId) then return false,"Esta respuesta no está disponible." end
            local key="choice_"..sceneId
            local effect=copy(choice.effects)
            effect.id=key
            effect.text=choice.label
            local _,err=applyEffect(session,effect,sceneId)
            if err then return false,err end
            session.decisions[key]=choiceId
            return true
        end
    end
    return false,"Decisión desconocida."
end
function Progression.scene(session,id)
    local node=Chapters.checkpoints[id]
    if not node or node.kind~="scene" then return nil end
    local raw=definition(session,id)
    local scene=copy(raw)
    scene.title=resolveText(raw.title,session,id)
    scene.lines={}
    scene.choices=nil
    if not savedChoice(session,id) and raw.choices then
        scene.choices={}
        for _,choice in ipairs(raw.choices) do
            if meets(session,choice.requires,id) then scene.choices[#scene.choices+1]=choice end
        end
    end
    local function append(line)
        if not meets(session,line.requires,id) then return end
        scene.lines[#scene.lines+1]={
            speaker=line.speaker=="companion" and (Progression.companion(session,id) or "sylphiette") or line.speaker,
            expression=line.expression or "neutral",animation=line.animation,text=resolveText(line.text,session,id),
            delivery=line.delivery,effect=line.effect,stateEffect=line.stateEffect,
            portrait=line.portrait,stage=line.stage}
        local added=scene.lines[#scene.lines]
        if added.speaker=="rudeus" and not require("src.systems.curse").canSpeak(session,added.delivery) then
            added.delivery=session.events.starter_gift and "enchanted" or "thought"
        end
    end
    if raw.resultLines then
        local outcome=(session.decisions or {})["outcome_"..raw.resultKey] or "partial"
        local selected=raw.resultLines[outcome] or raw.resultLines.partial
        if selected.speaker then append(selected) else for _,line in ipairs(selected) do append(line) end end
    end
    for _,line in ipairs(raw.lines or {}) do append(line) end
    return scene
end
function Progression.encounter(session,id)
    local node=Chapters.checkpoints[id]
    if not node or node.kind~="encounter" then return nil end
    local encounter=definition(session,id)
    if encounter.character=="companion" then encounter.character=Progression.companion(session,id) end
    for _,adjustment in ipairs(encounter.adjustments or {}) do
        if meets(session,adjustment.requires,id) then
            if adjustment.targetScore~=nil then encounter.targetScore=adjustment.targetScore end
            if adjustment.intro~=nil then encounter.intro=adjustment.intro end
        end
    end
    encounter.title=resolveText(encounter.title,session,id)
    encounter.intro=resolveText(encounter.intro,session,id)
    return encounter
end
function Progression.summary(session)
    local node=Chapters.checkpoints[session.checkpoint]
    if not node or node.kind~="summary" then return nil end
    local summary=copy(node.definition)
    if summary.ending then
        local id,reason=require("src.systems.relationships").ending(session.relationships)
        local ending=id and require("src.data.endings").byId[id]
        if ending then
            for key,value in pairs(ending) do summary[key]=value end
            summary.endingId=id
            summary.epilogue=ending.footer
            summary.footer="Fin de la campaña · El diario conserva tus decisiones."
        else
            summary.body="Falta resolver los acuerdos matrimoniales: "..tostring(reason)
        end
    end
    for key,value in pairs(summary) do if type(value)=="string" then summary[key]=resolveText(value,session,session.checkpoint) end end
    return summary
end
local function transitions(checkpoint)
    local chapter=chapterFor(checkpoint)
    return chapter and chapter.transitions and chapter.transitions[checkpoint] or {}
end
function Progression.canContinue(session)
    local node=Chapters.checkpoints[session.checkpoint]
    if not node or node.kind~="summary" or node.definition.terminal then return false end
    for _,transition in ipairs(transitions(session.checkpoint)) do
        if Chapters.checkpoints[transition.to] and meets(session,transition.requires,session.checkpoint) then return true end
    end
    return false
end
local function finite(value)
    value=tonumber(value)
    return value and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge and value or 0
end
local function recordEncounter(session,checkpoint,result)
    local encounter=Progression.encounter(session,checkpoint)
    local score=finite(type(result)=="table" and result.score)
    local success=score>=encounter.targetScore
    local key="resolved_"..checkpoint
    if not session.events[key] then
        local trust=finite(type(result)=="table" and result.trust)
        local chemistry=finite(type(result)=="table" and result.chemistry)
        Events.apply(session,key,{decision="outcome_"..checkpoint,value=success and "success" or "partial",
            character=encounter.character,trust=trust,chemistry=chemistry,
            text=encounter.title..(success and ": objetivo alcanzado." or ": tarea pendiente; la historia continúa.")})
        session.lastResult={score=score,success=success,character=encounter.character,title=encounter.title,
            targetScore=encounter.targetScore,trust=trust,chemistry=chemistry}
    end
end
function Progression.next(session,checkpoint,result)
    checkpoint=checkpoint or session.checkpoint
    if session.checkpoint~=checkpoint then return nil,"La pantalla de origen ya cambió." end
    local node=Chapters.checkpoints[checkpoint]
    if not node then return nil,"Punto de historia desconocido: "..tostring(checkpoint) end
    if node.definition.document and not (session.clues and session.clues[node.definition.document]) then
        return nil,"Examina y lee la carta antes de continuar."
    end
    if node.definition.requiresCompanion and not Progression.companion(session,checkpoint) then
        return nil,"Elige un acompañante antes de continuar."
    end
    if node.kind=="scene" and #Progression.choices(session,checkpoint)>0 and not savedChoice(session,checkpoint) then
        return nil,"Elige una respuesta antes de continuar."
    end
    if node.kind=="encounter" then
        if node.definition.training and not session.events[require("src.systems.training_result").key(checkpoint)] then
            return nil,"Lee la valoración de Eris antes de cerrar el entrenamiento."
        end
        recordEncounter(session,checkpoint,result)
    end
    for _,transition in ipairs(transitions(checkpoint)) do
        if meets(session,transition.requires,checkpoint) then
            if not Chapters.checkpoints[transition.to] then return nil,"Destino narrativo no disponible." end
            applyEffects(session,transition.effects,checkpoint)
            return move(session,transition.to)
        end
    end
    if node.kind=="hub" or node.definition.terminal then return checkpoint end
    return nil,"Completa los requisitos antes de continuar."
end

-- Solo una victoria real entrega el premio, con una clave por checkpoint.
-- Los vínculos sociales jamás reciben deltas por infligir daño mágico.
function Progression.finishCombat(session,enc)
    local def=Progression.encounter(session,session.checkpoint)
    if def and def.training then
        local Result=require("src.systems.training_result")
        if not Result.current(session,enc) then return nil,"El entrenamiento todavía no terminó." end
        if not session.events[Result.key(session.checkpoint)] then return nil,"Falta leer la reacción de Eris." end
        return Progression.next(session,session.checkpoint,{score=enc.outcome=="victory" and def.targetScore or 0,trust=0,chemistry=0})
    end
    if session.combat~=enc or not enc.finished or enc.outcome~="victory" then
        return nil,"El enfrentamiento todavía no tiene una victoria confirmada."
    end
    local checkpoint=session.checkpoint
    def=Progression.encounter(session,checkpoint)
    if not def or def.kind~="magic" then return nil,"No hay una anomalía activa." end
    local enemy=require("src.data.enemies").byId[enc.enemy.id]
    local key="combat_reward_"..checkpoint
    if not session.events[key] then
        session.events[key]=true
        session.events["mirror_defeated_"..checkpoint]=true
        if enemy and enemy.narrativeEvent then session.events[enemy.narrativeEvent]=true end
        if enemy and enemy.reward and enemy.reward.event then session.events[enemy.reward.event]=true end
        session.decisions["combat_turns_"..checkpoint]=enc.turn
        session.defeatedEnemies=session.defeatedEnemies or {}
        session.defeatedEnemies[enc.enemy.id]=true
        for _,effect in ipairs(enc.relationshipEvents or {}) do
            local resolved=copy(effect); resolved.text=effect.reason or "Decisión compartida en combate."
            Events.apply(session,"tactic_"..checkpoint.."_"..effect.id,resolved)
        end
        if checkpoint=="day1_tutorial" then
            Events.apply(session,"first_anomaly",{unlock={"self_joke"}})
            session.events.combat_tutorial_completed=true
        end
        -- Una recompensa narrativa persiste por encuentro, sin multiplicarse
        -- al reabrir la pantalla de victoria o repetir el botón Continuar.
        session.decisions["combat_reward_text_"..checkpoint]=enemy and enemy.reward and enemy.reward.text or "Anomalía disipada"
    end
    return Progression.next(session,checkpoint,{score=def.targetScore,trust=0,chemistry=0})
end

return Progression
````

````lua
local Characters = require("src.data.characters")
local Relationships = {defaults={love=65,trust=65}, thresholds={maintain=55,united=75}}

local function finite(n, fallback)
    if type(n)~="number" or n~=n or math.abs(n)==math.huge then return fallback or 0 end
    return n
end
local function clamp(n) return math.max(0,math.min(100,finite(n))) end
local function empty(t) return not t or next(t)==nil end

function Relationships.new(config)
    config=config or Relationships.defaults
    local all={}
    for _,id in ipairs(Characters.romanceIds) do
        local personal={}
        all[id]={love=clamp(finite(config.love,65)),trust=clamp(finite(config.trust,65)),
            chemistry=clamp(finite(config.love,65)),events=personal,personalEvents=personal,
            decisions={},criticalDecisions={},promises={},brokenPromises={},sharedMoments={},
            pendingConflicts={},reconciliations={},history={},marriageState="married",routeState="married"}
    end
    return all
end

function Relationships.refresh(r)
    r.chemistry=r.love -- Compatibility with the original social-card renderer.
    if r.marriageState~="separated" then
        r.marriageState=(r.love<55 or r.trust<55 or not empty(r.pendingConflicts)) and "strained" or "married"
    end
    r.routeState=r.marriageState
end

function Relationships.apply(all,id,delta)
    local r=all[id]
    if not r then return end
    delta=delta or {}
    r.love=clamp(r.love+finite(delta.love~=nil and delta.love or delta.chemistry))
    r.trust=clamp(r.trust+finite(delta.trust))
    Relationships.refresh(r)
end

function Relationships.preview(all,id,delta)
    local r=all[id]
    if not r then return {love=0,trust=0,chemistry=0} end
    delta=delta or {}
    local love=clamp(r.love+finite(delta.love~=nil and delta.love or delta.chemistry))-r.love
    return {love=love,chemistry=love,trust=clamp(r.trust+finite(delta.trust))-r.trust}
end

function Relationships.complete(all,id,event)
    if not all[id] or type(event)~="string" then return end
    all[id].events[event]=true
    all[id].personalEvents=all[id].events
end

-- A number alone never separates a couple. Broken commitments remain in the
-- record even after an explicit reconciliation repairs the ongoing conflict.
function Relationships.record(all,id,effect,eventId,day)
    local r=all[id]
    if not r then return end
    local before=Relationships.preview(all,id,effect)
    Relationships.apply(all,id,effect)
    if effect.relationshipEvent then Relationships.complete(all,id,effect.relationshipEvent) end
    if effect.decision then r.decisions[effect.decision]=effect.value end
    if effect.critical then r.criticalDecisions[effect.critical.id]=effect.critical.value end
    for _,flag in ipairs(effect.flags or {}) do r.criticalDecisions[flag]=true end
    if effect.promise then
        local p=effect.promise
        local previous=r.promises[p.id]
        if p.status~="pending" or previous==nil then r.promises[p.id]=p.status end
        if p.status=="broken" then r.brokenPromises[p.id]=true; r.pendingConflicts[p.id]=true end
    end
    if effect.conflict then r.pendingConflicts[effect.conflict]=true end
    if effect.reconcile then
        r.pendingConflicts[effect.reconcile]=nil
        r.reconciliations[effect.reconcile]=true
        if r.promises[effect.reconcile]=="broken" then r.promises[effect.reconcile]="reconciled" end
    end
    if effect.sharedMoment then r.sharedMoments[effect.sharedMoment]=true end
    if effect.marriageState=="separated" then r.marriageState="separated" end
    Relationships.refresh(r)
    r.history[#r.history+1]={id=eventId,day=day,love=before.love,trust=before.trust,
        choice=effect.decision,value=effect.value,context=effect.context or "story",
        conflict=effect.conflict,reconcile=effect.reconcile,promise=effect.promise and effect.promise.id,
        promiseStatus=effect.promise and effect.promise.status,marriageState=r.marriageState}
end

function Relationships.canMaintain(all,id)
    local r=all[id]
    if not r or r.marriageState=="separated" then return false,"separated" end
    if r.love<Relationships.thresholds.maintain or r.trust<Relationships.thresholds.maintain then return false,"distance" end
    if not r.events.personal_resolution then return false,"personal_event" end
    if r.criticalDecisions.commitment~=true then return false,"commitment" end
    if not empty(r.pendingConflicts) then return false,"conflicts" end
    for promise in pairs(r.brokenPromises) do
        if not r.reconciliations[promise] then return false,"broken_promise" end
    end
    return true
end

function Relationships.viable(all)
    local list={}
    for _,id in ipairs(Characters.romanceIds) do
        if Relationships.canMaintain(all,id) then list[#list+1]=id end
    end
    return list
end

function Relationships.canUnite(all)
    for _,id in ipairs(Characters.romanceIds) do
        local r=all[id]
        if not Relationships.canMaintain(all,id) or r.love<Relationships.thresholds.united
            or r.trust<Relationships.thresholds.united then return false end
    end
    return true
end

-- Exactly five principal endings. An unresolved pair is an intermediate
-- conversation, never a sixth ending and never a silent forced separation.
function Relationships.ending(all)
    if Relationships.canUnite(all) then return "family_united" end
    local viable=Relationships.viable(all)
    if #viable==0 then return "solitary" end
    if #viable==1 then return viable[1] end
    return nil,"resolution_required",viable
end

function Relationships.canRomance(all,id) return Relationships.canMaintain(all,id) end
return Relationships
````

````lua
local function portrait(id,expression)
    -- Adapta el boceto provisional a 64x64 con proporciones uniformes.
    -- Cada trazo se rasteriza a píxeles enteros, sin estirar ni recortar la cara.
    local drawRect,drawPolygon,drawLine=r,poly,pixelLine
    local function r(c,x,y,w,h)
        local left,top=math.floor(x/2),math.floor(y/2)
        drawRect(c,left+8,top,math.max(1,math.floor((x+w)/2)-left),math.max(1,math.floor((y+h)/2)-top))
    end
    local function poly(c,points)
        local scaled={}
        for i,value in ipairs(points) do scaled[i]=math.floor(value/2)+(i%2==1 and 8 or 0) end
        drawPolygon(c,scaled)
    end
    local function pixelLine(c,x1,y1,x2,y2,width)

function Resources.new()
    return setmetatable({backgrounds={},portraits={},icons={},frames={},categoryIcons={},quads={},
        images={},sources={},warnings={}},Resources)
end
-- Una única carga por ruta: garden/courtyard y training/forest comparten imagen.
-- sources permite inspeccionar cada sustitución; nunca se oculta un fallo de PNG.
function Resources:_load(path,w,h,fallback,id)
    local key=path or ("unmapped:"..id)
    if not self.images[key] then
        local img,reason=image(path,w,h)
        if img then
            self.sources[key]={status="png",path=path,width=w,height=h}
        else
            local message="[Recursos] "..key..": "..reason.."; usando recurso provisional."
            self.warnings[#self.warnings+1]=message
            print(message)
            self.sources[key]={status="fallback",path=path,reason=reason,width=w,height=h}
            img=canvas(w,h,fallback)
        end
        self.images[key]=img
    end
    return self.images[key]
end
local function integerScale(scale) return math.max(1,math.floor(tonumber(scale) or 1)) end
local function draw(img,x,y,scale)
    scale=integerScale(scale)
    love.graphics.setColor(1,1,1,1)
    love.graphics.draw(img,math.floor(x or 0),math.floor(y or 0),0,scale,scale)
    return img
end
function Resources:getBackground(id)
    id=id or "courtyard"
    if not self.backgrounds[id] then
        self.backgrounds[id]=self:_load(Assets.backgrounds[id],BACKGROUND_WIDTH,BACKGROUND_HEIGHT,backgrounds[id] or courtyard,"background:"..id)
    end
    return self.backgrounds[id]
end
function Resources:background(id) return draw(self:getBackground(id),0,0,2) end
function Resources:getPortrait(id)
    id=id or "rudeus"
    if not self.portraits[id] then
        local wide,tall=id=="badigadi_battle" and 512 or SHEET_WIDTH,id=="badigadi_battle" and 128 or SPRITE_HEIGHT
        self.portraits[id]=self:_load(Assets.characters[id],wide,tall,function()
            for name,index in pairs(EXPRESSIONS) do
                love.graphics.push()
                love.graphics.translate(index*SPRITE_WIDTH,0)
                portrait(profiles[id] and id or "rudeus",name)
                love.graphics.pop()
            end
        end,"character:"..id)
    end
    return self.portraits[id]
end
function Resources:portrait(id,expression,x,y,scale)
    local img=self:getPortrait(id)
    local frame=EXPRESSIONS[expression or "neutral"] or 0
    local width,height=img:getWidth()/4,img:getHeight()
    local key=frame..":"..width
    if not self.quads[key] then
        self.quads[key]=love.graphics.newQuad(frame*width,0,width,height,img:getWidth(),height)
    end
    scale=integerScale(scale)
    love.graphics.setColor(1,1,1,1)
    love.graphics.draw(img,self.quads[key],math.floor(x),math.floor(y),0,scale,scale)
    return img
end
function Resources:getIcon(id)
    id=id or "magic"
    if not self.icons[id] then
        self.icons[id]=self:_load(Assets.cardIcons[id],ICON_WIDTH,ICON_HEIGHT,function() icon(id) end,"card-icon:"..id)
    end
    return self.icons[id]
end
function Resources:icon(id,x,y,scale) return draw(self:getIcon(id),x,y,scale) end
function Resources:getCardBase()
    self.base=self.base or self:_load(Assets.cardBase,CARD_WIDTH,CARD_HEIGHT,function()
        r("E2CC9F",1,1,78,110);r("D5BD92",3,3,74,106)
    end,"card-base")
    return self.base
end
function Resources:cardBase(x,y,scale) return draw(self:getCardBase(),x,y,scale) end
function Resources:getCardFrame(category)
    category=category or "empathy"
    if not self.frames[category] then
        self.frames[category]=self:_load(Assets.cardFrames[category],CARD_WIDTH,CARD_HEIGHT,function()
            local tint=({empathy=P.teal,humor=P.gold,sincerity=P.rose,initiative=P.lavender})[category] or P.gold
            r("101A2B",0,0,80,3);r("101A2B",0,109,80,3)
            r("101A2B",0,0,3,112);r("101A2B",77,0,3,112)
            r(tint,3,3,74,3);r(tint,3,106,74,3)
            r(tint,3,3,3,106);r(tint,74,3,3,106)
        end,"card-frame:"..category)
    end
    return self.frames[category]
end
function Resources:cardFrame(category,x,y,scale) return draw(self:getCardFrame(category),x,y,scale) end
function Resources:getCardBack()
    self.back=self.back or self:_load(Assets.cardBack,CARD_WIDTH,CARD_HEIGHT,function()
        r("21344B",0,0,80,112);r("BBA78A",4,4,72,104);r("344B60",7,7,66,98)
        r("83C6BA",25,31,30,50);r("D5E2BF",29,35,22,42)
    end,"card-back")
    return self.back
end
function Resources:cardBack(x,y,scale) return draw(self:getCardBack(),x,y,scale) end
function Resources:getCategoryIcon(category)
    category=category or "empathy"
    if not self.categoryIcons[category] then
        local representative=({empathy="listen",humor="light_joke",sincerity="be_honest",initiative="shared_magic"})[category]
        self.categoryIcons[category]=self:_load(Assets.categoryIcons[category],ICON_WIDTH,ICON_HEIGHT,function() icon(representative) end,"category-icon:"..category)
    end
    return self.categoryIcons[category]
end
function Resources:categoryIcon(category,x,y,scale) return draw(self:getCategoryIcon(category),x,y,scale) end
function Resources:getManaIcon()
    self.mana=self.mana or self:_load(Assets.manaIcon,ICON_WIDTH,ICON_HEIGHT,function() icon("magic") end,"mana-icon")
    return self.mana
end
function Resources:manaIcon(x,y,scale) return draw(self:getManaIcon(),x,y,scale) end
-- Valida todos los PNG sin dibujarlos ni exigir que la historia ya los visite.
function Resources:preload()
    for id in pairs(Assets.characters) do self:getPortrait(id) end
    for id in pairs(Assets.backgrounds) do self:getBackground(id) end
    for id in pairs(Assets.cardIcons) do self:getIcon(id) end
    for category in pairs(Assets.cardFrames) do self:getCardFrame(category); self:getCategoryIcon(category) end
    self:getCardBase(); self:getCardBack(); self:getManaIcon()
    return self
end
return Resources
````

````lua
local Json=require("src.systems.json")
local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
local CardData=require("src.data.cards")
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local Relationships=require("src.systems.relationships")
local Story=require("src.data.story")
local Chapters=require("src.data.chapters")
local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
local Options=require("src.systems.options")
local Save={version=3,filename="campaign-v3.json",backup="campaign-v3.backup.json",optionsFile="options.json",
    legacyFilename="save.json",legacyBackup="save.backup.json"}

local function number(value,default,min,max)
    if type(value)~="number" or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return default end
    return math.max(min,math.min(max,value))
end
local function map(value,booleans)
    local out={}
    if type(value)~="table" then return out end
    local count=0
    for key,item in pairs(value) do
        if type(key)=="string" and #key<=150 then
            if booleans then
                if item==true then out[key]=true end
            elseif type(item)=="boolean" or (type(item)=="string" and #item<=1000) then out[key]=item
            elseif type(item)=="number" and item==item and math.abs(item)<=100000 then out[key]=item end
            count=count+1
            if count>=2048 then break end
        end
    end
    return out
end
local function records(value)
    local out={}
    if type(value)~="table" then return out end
    for _,entry in ipairs(value) do
        if #out>=1024 then break end
        if type(entry)=="table" and type(entry.id)=="string" and #entry.id<=150 then out[#out+1]=map(entry,false) end
    end
    return out
end
local function copyList(source)
    local out={}; for i,id in ipairs(source or {}) do out[i]=id end; return out
end

function Save.newSession(config)
    return {version=Save.version,continuity="rudy_curse",day=Chapters.first.day,checkpoint=Chapters.first.initial,
        dialogueIndex=1,relationships=Relationships.new(config),affinities=require("src.systems.affinity").new(),unlocked={},deck={},combatDeck={},events={},decisions={},
        curse=require("src.systems.curse").new(),clues={},inventory={},externalEnergy=0,
        journal={},rewardQueue={},rewards={},missions={},defeatedEnemies={},familyEvents={},options=Options.normalize()}
end

function Save.validate(input)
    if type(input)~="table" or input==Json.null then return nil,"El guardado no contiene una partida." end
    if not next(input) then return nil,"El guardado está vacío." end
    if input.version==1 or input.version==nil then
        return nil,"Esta partida pertenece a la continuidad anterior. Inicia una nueva campaña compatible; el archivo original se conserva."
    end
    if input.version~=Save.version then return nil,"Versión de guardado no compatible." end
    local s=Save.newSession()
    s.checkpoint=Chapters.get(input.checkpoint) and input.checkpoint or Chapters.first.initial
    s.day=Chapters.get(s.checkpoint).day
    s.dialogueIndex=math.floor(number(input.dialogueIndex,1,1,100))
    s.events=map(input.events,true); s.decisions=map(input.decisions,false)
    s.affinities=require("src.systems.affinity").normalize(input.affinities)
    s.trainingResults=require("src.systems.training_result").normalize(input.trainingResults,s.events)
    s.dialogueMemory={used={}}
    for id,count in pairs(map(type(input.dialogueMemory)=="table" and input.dialogueMemory.used,false)) do
        if type(count)=="number" then s.dialogueMemory.used[id]=math.floor(number(count,0,0,10000)) end
    end
    s.options=Options.normalize(input.options)
    s.clues=map(input.clues,true); s.inventory=map(input.inventory,true)
    s.externalEnergy=number(input.externalEnergy,0,0,30)
    if type(input.curse)=="table" then
        s.curse.discoveredVoice=input.curse.discoveredVoice==true
        s.curse.discoveredMana=input.curse.discoveredMana==true
    end
    if s.inventory.antidoteUsed then
        s.curse.active=false; s.curse.voiceSealed=false; s.curse.manaBlocked=false
    end
    if type(input.documentState)=="table" and require("src.data.documents")[input.documentState.id] then
        local phases={resting=true,lifting=true,opening=true,reading=true,signature=true}
        s.documentState={id=input.documentState.id,phase=phases[input.documentState.phase] and input.documentState.phase or "resting",
            page=math.floor(number(input.documentState.page,1,1,100)),elapsed=number(input.documentState.elapsed,0,0,3600)}
    end
    s.journal=records(input.journal)
    for _,field in ipairs({"rewards","missions","defeatedEnemies","familyEvents"}) do s[field]=map(input[field],true) end
    if type(input.migration)=="table" then s.migration=map(input.migration,false) end
    if type(input.relationships)=="table" then
        for _,id in ipairs(Characters.romanceIds) do
            local data=input.relationships[id]
            if type(data)=="table" then
                local r=s.relationships[id]
                r.trust=number(data.trust,65,0,100); r.love=number(data.love,65,0,100)
                r.events=map(data.events,true); r.personalEvents=r.events
                r.decisions=map(data.decisions,false); r.criticalDecisions=map(data.criticalDecisions,false)
                for _,field in ipairs({"brokenPromises","sharedMoments","pendingConflicts","reconciliations"}) do r[field]=map(data[field],true) end
                for key,status in pairs(map(data.promises,false)) do
                    if status=="pending" or status=="kept" or status=="broken" or status=="reconciled" then r.promises[key]=status end
                end
                r.history=records(data.history)
                if data.marriageState=="separated" then r.marriageState="separated" end
                Relationships.refresh(r)
            end
        end
    end
    local CombatData=require("src.data.combat_cards")
    for id in pairs(map(input.unlocked,true)) do if CardData.byId[id] or CombatData.byId[id] then s.unlocked[id]=true end end
    -- Repair only an earned starter gift. This is not a new reward and never
    -- queues its animation or reapplies the story decision.
    if s.events.starter_gift then
        for _,id in ipairs(CardData.starterDeck) do s.unlocked[id]=true end
        for _,id in ipairs(CombatData.starterDeck or {}) do s.unlocked[id]=true end
    end
    if Cards.validateDeck(input.deck,s.unlocked) then
        s.deck=copyList(input.deck)
    elseif Cards.validateDeck(CardData.starterDeck,s.unlocked) then s.deck=copyList(CardData.starterDeck) end
    local Combat=require("src.systems.combat")
    if Combat.validateDeck and Combat.validateDeck(input.combatDeck,s.unlocked) then
        s.combatDeck=copyList(input.combatDeck)
    elseif CombatData.starterDeck and Combat.validateDeck and Combat.validateDeck(CombatData.starterDeck,s.unlocked) then
        s.combatDeck=copyList(CombatData.starterDeck)
    end
    local queued={}
    for _,reward in ipairs(type(input.rewardQueue)=="table" and input.rewardQueue or {}) do
        if type(reward)=="table" and type(reward.id)=="string" and type(reward.eventId)=="string"
            and s.events[reward.eventId] and not queued[reward.id] and #s.rewardQueue<128 then
            local entry={id=reward.id,eventId=reward.eventId,presenter=Characters.byId[reward.presenter] and reward.presenter or "nanahoshi",cards={}}
            local seen={}
            for _,id in ipairs(type(reward.cards)=="table" and reward.cards or {}) do
                if s.unlocked[id] and not seen[id] then entry.cards[#entry.cards+1]=id; seen[id]=true end
            end
            if #entry.cards>0 then
                entry.presentationPage=math.floor(number(reward.presentationPage,1,1,#entry.cards))
                s.rewardQueue[#s.rewardQueue+1]=entry; queued[entry.id]=true
            end
        end
    end
    if type(input.route)=="string" and s.relationships[input.route] then s.route=input.route end
    if type(input.selectedCompanion)=="string" and s.relationships[input.selectedCompanion] then s.selectedCompanion=input.selectedCompanion end
    for _,chapter in ipairs(Chapters.list) do
        local companion=chapter.companion
        if companion then
            local key=companion.decisionKey
            if type(s.decisions[key])~="string" or not s.relationships[s.decisions[key]] then
                s.decisions[key]=nil; s.events[companion.event]=nil
            end
        end
    end
    for sceneId in pairs(Story.scenes) do
        local key="choice_"..sceneId
        local selected=s.decisions[key]
        local valid=false
        for _,choice in ipairs(Progression.choices(s,sceneId)) do if selected==choice.id then valid=true end end
        if not valid then s.decisions[key]=nil end
    end
    local node=Chapters.get(s.checkpoint)
    local chapter=Chapters.chapterFor(s.checkpoint)
    if node.definition.requiresCompanion and chapter.companion and not s.decisions[chapter.companion.decisionKey] then
        s.checkpoint=chapter.companion.selectionCheckpoint; s.dialogueIndex=1
        s.day=Chapters.get(s.checkpoint).day
    end
    if (Chapters.get(s.checkpoint).kind=="encounter" or s.day>1) and (not Cards.validateDeck(s.deck,s.unlocked) or not Combat.validateDeck(s.combatDeck,s.unlocked)) then
        s.checkpoint=Chapters.get("day1_cards") and "day1_cards" or Chapters.first.initial
        s.day=Chapters.get(s.checkpoint).day; s.dialogueIndex=1
        s.recoveryNotice="El mazo guardado estaba incompleto. Nanahoshi revisará la entrega; las decisiones permanecen registradas."
    end
    local definition=Progression.encounter(s,s.checkpoint)
    if definition then
        local context=require("src.systems.dialogue_resolver").context(s,definition,s.checkpoint)
        if definition.tutorial and type(input.encounter)=="table" and type(input.encounter.context)=="table"
            and input.encounter.context.socialTutorial then
            context=require("src.systems.dialogue_resolver").context(s,{kind="conversation",character="nanahoshi"},"nanahoshi_test")
            context.socialTutorial=true
        end
        s.encounter=Cards.restore(input.encounter,s.deck,context)
    end
    if s.encounter and #s.encounter.log>0 and input.encounterReview==true then s.encounterReview=true end
    if definition and definition.tutorial and input.tutorial and not s.events.tutorial_completed then
        s.tutorial=require("src.systems.tutorial").restore(input.tutorial,s.encounter)
    end
    if definition and definition.kind=="magic" and not s.encounter then
        if input.combatPreparation==true then s.combatPreparation=true end
        if not s.combatPreparation and type(input.combat)=="table" then
            s.combat=Combat.restore(input.combat,s.deck,{character=definition.character,tutorial=definition.tutorial,
                enemyId=definition.enemyId,unlocked=s.unlocked,combatDeck=s.combatDeck,tacticalContext=definition.tacticalContext,curse=s.curse,externalEnergy=s.externalEnergy,
                day=s.day,difficulty=definition.difficulty})
        end
    end
    if type(input.lastResult)=="table" then
        local result=input.lastResult
        s.lastResult={score=number(result.score,0,0,100),success=result.success==true,targetScore=number(result.targetScore,3,0,100),
            trust=number(result.trust,0,-100,100),chemistry=number(result.chemistry,0,-100,100),love=number(result.love or result.chemistry,0,-100,100)}
        if type(result.title)=="string" and #result.title<=200 then s.lastResult.title=result.title end
        if Characters.byId[result.character] then s.lastResult.character=result.character end
    end
    if definition and definition.training and s.combat and s.combat.finished then
        local result=require("src.systems.training").evaluate(s.combat)
        local data=result and require("src.data.training_dialogue")[result.id]
        if data then
            local review=type(input.trainingReview)=="table" and input.trainingReview or {}
            s.trainingReview={line=math.floor(number(review.line,1,1,#data.lines))}
        end
    end
    return s
end

local function readFile(path)
    local ok,info=pcall(love.filesystem.getInfo,path,"file")
    if not ok or not info then return nil,"No hay guardado disponible." end
    if info.size and info.size>524288 then return nil,"El archivo de guardado es demasiado grande." end
    local readOk,data,err=pcall(love.filesystem.read,path)
    if not readOk or not data then return nil,err or "No se pudo leer el archivo." end
    return data
end
local function writeFile(path,data)
    local ok,written,err=pcall(love.filesystem.write,path,data)
    if not ok or not written then return false,err or "No se pudo escribir el archivo." end
    return true
end
local function decodeSession(data)
    local decoded,err=Json.decode(data)
    if not decoded then return nil,err end
    return Save.validate(decoded)
end

function Save.write(session)
    local clean,err=Save.validate(session)
    if not clean then return false,err end
    local data; data,err=Json.encode(clean)
    if not data then return false,err end
    local ok; ok,err=writeFile("campaign-v3.tmp.json",data)
    if not ok then return false,err end
    local old=readFile(Save.filename)
    if old and decodeSession(old) then
        ok,err=writeFile(Save.backup,old)
        if not ok then return false,err end
    end
    ok,err=writeFile(Save.filename,data)
    if not ok then return false,err end
    pcall(love.filesystem.remove,"campaign-v3.tmp.json")
    return true
end

function Save.load()
    local raw,err=readFile(Save.filename)
    if raw then
        local session; session,err=decodeSession(raw)
        if session then return session,session.recoveryNotice end
    end
    local backup=readFile(Save.backup)
    if backup then
        local session=decodeSession(backup)
        if session then return session,"Se recuperó la copia anterior del guardado." end
    end
    return nil,err or "No hay guardado válido disponible."
end
function Save.exists() return Save.load()~=nil end

-- The UI explicitly offers a new continuity. Original files stay untouched.
function Save.legacyInfo()
    for _,path in ipairs({"campaign-v2.json","campaign-v2.backup.json",Save.legacyFilename,Save.legacyBackup}) do
        local raw=readFile(path)
        local input=raw and Json.decode(raw)
        if type(input)=="table" and input~=Json.null and (input.version==2 or input.version==1 or input.version==nil) and next(input) then
            return {source=path,day=number(input.day,1,1,7),checkpoint=type(input.checkpoint)=="string" and input.checkpoint or "intro",
                unlocked=map(input.unlocked,true),options=Options.normalize(input.options)}
        end
    end
end
function Save.migrateLegacy(accepted)
    if accepted~=true then return nil,"Confirma la nueva continuidad de la maldición antes de importar la colección." end
    local legacy=Save.legacyInfo()
    if not legacy then return nil,"No hay una partida anterior compatible para importar." end
    local s=Save.newSession()
    s.options=legacy.options
    local count=0
    for id in pairs(legacy.unlocked) do if CardData.byId[id] then s.unlocked[id]=true; count=count+1 end end
    s.migration={source=legacy.source,previousDay=legacy.day,previousCheckpoint=legacy.checkpoint,acceptedContinuity=true,importedCards=count}
    return s,"Nueva campaña matrimonial: se conservó la colección compatible y el guardado original."
end
function Save.readOptions()
    local data=readFile(Save.optionsFile)
    if not data then return Options.normalize() end
    return Options.normalize(Json.decode(data))
end
function Save.writeOptions(value)
    local data,err=Json.encode(Options.normalize(value))
    if not data then return false,err end
    return writeFile(Save.optionsFile,data)
end
return Save
````

````lua
-- Métricas y evaluación pura de duelos. La campaña aplica después los eventos.
local Config=require("src.data.training")
local Training={}
local function copy(value)
    if type(value)~="table" then return value end
    local out={};for key,item in pairs(value) do out[key]=copy(item) end;return out
end
function Training.config(enc)
    return enc and enc.enemy and Config[enc.enemy.trainingId]
end
function Training.new(id)
    if not Config[id] then return nil end
    return {id=id,version=1,counterReady=false,metrics={turns=1,completedTurns=0,actionsTaken=0,
        attacksAttempted=0,attacksHit=0,validHits=0,damageDealt=0,damageReceived=0,
        blockedAttacks=0,blockedDamage=0,successfulDodges=0,dodgedDamage=0,
        tacticalActions=0,defensiveActions=0,idleTurns=0,avoidableEmptyTurns=0,
        missedOpportunities=0,offensiveOpportunityTurns=0},
        turn={actions=0,attacks=0,dodgeShield=0}}
end
function Training.beforeEndTurn(enc,canAttack)
    if not enc.training then return end
    local turn=enc.training.turn
    enc.training.pendingEnd={canAttack=canAttack,actions=turn.actions,attacks=turn.attacks}
end
-- Una esquiva cuenta solo si su escudo adicional evita daño que los demás
-- escudos no cubrían; pulsar Esquiva sin amenaza no fabrica una buena métrica.
function Training.dodgeAbsorbed(enc,blocked,totalShield)
    if not enc.training then return nil end
    local turn=enc.training.turn
    local other=math.max(0,totalShield-turn.dodgeShield)
    local used=math.min(turn.dodgeShield,math.max(0,blocked-other))
    turn.dodgeShield=math.max(0,turn.dodgeShield-used)
    return used
end
function Training.observe(enc,result,command)
    local state=enc.training;if not state then return end
    local m,turn=state.metrics,state.turn
    local config=Training.config(enc)
    m.turns=math.max(m.turns,result.turn or enc.turn)
    local damaging,tactical,defensive=false,false,false
    for _,entry in ipairs(result.events or {}) do
        if entry.kind=="damage" and entry.target=="enemy" then
            damaging=true
            m.damageDealt=m.damageDealt+entry.hpLost
            if entry.hpLost>0 then m.attacksHit=m.attacksHit+1 end
            if entry.hpLost>=config.victory.minHitDamage then m.validHits=m.validHits+1 end
        elseif entry.kind=="damage" and entry.target=="player" then
            m.damageReceived=m.damageReceived+entry.hpLost
            m.blockedDamage=m.blockedDamage+entry.blocked
            if entry.blocked>0 then m.blockedAttacks=m.blockedAttacks+1 end
            if (entry.dodgeBlocked or 0)>0 then
                m.successfulDodges=m.successfulDodges+1;m.dodgedDamage=m.dodgedDamage+entry.dodgeBlocked
            end
        elseif entry.kind=="shield" or entry.kind=="heal" or entry.kind=="status" or entry.kind=="mana" then
            if command.kind~="endTurn" then tactical=true end
            if entry.target=="player" and (entry.kind=="shield" or entry.kind=="heal") then defensive=true end
        end
    end
    if command.kind~="endTurn" then
        m.actionsTaken=m.actionsTaken+1;turn.actions=turn.actions+1
        if damaging then m.attacksAttempted=m.attacksAttempted+1;turn.attacks=turn.attacks+1 end
        if tactical or command.kind=="tactic" or (command.kind=="basic" and command.id=="counter") then m.tacticalActions=m.tacticalActions+1 end
        if defensive then m.defensiveActions=m.defensiveActions+1 end
        if command.kind=="basic" and command.id=="dodge" then turn.dodgeShield=turn.dodgeShield+3 end
    else
        state.counterReady=false
        for _,entry in ipairs(result.events or {}) do
            if entry.kind=="damage" and entry.target=="player" and entry.blocked>0 then state.counterReady=true end
        end
        local pending=state.pendingEnd or {actions=turn.actions,attacks=turn.attacks}
        m.completedTurns=m.completedTurns+1
        if pending.actions==0 then m.idleTurns=m.idleTurns+1 end
        if pending.canAttack then
            m.offensiveOpportunityTurns=m.offensiveOpportunityTurns+1
            if pending.attacks==0 then m.missedOpportunities=m.missedOpportunities+1 end
            if pending.actions==0 then m.avoidableEmptyTurns=m.avoidableEmptyTurns+1 end
        end
        state.pendingEnd=nil;state.turn={actions=0,attacks=0,dodgeShield=0}
    end
end
function Training.goalReached(enc)
    local config=Training.config(enc)
    return enc.training and config and config.victory.kind=="hits" and
        enc.training.metrics.validHits>=config.victory.targetHits
end
function Training.evaluate(enc)
    local config=Training.config(enc)
    if not config or not enc.training or not enc.finished then return nil end
    local m=enc.training.metrics
    local ratio=m.damageDealt/math.max(1,enc.enemy.maxHp)
    local id="honest_defeat"
    if enc.outcome=="victory" then id="victory"
    else
        local s=config.suspected
        -- Rapidez, pocos puntos o una mala elección nunca bastan. Deben
        -- repetirse al menos tres oportunidades legales y turnos evitables.
        local suspected=m.turns>=s.minTurns and m.missedOpportunities>=s.minRepeatedMisses and
            m.avoidableEmptyTurns>=s.minAvoidableEmptyTurns and m.attacksAttempted<=s.maxAttempts and
            ratio<=s.maxDamageRatio and m.tacticalActions<=s.maxTacticalActions
        if suspected then id="suspected_throw"
        elseif m.attacksAttempted>0 then
            local h=config.honorable
            local activity=1-m.idleTurns/math.max(1,m.completedTurns)
            local signals=0
            for _,passed in ipairs({m.turns>=h.minTurns,m.attacksAttempted>=h.minAttempts,
                m.attacksHit>=h.minHits,ratio>=h.minDamageRatio,
                m.defensiveActions>=h.minDefensiveActions or m.successfulDodges>0,
                activity>=h.minActivityRatio}) do if passed then signals=signals+1 end end
            local sustained=m.turns>=h.minTurns or (ratio>=h.minDamageRatio and (m.blockedAttacks>0 or m.successfulDodges>0))
            if signals>=h.minSignals and sustained then id="honorable_defeat" end
        end
    end
    local result=copy(config.results[id]);result.id=id;result.winner=enc.outcome=="victory" and "rudeus" or "eris"
    result.nonlethal=true;result.metrics=copy(m);result.metrics.winner=result.winner
    return result
end
function Training.complete(enc)
    if not enc.training or not enc.finished then return nil end
    enc.training.metrics.winner=enc.outcome=="victory" and "rudeus" or "eris"
    return Training.evaluate(enc)
end
return Training
````

````lua
local Training=require("src.systems.training")
local Dialogue=require("src.data.training_dialogue")
local Events=require("src.systems.events")
local Relationships=require("src.systems.relationships")
local Result={}
local function copy(value)
 if type(value)~="table" then return value end
 local out={};for k,v in pairs(value) do out[k]=copy(v) end;return out
end
function Result.key(checkpoint) return "training_result_"..checkpoint end
function Result.current(session,enc)
 if not enc or session.combat~=enc then return nil end
 local node=require("src.data.chapters").get(session.checkpoint)
 if not node or not node.definition.training then return nil end
 return Training.evaluate(enc)
end
function Result.commit(session,enc)
 local result=Result.current(session,enc)
 if not result then return nil,"El entrenamiento todavía no tiene un resultado válido." end
 local cp=session.checkpoint;local key=Result.key(cp)
 session.trainingResults=session.trainingResults or {}
 if session.events[key] then return session.trainingResults[cp],false end
 local before=Relationships.preview(session.relationships,"eris",{love=result.love,trust=result.trust})
 local record=copy(result)
 record.actualLove,record.actualTrust=before.love,before.trust
 record.checkpoint=cp
 local effect={character="eris",love=result.love,trust=result.trust,
  context="training",decision=cp=="day5_eris_duel" and "eris_training_result" or "eris_training_last_result",value=result.id,
  text=Dialogue[result.id].effort..": "..result.reason,
  relationshipEvent=result.eventId,sharedMoment="training_"..cp}
 if result.id=="suspected_throw" then effect.conflict="training_effort" end
 if cp=="day6_eris_rematch" and (result.id=="victory" or result.id=="honorable_defeat")
  and (session.decisions.eris_training_followup=="apologized" or session.events.eris_duel_apology_heard) then
  effect.reconcile="training_effort"
 end
 if not Events.apply(session,key,effect) then return session.trainingResults[cp],false end
 -- Ambos resultados quedan en el historial; una revancha no borra el primero.
 session.events[result.eventId]=true
 session.decisions.eris_training_last_result=result.id
 if effect.reconcile then session.events.eris_training_reconciled=true end
 session.trainingResults[cp]=record
 return record,true
end
function Result.normalize(records,events)
 local out={}
 for _,cp in ipairs({"day5_eris_duel","day6_eris_rematch"}) do
  local r=type(records)=="table" and records[cp]
  if type(r)=="table" and events[Result.key(cp)] and Dialogue[r.id] then
   local clean={id=r.id,eventId=Dialogue[r.id].eventId,checkpoint=cp,
    winner=r.id=="victory" and "rudeus" or "eris",nonlethal=true,metrics={}}
   for _,key in ipairs({"love","trust","actualLove","actualTrust"}) do
    local v=r[key];clean[key]=type(v)=="number" and v==v and math.abs(v)<=100 and v or 0
   end
   clean.reason=type(r.reason)=="string" and r.reason:sub(1,800) or "Resultado guardado."
   for k,v in pairs(type(r.metrics)=="table" and r.metrics or {}) do
    if type(k)=="string" and #k<60 and type(v)=="number" and v==v and v>=0 and v<=100000 then clean.metrics[k]=v end
   end
   clean.metrics.winner=clean.winner
   out[cp]=clean
  end
 end
 return out
end
return Result
````

````lua
-- Guía persistente: los pasos de acción solo avanzan al recibir una acción real.
-- La demostración de energía cero usa una copia de consulta, nunca altera la partida.
local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
local Tutorial={}
local stages={hand=0,energy=0,select=0,ready=0,result=1,draw=1,second=1,
    second_result=2,free_demo=2,free=2,summary=3,complete=3}
Tutorial.instructions={
    hand={step=1,title="MAZO Y MANO",text="Nanahoshi: recibes 5 cartas sociales y robas 3 a tu mano. Su magia almacenada reproduce tu voz. Verde: Empatía; naranja: Humor; azul: Sinceridad; violeta: Magia e iniciativa. Cada color indica una intención.",button="Ver la energía"},
    energy={step=2,title="ENERGÍA SOCIAL",text="Tienes 4 de energía para 3 acciones sociales. El coste se paga al jugar; no recuperas energía. La energía permite actuar, no es vida. En combate se recarga a 3 cada turno.",button="Elegir una carta"},
    select={step=3,title="PRIMERO, CONSULTA LA CARTA",text="Selecciona una carta con clic, 1/2/3 o flechas. Lee su nombre completo, coste y efecto a la derecha. Después confirma con Enter o Jugar."},
    ready={step=3,title="DECIDE CON EL CONTEXTO",text="Nanahoshi: amor mide cercanía; confianza, seguridad en tus actos. Una broma en mal momento puede reducirlos. Aquí prueba una respuesta: necesito que acordemos cómo investigar."},
    result={step=5,title="LEE LO QUE OCURRIÓ",text="Nanahoshi: has reproducido la voz con magia almacenada, sin gastar tu maná. Mira mi reacción. No soy una relación romántica; tus esposas sí valoran el tono y el contexto.",button="Ver el robo"},
    draw={step=6,title="DESCARTA Y ROBA",text="La carta usada fue al descarte. Has robado otra del mazo y vuelves a tener 3. El robo no cuesta energía. Ahora juega tu segundo turno.",button="Jugar el segundo turno"},
    second={step=6,title="PONLO EN PRÁCTICA",text="Selecciona otra carta y confirma su uso. Compara categorías y contexto. Una carta barata también puede ser útil."},
    second_result={step=6,title="SEGUNDA ACCIÓN",text="El registro conserva ambos resultados. La energía restante depende de lo que pagaste. Falta un turno: aprenderás la acción gratuita.",button="Aprender la acción gratuita"},
    free_demo={step=7,title="EJEMPLO: SIN ENERGÍA",text="Probemos en una simulación: Escuchar cuesta 1. Con 0 energía no puede jugarse. Tu energía real NO cambia. Comprueba el coste para continuar.",button="Probar carta con 0 energía"},
    free={step=7,title="TOMAR UN RESPIRO",text="Sin energía puedes usar cartas de coste 0 o Tomar un respiro [P]. El respiro gasta un turno, no roba ni descarta. Úsalo ahora para cerrar la práctica."},
    summary={step=8,title="EL RESULTADO SOCIAL",text="Al alcanzar la meta: ENCUENTRO EXITOSO. Si falta avance: ENCUENTRO DESFAVORABLE. Cambian la respuesta y los vínculos, pero la historia sigue. Tu voz y maná siguen sellados. Continúa para practicar ataques físicos, vida y escudo."},
    complete={step=8,title="PRÁCTICA COMPLETADA",text="Ya puedes continuar la historia."},
}
function Tutorial.restore(value,enc)
    local count=enc and #enc.log or 0
    local stage=type(value)=="table" and value.stage
    if stage=="complete" or stages[stage]~=count then stage=({[0]="hand",[1]="result",[2]="second_result",[3]="summary"})[count] or "hand" end
    return {stage=stage}
end
function Tutorial.instruction(state) return Tutorial.instructions[state.stage] end
function Tutorial.select(state)
    if state.stage=="select" then state.stage="ready"; return true end
end
function Tutorial.canAct(state,index)
    if not state then return true end
    if index then return state.stage=="ready" or state.stage=="second" end
    return state.stage=="free"
end
function Tutorial.action(state,enc)
    state.stage=({[1]="result",[2]="second_result",[3]="summary"})[#enc.log]
end
function Tutorial.advance(state)
    local nextStage={hand="energy",energy="select",result="draw",draw="second",second_result="free_demo"}
    if nextStage[state.stage] then state.stage=nextStage[state.stage]; return true end
    if state.stage=="free_demo" then
        local allowed=Cards.canPlay({hand={"listen"},context={kind="conversation",character="nanahoshi"},energy=0,finished=false},1)
        if not allowed then state.stage="free"; return true end
    end
    return false
end
function Tutorial.complete(session,options)
    if not session.tutorial or session.tutorial.stage~="summary" or not session.encounter or not session.encounter.finished then return false end
    session.tutorial.stage="complete"
    session.events.tutorial_completed=true
    options.tutorialCompleted=true
    return true
end
function Tutorial.skip(session,options)
    if not options.tutorialCompleted and not session.events.tutorial_completed then return false end
    session.tutorial=nil
    session.events.tutorial_completed=true
    return true
end
return Tutorial
````

````lua
-- Cuenta puntos de código UTF-8, nunca bytes de una tilde o un signo.
local utf8=require("utf8")
local Typewriter={}
Typewriter.__index=Typewriter

function Typewriter.slice(text,count)
    count=math.max(0,math.floor(tonumber(count) or 0))
    local boundary=utf8.offset(text,count+1)
    return boundary and text:sub(1,boundary-1) or text
end

function Typewriter.new(text,options)
    local self=setmetatable({},Typewriter)
    self:setText(text or "",options)
    return self
end

function Typewriter:setText(text,options)
    options=options or {}
    self.text=text
    self.length=assert(utf8.len(text),"El diálogo contiene UTF-8 inválido")
    self.speed=math.max(1,tonumber(options.textSpeed) or 50)
    self.enabled=options.textAnimation~=false
    self.elapsed,self.visible=0,self.enabled and 0 or self.length
end

function Typewriter:update(dt)
    self.elapsed=self.elapsed+math.max(0,dt or 0)
    self.visible=self.enabled and math.min(self.length,math.floor(self.elapsed*self.speed+.000001)) or self.length
    return self:shown()
end

function Typewriter:showAll()
    self.visible=self.length
    self.elapsed=self.length/self.speed
end

function Typewriter:isComplete() return self.visible>=self.length end
function Typewriter:shown() return Typewriter.slice(self.text,self.visible) end
return Typewriter
````

````lua
-- Composición compartida por la mano y la colección. Todas las medidas son

local Font = require("src.ui.font")

}

function Card.labels(card)

end

function Card.draw(resources,card,x,y,opts)
    opts=opts or {}
    x,y=math.floor(x),math.floor(y)
    if opts.selected then
        love.graphics.setColor(P.gold)
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill",x-2,y-2,84,116)
    end
    resources:cardBase(x,y,1)
    resources:cardFrame(card.category,x,y,1)
    local labels=Card.labels(card)
    local function label(key)
        local box=Card.regions[key]
        Font.draw(labels[key],x+box.x,y+box.y,{maxWidth=box.w,align="center",color=ink})
    end
    label("name")
    if card.icon and card.icon:match("^procedural") then
        love.graphics.setColor(card.element=="water" and {.2,.6,.9,1} or {.5,.35,.2,1})
        love.graphics.polygon("fill",x+40,y+62,x+50,y+77,x+40,y+88,x+30,y+77)
    else resources:icon(card.icon or card.id,x+Card.regions.icon.x,y+Card.regions.icon.y,1) end
    label("cost")
    if opts.status then
        love.graphics.setColor(P.panel)
        love.graphics.rectangle("fill",x,y+112,80,13)
        Font.draw(opts.status,x,y+114,{maxWidth=80,align="center",color=opts.disabled and P.muted or P.gold})
    end
end

return Card
````
