````lua
-- Fuente bitmap original 5x7. No requiere TTF, red ni archivos adicionales.
-- Caja de línea: 11 px. El español conserva sus tildes y signos de apertura.
local Font = {lineHeight = 11, advance = 6}
local glyphs = {}
local function add(char, rows)
    local bitmap = {}
    for row in rows:gmatch("[^/]+") do bitmap[#bitmap + 1] = row end
    glyphs[char] = bitmap
end
local patterns = {
    A="01110/10001/10001/11111/10001/10001/10001", B="11110/10001/10001/11110/10001/10001/11110",
    C="01111/10000/10000/10000/10000/10000/01111", D="11110/10001/10001/10001/10001/10001/11110",
    E="11111/10000/10000/11110/10000/10000/11111", F="11111/10000/10000/11110/10000/10000/10000",
    G="01111/10000/10000/10111/10001/10001/01110", H="10001/10001/10001/11111/10001/10001/10001",
    I="11111/00100/00100/00100/00100/00100/11111", J="00111/00010/00010/00010/10010/10010/01100",
    K="10001/10010/10100/11000/10100/10010/10001", L="10000/10000/10000/10000/10000/10000/11111",
    M="10001/11011/10101/10101/10001/10001/10001", N="10001/11001/11001/10101/10011/10011/10001",
    O="01110/10001/10001/10001/10001/10001/01110", P="11110/10001/10001/11110/10000/10000/10000",
    Q="01110/10001/10001/10001/10101/10010/01101", R="11110/10001/10001/11110/10100/10010/10001",
    S="01111/10000/10000/01110/00001/00001/11110", T="11111/00100/00100/00100/00100/00100/00100",
    U="10001/10001/10001/10001/10001/10001/01110", V="10001/10001/10001/10001/10001/01010/00100",
    W="10001/10001/10001/10101/10101/10101/01010", X="10001/10001/01010/00100/01010/10001/10001",
    Y="10001/10001/01010/00100/00100/00100/00100", Z="11111/00001/00010/00100/01000/10000/11111",
    ["0"]="01110/10001/10011/10101/11001/10001/01110", ["1"]="00100/01100/00100/00100/00100/00100/01110",
    ["2"]="01110/10001/00001/00010/00100/01000/11111", ["3"]="11110/00001/00001/01110/00001/00001/11110",
    ["4"]="00010/00110/01010/10010/11111/00010/00010", ["5"]="11111/10000/10000/11110/00001/00001/11110",
    ["6"]="01110/10000/10000/11110/10001/10001/01110", ["7"]="11111/00001/00010/00100/01000/01000/01000",
    ["8"]="01110/10001/10001/01110/10001/10001/01110", ["9"]="01110/10001/10001/01111/00001/00001/01110",
    [" "]="00000/00000/00000/00000/00000/00000/00000", ["."]="00000/00000/00000/00000/00000/00110/00110",
    [","]="00000/00000/00000/00000/00110/00100/01000", [":"]="00000/00110/00110/00000/00110/00110/00000",
    [";"]="00000/00110/00110/00000/00110/00100/01000", ["!"]="00100/00100/00100/00100/00100/00000/00100",
    ["?"]="01110/10001/00001/00010/00100/00000/00100", ["¡"]="00100/00000/00100/00100/00100/00100/00100",
    ["¿"]="00100/00000/00100/01000/10000/10001/01110", ["-"]="00000/00000/00000/11111/00000/00000/00000",
    ["+"]="00000/00100/00100/11111/00100/00100/00000", ["="]="00000/00000/11111/00000/11111/00000/00000",
    ["/"]="00001/00001/00010/00100/01000/10000/10000", ["\\"]="10000/10000/01000/00100/00010/00001/00001",
    ["("]="00010/00100/01000/01000/01000/00100/00010", [")"]="01000/00100/00010/00010/00010/00100/01000",
    ["["]="01110/01000/01000/01000/01000/01000/01110", ["]"]="01110/00010/00010/00010/00010/00010/01110",
    ["'"]="00100/00100/01000/00000/00000/00000/00000", ['"']="01010/01010/01010/00000/00000/00000/00000",
    ["<"]="00010/00100/01000/10000/01000/00100/00010", [">"]="01000/00100/00010/00001/00010/00100/01000",
    ["%"]="11001/11010/00010/00100/01000/01011/10011", ["_"]="00000/00000/00000/00000/00000/00000/11111",
    ["*"]="00000/10101/01110/11111/01110/10101/00000", ["#"]="01010/01010/11111/01010/11111/01010/01010",
    ["|"]="00100/00100/00100/00100/00100/00100/00100", ["&"]="01100/10010/10100/01000/10101/10010/01101",
    ["@"]="01110/10001/10111/10101/10111/10000/01110",
    ["·"]="00000/00000/00000/00110/00110/00000/00000", ["…"]="00000/00000/00000/00000/00000/00000/10101",
}
for char, pattern in pairs(patterns) do add(char, pattern) end
local accents = { ["Á"]="A", ["É"]="E", ["Í"]="I", ["Ó"]="O", ["Ú"]="U", ["Ñ"]="N", ["Ü"]="U" }
for char, base in pairs(accents) do
    local rows = {}
    rows[1] = char == "Ñ" and "01010" or (char == "Ü" and "01010" or "00010")
    rows[2] = char == "Ñ" and "10100" or (char == "Ü" and "00000" or "00100")
    for i, row in ipairs(glyphs[base]) do rows[i+2] = row end
    glyphs[char] = rows
end
local upper = { ["á"]="Á", ["é"]="É", ["í"]="Í", ["ó"]="Ó", ["ú"]="Ú", ["ñ"]="Ñ", ["ü"]="Ü" }
local aliases = { ["—"]="-", ["–"]="-", ["‘"]="'", ["’"]="'", ["“"]='"', ["”"]='"', ["«"]='"', ["»"]='"', ["•"]="*", ["→"]=">", ["♥"]="*" }
local function chars(text)
    local result = {}
    for char in tostring(text or ""):gmatch("[%z\1-\127\194-\244][\128-\191]*") do result[#result + 1] = char end
    return result
end
function Font.width(text, scale)
    scale = scale or 1
    local width, maximum = 0, 0
    for _, char in ipairs(chars(text)) do
        if char == "\n" then maximum = math.max(maximum, width); width = 0 else width = width + 6 end
    end
    return math.max(maximum, width) * scale
end
function Font.wrap(text, maxWidth, scale)
    text, scale = tostring(text or ""), scale or 1
    if not maxWidth then
        local lines = {}; for line in (text.."\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do lines[#lines+1] = line end
        return lines
    end
    local capacity = math.max(1, math.floor(maxWidth / (6 * scale)))
    local lines = {}
    for paragraph in (text.."\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
        local line = ""
        for word in paragraph:gmatch("%S+") do
            if line ~= "" and Font.width(line.." "..word, 1) > capacity*6 then lines[#lines+1] = line; line = "" end
            local wordChars = chars(word)
            while #wordChars > capacity do
                if line ~= "" then lines[#lines+1] = line; line = "" end
                lines[#lines+1] = table.concat(wordChars, "", 1, capacity)
                local rest = {}; for i=capacity+1,#wordChars do rest[#rest+1] = wordChars[i] end
                wordChars = rest
            end
            word = table.concat(wordChars)
            if word ~= "" then line = line == "" and word or (line.." "..word) end
        end
        lines[#lines+1] = line
    end
    return lines
end
function Font.height(text, maxWidth, scale)
    scale = scale or 1
    return #Font.wrap(text, maxWidth, scale) * Font.lineHeight * scale
end
function Font.draw(text, x, y, opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local scale = opts.scale or 1
    local color = opts.color or {1,1,1,1}
    love.graphics.setColor(color)
    local lines = Font.wrap(text, opts.maxWidth, scale)
    for rowIndex, line in ipairs(lines) do
        local xx = x
        if opts.maxWidth and opts.align == "center" then xx = x + math.floor((opts.maxWidth - Font.width(line,scale))/2)
        elseif opts.maxWidth and opts.align == "right" then xx = x + opts.maxWidth - Font.width(line,scale) end
        for _, char in ipairs(chars(line)) do
            char = upper[char] or aliases[char] or char:upper()
            local glyph = glyphs[char] or glyphs["?"]
            local top = y + (rowIndex-1)*Font.lineHeight*scale + (#glyph == 9 and 0 or 2*scale)
            for gy, pixels in ipairs(glyph) do
                for gx=1,#pixels do
                    if pixels:sub(gx,gx) == "1" then love.graphics.rectangle("fill", math.floor(xx + (gx-1)*scale), math.floor(top + (gy-1)*scale), scale, scale) end
                end
            end
            xx = xx + 6*scale
        end
    end
    return #lines*Font.lineHeight*scale
end
return Font
````

## src/ui/relationship_bars.lua

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/src/ui/relationship_bars.lua`

````lua
-- Presentación únicamente: lee valores definitivos, nunca modifica la partida.
local Font=require("src.ui.font")
local Animation=require("src.systems.animation")
local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
local P=require("src.ui.palette")
local Bars={height=42,duration=.6}
Bars.__index=Bars
Bars.colors={love={.94,.48,.65,1},trust={.40,.68,.96,1},interest={.91,.74,.37,1}}
local function finite(value)
    return type(value)=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge and value or 0
end
local function clamp(value) return math.max(0,math.min(100,finite(value))) end
local function copy(values)
    local out={}; for key,value in pairs(values or {}) do out[key]=value end; return out
end
local function signed(value) return (value>=0 and "+" or "")..tostring(value) end
function Bars.read(session,character)
    local data=Characters.byId[character]
    if data and data.romance and session and session.relationships and session.relationships[character] then
        local r=session.relationships[character]
        return {love=clamp(r.love),trust=clamp(r.trust)},{{key="love",label="Amor"},{key="trust",label="Confianza"}}
    elseif character=="nanahoshi" then
        local r=require("src.systems.affinity").get(session,character)
        return {trust=clamp(r.trust),interest=clamp(r.interest)},{{key="trust",label="Confianza"},{key="interest",label="Interés"}}
    end
end
function Bars.new(session,character,options)
    local values,fields=Bars.read(session,character)
    if not values then return nil end
    local seen={}
    -- Al cargar, los acontecimientos históricos ya están vistos. No reaparecen
    -- corazones ni sonidos aunque el resultado vuelva a dibujarse.
    for key,value in pairs(session.events or {}) do if value==true then seen[key]=true end end
    return setmetatable({character=character,name=Characters.byId[character].shortName,
        fields=fields,value=copy(values),target=copy(values),options=options or {},seen=seen,
        age=0,feedbackTime=0,notifications=0},Bars)
end
function Bars:_target(values)
    local changed=false
    for key,value in pairs(values) do if value~=self.target[key] then changed=true end end
    if not changed then return end
    self.target=copy(values)
    self.tween=Animation.tween(self.value,self.target,Bars.duration,{easing="inOut",reducedMotion=self.options.reducedMotion})
    if self.options.reducedMotion then self.tween:finish(); self.value=copy(self.tween.value) end
end
function Bars:sync(session)
    local values=Bars.read(session,self.character)
    if values then self:_target(values) end
end
function Bars:apply(eventKey,session,deltas,explanation)
    if type(eventKey)~="string" or self.seen[eventKey] then return false end
    self.seen[eventKey]=true
    local values=Bars.read(session,self.character)
    if not values then return false end
    local actual,positive,negative={},false,false
    for _,field in ipairs(self.fields) do
        -- El estado lógico determina el delta, incluso cerca de 0 o 100.
        local change=values[field.key]-self.target[field.key]
        actual[field.key]=change
        positive=positive or change>0; negative=negative or change<0
    end
    self:_target(values)
    if not positive and not negative then return false end
    self.feedbackData={id=eventKey,deltas=actual,explanation=explanation or "",
        positive=positive,negative=negative,age=0}
    self.feedbackTime=1.2; self.notifications=self.notifications+1
    if self.options.audio then self.options.audio:effect(negative and "negative" or "positive") end
    return true
end
function Bars:update(dt)
    dt=math.max(0,finite(dt)); self.age=self.age+dt
    if self.tween then
        self.tween:update(dt); self.value=copy(self.tween.value)
        if self.tween.done then self.value=copy(self.target); self.tween=nil end
    end
    self.feedbackTime=math.max(0,self.feedbackTime-dt)
    if self.feedbackData then self.feedbackData.age=self.feedbackData.age+dt end
end
function Bars:feedback() return self.feedbackTime>0 and self.feedbackData or nil end
function Bars:layout(anchor)
    local width=math.max(110,math.floor(anchor.width or anchor.w or 128))
    local x=math.floor(anchor.x+(anchor.w or width)/2-width/2)
    local y=math.floor(anchor.y-Bars.height-4)
    return {x=x,y=y,w=width,h=Bars.height,portrait={x=anchor.x,y=anchor.y,w=anchor.w,h=anchor.h},alpha=anchor.alpha or 1}
end
local function color(c,alpha) love.graphics.setColor(c[1],c[2],c[3],(c[4] or 1)*alpha) end
local function rect(c,x,y,w,h,alpha)
    color(c,alpha); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",math.floor(x),math.floor(y),math.floor(w),math.floor(h))
end
local function heart(x,y,alpha)
    for row,bits in ipairs({"0110110","1111111","1111111","0111110","0011100","0001000"}) do
        for col=1,#bits do if bits:sub(col,col)=="1" then rect(Bars.colors.love,x+col-1,y+row-1,1,1,alpha) end end
    end
end
function Bars:draw(anchor)
    local box=self:layout(anchor); self.lastBounds=box
    local alpha=math.max(0,math.min(1,box.alpha)); if alpha<=0 then return box end
    local feedback=self:feedback()
    local reduced=self.options.reducedMotion
    local shake=feedback and feedback.negative and not reduced and feedback.age<.4
        and math.floor(math.sin(feedback.age*45)*(1-feedback.age/.4)*2) or 0
    local x,y=box.x+shake,box.y
    rect(P.border,x,y,box.w,box.h,alpha); rect(P.panel,x+1,y+1,box.w-2,box.h-2,alpha)
    Font.draw(self.name,x+4,y+3,{maxWidth=box.w-8,align="center",color={P.ink[1],P.ink[2],P.ink[3],alpha}})
    for i,field in ipairs(self.fields) do
        local row=y+13+(i-1)*14
        Font.draw(field.label,x+5,row,{maxWidth=58,color={P.muted[1],P.muted[2],P.muted[3],alpha}})
        local value=math.floor(clamp(self.value[field.key])+.5)
        Font.draw(tostring(value),x+box.w-26,row,{maxWidth=21,align="right",color={P.ink[1],P.ink[2],P.ink[3],alpha}})
        rect(P.shadow,x+5,row+9,box.w-10,4,alpha)
        rect(Bars.colors[field.key],x+6,row+10,math.floor((box.w-12)*clamp(self.value[field.key])/100),2,alpha)
        local delta=feedback and feedback.deltas[field.key] or 0
        if delta~=0 then
            local lift=reduced and 0 or math.floor(math.min(1,feedback.age/.8)*4)
            local tint=delta>0 and P.green or P.danger
            Font.draw(signed(delta),x+box.w-51,row-lift,{maxWidth=24,align="right",color={tint[1],tint[2],tint[3],alpha}})
        end
    end
    if feedback and feedback.positive and not feedback.negative then
        if self.character=="nanahoshi" then
            rect(Bars.colors.interest,x+box.w-12,y+4,2,6,alpha); rect(Bars.colors.interest,x+box.w-14,y+6,6,2,alpha)
        else
            local lift=reduced and 0 or math.floor(math.min(1,feedback.age)*3)
            heart(x+box.w-14,y+4-lift,alpha)
        end
    end
    return box
end
return Bars
````

## src/ui/screen.lua

````lua
local Font = require("src.ui.font")
local W = require("src.ui.widgets")
local P = require("src.ui.palette")
local Controls = require("src.config.controls")
local Screen = {}
Screen.__index = Screen

function Screen.new(app)
    return setmetatable({app=app,buttons={}},Screen)
end

function Screen:begin()
    self.buttons = {}
end

function Screen:text(text,x,y,width,color,scale,align)
    Font.draw(tostring(text or ""),x,y,{maxWidth=width,color=color or P.ink,scale=scale or 1,align=align or "left"})
end

function Screen:button(label,x,y,w,h,action,disabled,selected)
    local mx,my = self.app:mouse()
    local hover = mx and mx >= x and mx < x+w and my >= y and my < y+h
    if hover and not disabled then
        local target=label..":"..x..":"..y
        if self.hoveredButton~=target and self.app.audio then self.app.audio:effect("menu") end
        self.hoveredButton=target
    end
    W.button(label,x,y,w,h,{hover=hover,disabled=disabled,selected=selected or self.keyboardFocus==#self.buttons+1})
    self.buttons[#self.buttons+1]={label=label,x=x,y=y,w=w,h=h,action=action,disabled=disabled}
    return hover
end

function Screen:click(x,y,button)
    if button ~= 1 then return false end
    self.keyboardFocus=nil
    for _,b in ipairs(self.buttons) do
        if x >= b.x and x < b.x+b.w and y >= b.y and y < b.y+b.h then
            if not b.disabled then
                if self.app.audio then self.app.audio:effect("confirm") end
                b.action()
            end
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- Reutiliza las mismas acciones e hitboxes del mouse. Tab y flechas verticales
-- recorren botones habilitados; Enter/Espacio activan únicamente el foco visible.
function Screen:navigate(key)
    local direction=(Controls.matches(Controls.previousButton,key) and -1)
        or (Controls.matches(Controls.nextButton,key) and 1)
    if direction then
        local count=#self.buttons
        if count==0 then return true end
        local current=self.keyboardFocus or (direction==1 and 0 or count+1)
        for _=1,count do
            current=(current-1+direction)%count+1
            local button=self.buttons[current]
            if button.label and not button.disabled then
                self.keyboardFocus=current
                if self.app.audio then self.app.audio:effect("menu") end
                return true
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    if self.keyboardFocus and Controls.matches(Controls.advance,key) then
        local button=self.buttons[self.keyboardFocus]
        if not button then self.keyboardFocus=nil; return false end
        if button and not button.disabled then
            if self.app.audio then self.app.audio:effect("confirm") end
            button.action()
        end
        return true
    end
    return false
end

function Screen:header(title,back)
    W.panel(8,7,624,30)
    self:text(title,18,18,340,P.gold)
    if back then
        self:button("Volver",548,12,76,20,function() self.app:resume() end)
    else
        self:button("Diario [J]",350,12,94,20,function() self.app:overlay("journal") end)
        self:button("Mazo [M]",450,12,88,20,function() self.app:overlay("deck") end)
        self:button("Pausa",544,12,80,20,function() self.app:overlay("pause") end)
    end
end

function Screen:mousepressed(x,y,button) self:click(x,y,button) end
function Screen:keypressed(key) self:navigate(key) end
return Screen
````

````lua
local P = require("src.ui.palette")
local Font = require("src.ui.font")
local W = {}
local function rect(color,x,y,w,h)
    love.graphics.setColor(color); love.graphics.rectangle("fill",math.floor(x),math.floor(y),w,h)
end
function W.panel(x,y,w,h,opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    if opts.shadow ~= false then rect(P.shadow,x+3,y+3,w,h) end
    rect(opts.border or P.border,x+1,y,w-2,h)
    rect(opts.border or P.border,x,y+1,w,h-2)
    rect(opts.fill or P.panel,x+1,y+1,w-2,h-2)
    if opts.accent then rect(opts.accent,x+1,y+1,2,h-2) end
end
function W.button(label,x,y,w,h,opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local active = (opts.hover or opts.selected) and not opts.disabled
    W.panel(x,y,w,h,{border=active and P.gold or P.border,fill=active and P.panelLight or P.panel,shadow=opts.shadow})
    if active then rect(P.gold,x+2,y+2,2,h-4) end
    local scale = opts.scale or 1
    local height = Font.height(label,w-12,scale)
    Font.draw(label,x+6,y+math.floor((h-height)/2),{maxWidth=w-12,align=opts.align or "center",scale=scale,color=opts.disabled and P.border or (active and P.gold or P.ink)})
end
function W.bar(x,y,w,h,value,maximum,color)
    rect(P.shadow,x,y,w,h)
    local ratio = math.max(0,math.min(1,(tonumber(value) or 0)/math.max(1,maximum or 10)))
    local available = w-2
    rect(color or P.teal,x+1,y+1,math.floor(available*ratio),h-2)
    local divisions=math.min(10,maximum or 10)
    for i=1,divisions-1 do rect(P.panel,x+math.floor(available*i/divisions),y+1,1,h-2) end
end
function W.label(text,x,y,opts) return Font.draw(text,x,y,opts) end
function W.divider(x,y,w,color) rect(color or P.border,x,y,w,1) end
return W
````

````lua
local Suite={}

function Suite.run()
    local Audio=require("src.systems.audio")
    local Options=require("src.systems.options")
    local Manifest=require("src.data.audio")
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local checked=0
    local function check(ok,message) assert(ok,message); checked=checked+1 end
    local function near(a,b) return math.abs(a-b)<.00001 end
    local d=Options.normalize()
    check(d.volume==.6 and d.musicVolume==.45 and d.effectsVolume==.55,"Volúmenes iniciales")
    check(d.textSpeed==50 and d.textAnimation and not d.reducedMotion,"Lectura y movimiento iniciales")
    check(not d.tutorialCompleted and not d.fullscreen,"Guía y pantalla iniciales")
    local old=Options.normalize({volume=.2,muted=true})
    check(old.volume==.2 and old.muted and old.musicVolume==.45,"Compatibilidad con opciones antiguas")
    local bad=Options.normalize({volume=-5,musicVolume=9,effectsVolume=0/0,textSpeed=math.huge,
        muted="yes",textAnimation=false,reducedMotion=true,fullscreen=true,tutorialCompleted=true})
    check(bad.volume==0 and bad.musicVolume==1 and bad.effectsVolume==.55,"Normalizar volúmenes corruptos")
    check(bad.textSpeed==50 and not bad.muted and not bad.textAnimation,"Normalizar texto y booleanos")
    check(bad.reducedMotion and bad.fullscreen and bad.tutorialCompleted,"Persistir banderas accesibles")
    check(Options.normalize({textSpeed=1}).textSpeed==15 and Options.normalize({textSpeed=999}).textSpeed==100,"Límites de velocidad")

    local sources,samples={},0
    local function source()
        local s={plays=0,stops=0,volume=0,playing=false}
        function s:setVolume(v) assert(v>=0 and v<=1); self.volume=v end
        function s:setLooping(v) self.looping=v end
        function s:play() self.plays=self.plays+1; self.playing=true end
        function s:stop() self.stops=self.stops+1; self.playing=false end
        function s:clone() return source() end
        sources[#sources+1]=s
        return s
    end
    local fake={
        getInfo=function(path) if path=="broken.ogg" then return {size=3} end end,
        newSource=function(value) if value=="broken.ogg" then error("bad audio") end; return source() end,
        newSoundData=function(count,rate,bits,channels)
            assert(count>0 and rate==22050 and bits==16 and channels==1)
            return {setSample=function(_,i,value) assert(i>=0 and i<count and math.abs(value)<=.2); samples=samples+1 end}
        end,
    }
    local manager=Audio.new({volume=.8,musicVolume=.5,effectsVolume=.25},{backend=fake})
    check(manager:setContext("menu"),"Comenzar contexto musical")
    local first=manager.current.source
    check(first.plays==1 and first.looping and first.volume==0,"Música entra desde silencio y repite")
    manager:update(.225)
    check(near(first.volume,.2),"Fundido de entrada a mitad")
    manager:update(.225)
    check(near(first.volume,.4),"Maestro multiplicado una sola vez")
    check(not manager:setContext("menu") and first.plays==1,"No reiniciar el mismo contexto")
    check(manager:setContext("forest") and manager.outgoing.source==first,"Cambio inicia fundido cruzado intencional")
    local second=manager.current.source
    manager:update(.225)
    check(near(first.volume,.2) and near(second.volume,.2),"Dos pistas solo durante el fundido")
    manager:setContext("mystery")
    check(not first.playing and manager.outgoing.source==second,"Cambios rápidos detienen la salida antigua")
    manager:update(1)
    check(not second.playing and manager.outgoing==nil,"Fundido de salida termina y detiene la fuente")
    manager:setOptions({volume=.8,musicVolume=.5,effectsVolume=.25,muted=true})
    check(manager.current.source.volume==0,"Silencio afecta a música activa")
    check(not manager:effect("confirm"),"No crear efectos silenciados")
    local musicPlays=manager.current.source.plays
    manager:setOptions({volume=.8,musicVolume=.5,effectsVolume=.25})
    check(near(manager.current.source.volume,.4) and manager.current.source.plays==musicPlays,"Restaurar volumen sin reinicio")
    check(manager:effect("menu"),"Reproducir efecto original")
    check(near(manager.effectVoices[1].source.volume,.2),"Volumen independiente de efectos")
    check(not manager:effect("menu") and not manager:effect("card_select"),"Evitar saturación de navegación")
    manager:update(.1)
    check(manager:effect("card_select"),"Navegación disponible tras intervalo")
    for _,id in ipairs({"confirm","cancel","card_draw","card_play","positive","negative","magic","new_day",
        "text_blip","card_discard","scene_change","combat_start","attack","guard","hurt","heal","victory","defeat"}) do
        check(manager:effect(id),"Efecto sintetizado: "..id)
        check(#manager.effectVoices<=4,"Límite de voces: "..id)
    end
    manager:update(1)
    check(#manager.effectVoices==0,"Las voces finalizan")
    local contexts=0
    for id in pairs(Manifest.music) do
        manager:setContext(id); manager:update(1)
        check(manager.current and manager.current.source.playing,"Contexto musical original: "..id)
        contexts=contexts+1
    end
    check(contexts==17 and Manifest.music.training and samples>0,"Diecisiete contextos, incluido entrenamiento, contienen PCM sintetizado")
    manager:setContext("victory")
    check(manager.current.source.looping==false,"La fanfarria de victoria no se repite")
    manager:stop()
    check(not manager.current and not manager.outgoing and #manager.effectVoices==0,"Detener gestor libera voces")

    local missingManifest={music={absent={path="missing.ogg"},broken={path="broken.ogg"},
        fallback={path="missing.ogg",synth={notes={60,64},beat=.1}}},effects={}}
    local silent=Audio.new(nil,{backend=fake,manifest=missingManifest})
    check(silent:setContext("absent") and not silent.current,"Archivo ausente produce silencio seguro")
    check(#silent.warnings==1 and not silent:setContext("absent"),"Diagnóstico no se repite cada frame")
    check(silent:setContext("broken") and not silent.current,"Archivo inválido produce silencio seguro")
    check(silent:setContext("fallback") and silent.current~=nil,"Respaldo sintetizado declarado")
    check(silent:setContext("unknown") and not silent.current,"Contexto desconocido seguro")
    check(not silent:effect("unknown"),"Efecto desconocido seguro")
    silent:update(1); silent:stop()

    -- Comprueba muestras LÖVE reales; no depende de tener altavoces conectados.
    if love and love.sound then
        local pcm=Audio.synthesize(Manifest.effects.positive,false,love.sound.newSoundData)
        check(pcm:getSampleRate()==22050 and pcm:getChannelCount()==1,"Síntesis real mono 22050 Hz")
        check(pcm:getSampleCount()==math.floor(.25*22050),"Duración de efecto real")
        local maximum,nonzero=0,false
        for i=0,pcm:getSampleCount()-1 do
            local value=pcm:getSample(i)
            maximum=math.max(maximum,math.abs(value)); nonzero=nonzero or value~=0
        end
        check(nonzero and maximum<=.17,"Efecto contiene audio discreto sin clipping")
    end

    -- El runner usa identidad aislada; nunca se sobrescriben opciones del jugador.
    if love and love.filesystem and love.filesystem.getIdentity():match("_tests$") then
        local before=Save.readOptions()
        local requested=Options.normalize({volume=.27,musicVolume=.34,effectsVolume=.41,muted=true,
            textSpeed=75,textAnimation=false,reducedMotion=true,fullscreen=true,tutorialCompleted=true})
        check(Save.writeOptions(requested),"Guardar preferencias reales en disco aislado")
        local loaded=Save.readOptions()
        for key,value in pairs(requested) do check(loaded[key]==value,"Restaurar preferencia "..key) end
        check(Save.writeOptions(before),"Restaurar preferencias previas de pruebas")
    end
    print("Audio/options: "..checked.." checks passed (synthesis, fades, missing files and persistent preferences).")
    return checked
end

return Suite
````

````lua
-- Native-size typography and the real collection screen, without app saves.
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    local Collection=require("src.screens.collection")
    local Data=require("src.data.cards")
    local Font=require("src.ui.font")
    local Card=require("src.ui.card")
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local checks=0
    local function check(value,message) assert(value,message); checks=checks+1 end
    local session=Save.newSession()
    session.unlocked.self_joke,session.unlocked.remember=true,true
    local before=assert(Json.encode(session))
    local groups=Collection.groups(session)
    check(#groups.equipped==10 and #groups.available==2 and #groups.locked==4,"Collection groups the fixed deck, earned cards and future cards")
    local seen={}
    for _,state in ipairs({"equipped","available","locked"}) do
        for _,entry in ipairs(groups[state]) do
            check(not seen[entry.card.id],"A card appears in exactly one collection group")
            seen[entry.card.id]=true
        end
    end
    for _,card in ipairs(Data.list) do
        check(seen[card.id],"Every card remains accessible in the collection")
        check(Font.width(card.shortName)<=Card.regions.name.w,"Native-size short label fits in one line: "..card.id)
        check(Font.height(card.shortName,Card.regions.name.w)==11,"Short card name never shrinks or wraps: "..card.id)
        check(Card.labels(card).name==card.shortName,"The card face uses its declared visual label")
        local details=Collection.details(card,session)
        check(details.name==card.name,"Details retain the full logical card name")
        check(details.category==Data.categories[card.category] and details.cost=="Energía: "..card.cost,"Details show canonical category and cost")
        check(type(details.unlock)=="string" and #details.unlock>0 and not details.unlock:find("Capítulos futuros",1,true),"Every unlock has a specific known requirement")
        check(Font.height(details.description,275)<=33,"Full description fits in the detail panel")
        check(Font.height(details.base,275)<=22,"Base effect values fit in the detail panel")
        check(Font.height("OBTENCIÓN: "..details.unlock,275)<=22,"Unlock method fits in the detail panel")
        check(Font.height(details.affinity,183)<=33 and Font.height(details.contexts,275)<=22,"Affinity and recommended contexts fit")
    end
    local returns,sounds=0,0
    local app={session=session,resources=require("src.systems.resources").new():preload(),
        mouse=function() return nil,nil end,
        resume=function() returns=returns+1 end,
        audio={effect=function(_,name) if name=="card_select" then sounds=sounds+1 end end}}
    local screen=Collection.new(app)
    local originalFontDraw=Font.draw
    local ok,err=xpcall(function()
        -- Actual text calls must stay within their assigned rows at the 640x360
        -- logical resolution. Integer window scaling preserves the same bounds.
        local heights={[56]=11,[79]=22,[107]=11,[132]=11,[155]=33,[198]=33,[234]=22,[261]=11,[274]=22,[299]=22,[328]=11,[347]=11}
        for index,card in ipairs(Data.list) do
            screen.selected=index
            local fullName,cost,unlock=false,false,false
            Font.draw=function(text,x,y,opts)
                local allowed=heights[y]
                if x>=337 and allowed then
                    check(Font.height(text,opts.maxWidth,opts.scale)<=allowed,"Rendered detail text fits its reserved row: "..card.id)
                    check(x+opts.maxWidth<=626 and y+allowed<=342,"Rendered detail text stays inside its panel")
                end
                fullName=fullName or text==card.name
                cost=cost or text=="Energía: "..card.cost
                unlock=unlock or text=="OBTENCIÓN: "..card.unlockHint
                return originalFontDraw(text,x,y,opts)
            end
            screen:draw()
            check(fullName and cost and unlock,"Rendered full name, cost and unlock requirement: "..card.id)
        end
        Font.draw=originalFontDraw
        screen:draw()
        for index=1,#Data.list do
            local row
            for _,button in ipairs(screen.buttons) do if button.cardIndex==index then row=button end end
            check(row~=nil and row.y+row.h<=342,"Every collection row has a visible mouse hitbox")
            screen:mousepressed(row.x+4,row.y+4,1)
            check(screen.selected==index,"Mouse can inspect every card, including locked cards")
        end
        local initial=screen.selected
        local visited={}
        for _=1,#Data.list do screen:keypressed("right"); visited[screen.selected]=true end
        check(screen.selected==initial,"Keyboard inspection wraps through the collection")
        for i=1,#Data.list do check(visited[i],"Keyboard reaches every card") end
        screen.keyboardFocus=nil
        screen:keypressed("tab"); screen:keypressed("down"); screen:keypressed("down"); screen:keypressed("return")
        check(screen.selected==2,"Tab/Enter activate the visible list row")
        screen:keypressed("escape")
        check(returns==1 and sounds>0,"Back returns once and selection produces sound")
        check(Json.encode(session)==before,"Inspecting the collection never edits the deck, unlocks or narrative")
    end,debug.traceback)
    Font.draw=originalFontDraw
    assert(ok,err)
    print("Collection: "..checks.." checks passed (16 readable faces, complete details, grouped states and input).")
    return checks
end
return Suite
````

````lua
-- Regresión de capítulos y partidas de Fase 1. No escribe partidas ni recursos;
-- los fallos físicos se simulan mediante hooks que siempre se restauran.
local Suite={}

function Suite.run()
    local Chapters=require("src.data.chapters")
    local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
    local Conditions=require("src.systems.conditions")
    local Validator=require("src.systems.narrative_validator")
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
    local Data=require("src.data.cards")
    local Events=require("src.systems.events")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local Font=require("src.ui.font")
    local count=0
    local function check(ok,message) assert(ok,message); count=count+1 end
    local function encode(value) return assert(Json.encode(value)) end
    local function copy(value)
        if type(value)~="table" then return value end
        local out={}; for k,v in pairs(value) do out[k]=copy(v) end
        return out
    end
    local function roundtrip(session)
        return assert(Save.validate(assert(Json.decode(encode(session)))))
    end
    local function advance(session,destination,result)
        local nextId,err=Progression.next(session,session.checkpoint,result)
        check(nextId==destination,"Avanzar a "..destination..": "..tostring(err))
        check(session.dialogueIndex==1 and session.encounter==nil,"Transición limpia el estado de pantalla")
        return roundtrip(session)
    end
    local companions={"sylphiette","roxy","eris"}
    local exclusive={"shared_magic","combined_spell","sword_magic","choose_together"}
    local function checkLocked(session)
        for _,id in ipairs(exclusive) do check(not session.unlocked[id],"No adelantar desbloqueo de "..id) end
    end

    -- Fixture del esquema anterior, no generado por Save.newSession ni por el
    -- registro nuevo: debe seguir siendo compatible aunque cambien ambos.
    local function legacy(companion)
        local session={version=1,day=2,checkpoint="phase_complete",dialogueIndex=1,
            relationships={},deck={"listen","encourage","light_joke","change_subject","be_honest",
                "admit_error","share_fear","propose_plan","analyze_runes","earth_barrier"},
            unlocked={remember=true,self_joke=true},
            events={first_anomaly=true,day1_complete=true,all_reunions=true,companion_selected=true,
                seal_memory=true,day2_complete=true,phase1_complete=true},
            decisions={companion=companion,choice_meet_sylphiette="listen_first",sylphiette_priority="listen",
                choice_meet_roxy="compare_notes",roxy_equality="colleagues",
                choice_meet_eris="mutual_support",eris_support="mutual"},
            options={volume=.3,muted=true},selectedCompanion=companion}
        for _,id in ipairs(session.deck) do session.unlocked[id]=true end
        for _,id in ipairs(companions) do
            session.relationships[id]={trust=1,chemistry=0,events={reunion=true},routeState="friend",decisions={}}
            session.events["meeting_"..id]=true
            session.events["choice_meet_"..id]=true
            if id==companion then session.relationships[id].events.memory_seal=true end
        end
        return session
    end

    local ok,errors=Validator.validate(Chapters)
    check(ok,"Registro narrativo válido: "..table.concat(errors or {},"; "))
    for day=1,3 do
        local chapter=Chapters.byId["day"..day]
        check(chapter and chapter.day==day and chapter.implemented~=false,"Capítulo implementado: "..day)
        check(Chapters.get(chapter.initial)~=nil,"Escena inicial registrada: "..day)
    end
    for day=4,7 do
        local chapter=Chapters.byId["day"..day]
        check(chapter and chapter.implemented==false,"Capítulo futuro declarado sin escenas: "..day)
        check(not chapter.initial or not Chapters.get(chapter.initial),"No publicar checkpoint futuro: "..day)
    end
    for _,id in ipairs({"intro","day1_tutorial","hub","meet_sylphiette","meet_roxy","meet_eris",
        "seal_intro","seal_encounter","seal_result","day2_close","phase_complete"}) do
        check(Chapters.get(id)~=nil,"Conservar checkpoint antiguo: "..id)
    end

    for _,oldCompanion in ipairs(companions) do
        local old=legacy(oldCompanion)
        local loaded=roundtrip(old)
        check(loaded.checkpoint=="phase_complete" and loaded.day==2,"Cargar resumen anterior sin saltos implícitos")
        check(encode(loaded.relationships)==encode(old.relationships),"Migrar conserva todos los vínculos")
        check(encode(loaded.decisions)==encode(old.decisions),"Migrar conserva decisiones antiguas")
        check(encode(loaded.deck)==encode(old.deck) and encode(loaded.unlocked)==encode(old.unlocked),
            "Migrar conserva mazo y colección")
        check(loaded.options.volume==.3 and loaded.options.muted,"Migrar conserva preferencias")
        check(Progression.canContinue(loaded),"Resumen de Fase 1 ofrece continuación")
        local before=encode(loaded.relationships)
        loaded=advance(loaded,"day3_intro")
        check(loaded.day==3 and loaded.decisions.companion==oldCompanion,"Avanzar día manteniendo compañía histórica")
        check(encode(loaded.relationships)==before and loaded.events.seal_memory,"Continuar no vuelve a conceder el primer sello")
        check(loaded.route==nil,"Continuar no fija una ruta romántica")
        checkLocked(loaded)
    end

    local variants={}
    local forestTexts,illusionTexts={},{}
    local choicesByCharacter={sylphiette={"agree_messages","stay_present"},
        roxy={"check_together","value_company"},eris={"share_guard","stand_beside"}}
    local successCards={sylphiette={"listen","be_honest","share_fear"},
        roxy={"propose_plan","analyze_runes","admit_error"},
        eris={"earth_barrier","encourage","propose_plan"}}
    local kinds={sylphiette="conversation",roxy="investigation",eris="magic"}
    local function orderedDeck(first)
        local chosen,deck={},{}
        for _,id in ipairs(first) do chosen[id]=true end
        for _,id in ipairs(Data.starterDeck) do if not chosen[id] then deck[#deck+1]=id end end
        for i=#first,1,-1 do deck[#deck+1]=first[i] end
        return deck
    end

    -- Cada acompañante, ambas decisiones y ambos resultados, con cargas
    -- intermedias y acciones reales del motor de cartas.
    for i,companion in ipairs(companions) do
        for choiceIndex=1,2 do
            for _,high in ipairs({false,true}) do
                local oldCompanion=companions[i%3+1]
                local session=roundtrip(legacy(oldCompanion))
                session=advance(session,"day3_intro")
                local intro=Progression.scene(session,"day3_intro")
                local speakers={}
                for _,line in ipairs(intro.lines) do speakers[line.speaker]=true end
                check(speakers.rudeus and speakers.nanahoshi and speakers.cliff,"Nueva pista reúne a Rudy, Nanahoshi y Cliff")
                session=advance(session,"day3_companion")
                check(#Progression.availableCompanions(session)==3,"Tres acompañantes disponibles cada día tres")
                local before=encode(session)
                check(not Progression.selectCompanion(session,"unknown"),"Rechazar compañía desconocida")
                check(encode(session)==before,"Selección inválida no altera estado")
                check(Progression.selectCompanion(session,companion)=="day3_forest","Elegir compañía para el bosque")
                check(session.decisions.day3_companion==companion and session.decisions.companion==oldCompanion,
                    "Compañías de día dos y tres independientes")
                check(session.route==nil,"Elección de expedición no bloquea romance")
                session=roundtrip(session)
                check(Progression.companion(session,"day3_forest")==companion,"Resolver acompañante desde capítulo")
                local forest=Progression.scene(session,"day3_forest")
                forestTexts[companion]=encode(forest.lines)
                check(forest.background=="forest" and #forest.lines>=3,"Conversación completa en el bosque")
                check(#forest.choices==2,"Dos decisiones propias del personaje")
                local found=false
                for _,line in ipairs(forest.lines) do
                    if line.speaker==companion then found=true end
                    check(Font.height(line.text,572)<=66,"Diálogo del bosque cabe sin recorte")
                end
                check(found,"Acompañante habla con voz propia en el bosque")
                check(not Progression.next(session),"No saltar una decisión pendiente del bosque")
                local choice=forest.choices[choiceIndex]
                check(choice.id==choicesByCharacter[companion][choiceIndex],"Decisión específica de "..companion)
                check(Font.height(choice.label,419)<=22,"Elección del bosque cabe en su botón")
                local trust,chemistry=session.relationships[companion].trust,session.relationships[companion].chemistry
                check(Progression.choose(session,"day3_forest",choice.id),"Confirmar decisión del bosque")
                check(session.relationships[companion].trust==trust+(choice.effects.trust or 0)
                    and session.relationships[companion].chemistry==chemistry+(choice.effects.chemistry or 0),
                    "Decisión concede solo sus deltas de relación")
                local afterChoice=encode(session.relationships)
                check(Progression.choose(session,"day3_forest",choice.id),"Repetir decisión confirmada es seguro")
                check(not Progression.choose(session,"day3_forest",forest.choices[3-choiceIndex].id),"No sustituir decisión confirmada")
                session=roundtrip(session)
                check(encode(session.relationships)==afterChoice,"Cargar decisión no duplica vínculos")
                check(Progression.scene(session,"day3_forest").choices==nil,"Escena contestada permite continuar al cargar")
                session=advance(session,"day3_illusion")
                local illusion=Progression.scene(session,"day3_illusion")
                illusionTexts[companion]=encode(illusion.lines)
                check(illusion.background=="ruins" and #illusion.lines>=3,"Ilusión completa en las ruinas")
                for _,line in ipairs(illusion.lines) do check(Font.height(line.text,572)<=66,"Ilusión cabe en cuadro de diálogo") end
                session=advance(session,"day3_encounter")
                session.deck=orderedDeck(successCards[companion])
                check(Cards.validateDeck(session.deck,session.unlocked),"Mazo de diez cartas normales para el encuentro")
                local definition=Progression.encounter(session,session.checkpoint)
                check(definition.character==companion and definition.kind==kinds[companion],"Contexto apropiado para el temor de "..companion)
                session.encounter=Cards.new(session.deck,{kind=definition.kind,character=definition.character},function(n) return n end)
                check(#session.encounter.hand==3 and session.encounter.energy==4 and session.encounter.maxTurns==3,
                    "Día tres conserva las reglas de cartas")
                local relationsBefore=encode(session.relationships)
                local baseTrust,baseChemistry=session.relationships[companion].trust,session.relationships[companion].chemistry
                for turn=1,3 do
                    local result
                    if high then result=Cards.play(session.encounter,1) else result=Cards.pass(session.encounter) end
                    check(result~=nil,"Acción válida del turno "..turn)
                    check(result.cardId==(high and successCards[companion][turn] or "pass"),"Acción esperada, sin sustituir una carta por un pase")
                    check(session.encounter.turn==turn+1 and #session.encounter.log==turn,"Una sola acción por turno")
                    local expected=encode(session.encounter)
                    session=roundtrip(session)
                    check(encode(session.encounter)==expected,"Cargar preserva pilas, energía, turno y registro")
                    check(encode(session.relationships)==relationsBefore,"Acción no confirma vínculos prematuramente")
                end
                check(session.encounter.finished,"Encuentro termina en tres acciones")
                local result={score=session.encounter.score,trust=0,chemistry=0}
                for _,entry in ipairs(session.encounter.log) do
                    result.trust=result.trust+entry.trust
                    result.chemistry=result.chemistry+entry.chemistry
                end
                check((result.score>=definition.targetScore)==high,"Las cartas apropiadas alcanzan éxito y pasar produce parcial")
                session=advance(session,"day3_result",result)
                check(session.decisions.outcome_day3_encounter==(high and "success" or "partial"),"Registrar resultado apropiado")
                check(session.relationships[companion].trust==math.min(10,baseTrust+result.trust)
                    and session.relationships[companion].chemistry==math.min(10,baseChemistry+result.chemistry),
                    "Confirmar exactamente los efectos de las cartas")
                local afterEncounter=encode(session.relationships)
                check(not Progression.next(session,"day3_encounter",result),"Confirmación desde pantalla anterior rechazada")
                check(encode(session.relationships)==afterEncounter,"Resultado repetido no duplica efectos")
                local replay=roundtrip(session)
                replay.checkpoint="day3_encounter"
                check(Progression.next(replay,"day3_encounter",result)=="day3_result","Revisitar encuentro registrado continúa")
                check(encode(replay.relationships)==afterEncounter,"Evento persistido impide duplicar recompensa al revisitar")
                local resultScene=Progression.scene(session,"day3_result")
                variants[companion..tostring(high)]=encode(resultScene.lines)
                check(#resultScene.lines>=2,"Resultado tiene diálogo narrativo")
                session=advance(session,"day3_truth")
                check(not session.events.seal_truth,"Visitar escena del sello no anticipa recompensa")
                local beforeSeal=session.relationships[companion].trust
                session=advance(session,"day3_return")
                check(session.events.seal_truth and session.unlocked.remember,"Recuperar Sello de la Verdad y recompensa normal")
                check(session.relationships[companion].trust==math.min(10,beforeSeal+1),"Sello concede confianza una vez")
                local afterSeal=encode(session.relationships)
                check(not Events.apply(session,"seal_truth",{character=companion,trust=4}),"Sello con clave estable es idempotente")
                session=roundtrip(session)
                check(encode(session.relationships)==afterSeal,"Guardar/cargar sello no modifica vínculos")
                replay=roundtrip(session); replay.checkpoint="day3_truth"
                check(Progression.next(replay)=="day3_return","Volver a escena del sello sigue permitiendo salir")
                check(encode(replay.relationships)==afterSeal,"Revisitar sello no concede premio otra vez")
                checkLocked(session)
                session=advance(session,"day3_complete")
                check(session.day==3 and session.events.day3_complete and session.events.seal_truth,"Cierre claro del día tres")
                check(session.decisions.companion==oldCompanion and session.decisions.day3_companion==companion,
                    "Resumen conserva ambas compañías y decisiones")
                check(session.route==nil and not Progression.canContinue(session),"Resumen no abre una ruta ni un capítulo incompleto")
                local terminal=encode(session)
                local nextId=Progression.next(session)
                check(nextId==nil or nextId=="day3_complete","Terminal no envía a escena inexistente")
                check(encode(session)==terminal,"Intentar continuar terminal no altera guardado")
                check(roundtrip(session).checkpoint=="day3_complete","Resumen final se restaura correctamente")
            end
        end
    end
    for i=1,#companions do
        local id=companions[i]
        check(variants[id.."true"]~=variants[id.."false"],"Éxito y parcial tienen diálogo distinto: "..id)
        for j=i+1,#companions do
            check(forestTexts[id]~=forestTexts[companions[j]],"Bosque distinto entre acompañantes")
            check(illusionTexts[id]~=illusionTexts[companions[j]],"Ilusión distinta entre acompañantes")
        end
    end

    for _,companion in ipairs(companions) do
        local adjusted=legacy("roxy")
        adjusted.day,adjusted.checkpoint=3,"day3_encounter"
        adjusted.decisions.day3_companion=companion
        adjusted.relationships[companion].trust=3
        check(Progression.encounter(adjusted,"day3_encounter").targetScore==5,"Vínculo bajo mantiene dificultad base")
        adjusted.relationships[companion].trust=4
        check(Progression.encounter(adjusted,"day3_encounter").targetScore==4,"Confianza acumulada ayuda sin cambiar reglas de cartas")
        adjusted=roundtrip(adjusted)
        check(Progression.encounter(adjusted,"day3_encounter").targetScore==4,"Carga conserva ajuste por relación")
    end

    local damaged=legacy("roxy")
    damaged.day,damaged.checkpoint=3,"day3_encounter"
    damaged.events.day3_companion_selected=true
    damaged=roundtrip(damaged)
    check(damaged.checkpoint=="day3_companion" and damaged.encounter==nil,"Compañía perdida recupera selector del día correcto")
    check(damaged.decisions.companion=="roxy" and not damaged.events.day3_companion_selected,
        "Recuperación no borra compañero histórico ni impide elegir de nuevo")
    check(Progression.selectCompanion(damaged,"eris")=="day3_forest","Guardado incompleto puede repararse sin reiniciar")
    damaged.decisions.choice_day3_forest="check_together"
    damaged.events.choice_day3_forest=true
    local beforeRepair=encode(damaged.relationships)
    damaged=roundtrip(damaged)
    check(damaged.decisions.choice_day3_forest==nil,"Descartar decisión que pertenece a otra variante")
    check(Progression.choose(damaged,"day3_forest","share_guard"),"Recuperar una decisión perdida o incompatible")
    check(encode(damaged.relationships)==beforeRepair,"Evento previo evita duplicar vínculos al reparar decisión")

    local reward=legacy("roxy")
    reward.day,reward.checkpoint=3,"day3_truth"
    reward.decisions.day3_companion="eris"
    reward.unlocked.remember=nil
    reward=roundtrip(reward)
    local originalDeck=encode(reward.deck)
    check(not reward.unlocked.remember,"Preparar colección antigua sin recompensa normal")
    reward=advance(reward,"day3_return")
    check(reward.unlocked.remember and encode(reward.deck)==originalDeck,"Sello concede carta normal sin editar mazo equipado")
    checkLocked(reward)

    -- Sin energía, una mano de cartas de coste positivo mantiene siempre la
    -- salida gratuita. No se serializa este estado sintético: restore recalcula.
    local exhausted=Cards.new(Data.starterDeck,{kind="magic",character="eris"},function(n) return n end)
    exhausted.energy=0
    for index in ipairs(exhausted.hand) do check(not Cards.canPlay(exhausted,index),"Mano cara deshabilitada sin energía") end
    for _=1,3 do check(Cards.pass(exhausted)~=nil,"Acción gratuita disponible sin energía") end
    check(exhausted.finished and exhausted.energy==0,"Agotar energía no bloquea final del encuentro")

    local conditionSession=legacy("roxy")
    conditionSession.decisions.day3_companion="eris"
    conditionSession.relationships.eris.trust=4
    conditionSession.relationships.eris.chemistry=2
    local context={companion="eris"}
    check(Conditions.evaluate(conditionSession,nil,context),"Sin requisitos permite transición")
    check(Conditions.evaluate(conditionSession,{all={{event="seal_memory"},{decision="day3_companion",equals="eris"}}},context),
        "Combinar requisitos de evento y decisión")
    check(Conditions.evaluate(conditionSession,{any={{event="seal_truth"},{decision="companion",oneOf={"roxy","sylphiette"}}}},context),
        "Alternativas de condición")
    check(Conditions.evaluate(conditionSession,{["not"]={event="seal_truth"}},context),"Negación de evento pendiente")
    check(Conditions.evaluate(conditionSession,{event="seal_truth",equals=false},context),"Condición de evento todavía no completado")
    check(Conditions.evaluate(conditionSession,{relationship="companion",trust=4,chemistry=2},context),"Condición sobre vínculos del acompañante")
    check(not Conditions.evaluate(conditionSession,{relationship="companion",trust=5},context),"Requisito de confianza no cumplido")
    check(not Conditions.evaluate(conditionSession,{route="eris"},context),"Compañía no equivale a ruta")
    conditionSession.route="eris"
    check(Conditions.evaluate(conditionSession,{route="eris"},context),"Condición de ruta explícita")
    check(not Conditions.validate({execute="os.execute('anything')"}),"Rechazar operadores ejecutables")
    local executed=false
    check(not Conditions.validate({predicate=function() executed=true; return true end}),"Rechazar funciones en condiciones")
    check(not executed,"Validación nunca ejecuta código arbitrario")

    -- Preparación de una futura elección de ruta, sin publicar el día cinco.
    -- El mismo evento rechazado antes de tiempo debe poder aplicarse más tarde.
    local futureRoute=Save.newSession()
    local beforeRoute=encode(futureRoute)
    local routeReward={route="roxy",character="roxy",trust=2,unlock={"combined_spell"}}
    check(not Events.apply(futureRoute,"future_route_choice",routeReward),"No fijar ruta antes del día cinco")
    check(encode(futureRoute)==beforeRoute,"Ruta prematura no marca evento, concede puntos ni adelanta cartas")
    futureRoute.day=5
    check(Events.apply(futureRoute,"future_route_choice",routeReward) and futureRoute.route=="roxy"
        and futureRoute.unlocked.combined_spell and futureRoute.relationships.roxy.trust==2,
        "Efecto declarativo prepara elección explícita de ruta futura")
    check(not Events.apply(futureRoute,"future_route_choice",{route="eris",unlock={"sword_magic"}})
        and futureRoute.route=="roxy" and not futureRoute.unlocked.sword_magic,
        "Evento de ruta repetido no sustituye elección confirmada")
    check(not Events.apply(futureRoute,"invalid_route_choice",{route="nanahoshi"}) and not futureRoute.events.invalid_route_choice,
        "Rechazar ruta ajena a personajes románticos")

    -- El intérprete evalúa decisiones previas y utiliza la alternativa declarada
    -- cuando falla un requisito. Restaurar los datos incluso ante un fallo.
    local originalTransitions=Chapters.byId.day3.transitions.day3_intro
    local transitionsOk,transitionsError=xpcall(function()
        Chapters.byId.day3.transitions.day3_intro={
            {to="phase_complete",requires={decision="roxy_equality",equals="personal"}},
            {to="day3_companion"},
        }
        local path=legacy("roxy"); path.day,path.checkpoint=3,"day3_intro"
        check(Progression.next(path)=="day3_companion","Transición usa alternativa cuando no se cumple decisión previa")
        path=legacy("roxy"); path.day,path.checkpoint=3,"day3_intro"
        path.decisions.roxy_equality="personal"
        check(Progression.next(path)=="phase_complete","Transición selecciona rama por decisión previa")
    end,debug.traceback)
    Chapters.byId.day3.transitions.day3_intro=originalTransitions
    assert(transitionsOk,transitionsError)

    local function invalidCase(label,mutate)
        local list=copy(Chapters.list)
        mutate(list)
        local valid,messages=Validator.validate(Chapters.build(list))
        check(not valid and type(messages)=="table" and #messages>0,"Validador detecta "..label)
    end
    invalidCase("checkpoints duplicados",function(list) list[3].scenes.intro=copy(list[1].scenes.intro) end)
    invalidCase("destinos desconocidos",function(list) list[3].transitions.day3_intro[1].to="missing_checkpoint" end)
    invalidCase("personajes desconocidos",function(list) list[3].scenes.day3_intro.lines[1].speaker="missing_character" end)
    invalidCase("fondos desconocidos",function(list) list[3].scenes.day3_intro.background="missing_background" end)
    invalidCase("cartas desconocidas",function(list)
        list[3].transitions.day3_intro[1].effects={{id="invalid_reward",unlock={"missing_card"}}}
    end)
    invalidCase("cartas exclusivas antes del día permitido",function(list)
        list[3].transitions.day3_intro[1].effects={{id="premature_route_reward",unlock={"shared_magic"}}}
    end)
    invalidCase("condiciones inválidas",function(list) list[3].transitions.day3_intro[1].requires={execute="anything"} end)
    invalidCase("requisitos en campos de nodo que el motor no interpreta",function(list)
        list[3].scenes.day3_intro.requires={event="seal_memory"}
    end)
    invalidCase("elección de ruta antes del día cinco",function(list)
        list[3].transitions.day3_intro[1].effects={{id="premature_route",route="roxy"}}
    end)
    invalidCase("escenas sin salida",function(list) list[3].transitions.day3_intro=nil end)
    invalidCase("ciclos que impiden llegar al cierre",function(list) list[3].transitions.day3_return={{to="day3_intro"}} end)
    invalidCase("salidas bloqueadas por eventos imposibles",function(list)
        list[3].transitions.day3_intro[1].requires={event="never_emitted"}
    end)
    invalidCase("salida bloqueada por recompensa que solo se obtiene después",function(list)
        list[3].transitions.day3_intro[1].requires={event="day3_complete"}
    end)
    invalidCase("selector bloqueado por evento de un capítulo posterior",function(list)
        list[2].hubs.hub.companion.requires={event="day3_complete"}
    end)
    check(Validator.validate(Chapters),"Fixtures inválidos no modifican datos canónicos")

    -- Validar autoría puede exigir los archivos físicos; iniciar una partida
    -- permite que Resources diagnostique un PNG ausente y use su reserva.
    local Assets=require("src.data.assets")
    local originalInfo=love.filesystem.getInfo
    local filesOk,filesError=xpcall(function()
        love.filesystem.getInfo=function(path,...)
            if path==Assets.backgrounds.library then return nil end
            return originalInfo(path,...)
        end
        local valid,messages=Validator.validate(Chapters)
        check(not valid and #messages>0,"Validación de autoría detecta fondo físico ausente")
        check(Validator.validate(Chapters,{checkFiles=false}),"Inicio permite reserva visual sin abortar narrativa válida")
        local list=copy(Chapters.list)
        list[3].scenes.day3_intro.background="missing_background"
        check(not Validator.validate(Chapters.build(list),{checkFiles=false}),"Modo de ejecución sigue rechazando IDs de fondo desconocidos")
    end,debug.traceback)
    love.filesystem.getInfo=originalInfo
    assert(filesOk,filesError)

    print("Chapters: "..count.." checks passed (legacy saves, 12 day-three paths, conditions and narrative validation).")
    return count
end

return Suite
````

````lua
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    local Combat=require("src.systems.combat")
    local Techniques=require("src.data.combat_cards")
    local Data=require("src.data.cards")
    local Enemies=require("src.data.enemies")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local checked=0
    local function check(value,message) assert(value,message);checked=checked+1 end
    local function clone(value) return assert(Json.decode(assert(Json.encode(value)))) end
    local unlocked={};for _,c in ipairs(Techniques.list) do unlocked[c.id]=true end
    for _,c in ipairs(Data.list) do unlocked[c.id]=true end
    local cursed={active=true,manaBlocked=true,voiceSealed=true}
    local function context(extra)
        local c={tutorial=true,unlocked=unlocked,combatDeck=Techniques.starterDeck,curse=cursed,externalEnergy=0}
        for k,v in pairs(extra or {}) do c[k]=v end
        return c
    end
    local function new(extra,seed) return Combat.new(Data.starterDeck,context(extra),function() return seed or 7 end) end
    local function play(enc,id)
        for i,v in ipairs(enc.hand) do if v==id then return assert(Combat.play(enc,i,enc.revision)) end end
        error(id.." no está en mano")
    end
    local function hasEvent(result,kind,target)
        for _,e in ipairs(result.events) do if e.kind==kind and (not target or e.target==target) then return e end end
    end
    check(#Techniques.starterDeck==5 and Combat.validateDeck(Techniques.starterDeck,unlocked),"Cinco técnicas físicas adquiridas constituyen el mazo inicial")
    for _,id in ipairs(Techniques.starterDeck) do check(Combat.card(id).manaCost==0,"Carta física sin maná "..id) end
    check(not Combat.validateDeck(Techniques.starterDeck,{}),"No entrar con técnicas bloqueadas")
    local duplicate=clone(Techniques.starterDeck);duplicate[1]=duplicate[2]
    check(not Combat.validateDeck(duplicate,unlocked),"Rechazar duplicadas")
    check(not Combat.validateDeck({"arcane_guard","heal","focus","wind_guard","earth_wall"},unlocked),"Se exigen dos ataques viables")
    local exclusive=clone(Techniques.starterDeck);exclusive[5]="sword_magic"
    local adapted,_,adjustments=Combat.adaptDeck(Data.starterDeck,context({character="roxy",combatDeck=exclusive}))
    check(#adapted==5 and #adjustments==1 and not table.concat(adapted,","):find("sword_magic"),"Exclusiva incompatible se sustituye sólo por adquirida")
    check(Combat.adaptDeck(Data.starterDeck,context({unlocked={}}))==nil,"Sin préstamo de mazo gratuito")
    local enc=new()
    check(enc.player.hp==30 and enc.player.mana==0 and enc.player.externalEnergy==0 and enc.energy==3,"Vida, maná sellado, energía externa y acciones separados")
    check(table.concat(enc.hand,",")=="staff_strike,push,stone_throw","Tutorial físico reproducible")
    local before=Json.encode(enc);local preview=Combat.preview(enc,1)
    check(before==Json.encode(enc) and preview.damage==4 and preview.manaCost==0,"Vista previa pura")
    play(enc,"staff_strike")
    check(enc.enemy.hp==18 and enc.player.mana==0 and enc.player.hp==30 and enc.energy==2,"Bastón funciona sin magia ni coste de vida")
    local unchanged=Json.encode(enc)
    check(not Combat.play(enc,1,0) and unchanged==Json.encode(enc),"Token obsoleto no vuelve a gastar")
    Combat.basic(enc,"defend",enc.revision)
    check(enc.player.shield==5 and enc.player.physicalShield==5 and enc.energy==1,"Defensa sin carta ni maná")
    local incoming=Combat.endTurn(enc)
    check(enc.player.hp==30 and hasEvent(incoming,"damage","player").blocked==4,"Escudo absorbe antes de PV")
    check(enc.player.shield==0 and enc.player.mana==0 and enc.energy==3,"Escudo temporal; maná natural no se regenera estando bloqueado")

    for _,key in ipairs({"hp","mana","shield","externalEnergy"}) do
        local forged=clone(enc);forged.player[key]=forged.player[key]+1
        check(not Combat.restore(forged,Data.starterDeck,context()),"Rechazo campo alterado "..key)
    end
    local retry=Combat.retry(enc)
    check(retry.player.hp==30 and retry.player.mana==0 and retry.revision==0 and #retry.relationshipEvents==0,"Reintento conserva la maldición")
    local dodge=new();assert(Combat.basic(dodge,"dodge"));check(dodge.player.shield==3 and not Combat.basic(dodge,"dodge"),"Esquiva disponible y limitada por turno")
    local sword=new();sword.hand={"simple_cut"};play(sword,"simple_cut")
    check(sword.player.hp==29 and sword.player.mana==0 and sword.enemy.hp==17,"Corte cuesta esfuerzo físico explícito")
    local unsafe=new();unsafe.hand={"quick_study"};unsafe.player.hp=4
    check(not Combat.canPlay(unsafe,1),"Esfuerzo no puede dejar menos de un PV")
    unsafe.player.hp=5;play(unsafe,"quick_study")
    check(unsafe.player.hp==1,"Esfuerzo puede dejar exactamente un PV")
    local magic=new({externalEnergy=12});magic.hand={"magic_bolt"};play(magic,"magic_bolt")
    check(magic.enemy.hp==16 and magic.player.externalEnergy==10 and magic.player.mana==0,"Bala usa energía externa sin restaurar magia natural")
    local depleted=new();depleted.hand={"magic_bolt"}
    check(not Combat.canPlay(depleted,1),"Sin fragmentos no lanzar magia de artefacto")
    local natural=new({externalEnergy=12});natural.hand={"heal"};local oldResource=Techniques.byId.heal.resource;Techniques.byId.heal.resource="natural"
    check(not Combat.canPlay(natural,1),"Magia natural bloqueada aunque haya energía externa")
    Techniques.byId.heal.resource=oldResource
    local cured=new({curse={active=false,manaBlocked=false}});cured.hand={"magic_bolt"};play(cured,"magic_bolt")
    check(cured.player.mana==10 and cured.player.externalEnergy==0,"Tras cura vuelve el maná natural")
    local earth=new({externalEnergy=12});earth.hand={"arcane_guard"};play(earth,"arcane_guard")
    check(earth.player.magicShield==5 and earth.player.physicalShield==0,"Escudos mágico y físico diferenciados")
    local weak=new({externalEnergy=12});weak.hand={"swamp"};play(weak,"swamp")
    check(weak.enemy.weak==2 and weak.enemy.intent.damage==2,"Pantano modifica intención visible")
    for _,id in ipairs({"sylphiette","roxy","eris"}) do
        local ally=new({character=id,enemyId="badigadi_final",tutorial=false})
        local result=assert(Combat.tactic(ally,"together",ally.revision))
        check(ally.companion and ally.companion.id==id and hasEvent(result,"companion_action"),id.." actúa realmente sin maná de Rudy")
        check(ally.enemy.hp<72 and ally.player.mana==0,"Compañera actúa durante la maldición")
        check(not Combat.tactic(ally,"assist"),"Una acción de compañera por turno")
        Combat.endTurn(ally);Combat.tactic(ally,"together")
        check(#ally.relationshipEvents==1,"Acciones repetidas no acumulan amor")
        check(Combat.restore(clone(ally),Data.starterDeck,context({character=id,enemyId="badigadi_final",tutorial=false}))~=nil,"Replay de compañera "..id)
    end
    local capable=new({character="eris"});Combat.tactic(capable,"protect")
    check(capable.relationshipEvents[1].trust<0,"Sobreproteger a Eris capaz perjudica confianza")
    local wounded=new({character="eris",tacticalContext={companionInjured=true}});Combat.tactic(wounded,"protect")
    check(wounded.relationshipEvents[1].trust>0 and wounded.companion.shield==6,"Proteger a Eris herida ayuda")
    local victory=new();victory.enemy.hp=1;play(victory,"staff_strike")
    check(victory.finished and victory.outcome=="victory","Victoria normal a cero PV enemigo")
    check(not Combat.endTurn(victory),"No actuar después de victoria")
    local defeat=new();defeat.player.hp=1;Combat.endTurn(defeat)
    check(defeat.finished and defeat.outcome=="defeat","Derrota a cero PV Rudy")
    local waiting=new();while not waiting.finished do Combat.endTurn(waiting) end
    check(waiting.turn<=30 and waiting.outcome=="defeat","Inacción conduce a derrota finita")
    check(Combat.restore(clone(waiting),Data.starterDeck,context())~=nil,"Derrota guardable y reintentable")
    local final=new({enemyId="badigadi_final"});final.enemy.hp=1;play(final,"staff_strike")
    check(not final.finished and final.enemy.phase=="seal" and final.enemy.seal==12,"Cero vida no basta: sello expuesto")
    assert(Combat.breakSeal(final));check(not final.finished and final.enemy.seal==6,"Primer anclaje no da victoria")
    assert(Combat.breakSeal(final));check(final.outcome=="victory" and final.enemy.sealBroken,"Neutralizar ambos anclajes libera antídoto")
    local late=clone(Techniques.starterDeck)
    for _,id in ipairs({"water_projectile","magic_bolt","arcane_guard","heavy_spell","swamp"}) do late[#late+1]=id end
    local wins,total=0,0
    for _,enemy in ipairs(Enemies.list) do
        for _,wife in ipairs({"sylphiette","roxy","eris"}) do
            for seed=1,4 do
                local c=context({character=wife,enemyId=enemy.id,tutorial=false,combatDeck=late,externalEnergy=12})
                local battle=Combat.new(Data.starterDeck,c,function() return seed*4729 end)
                while not battle.finished do
                    if Combat.canBreakSeal(battle) then Combat.breakSeal(battle)
                    else
                        if Combat.canTactic(battle,"coordinate") then Combat.tactic(battle,"coordinate")
                        elseif Combat.canTactic(battle,"together") then Combat.tactic(battle,"together") end
                        local played=true
                        while played and not battle.finished do
                            played=false;local best,bestValue
                            for i,id in ipairs(battle.hand) do
                                if Combat.canPlay(battle,i) then
                                    local e=Combat.card(id).effects
                                    local value=(e.damage or 0)+(e.shield or 0)*.7+math.min(e.heal or 0,battle.player.maxHp-battle.player.hp)
                                    if not bestValue or value>bestValue then best,bestValue=i,value end
                                end
                            end
                            if best then Combat.play(battle,best);played=true end
                        end
                    end
                    if not battle.finished and not Combat.canBreakSeal(battle) then Combat.endTurn(battle) end
                end
                total=total+1;if battle.outcome=="victory" then wins=wins+1 end
                check(battle.outcome=="victory","Mazo desbloqueado viable: "..enemy.id.." / "..wife.." / "..seed)
                check(Combat.restore(clone(battle),Data.starterDeck,c)~=nil,"Victoria legal se restaura "..enemy.id)
                local count,seen=0,{}
                for _,zone in ipairs({"hand","drawPile","discard"}) do
                    for _,id in ipairs(battle[zone]) do count=count+1;check(not seen[id],"Carta no duplicada");seen[id]=true end
                end
                check(count==#late and #battle.relationshipEvents<=1,"Conservación de mazo y límite sentimental")
            end
        end
    end
    print("Combat curse: "..checked.." comprobaciones; "..wins.."/"..total.." victorias simuladas.")
    return checked
end
return Suite
````
