````lua
-- Balance por datos y comandos legales. No requiere renderer ni modifica campaña.
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    local Combat=require("src.systems.combat")
    local Enemies=require("src.data.enemies")
    local Techniques=require("src.data.combat_cards")
    local Chapters=require("src.data.chapters")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local count,wins=0,0
    local function check(value,message) count=count+1;assert(value,message) end
    local function clone(value) return assert(Json.decode(assert(Json.encode(value)))) end
    local function event(result,kind,target)
        for _,entry in ipairs(result.events) do if entry.kind==kind and (not target or entry.target==target) then return entry end end
    end
    local function context(extra)
        local value={enemyId="mana_anomaly",day=1,combatDeck=Techniques.starterDeck,
            curse={active=true,manaBlocked=true},externalEnergy=12}
        for k,v in pairs(extra or {}) do value[k]=v end
        return value
    end
    local function battle(extra,seed) return Combat.new({},context(extra),function() return seed or 17 end) end

    local source=Json.encode(Enemies.list)
    local early=Enemies.resolve("mana_anomaly",{day=1})
    local late=Enemies.resolve("mana_anomaly",{day=5})
    check(early.maxHp==22 and late.maxHp==40,"El mismo enemigo tiene dificultad de día declarada y acotada")
    check(late.actions[1].damage>early.actions[1].damage and #late.actions>#early.actions,"La dificultad cambia daño y repertorio además de PV")
    check(Enemies.resolve("mana_anomaly",{day=5,tutorial=true}).maxHp==22,"El tutorial conserva dificultad baja")
    check(Enemies.resolve("forest_beast",{day=2,difficulty=5}).maxHp==53,"Un encuentro puede seleccionar dificultad explícita")
    for day=1,7 do
        local boss=Enemies.resolve("badigadi_final",{day=day})
        check(boss.maxHp==72 and boss.sealMax==12 and boss.actions[1].damage==7,"Badigadi no recibe escalado indiscriminado: "..day)
    end
    check(Json.encode(Enemies.list)==source,"Resolver encuentros no muta las definiciones compartidas")

    local guarded=battle({enemyId="ruins_guardian",day=3})
    guarded.enemy.actionIndex=4
    -- Actualiza intención por una acción legítima que no cambia los PV enemigos.
    Combat.basic(guarded,"defend")
    local result=assert(Combat.endTurn(guarded))
    local hit=event(result,"damage","player")
    check(hit.damage==11 and hit.blocked==5 and hit.hpLost==6,"Escudo usado, daño bloqueado y PV perdidos coinciden")
    check(guarded.player.hp==24 and guarded.player.shield==0,"La defensa reduce daño real y caduca")

    local interrupted=battle({day=5})
    Combat.basic(interrupted,"defend");Combat.endTurn(interrupted)
    check(interrupted.enemy.intent.kind=="interrupt" and interrupted.enemy.intent.actionLoss==1,"Interrupción se anuncia antes de elegir")
    local action=interrupted.enemy.intent.id
    local cut=assert(Combat.endTurn(interrupted))
    check(cut.enemyAction==action and event(cut,"interrupt").amount==1 and interrupted.energy==2,"La acción anunciada reduce exactamente una acción")
    check(interrupted.enemy.intent.hits==2 and interrupted.enemy.intent.damage==3,"Ataque múltiple declara cantidad y daño de cada golpe")
    Combat.basic(interrupted,"defend")
    local multiple=assert(Combat.endTurn(interrupted))
    local hits,blocked,lost=0,0,0
    for _,entry in ipairs(multiple.events) do if entry.kind=="damage" and entry.target=="player" then
        hits=hits+1;blocked=blocked+entry.blocked;lost=lost+entry.hpLost
    end end
    check(hits==2 and blocked==5 and lost==1,"Escudo se consume una vez entre los golpes del ataque múltiple")
    check(interrupted.energy==3,"La interrupción dura un solo turno")

    local recovery=battle()
    recovery.enemy.actionIndex=2;recovery.enemy.actionUses.arcane_barrier=3
    local empty=assert(Combat.endTurn(recovery))
    check(event(empty,"recovery_exhausted","enemy") and recovery.enemy.shield==0,"La recuperación enemiga de escudo se agota")
    local healing=battle()
    for use=1,3 do
        healing.hand={"heal"};healing.energy=3;healing.player.externalEnergy=12;healing.player.hp=29
        local heal=assert(Combat.play(healing,1))
        check(healing.player.hp==30 and event(heal,"heal").amount==1,"Curación efectiva no supera la vida máxima")
    end
    healing.hand={"heal"};healing.energy=3;healing.player.hp=20
    check(not Combat.canPlay(healing,1) and Combat.preview(healing,1).usesLeft==0,"Curación básica consume tres cargas como máximo")
    check(Combat.card("shared_magic").perBattle==3,"La curación híbrida también tiene límite")
    local ally=battle({character="sylphiette",enemyId="badigadi_final",day=6})
    for use=1,4 do
        ally.player.hp=20;ally.energy=3;ally.perTurn={}
        local assisted=assert(Combat.tactic(ally,"assist"))
        check(ally.player.hp==(use<=3 and 23 or 20),"Sylphiette tiene tres curaciones efectivas: "..use)
        if use==4 then check(event(assisted,"recovery_exhausted","companion"),"El agotamiento se explica sin bloquear su ataque") end
    end
    check(ally.companionHeals==3,"La recuperación aliada no se renueva por turno")
    local healContext=context({enemyId="badigadi_final",day=6,
        combatDeck={"staff_strike","simple_cut","stone_throw","heal","focus"}})
    local savedHeal=Combat.new({},healContext,function() return 45 end)
    local healed=false
    for _=1,6 do
        for index,id in ipairs(savedHeal.hand) do
            if id=="heal" and Combat.canPlay(savedHeal,index) then Combat.play(savedHeal,index);healed=true;break end
        end
        if healed then break end
        Combat.endTurn(savedHeal)
    end
    check(healed and Combat.restore(clone(savedHeal),{},healContext),"Guardar y cargar conserva una carga gastada con comandos legales")
    local forged=clone(savedHeal);forged.perBattle.heal=0
    check(not Combat.restore(forged,{},healContext),"Cargar no permite recuperar cargas de curación manipuladas")
    forged=clone(savedHeal);forged.companionHeals=2
    check(not Combat.restore(forged,{},healContext),"El replay valida también el presupuesto aliado")

    -- Forma exacta del snapshot previo al balance, sin campos añadidos. La
    -- apertura se reconstruye con la mano guardada; el día de campaña no puede
    -- introducir nuevas estadísticas en mitad de ese combate.
    local legacyContext=context({character="sylphiette"});legacyContext.day=nil
    local old=Combat.new({},legacyContext,function() return 91 end)
    old.balanceVersion=nil;old.perBattle=nil;old.companionHeals=nil
    old.enemy.difficulty=nil;old.enemy.actionUses=nil
    for _,action in ipairs(old.enemy.actions) do action.maxUses=nil end
    old.log[1].text=old.log[1].text:gsub("0 maná","12 maná")
    local newContext=clone(legacyContext);newContext.day=5
    local migrated=Combat.restore(clone(old),{},newContext)
    check(migrated and migrated.balanceVersion==1 and migrated.enemy.maxHp==22,"La batalla anterior conserva reglas y dificultad originales")
    check(Json.encode(migrated.hand)==Json.encode(old.hand) and migrated.randomState==old.randomState,"Migrar no vuelve a sortear la mano ni la semilla")
    assert(Combat.tactic(migrated,"assist"));assert(Combat.endTurn(migrated))
    local prior=clone(migrated)
    prior.balanceVersion=nil;prior.perBattle=nil;prior.companionHeals=nil;prior.enemy.actionUses=nil
    local continuing=Combat.restore(prior,{},newContext)
    check(continuing and continuing.revision==2 and continuing.player.hp==migrated.player.hp,"Un combate antiguo ya avanzado se valida y continúa")
    check(Json.encode(continuing.hand)==Json.encode(prior.hand) and Json.encode(continuing.discard)==Json.encode(prior.discard)
        and Json.encode(continuing.log)==Json.encode(prior.log),"Mano, descarte e historial antiguos se conservan exactamente")
    check(Combat.restore(clone(continuing),{},newContext)~=nil,"El snapshot migrado vuelve a guardar/cargar con su versión de balance")
    local oldRetry=Combat.retry(continuing)
    check(oldRetry.balanceVersion==1 and oldRetry.enemy.maxHp==22 and Json.encode(oldRetry.initial)==Json.encode(old.initial),"Reintento antiguo conserva reglas y orden inicial")
    local tampered=clone(prior);tampered.player.hp=tampered.player.hp+1
    check(not Combat.restore(tampered,{},newContext),"La compatibilidad no acepta vida antigua manipulada")
    local nextBattle=Combat.new({},newContext,function() return 91 end)
    check(nextBattle.balanceVersion==2 and nextBattle.enemy.maxHp==40,"Solo la próxima batalla nueva usa el balance actual")

    -- Estrategia sencilla que lee la intención; no exige una carta concreta.
    local function win(enc)
        local guard=0
        while not enc.finished do
            guard=guard+1;assert(guard<500,"El combate no termina")
            if Combat.canBreakSeal(enc) then Combat.breakSeal(enc)
            else
                if Combat.canTactic(enc,"coordinate") then Combat.tactic(enc,"coordinate")
                elseif Combat.canTactic(enc,"together") then Combat.tactic(enc,"together") end
                while not enc.finished and enc.energy>0 do
                    local incoming=enc.enemy.intent.kind=="attack" and enc.enemy.intent.damage*(enc.enemy.intent.hits or 1) or 0
                    if incoming-enc.player.shield>=5 and Combat.canBasic(enc,"defend") then Combat.basic(enc,"defend")
                    else
                        local best,value
                        for index,id in ipairs(enc.hand) do if Combat.canPlay(enc,index) then
                            local e=Combat.card(id).effects
                            local score=(e.damage or 0)+math.min(e.shield or 0,math.max(0,incoming-enc.player.shield))+
                                math.min(e.heal or 0,enc.player.maxHp-enc.player.hp)+(e.weak or 0)*.5
                            if not value or score>value then best,value=index,score end
                        end end
                        if best then Combat.play(enc,best) else break end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not enc.finished and not Combat.canBreakSeal(enc) then Combat.endTurn(enc) end
        end
    end
    local lateDeck={"staff_strike","simple_cut","stone_throw","push","coordinated_attack","water_projectile","arcane_guard","heal","swamp","earth_wall"}
    local encounters=0
    for id,node in pairs(Chapters.checkpoints) do
        if node.kind=="encounter" and node.definition.kind=="magic" then
            encounters=encounters+1
            check(node.day<=6,"No hay combates en el desenlace del día siete")
            local def=node.definition
            local companions=def.requiresCompanion and {"sylphiette","roxy","eris"} or {def.character or false}
            for _,character in ipairs(companions) do for _,deck in ipairs({Techniques.starterDeck,lateDeck}) do for seed=1,6 do
                local c=context({day=node.day,difficulty=def.difficulty,enemyId=def.enemyId,character=character or nil,
                    tacticalContext=def.tacticalContext,tutorial=def.tutorial,combatDeck=deck,
                    externalEnergy=node.day>=3 and 12 or 0})
                local enc=Combat.new({},c,function() return seed*4729 end)
                win(enc)
                check(enc.outcome=="victory","Batalla viable con cartas disponibles: "..id.." / "..tostring(character).." / "..#deck.." / "..seed)
                wins=wins+1
                check(Combat.restore(clone(enc),{},c)~=nil,"Victoria y recursos se restauran por replay: "..id)
                local retry=Combat.retry(enc)
                check(retry.perBattle.heal==nil and retry.companionHeals==0 and retry.enemy.maxHp==enc.enemy.maxHp,"Reintento restaura cargas y mismo balance")
            end end end
        end
    end
    check(encounters>=8,"Se comprueban los encuentros de toda la campaña")
    print("Combat balance: "..count.." checks; "..wins.."/"..wins.." legal campaign victories (days, shields, healing limits, intentions, replay).")
    return count
end
return Suite
````

## tests/combat_integration.lua

````lua
-- Integración de campaña matrimonial y combate. El runner aporta App real con identidad de pruebas.
local Suite={}
function Suite.run(app)
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local Combat=require("src.systems.combat")
    local Chapters=require("src.data.chapters")
    local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
    local Events=require("src.systems.events")
    local checks=0
    local function check(ok,msg) assert(ok,msg);checks=checks+1 end
    local function encode(v) return assert(Json.encode(v)) end
    local function clone(v) return assert(Json.decode(encode(v))) end
    local function prepare(checkpoint,character)
        local s=Save.newSession()
        assert(Events.apply(s,"nanahoshi_starter",{equipStarter=true,presenter="nanahoshi"}))
        s.rewardQueue={};s.checkpoint=checkpoint or "day1_tutorial";s.day=Chapters.get(s.checkpoint).day
        s.events.tutorial_completed=true
        for _,chapter in ipairs(Chapters.list) do
            if character and chapter.companion then s.decisions[chapter.companion.decisionKey]=character end
        end
        local def=assert(Progression.encounter(s,s.checkpoint))
        local c={character=def.character,tutorial=def.tutorial,enemyId=def.enemyId,day=s.day,difficulty=def.difficulty,tacticalContext=def.tacticalContext,unlocked=s.unlocked,combatDeck=s.combatDeck,curse=s.curse,externalEnergy=s.externalEnergy}
        s.combat=Combat.new(s.deck,c,function() return 17 end)
        return s,c
    end
    local function win(e,useAlly)
        local guard=0
        while not e.finished do
            guard=guard+1;assert(guard<500,"Estrategia de integración no termina")
            if Combat.canBreakSeal(e) then Combat.breakSeal(e) end
            if e.finished then break end
            if useAlly and Combat.canTactic(e,"coordinate") then Combat.tactic(e,"coordinate")
            elseif useAlly and Combat.canTactic(e,"together") then Combat.tactic(e,"together") end
            local best,value
            for i,id in ipairs(e.hand) do
                if Combat.canPlay(e,i) then
                    local card=Combat.card(id);local f=card.effects
                    local score=(f.damage or 0)+(f.shield or 0)*.7+math.min(f.heal or 0,e.player.maxHp-e.player.hp)+math.min(f.mana or 0,e.player.maxMana-e.player.mana)*.5
                    if not value or score>value then best,value=i,score end
                end
            end
            if best then Combat.play(e,best) elseif not e.finished then Combat.endTurn(e) end
        end
        check(e.outcome=="victory","La campaña ofrece una estrategia ganadora legal")
    end
    local s,c=prepare()
    Combat.play(s.combat,1,s.combat.revision);s.combat.tutorial={stage="attack_result"}
    local restored=assert(Save.validate(clone(s)))
    check(restored.combat and encode(restored.combat)==encode(s.combat),"Guardar durante animación conserva todo el estado lógico de combate")
    check(restored.encounter==nil,"El combate no reaparece como diálogo social")
    local forged=clone(s);forged.combat.player.mana=999
    local safe=assert(Save.validate(forged))
    check(safe.combat==nil and safe.events.nanahoshi_starter and #safe.combatDeck==5,"Snapshot inválido reinicia sólo batalla y conserva colección")
    local before=encode(s.relationships);win(s.combat,false)
    local stored=assert(Save.validate(clone(s)))
    check(stored.combat.outcome=="victory" and not stored.unlocked.self_joke,"Cargar victoria pendiente no entrega recompensa antes de confirmar")
    local finished=stored.combat;local nextId=assert(Progression.finishCombat(stored,finished))
    check(nextId~= "day1_tutorial" and stored.unlocked.self_joke and stored.events.combat_reward_day1_tutorial,"Confirmar entrega recompensa y avanza")
    check(stored.defeatedEnemies.mana_anomaly and stored.events.combat_tutorial_completed,"Enemigo y tutorial se recuerdan")
    check(encode(stored.relationships)==before,"Atacar repetidamente no da amor ni confianza")
    local once=encode(stored)
    check(not Progression.finishCombat(stored,finished) and once==encode(stored),"Confirmar otra vez no duplica cartas, puntos ni transición")
    local afterLoad=assert(Save.validate(clone(stored)))
    check(afterLoad.unlocked.self_joke and #afterLoad.rewardQueue==#stored.rewardQueue,"Carta y entrega pendiente sobreviven a cargar")
    local battleId
    for id,node in pairs(Chapters.checkpoints) do
        if node.kind=="encounter" and node.definition.kind=="magic" and node.definition.requiresCompanion and node.day>=3 then battleId=id;break end
    end
    assert(battleId,"Falta encuentro con compañera para integración")
    local companion=prepare(battleId,"eris")
    local prior=encode(companion.relationships)
    win(companion.combat,true)
    check(encode(companion.relationships)==prior,"Decisión táctica espera a la confirmación de resultado")
    local delta=clone(companion.combat.relationshipEvents[1]);local previousLove=companion.relationships.eris.love
    local done=companion.combat;assert(Progression.finishCombat(companion,done))
    check(companion.relationships.eris.love==math.min(100,previousLove+delta.love),"Decisión táctica contextual afecta matrimonio exactamente una vez")
    local relationship=encode(companion.relationships)
    check(not Progression.finishCombat(companion,done) and encode(companion.relationships)==relationship,"No cosechar amor al repetir victoria")
    local defeated=prepare()
    local persistent=encode({defeated.relationships,defeated.unlocked,defeated.events,defeated.journal})
    while not defeated.combat.finished do Combat.endTurn(defeated.combat) end
    check(not Progression.finishCombat(defeated,defeated.combat),"Derrota no entrega recompensa ni avanza")
    local reload=assert(Save.validate(clone(defeated)))
    check(reload.combat and reload.combat.outcome=="defeat","Derrota persiste con botón de reintento")
    reload.combat=Combat.retry(reload.combat)
    check(reload.combat.player.hp==30 and reload.combat.player.mana==0 and reload.combat.revision==0,"Reintento repone vida y maná")
    check(encode({reload.relationships,reload.unlocked,reload.events,reload.journal})==persistent,"Reintento conserva decisiones previas y no duplica premios")
    if app then
        local old={session=app.session,save=app.save,practice=app.practice,options=app.options}
        local ok,err=xpcall(function()
            app.session=prepare();app.practice=false;app.save=function() return true end
            app.options=require("src.systems.options").normalize({muted=true,reducedMotion=true})
            app:resume();app:update(2);app:draw()
            local screen=app.manager.current
            check(screen.enc and screen.enc.type=="combat","Resume abre pantalla de batalla v2")
            screen:select(1)
            check(screen.confirmReady and screen.enc.revision==0,"Inspección de carta sin gasto")
            check(screen:play(),"Confirmación de carta ejecutable")
            local revision=screen.enc.revision
            screen:play();check(screen.enc.revision==revision,"Bloqueo de doble entrada durante animación")
            app:update(1);app:draw()
            check(screen.displayHp.mana==screen.enc.player.mana,"Barra animada converge a maná real")
            app.session.combat=screen.enc
            check(Save.validate(app.session).combat~=nil,"Estado de pantalla acepta replay validado")
        end,debug.traceback)
        app.session,app.save,app.practice,app.options=old.session,old.save,old.practice,old.options
        app:applyOptions();assert(ok,err)
    end
    print("Combat campaign integration: "..checks.." comprobaciones de persistencia, recompensa, compañera y reintentos.")
    return checks
end
return Suite
````

## tests/combat_visual.lua

````lua
-- Recorrido de la interfaz real: selección, guía, animaciones y ambos resultados.
local Suite={}
-- Un paso de entrada por iteración para los recorridos generales de historia.
function Suite.drive(screen)
    if screen:busy() then return end
    if screen.enc.finished then screen:keypressed("return");return end
    local stage=screen.tutorial and screen.tutorial.stage
    if stage=="attack_result" or stage=="enemy_result" then screen:keypressed("return");return end
    if stage=="end_turn" then screen:keypressed("e");return end
    if stage=="shield" then screen:keypressed("d");return end
    if require("src.systems.combat").canBreakSeal(screen.enc) then screen:keypressed("b");return end
    local wanted=stage=="attack" and "staff_strike"
    local Combat=require("src.systems.combat")
    if not stage and Combat.canTactic(screen.enc,"coordinate") then screen:tactic("coordinate");return end
    if not stage and Combat.canTactic(screen.enc,"together") then screen:tactic("together");return end
    local best,bestScore
    for i,id in ipairs(screen.enc.hand) do
        local card=Combat.card(id)
        if screen:canPlay(i) and (not wanted or wanted==id) then
            local score=(card.effects.damage or 0)*10+(card.effects.energy or 0)*5+(card.effects.draw or 0)*4+(card.effects.shield or 0)+(card.effects.heal or 0)
            if not bestScore or score>bestScore then best,bestScore=i,score end
        end
    end
    if best then screen:keypressed(tostring(best));screen:keypressed("return") else screen:keypressed("e") end
end

function Suite.run(app)
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Combat=require("src.systems.combat")
    local Screen=require("src.screens.combat")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local checks,captures=0,0
    local function check(ok,message) assert(ok,message);checks=checks+1 end
    local old={session=app.session,options=app.options,save=app.save,mouse=app.mouse,practice=app.practice}
    local function settle() app:update(2);app:draw() end
    local function capture(name)
        app.toastTime=0;app:draw()
        local pixels=app.canvas:newImageData();local bytes=pixels:encode("png")
        local file=assert(io.open(love.filesystem.getSource().."/tests/artifacts/"..name..".png","wb"))
        file:write(bytes:getString());file:close();pixels:release();bytes:release();captures=captures+1
    end
    local function clickCard(screen,index)
        app:draw()
        for _,button in ipairs(screen.buttons) do
            if button.cardIndex==index then
                screen:mousepressed(button.x+6,button.y+6,1);return
            end
        end
        error("La carta no tiene hitbox: "..index)
    end
    local function indexOf(enc,id)
        for i,value in ipairs(enc.hand) do if value==id then return i end end
    end
    local function open(tutorial)
        app.session=Save.newSession();app.session.checkpoint="day1_tutorial";app.practice=true
        app.session.combatDeck={};for i,id in ipairs(require("src.data.combat_cards").starterDeck) do app.session.combatDeck[i]=id end
        app.options=require("src.systems.options").normalize({muted=true})
        app:applyOptions()
        local screen=Screen.new(app,{tutorial=tutorial,background="laboratory"})
        app:switch(screen);settle();return screen
    end
    local ok,err=xpcall(function()
        app.save=function() return true end;app.mouse=function() return nil,nil end
        local screen=open(true)
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="attack","La guía inicia en un ataque real")
        check(screen.enc.player.hp==30 and screen.enc.enemy.hp==22 and screen.enc.player.mana==0 and screen.enc.energy==3,"Vida, maná y acciones comienzan en sus valores de diseño")
        capture("combat-01-tutorial")
        screen:keypressed("e")
        check(screen.enc.turn==1,"La guía impide saltarse el ataque")
        local before=Json.encode(screen.enc)
        clickCard(screen,1)
        check(Json.encode(screen.enc)==before and screen.confirmReady,"Seleccionar con mouse inspecciona sin jugar")
        capture("combat-02-selected")
        screen:keypressed("return")
        check(screen.enc.enemy.hp==18 and screen.enc.energy==2 and screen.enc.player.mana==0,"Confirmar aplica cuatro daño y costes una sola vez")
        local revision=screen.enc.revision
        screen:keypressed("return");screen:keypressed("2");screen:keypressed("e")
        check(screen.enc.revision==revision,"Animación bloquea entradas repetidas")
        app:update(.35);capture("combat-03-impact")
        settle()
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="attack_result","La guía muestra el antes/después")
        screen:keypressed("return")
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="shield","Entendido habilita la defensa")
        screen:keypressed("d");settle()
        check(screen.enc.player.shield==5 and screen.tutorial.stage=="end_turn","Defensa básica concede cinco de escudo")
        capture("combat-04-shield")
        screen:keypressed("e");app:update(.35);capture("combat-05-enemy-attack")
        settle()
        check(screen.enc.player.hp==30 and screen.enc.energy==3 and screen.enc.player.shield==0 and screen.enc.player.mana==0,"Ataque cuatro bloqueado y recarga de maná")
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="enemy_result","La guía espera revisar el daño enemigo")
        screen:keypressed("h");capture("combat-06-history")
        local historyRevision=screen.enc.revision
        screen:keypressed("e")
        check(screen.enc.revision==historyRevision,"Historial modal no permite jugar por debajo")
        screen:keypressed("h");screen:keypressed("return")
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="free","La guía libera el combate después de explicar el enemigo")
        local safety=0
        while not screen.enc.finished and safety<100 do
            safety=safety+1
            local best
            for i,id in ipairs(screen.enc.hand) do
                local card=Combat.card(id)
                if screen:canPlay(i) and (card.effects.damage or card.effects.energy or card.effects.draw) then best=i;break end
            end
            if best then screen:keypressed(tostring(best));screen:keypressed("return") else screen:keypressed("e") end
            settle()
        end
        check(screen.enc.outcome=="victory" and screen.enc.enemy.hp==0,"El tutorial completo culmina en una victoria")
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="complete" and not screen:busy(),"La animación final termina y completa la guía")
        capture("combat-07-victory")
        screen=open(false)
        local initial=Json.encode(screen.enc.initial)
        while not screen.enc.finished do screen:keypressed("e");settle() end
        check(screen.enc.outcome=="defeat" and screen.enc.player.hp==0,"Pasar turnos permite observar una derrota real")
        capture("combat-08-defeat")
        screen:keypressed("return");settle();screen=app.manager.current
        check(not screen.enc.finished and screen.enc.player.hp==30 and screen.enc.enemy.hp==22,"Reintentar restaura vida, enemigo y turno")
        check(Json.encode(screen.enc.initial)==initial,"Reintentar conserva el mismo reparto inicial")
        screen:keypressed("escape");capture("combat-09-pause")
        check(screen.pauseOpen,"Escape abre controles de pausa")
        screen:keypressed("escape");check(not screen.pauseOpen,"Escape vuelve al combate")
        app.options.reducedMotion=true
        local playable
        for i in ipairs(screen.enc.hand) do if screen:canPlay(i) then playable=i;break end end
        screen:select(playable);screen:play();app:update(.2)
        check(not screen:busy(),"Movimiento reducido conserva una transición finita")
        -- Roles y movimiento de los retratos originales, no acompañantes decorativas.
        app.options.reducedMotion=false
        for _,wife in ipairs({"sylphiette","roxy","eris"}) do
            app.session.combat=nil;app.session.externalEnergy=12
            screen=Screen.new(app,{character=wife,enemyId="mirror_manifestation",background="mirror_dimension",tacticalContext={danger=true}})
            app:switch(screen);settle()
            check(screen.enc.companion.id==wife,"Retrato y rol de "..wife.." presentes en batalla")
            capture("combat-companion-"..wife)
            screen:keypressed("t");app:draw()
            check(screen.tacticsOpen,"Menú de tácticas accesible por teclado")
            if wife=="sylphiette" then capture("combat-tactics") end
            local chosen
            for _,button in ipairs(screen.buttons) do
                if button.label=="Coordinar magia y espada" then screen:mousepressed(button.x+4,button.y+4,1);chosen=true;break end
            end
            check(chosen and not screen.tacticsOpen and screen:busy(),"Táctica de compañera ejecutada desde botón real")
            app:update(.35);capture("combat-action-"..wife);settle()
            check(#screen.enc.relationshipEvents==1 and screen.enc.enemy.hp<68,"Acción visible produce daño y consecuencia contextual")
            check(screen.displayHp.mana==screen.enc.player.mana,"Maná se actualiza tras coordinación")
        end
        app.session.combat=nil;app.session.externalEnergy=12
        app.session.combatDeck={"staff_strike","simple_cut","stone_throw","push","coordinated_attack","water_projectile","magic_bolt","arcane_guard","heavy_spell","swamp"}
        screen=Screen.new(app,{character="roxy",enemyId="badigadi_final",background="arena"})
        app:switch(screen);settle();capture("combat-badigadi-endurance")
        check(screen.enc.enemy.portrait=="badigadi","Badigadi utiliza su PNG real")
        local phases={endurance=true};local steps=0
        while not screen.enc.finished do
            steps=steps+1;assert(steps<250,"El combate visual con Badigadi debe concluir")
            Suite.drive(screen);settle()
            local phase=screen.enc.enemy.phase
            if not phases[phase] then
                phases[phase]=true;capture("combat-badigadi-"..phase)
                if phase=="seal" then check(not screen.enc.finished and screen.enc.enemy.hp==0,"Sello requiere acción expresa después de vencer su resistencia") end
            end
        end
        check(phases.six_arms and phases.seal and phases.victory,"Interfaz recorre las cuatro fases de Badigadi")
        check(screen.enc.outcome=="victory" and screen.enc.enemy.sealBroken,"Botón/tecla B resuelve sello y victoria real")
        app.session.combat=nil;app.session.day=5
        screen=Screen.new(app,{enemyId="mana_anomaly",background="laboratory"})
        app:switch(screen);settle()
        check(screen.enc.enemy.maxHp==40,"La pantalla usa dificultad del día de campaña")
        screen:basic("defend");settle();screen:endTurn();settle()
        check(screen.enc.enemy.intent.kind=="interrupt","La interrupción se anuncia en la pantalla")
        capture("combat-day5-interruption")
        screen:endTurn();settle()
        check(screen.enc.energy==2,"La interfaz muestra dos acciones tras la interrupción")
        screen:basic("defend");settle();screen:endTurn();app:update(.35)
        check(screen.actionSummary:find("6 daño; 5 bloqueado",1,true) and screen.actionSummary:find("1 vida perdida",1,true),
            "El resumen suma ambos golpes y muestra el escudo consumido real")
        capture("combat-day5-multiple-blocked");settle()
    end,debug.traceback)
    app.session,app.options,app.save,app.mouse,app.practice=old.session,old.options,old.save,old.mouse,old.practice
    app:applyOptions()
    assert(ok,err)
    print("Combat visuals: "..checks.." checks passed; "..captures.." real-renderer screenshots.")

end
````

````lua
 check(not Events.apply(s,"early_cure",{cure=true}),"Sin antídoto no hay cura")
 Progression.next(s); Progression.next(s)

 end

 check(returned and #app.session.journal==journal,"Releer no repite acontecimientos")

 for _=1,#dialogue.scene.lines-1 do dialogue:advance(); dialogue:update(2) end
 capture(dialogue,"sealed")

 Events.apply(app.session,"starter_gift",{starter=true})

 Events.apply(app.session,"antidote_obtained",{antidote=true})
 local relations=Json.encode(app.session.relationships)
 check(Events.apply(app.session,"cured",{cure=true}),"El antídoto permite la cura")
 local healed=round(app.session)
 check(not healed.curse.active and Curse.canSpeak(healed) and Curse.canUseNaturalMagic(healed),"Voz y magia recuperadas sobreviven al guardado")
 check(Json.encode(healed.relationships)==relations,"La cura no restaura automáticamente relaciones")
 check(not Events.apply(healed,"cured",{cure=true}),"Antídoto se consume una sola vez")
 local documents=require("src.data.documents")

 function app:next() return true end
 local second=Document.new(app,"test_document")
 second:interact(); second:update(.7); second:update(.5); second:interact(); app:save()
 second=Document.new(app,"test_document")
 check(second.phase=="reading" and second.page==2,"Documento de varias páginas conserva la lectura")
 while second.phase=="reading" do second:interact() end

 check(app.session.events.test_document_read and app.session.clues.test_document,"Segundo documento usa su propio ID sin colisión")
 documents.test_document=nil
 local animation=require("src.systems.animation")
 for _,kind in ipairs({"enter_left","enter_right","exit_left","exit_right","happy_bounce","small_shake","surprised_jump","sad_lower","angry_shake","expression_change"}) do
  local a=animation.actor(kind,{reducedMotion=true}); check(a.done and a.value.x==0 and a.value.y==0,"Movimiento reducido: "..kind)
 end
 print("Curse intro: "..count.." checks passed (letter interaction, save/resume, secrecy, cure and motion).")
 return count
end
return Suite
````

````lua
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
    local Data=require("src.data.cards")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local Tutorial=require("src.systems.tutorial")
    local Collection=require("src.screens.collection")
    local checked=0
    local function check(value,message) assert(value,message); checked=checked+1 end
    local status=require("src.screens.overlays").curseStatus
    check(status({active=true,voiceSealed=true,manaBlocked=true})=="Sin diagnóstico","El diario no revela la maldición antes de leer la carta")
    check(status({active=true,voiceSealed=true,manaBlocked=true,discoveredVoice=true})=="VOZ SELLADA","Descubrir la voz no anticipa el bloqueo mágico")
    check(status({active=true,voiceSealed=true,manaBlocked=true,discoveredVoice=true,discoveredMana=true})=="VOZ SELLADA · MANÁ BLOQUEADO","Diario muestra ambos descubrimientos")
    check(status({active=false,voiceSealed=false,manaBlocked=false,discoveredVoice=true,discoveredMana=true})=="VOZ RECUPERADA · MAGIA RECUPERADA","Diario refleja la cura después del antídoto")
    local icons=require("src.data.assets").cardIcons
    for _,technique in ipairs(require("src.data.combat_cards").list) do
        check(icons[technique.icon] and not technique.icon:match("^procedural"),"Técnica usa PNG existente: "..technique.id)
    end
    check(#Data.starterDeck==5,"Exactamente cinco cartas sociales iniciales")
    local seen,tones={},{}
    for _,card in ipairs(Data.list) do
        check(not seen[card.id] and card.phrases and card.tone and card.unlockRequirements,"Contrato de carta "..card.id)
        seen[card.id]=true; tones[card.tone]=true
    end
    for tone in pairs(Data.tones) do check(tones[tone],"Tono alcanzable "..tone) end
    check(Cards.validateDeck(Data.starterDeck),"Mazo inicial válido")
    check(Collection.validatePlayableDeck(Data.starterDeck),"El primer mazo tiene respuestas útiles para las tres esposas")
    local context={kind="conversation",character="sylphiette",curse={active=true},sceneId="home_test"}
    local enc=Cards.new(Data.starterDeck,context,function(n) return n end)
    for turn=1,3 do
        check(Cards.play(enc,1,turn)~=nil,"Acción real "..turn)
        check(Cards.play(enc,1,turn)==nil,"La misma acción no se duplica")
        local restored=Cards.restore(assert(Json.decode(assert(Json.encode(enc)))),Data.starterDeck,context)
        check(restored and restored.score==enc.score and restored.energy==enc.energy,"Restaurar mano corta sin duplicar")
    end
    check(enc.finished and #enc.hand==2,"Mazo de cinco llega al final sin bloquearse")
    local function preview(id,character)
        return Cards.preview({hand={id},context={kind="conversation",character=character}},1)
    end
    local eris,sylphy=preview("bold_reply","eris"),preview("bold_reply","sylphiette")
    check(eris.trust>0 and sylphy.trust<0,"Misma carta, consecuencias distintas por personaje")
    check(eris.expression=="happy" and sylphy.expression=="angry","Reacciones coherentes con la decisión")

    local nano=preview("subtle_flirt","nanahoshi")
    check(nano.trust==0 and nano.chemistry==0 and nano.expression=="angry","Nanahoshi reacciona sin romance")
    local card=Data.byId.be_honest; card.revealsSecret=true
    check(not Cards.canPlay({hand={card.id},energy=4,context=context},1),"Bloqueo explícito de un secreto prohibido")
    card.revealsSecret=nil
    local practice=Cards.new(Data.starterDeck,{kind="conversation",character="nanahoshi",socialTutorial=true},function(n)return n end)
    local state=Tutorial.restore(nil,practice)
    check(Tutorial.advance(state) and Tutorial.advance(state),"Tutorial avanza hasta elegir")
    check(not Tutorial.canAct(state,1),"Leer el tutorial no ejecuta una carta")
    Tutorial.select(state)
    check(Tutorial.canAct(state,1),"Práctica real habilitada tras seleccionar")
    print("Curse social: "..checked.." checks passed")
end
return Suite
````

````lua
    check(recalls.kept~=recalls.broken,"El consejo del Día 4 recuerda el cumplimiento del Día 3")
    Suite.report={checks=checks,conversations=conversations,responses=responses,variants=variants,distinctHands=distinct}
    print("Branching dialogue: "..checks.." checks; "..conversations.." conversations, "..responses.." authored card responses, "..variants.." variants; "..distinct.." different seeded hands.")
    return checks
end
return Suite
````

````lua
-- Pruebas A-D mediante la App real: teclado, previsualización, cancelación,
-- reacción en varias líneas, guardado en disco y capturas de LÖVE.
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    local Fixtures=require("tests.dialogue_branching")
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
    local Resolver=require("src.systems.dialogue_resolver")
    local Events=require("src.systems.events")
    local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
    local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
    local Data=require("src.data.cards")
    local Chapters=require("src.data.chapters")
    local Font=require("src.ui.font")
    local checks,captures=0,0
    local function check(value,message) assert(value,message); checks=checks+1 end
    local function encode(value) return assert(Json.encode(value)) end
    local function clone(value) return assert(Json.decode(encode(value))) end
    local identity=love.filesystem.getIdentity()
    local originalOptions,originalFont=Save.readOptions,Font.draw
    local app
    love.filesystem.setIdentity("cartas_del_destino_dialogue_tests")
    Save.readOptions=function() return {muted=true,textAnimation=false,reducedMotion=false} end
    love.graphics.push("all")
    local ok,err=xpcall(function()
        app=require("src.app").new()
        app.mouse=function() return nil,nil end
        local rendered={}
        Font.draw=function(text,...)
            rendered[#rendered+1]=tostring(text)
            return originalFont(text,...)
        end
        local function draw()
            app.toastTime=0; rendered={}; app:draw()
            return table.concat(rendered,"\n")
        end
        local function capture(name)
            draw()
            local pixels=app.canvas:newImageData(); local bytes=pixels:encode("png")
            local file=assert(io.open(love.filesystem.getSource().."/tests/artifacts/dialogue-"..name..".png","wb"))
            file:write(bytes:getString()); file:close(); bytes:release(); pixels:release()
            captures=captures+1
        end
        local function settle()
            if app.manager.transition>0 then app:update(app.manager.transition) end
            app:update(2); draw()
        end
        local function prepare(checkpoint,cardId,prior,seed)
            local session=prior and clone(prior) or Fixtures.fixture(checkpoint)
            session.checkpoint=checkpoint; session.day=Chapters.get(checkpoint).day
            session.encounter=nil; session.encounterReview=nil; session.tutorial=nil
            session.rewardQueue={}; session.events.tutorial_completed=true
            local deck={}
            for _,id in ipairs(session.deck) do if id~=cardId then deck[#deck+1]=id end end
            if cardId then
                if #deck>=10 then table.remove(deck,1) end
                deck[#deck+1]=cardId; session.unlocked[cardId]=true
            end
            session.deck=deck
            local definition=assert(Progression.encounter(session,checkpoint))
            session.encounter=Cards.new(session.deck,Resolver.context(session,definition),seed and Fixtures.rng(seed) or function(n) return n end)
            app.session=session; app:resume(); settle()
            check(app.manager.current.enc.narrativeVersion==1,"La pantalla usa el motor narrativo: "..checkpoint)
            if cardId then check(app.manager.current.enc.hand[1]==cardId,"Fixture independiente presenta la carta solicitada") end
            return app.manager.current
        end
        local function state(screen)
            return encode({hand=screen.enc.hand,drawPile=screen.enc.drawPile,discard=screen.enc.discard,
                energy=screen.enc.energy,turn=screen.enc.turn,relationships=app.session.relationships,events=app.session.events})
        end
        local function playCase(checkpoint,cardId,name,expected,prior)
            local screen=prepare(checkpoint,cardId,prior)
            local character=screen.definition.character
            local previous=clone(app.session.relationships[character])
            local unchanged=state(screen)
            app:keypressed("1"); app:update(.2)
            local preview=Cards.preview(screen.enc,1)
            check(screen.confirmReady and state(screen)==unchanged,"Seleccionar consulta sin gastar ni aplicar: "..name)
            local text=draw()
            check(text:find("Rudy dirá:",1,true) and text:find(preview.phrase,1,true),"Vista previa muestra la frase contextual completa: "..name)
            check(Font.height(preview.phrase,173)<=88,"La frase cabe en el panel de confirmación: "..name)
            capture(name.."-preview")
            app:keypressed("escape")
            check(app.manager.current==screen and not screen.confirmReady and state(screen)==unchanged,"Cancelar devuelve a la mano sin mutaciones: "..name)
            app:keypressed("1"); app:keypressed("return")
            check(#screen.enc.log==1 and screen:busy(),"Confirmar inicia una sola animación: "..name)
            local result=screen.enc.log[1]
            check(result.phrase==preview.phrase,"La carta dice exactamente lo previsualizado: "..name)
            app:keypressed("return"); app:keypressed("1")
            check(#screen.enc.log==1,"Pulsaciones durante la animación no vuelven a jugar la carta")
            app:update(.45); capture(name.."-card")
            app:update(2)
            check(screen:responseLine().speaker=="rudeus" and screen:responseLine().text==preview.phrase,"Primero aparece la frase de Rudy")
            check(not result.applied and app.session.relationships[character].love==previous.love
                and app.session.relationships[character].trust==previous.trust,"La reacción todavía no concede puntos")
            check(draw():find(preview.phrase,1,true),"El renderer muestra la frase pronunciada")
            check(app:save(),"Guardar entre la frase de Rudy y la reacción")
            app:continueGame(); settle(); screen=app.manager.current; result=screen.enc.log[1]
            check(screen.enc.reactionIndex==1 and not result.applied,"Continuar conserva la reacción pendiente")
            app:keypressed("return"); app:update(.2)
            check(screen:responseLine().apply and result.applied,"Leer la reacción aplica el resultado")
            local wantedLove=expected and expected.love or preview.projectedLove
            local wantedTrust=expected and expected.trust or preview.projectedTrust
            check(app.session.relationships[character].love==previous.love+wantedLove
                and app.session.relationships[character].trust==previous.trust+wantedTrust,"Efectos reales en "..name)
            check(result.actualLove==wantedLove and result.actualTrust==wantedTrust,"La reacción informa el delta realmente aplicado")
            if expected then
                check(result.expression==expected.expression and result.nextNode==expected.next,"Expresión y rama esperadas: "..name)
                if expected.flag then check(app.session.events[expected.flag],"Consecuencia persistente de "..name) end
            end
            local displayed=draw()
            local label=Characters.byId[character].shortName.." · AMOR "..Cards.signed(wantedLove).." / CONFIANZA "..Cards.signed(wantedTrust)
            check(displayed:find(label,1,true) and displayed:find(result.reaction,1,true),"Reacción y cambios exactos visibles en pantalla")
            local originalPortrait=app.resources.portrait
            local seenExpression
            app.resources.portrait=function(self,id,expression,...)
                if id==character then seenExpression=expression end
                return originalPortrait(self,id,expression,...)
            end
            draw(); app.resources.portrait=originalPortrait
            check(seenExpression==result.expression,"El retrato renderizado cambia a la emoción de la reacción")
            capture(name.."-reaction")
            local applied=encode(app.session.relationships)
            check(app:save(),"Guardar tras aplicar la reacción")
            app:continueGame(); settle(); screen=app.manager.current; result=screen.enc.log[1]
            check(result.applied and screen.enc.reactionIndex==2 and encode(app.session.relationships)==applied,"Continuar no duplica el efecto ya leído")
            check(math.abs(screen.relationVisual.love-app.session.relationships[character].love)<.01
                and math.abs(screen.relationVisual.trust-app.session.relationships[character].trust)<.01,"Barras animadas terminan en los valores reales")
            app:keypressed("return"); app:update(.3)
            check(screen:responseLine().text==require("src.data.dialogue").nodes[result.nextNode].text,"La elección abre su continuación escrita")
            capture(name.."-branch")
            local steps=0
            while screen.phase=="result" do
                steps=steps+1; check(steps<12,"La secuencia extendida termina")
                app:keypressed("return"); app:update(.3)
            end
            check(encode(app.session.relationships)==applied,"Leer todas las líneas no vuelve a sumar puntos")
            check(screen.phase=="hand" and #screen.enc.log==1,"La siguiente decisión espera una nueva elección humana")
            return clone(app.session),result
        end

        local eris={
            {card="light_joke",name="eris-joke",love=-5,trust=-2,expression="angry",next="eris_training_argument",flag="eris_disliked_training_joke"},
            {card="encourage",name="eris-support",love=5,trust=3,expression="happy",next="eris_training_together",flag="eris_training_supported"},
            {card="subtle_flirt",name="eris-flirt",love=10,trust=1,expression="happy",next="eris_training_challenge",flag="eris_romantic_training"},
        }
        local distinct={}
        for _,case in ipairs(eris) do
            local _,result=playCase("encounter_eris",case.card,case.name,case)
            distinct[result.nextNode]=true
        end
        local count=0; for _ in pairs(distinct) do count=count+1 end
        check(count==3,"Prueba A: tres fixtures independientes, tres consecuencias y tres ramas")
        for _,case in ipairs({
            {card="listen",name="roxy-listen",love=3,trust=4,expression="happy",next="roxy_formula_check"},
            {card="light_joke",name="roxy-joke",love=-2,trust=-1,expression="worried",next="roxy_formula_boundaries"},
            {card="be_honest",name="roxy-honest",love=4,trust=3,expression="happy",next="roxy_formula_equals"},
        }) do playCase("encounter_roxy",case.card,case.name,case) end

        local promised=playCase("encounter_sylphiette","encourage","sylphiette-promise")
        check(promised.events.sylphiette_promised_family_time and promised.relationships.sylphiette.promises.family_time=="pending",
            "Prueba C: la promesa de tiempo familiar queda pendiente")
        local futureResponses={}
        for _,outcome in ipairs({"kept","broken"}) do
            local prior=clone(promised)
            Events.apply(prior,"family_time_outcome",{character="sylphiette",decision="family_time_outcome",value=outcome,promise={id="family_time",status=outcome}})
            prior.events["sylphiette_family_time_"..outcome]=true
            local _,result=playCase("day5_mission_sylphiette","listen","sylphiette-"..outcome,nil,prior)
            futureResponses[outcome]=result.responseId
        end
        check(futureResponses.kept~=futureResponses.broken,"Prueba C: el cumplimiento cambia la conversación futura visible")

        local seedHands={}
        for _,seed in ipairs({13,29,51,83}) do
            local screen=prepare("encounter_eris",nil,nil,seed)
            seedHands[table.concat(screen.enc.hand,",")]=true
            capture("seed-"..seed)
            local order=encode({screen.enc.hand,screen.enc.drawPile,screen.enc.discard})
            app:save(); app:continueGame(); settle()
            local restored=app.manager.current.enc
            check(order==encode({restored.hand,restored.drawPile,restored.discard}),"Prueba D: continuar conserva exactamente la mano y el orden")
        end
        local varied=0; for _ in pairs(seedHands) do varied=varied+1 end
        check(varied>1,"Prueba D: distintos inicios muestran manos diferentes")

        local empty=Fixtures.fixture("encounter_eris",{"shared_magic","combined_spell","sword_magic","choose_together","angry_reply"})
        local screen=prepare("encounter_eris",nil,empty,7)
        check(#screen.enc.hand==0 and draw():find(screen.enc.notice,1,true),"La UI explica el mazo sin cartas compatibles")
        capture("no-compatible-cards")
        local steps=0
        while app.session.checkpoint=="encounter_eris" do
            steps=steps+1; check(steps<30,"La respuesta básica permite terminar sin bloqueo")
            screen=app.manager.current
            if screen.phase=="hand" then app:keypressed("p") else app:keypressed("return") end
            app:update(2)
            if app.manager.transition>0 then app:update(app.manager.transition) end
        end
        check(app.session.checkpoint=="result_eris","El encuentro sin cartas sigue una salida narrativa válida")
    end,debug.traceback)
    Save.readOptions=originalOptions; Font.draw=originalFont
    love.graphics.setCanvas(); love.graphics.pop()
    love.filesystem.setIdentity(identity)
````

## tests/experience.lua

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/tests/experience.lua`

````lua
-- Pruebas de los contratos de UX: explicaciones obtenidas del cálculo real,
-- acciones idempotentes y guía restaurable sin saltar instrucciones.
local Suite={}

function Suite.run()
    local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
    local Data=require("src.data.cards")
    local Tutorial=require("src.systems.tutorial")
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Options=require("src.systems.options")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local Chapters=require("src.data.chapters")
    local Validator=require("src.systems.narrative_validator")
    local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
    local checked=0
    local function check(ok,message) assert(ok,message); checked=checked+1 end
    local function encode(value) return assert(Json.encode(value)) end
    local function clone(value)
        if type(value)~="table" then return value end
        local out={}; for key,item in pairs(value) do out[key]=clone(item) end; return out
    end
    local function roundtrip(session)
        return assert(Save.validate(assert(Json.decode(encode(session)))))
    end
    local Relationships=require("src.systems.relationships")
    local relations=Relationships.new()
    relations.roxy.trust=9; relations.roxy.chemistry=0
    local before=encode(relations)
    local projected=Relationships.preview(relations,"roxy",{trust=4,chemistry=-2})
    check(projected.trust==1 and projected.chemistry==0,"La vista de cierre respeta ambos límites de relación")
    check(encode(relations)==before,"Consultar el cambio de vínculo no modifica estadísticas")
    Relationships.apply(relations,"roxy",{trust=4,chemistry=-2})
    check(relations.roxy.trust==9+projected.trust and relations.roxy.chemistry==projected.chemistry,"El cierre aplica exactamente el delta anunciado")
    check(Relationships.preview(relations,"nanahoshi",{trust=5}).trust==0,"No se promete vínculo romántico con Nanahoshi")
    local function deckFor(id)
        local deck=clone(Data.starterDeck)
        local existing
        for i,value in ipairs(deck) do if value==id then existing=i end end
        if existing then deck[existing],deck[10]=deck[10],deck[existing] else deck[10]=id end
        return deck
    end
    local metrics={"score","trust","chemistry"}
    local kinds={"conversation","investigation","magic"}
    local people={"sylphiette","roxy","eris"}
    for _,card in ipairs(Data.list) do
        for _,kind in ipairs(kinds) do
            for _,character in ipairs(people) do
                local deck=deckFor(card.id)
                local enc=Cards.new(deck,{kind=kind,character=character},function(n) return n end)
                local before=encode(enc)
                local result=Cards.preview(enc,1)
                local label=card.id.."/"..kind.."/"..character
                check(result.cardId==card.id and result.cost==card.cost and result.contextKind==kind,"Identidad, contexto y coste: "..label)
                check(encode(enc)==before,"Consultar no juega: "..label)
                for _,metric in ipairs(metrics) do
                    local base=(card.effects or {})[metric] or 0
                    local contextual=(card.contexts[kind] or {})[metric] or 0
                    local affinity=(card.affinities[character] or {})[metric] or 0
                    check(result.base[metric]==base and result.contextBonus[metric]==contextual
                        and result.affinityBonus[metric]==affinity,"Desglose canónico de "..metric..": "..label)
                    check(result[metric]==result.base[metric]+result.contextBonus[metric]
                        +result.affinityBonus[metric]+result.targetAdjustment[metric],"Suma de capas "..metric..": "..label)
                end
                local played=Cards.play(enc,1,1)
                if card.conditions.character and card.conditions.character~=character then
                    check(not played and encode(enc)==before,"Exclusiva incompatible no cambia nada: "..label)
                else
                    check(played and encode(played)==encode(result),"Aplicar coincide con la explicación: "..label)
                    check(enc.energy==4-card.cost and enc.energy>=0,"Pagar exactamente una vez: "..label)
                    local after=encode(enc)
                    check(not Cards.play(enc,1,1) and not Cards.pass(enc,1) and encode(enc)==after,"Token de turno rechaza doble pulsación: "..label)
                end
            end
            local scratch={hand={card.id},context={kind=kind,character="nanahoshi"}}
            local nonRomantic=Cards.preview(scratch,1)
            check(nonRomantic.trust==0 and nonRomantic.chemistry==0,"Nanahoshi no recibe puntos románticos: "..card.id.."/"..kind)
            for _,metric in ipairs(metrics) do
                check(nonRomantic[metric]==nonRomantic.base[metric]+nonRomantic.contextBonus[metric]
                    +nonRomantic.affinityBonus[metric]+nonRomantic.targetAdjustment[metric],"Ajuste sin romance explicado: "..card.id.."/"..metric)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Fixture aislada: no se cambian cartas existentes ni se añade contenido al
    -- catálogo. La entrada temporal se retira incluso si falla una aserción.
    local fixtureId="__ux_negative_fixture"
    check(Data.byId[fixtureId]==nil,"El fixture negativo no es una carta de producción")
    Data.byId[fixtureId]={id=fixtureId,name="Prueba negativa",category="sincerity",cost=2,
        effects={score=2,trust=-2,chemistry=1},contexts={magic={score=-1,trust=1,chemistry=-3}},
        affinities={roxy={score=-2,trust=-2,chemistry=1}},conditions={}}
    local negativeOK,negativeError=xpcall(function()
        local enc={hand={fixtureId},context={kind="magic",character="roxy"},energy=4,finished=false,
            drawPile={},discard={},log={},score=0,turn=1,maxTurns=3}
        local result=assert(Cards.play(enc,1,1))
        check(result.score==-1 and result.trust==-3 and result.chemistry==-1,"Deltas negativos reales")
        check(result.text:find("-1 avance",1,true) and result.text:find("-3 confianza",1,true),"Texto muestra signo negativo")
        check(not result.text:find("+-",1,true),"No presentar un negativo como bonificación")
        check(Cards.describe(result):find("-1 química",1,true),"Panel usa el desglose negativo")
        check(enc.energy==2 and enc.score==-1 and #enc.log==1,"La acción negativa se aplica una sola vez")
    end,debug.traceback)
    Data.byId[fixtureId]=nil
    assert(negativeOK,negativeError)
    check(#Data.list==16 and Data.byId[fixtureId]==nil,"Catálogo original intacto tras fixture")

    local free=Cards.new(Data.starterDeck,{kind="magic"},function(n) return n end)
    free.energy=0
    local beforeFree=encode(free)
    check(not Cards.play(free,1,1) and encode(free)==beforeFree,"Carta de coste dos no gasta con energía cero")
    for turn=1,3 do
        check(Cards.pass(free,turn)~=nil and free.energy==0,"Respiro válido sin energía: "..turn)
        local after=encode(free)
        check(not Cards.pass(free,turn) and encode(free)==after,"Respiro duplicado no consume otro turno: "..turn)
    end
    check(free.finished and #free.log==3 and #free.discard==0,"Tres respiros cierran encuentro sin bloqueo")

    local profile=Options.normalize()
    local session=Save.newSession()
    session.checkpoint="day1_tutorial"
    session.encounter=Cards.new(session.deck,{kind="magic"},function(n) return n end)
    session.tutorial=Tutorial.restore(nil,session.encounter)
    local function checkpoint(expected)
        check(session.tutorial.stage==expected,"Orden tutorial: "..expected)
        check(Tutorial.instruction(session.tutorial)~=nil,"Instrucción visible: "..expected)
        local originalEncounter=encode(session.encounter)
        local originalRelationships=encode(session.relationships)
        session=roundtrip(session)
        check(session.tutorial and session.tutorial.stage==expected,"Restaurar paso: "..expected)
        check(encode(session.encounter)==originalEncounter,"Restaurar cartas y cálculo: "..expected)
        check(encode(session.relationships)==originalRelationships,"Restaurar vínculos: "..expected)
        check(session.encounter.energy>=0 and session.encounter.energy<=4,"Energía válida en paso: "..expected)
    end
    checkpoint("hand")
    check(not Tutorial.skip(session,profile),"No omitir sin haber completado la guía")
    check(not Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial,1) and not Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial),"La mano debe explicarse antes de jugar")
    check(not Tutorial.complete(session,profile),"No completar sin las tres acciones")
    check(Tutorial.advance(session.tutorial),"Confirmar explicación de la mano")
    checkpoint("energy")
    check(not Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial,1),"La energía se explica antes de jugar")
    check(Tutorial.advance(session.tutorial),"Confirmar explicación de energía")
    checkpoint("select")
    check(not Tutorial.advance(session.tutorial),"No completar selección leyendo otro panel")
    check(not Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial,1),"Hace falta consultar antes de jugar")
    check(Tutorial.select(session.tutorial),"Selección real habilita confirmación")
    checkpoint("ready")
    check(Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial,1) and not Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial),"Primera acción requiere una carta")
    check(not Tutorial.advance(session.tutorial),"Confirmar un texto no simula jugar")
    check(Cards.play(session.encounter,1,1)~=nil,"Jugar la carta recomendada")
    Tutorial.action(session.tutorial,session.encounter)
    session.encounterReview=true
    checkpoint("result")
    check(session.encounterReview==true,"La lectura del resultado se restaura")
    check(not Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial,1),"Leer consecuencias antes de otra carta")
    check(Tutorial.advance(session.tutorial),"Confirmar consecuencias reales")
    checkpoint("draw")
    check(#session.encounter.hand==3 and #session.encounter.drawPile==6 and #session.encounter.discard==1,"Descarte y robo reales explicados")
    check(not Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial,1),"Leer el robo antes de actuar")
    check(Tutorial.advance(session.tutorial),"Confirmar el robo")
    checkpoint("second")
    check(Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial,1) and not Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial),"Segunda acción requiere otra carta")
    check(Cards.play(session.encounter,1,2)~=nil,"Jugar segunda carta")
    Tutorial.action(session.tutorial,session.encounter)
    checkpoint("second_result")
    check(not Tutorial.advance({stage="ready"}),"No saltar acción pendiente con continuar")
    check(Tutorial.advance(session.tutorial),"Pasar de segunda consecuencia a demostración")
    checkpoint("free_demo")
    local energy=session.encounter.energy
    check(Tutorial.advance(session.tutorial),"Probar rechazo real de carta sin energía")
    checkpoint("free")
    check(session.encounter.energy==energy,"Demostración no altera energía real")
    check(Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial) and not Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial,1),"El paso gratuito exige usar respiro")
    check(not Tutorial.advance(session.tutorial),"No completar respiro sin ejecutar acción")
    check(Cards.pass(session.encounter,3)~=nil,"Ejecutar respiro gratuito del tercer turno")
    Tutorial.action(session.tutorial,session.encounter)
    checkpoint("summary")
    check(session.encounter.finished and #session.encounter.log==3,"Resumen contiene tres acciones reales")
    check(not Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial,1) and not Tutorial.canAct(session.tutorial),"Resumen ya no admite acciones")
    check(Tutorial.restore({stage="complete"},session.encounter).stage=="summary","Reparar complete incoherente sin bloquear")
    local beforeCompletion=encode(session.encounter)
    check(Tutorial.complete(session,profile),"Finalizar guía tras las acciones y resumen")
    check(profile.tutorialCompleted and session.events.tutorial_completed,"Registrar completado en perfil y partida")
    check(not Tutorial.complete(session,profile) and encode(session.encounter)==beforeCompletion,"No completar ni recompensar dos veces")
    session=roundtrip(session)
    check(session.events.tutorial_completed and not session.tutorial,"Restaurar completado sin reactivar guía")
    check(Progression.next(session,session.checkpoint,{score=session.encounter.score,trust=0,chemistry=0})=="day1_result","Guía permite continuar historia")
    check(session.encounter==nil and session.encounterReview==nil and session.tutorial==nil,"La transición limpia estado de práctica")
    local nextGame=Save.newSession()
    nextGame.checkpoint="day1_tutorial"
    nextGame.encounter=Cards.new(nextGame.deck,{kind="magic"},function(n) return n end)
    nextGame.tutorial=Tutorial.restore(nil,nextGame.encounter)
    local beforeSkip=encode(nextGame.encounter)
    check(Tutorial.skip(nextGame,profile),"Perfil completado permite omitir guía en nueva partida")
    check(not nextGame.tutorial and nextGame.events.tutorial_completed and encode(nextGame.encounter)==beforeSkip,"Omitir no altera mano, energía ni recompensas")
    local restoredSkip=roundtrip(nextGame)
    check(restoredSkip.events.tutorial_completed and not restoredSkip.tutorial,"Omisión conservada al guardar y cargar")
    for _,invalid in ipairs({"does_not_exist","summary","second_result","free"}) do
        check(Tutorial.restore({stage=invalid},nextGame.encounter).stage=="hand","Reparar paso incompatible con registro vacío: "..invalid)
    end

    local function catalogChange(change)
        local list=clone(Chapters.list)
        change(list[1].scenes.intro)
        return Chapters.build(list)
    end
    local function invalid(change,fragment)
        local ok,errors=Validator.validate(catalogChange(change),{checkFiles=false})
        check(not ok and table.concat(errors,"; "):find(fragment,1,true),"Diagnosticar metadato inválido: "..fragment)
    end
    for _,kind in ipairs({"fade","fade_in","horizontal","new_day","magic","return"}) do
        check(Validator.validate(catalogChange(function(scene) scene.transition={type=kind,duration=.4} end),{checkFiles=false}),"Aceptar transición declarativa "..kind)
    end
    for _,kind in ipairs({"enter_left","enter_right","happy_bounce","shake","expression_change","exit_left","exit_right"}) do
        check(Validator.validate(catalogChange(function(scene) scene.lines[1].animation={type=kind,expression="happy"} end),{checkFiles=false}),"Aceptar animación declarativa "..kind)
    end
    for _,context in ipairs({"menu","university","casual","romantic","mystery","forest","tension","mirror","festival"}) do
        check(Validator.validate(catalogChange(function(scene) scene.music=context end),{checkFiles=false}),"Aceptar contexto musical "..context)
    end
    invalid(function(scene) scene.music="unknown_music" end,"contexto musical desconocido")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.animation="spin_blur" end,"animación desconocida")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.lines[1].animation={type="shake",unknown=true} end,"campo de animación desconocido")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.lines[1].animation={type="expression_change",expression="crying"} end,"expresión de animación desconocida")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.exitAnimation="unknown_exit" end,"salida de personaje desconocida")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.transition="fade" end,"transición visual inválida")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.transition={type="unknown"} end,"tipo de transición visual desconocido")
    for _,duration in ipairs({0,.1,1,math.huge,".4"}) do
        invalid(function(scene) scene.transition={type="fade",duration=duration} end,"duración visual fuera")
    end
    local executed=false
    invalid(function(scene) scene.animation=function() executed=true end end,"código ejecutable")
    check(not executed,"Validar metadatos nunca ejecuta código narrativo")
    print("Experience: "..checked.." checks passed (card breakdowns, action tokens, tutorial restoration and presentation metadata).")
    return checked
end

return Suite
````

````lua
-- Screens rendered by the real App. Save functions are isolated in tests/run.
-- The only negative-stat fixture is explicitly labelled QA and restored below.
local Suite={}
function Suite.run(app)
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
    local Data=require("src.data.cards")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local Font=require("src.ui.font")
    local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
    local checks,captures=0,0
    local function check(ok,message) assert(ok,message); checks=checks+1 end
    local function encode(value) return assert(Json.encode(value)) end
    local originalSession,originalOptions,originalMouse=app.session,app.options,app.mouse
    local originalDraw=Font.draw
    local originalBonus=Data.byId.analyze_runes.contexts.investigation
    app.mouse=function() return nil,nil end
    local function capture(name)
        app.toastTime=0; app:draw()
        local pixels=app.canvas:newImageData()
        local bytes=pixels:encode("png")
        local file=assert(io.open(love.filesystem.getSource().."/tests/artifacts/"..name..".png","wb"))
        file:write(bytes:getString()); file:close(); pixels:release(); bytes:release()
        captures=captures+1
    end
    local function settle()
        app:update(1.6)
        if app.manager.transition>0 then app:update(app.manager.transition) end
        app.toastTime=0; app:draw()
    end
    local function click(label)
        app:draw()
        for _,button in ipairs(app.manager.current.buttons) do
            if button.label==label then
                check(not button.disabled,"La instrucción tiene un control habilitado: "..label)
                app:mousepressed(app.offsetX+(button.x+button.w/2)*app.scale,
                    app.offsetY+(button.y+button.h/2)*app.scale,1)
                return
            end
        end
        error("No se encontró el control visual: "..label)
    end
    local function cardClick(index)
        app:draw()
        for _,button in ipairs(app.manager.current.buttons) do
            if button.cardIndex==index then
                app:mousepressed(app.offsetX+(button.x+4)*app.scale,app.offsetY+(button.y+4)*app.scale,1)
                return
            end
        end
        error("No existe hitbox de la carta "..index)
    end
    local function startEncounter(checkpoint,reduced)
        app.options=require("src.systems.options").normalize({volume=.6,muted=true,
            textSpeed=50,textAnimation=true,reducedMotion=reduced or false,tutorialCompleted=false})
        app:applyOptions()
        app.session=Save.newSession()
        app.session.checkpoint=checkpoint
        app.session.day=checkpoint=="day1_tutorial" and 1 or 2
        local def=Progression.encounter(app.session,checkpoint)
        app.session.encounter=Cards.new(app.session.deck,{kind=def.kind,character=def.character},function(n) return n end)
        app:resume(); settle()
        return app.manager.current
    end
    local function reducedResult(reduced,capturePositive)
        local screen=startEncounter("encounter_roxy",reduced)
        app:keypressed("2")
        check(screen.enc.turn==1 and screen.confirmReady,"Vista previa de runas no consume turno")
        app:keypressed("return")
        settle()
        check(screen.enc.log[1].score==3 and screen.enc.log[1].trust==1,"Resultado positivo real suma base, contexto y afinidad")
        if capturePositive then capture("ux-positive-result") end
        app:keypressed("return")
        app:keypressed("p"); settle(); app:keypressed("return")
        app:keypressed("p"); settle(); app:keypressed("return")
        check(app.session.checkpoint=="result_roxy","Encuentro finaliza también con movimiento reducido")
        return encode({relationships=app.session.relationships,events=app.session.events,
            decisions=app.session.decisions,unlocked=app.session.unlocked})
    end

    local ok,err=xpcall(function()
        local screen=startEncounter("day1_tutorial")
        check(screen.tutorial and screen.tutorial.stage=="hand","La primera práctica comienza en la mano")
        app:keypressed("p")
        check(#screen.enc.log==0 and screen.tutorial.stage=="hand","No se puede omitir la instrucción con un respiro")
        capture("ux-tutorial-initial")
        click("Ver la energía")
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="energy","Paso mano precede a energía")
        click("Elegir una carta")
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="select","La guía espera selección real")
        cardClick(1)
        app:update(.15)
        check(screen.confirmReady and screen.tutorial.stage=="ready" and #screen.enc.log==0,"Clic selecciona y eleva antes de jugar")
        capture("ux-card-selected")
        click("Jugar carta [Enter]")
        app:update(.2); capture("ux-card-play")
        local snapshot=encode(screen.enc)
        app:keypressed("return"); app:keypressed("1"); app:keypressed("return")
        check(encode(screen.enc)==snapshot,"Entradas repetidas durante animación no duplican efectos")
        app:update(.4); capture("ux-card-flash")
        check(screen:busy() and screen.phase=="result","El efecto visual mantiene bloqueado el siguiente turno")
        app:keypressed("f5")
        app:continueGame(); settle(); screen=app.manager.current
        check(encode(screen.enc)==snapshot and screen.phase=="result","Guardar/cargar durante animación conserva el resultado sin repetirlo")
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="result","Carga mantiene la explicación pendiente")
        capture("ux-tutorial-result")
        click("Ver el robo")
        app:update(.15); capture("ux-card-draw")
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="draw" and #screen.enc.hand==3,"El robo conserva una mano de tres")
        settle(); click("Jugar el segundo turno")
        app:keypressed("1"); app:keypressed("return"); settle()
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="second_result" and #screen.enc.log==2,"La segunda acción se aprende jugando")
        click("Aprender la acción gratuita")
        capture("ux-tutorial-no-energy")
        local energy=screen.enc.energy
        click("Probar carta con 0 energía")
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="free" and screen.enc.energy==energy,"La demostración de coste cero no altera la energía real")
        app:keypressed("p"); settle()
        check(screen.tutorial.stage=="summary" and screen.enc.finished and screen.enc.log[3].cardId=="pass","La guía exige realizar el respiro final")
        capture("ux-tutorial-summary")
        check(screen.historyOpen,"El cierre de la guía muestra el historial de las tres acciones")
        capture("ux-tutorial-history")
        app:keypressed("h")
        click("Ver resultado >")
        check(app.session.events.tutorial_completed and app.options.tutorialCompleted,"El resumen registra práctica completada en sesión y perfil")
        local completedEvents=encode(app.session.events)
        app:continueGame(); settle()
        check(encode(app.session.events)==completedEvents,"Carga posterior no repite el evento de la práctica")

        screen=startEncounter("day1_tutorial")
        app.options.tutorialCompleted=true
        app:draw(); click("Omitir guía")
        check(screen.tutorial==nil and #screen.enc.log==0 and screen.enc.energy==4,"Un perfil experto omite la guía sin inventar acciones ni premios")
        for turn=1,3 do
            app:keypressed("p"); settle()
            check(#screen.enc.log==turn,"La práctica omitida conserva sus tres turnos reales")
            if turn<3 then app:keypressed("return") end
        end
        app:keypressed("return")
        check(app.session.checkpoint=="day1_result","Omitir la guía conserva la salida narrativa")

        local normal=reducedResult(false,true)
        local reduced=reducedResult(true,false)
        check(normal==reduced,"Reducir movimiento produce los mismos vínculos, decisiones, cartas y eventos")

        screen=startEncounter("encounter_roxy")
        local originalHand=screen.enc.hand[1]
        for index,card in ipairs(Data.list) do
            screen.enc.hand[1]=card.id; screen.selected=1
            local fullName=false
            local rowHeights={[146]=22,[173]=22,[207]=55,[266]=11,[279]=33,[297]=22}
            Font.draw=function(text,x,y,options)
                if x==439 then
                    local maxHeight=rowHeights[y]
                    check(maxHeight~=nil,"El detalle usa una fila reservada: "..card.id)
                    check(Font.height(text,options.maxWidth,options.scale)<=maxHeight,"El detalle de encuentro cabe: "..card.id)
                    check(x+options.maxWidth<=622 and y+maxHeight<=323,"El texto queda dentro del panel de encuentro")
                    fullName=fullName or text==card.name
                end
                return originalDraw(text,x,y,options)
            end
            app:draw()
            check(fullName,"El panel muestra el nombre completo de la carta "..index)
            if card.id=="be_honest" then capture("ux-long-card") end
        end
        Font.draw=originalDraw; screen.enc.hand[1]=originalHand

        -- No production card currently subtracts stats. This labelled fixture
        -- exercises the real calculator/renderer without changing shipped data.
        Data.byId.analyze_runes.contexts.investigation={score=-3,trust=-2}
        screen.definition.title="QA: MODIFICADOR NEGATIVO"
        app:keypressed("2"); app:keypressed("return"); settle()
        check(screen.enc.log[1].score==-2 and screen.enc.log[1].trust==-1,"El cálculo admite y representa deltas negativos reales de una definición")
        local negativeShown=false
        Font.draw=function(text,...)
            if text:find("DESCENSO:",1,true) and text:find("-2",1,true) then negativeShown=true end
            return originalDraw(text,...)
        end
        capture("ux-negative-fixture")
        Font.draw=originalDraw
        check(negativeShown,"El resultado negativo muestra signo y palabra DESCENSO")
        Data.byId.analyze_runes.contexts.investigation=originalBonus

        screen=startEncounter("encounter_roxy")
        for turn=1,3 do
            app:keypressed("p"); settle()
            if turn<3 then app:keypressed("return") end
        end
        check(screen.enc.finished and screen.enc.score==0 and screen.enc.energy==4,"Tres respiros producen resultado parcial sin bloqueo de energía")
        capture("ux-partial-result")

        app.session=originalSession; app.options=originalOptions; app:applyOptions()
        app:overlay("deck"); settle(); capture("ux-collection")
        cardClick(7); capture("ux-collection-honesty")
        app:overlay("options"); settle(); capture("ux-audio-options")
        local activations=app.manager.activationCount
        app:resume({type="horizontal",duration=.4})
        local checkpoint=app.session.checkpoint
        app:update(.15); capture("ux-scene-transition")
        app:keypressed("return")
        check(app.manager.activationCount==activations+1 and app.session.checkpoint==checkpoint,"El barrido bloquea entrada y activa una sola pantalla")
        settle()
        check(app.manager.transition==0 and app.manager.activationCount==activations+1,"La transición termina sin reactivar la escena")
    end,debug.traceback)
    Font.draw=originalDraw
    Data.byId.analyze_runes.contexts.investigation=originalBonus
    app.session,app.options,app.mouse=originalSession,originalOptions,originalMouse
    if app.audio then app.audio:stop() end
    assert(ok,err)
    print("Experience visuals: "..checks.." checks passed; "..captures.." real-renderer screenshots (one labelled negative QA fixture).")
    return checks,captures
end
return Suite
````
