## tests/gameplay.lua

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/tests/gameplay.lua`

````lua
-- Run with the project's LÖVE test switch, or: lua -e "require('tests.gameplay').run()"
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
    local Data=require("src.data.cards")
    local Relationships=require("src.systems.relationships")
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local checked=0
    local function check(condition,message)
        assert(condition,message); checked=checked+1
    end
    check(#Data.list==16,"16 cartas definidas")
    check(Cards.validateDeck(Data.starterDeck),"Mazo inicial válido")
    check(not Cards.validateDeck({"listen"}),"Rechazar longitud incorrecta")
    local duplicate={}; for i,id in ipairs(Data.starterDeck) do duplicate[i]=id end
    duplicate[10]=duplicate[1]
    check(not Cards.validateDeck(duplicate),"Rechazar cartas repetidas")

    local calls={}
    local enc=Cards.new(Data.starterDeck,{kind="magic",character="nanahoshi"},function(n) calls[#calls+1]=n; return n end)
    check(#calls==9 and calls[1]==10 and calls[9]==2,"Fisher-Yates usa rangos descendentes")
    check(#enc.hand==3 and #enc.drawPile==7 and #enc.discard==0,"Repartir 3 de 10")
    check(enc.hand[1]=="earth_barrier","RNG determinista conserva orden")
    local first=Cards.play(enc,1)
    check(first.score==4 and first.trust==0,"Efecto mágico sin relación no romántica")
    check(enc.energy==2 and #enc.hand==3 and #enc.drawPile==6 and #enc.discard==1,"Pagar, descartar y robar")
    check(enc.turn==2 and not enc.finished,"Un turno por acción")
    local restored=Cards.restore(enc,Data.starterDeck,{kind="magic",character="nanahoshi"})
    check(restored and restored.energy==2 and restored.hand[1]==enc.hand[1] and restored.turn==2,"Restaurar turno y mano")
    check(not Cards.play(enc,0) and not Cards.play(enc,99) and not Cards.play(enc,1.1),"Rechazar índices inválidos")
    check(enc.turn==2 and enc.energy==2,"Acción inválida no modifica estado")
    Cards.pass(enc); Cards.pass(enc)
    check(enc.finished and enc.turn==4 and #enc.log==3,"Tres turnos exactos")
    check(not Cards.pass(enc) and not Cards.play(enc,1),"No actuar tras el final")

    local empty=Cards.new(Data.starterDeck,{kind="conversation",character="eris"},function(n) return n end)
    empty.energy=0
    local before=table.concat(empty.hand,",")
    check(not Cards.play(empty,1),"Una carta de coste 2 no se juega sin energía")
    check(empty.turn==1 and table.concat(empty.hand,",")==before,"No gastar turno al rechazar")
    Cards.pass(empty); Cards.pass(empty); Cards.pass(empty)
    check(empty.finished,"Acción gratuita evita bloqueo con mano cara")
    local free={hand={"light_joke"},context={kind="conversation",character="eris"},energy=0,finished=false,
        drawPile={},discard={},score=0,turn=1,maxTurns=3,log={}}
    check(Cards.play(free,1)~=nil and free.energy==0 and #free.hand==0,"Coste cero y pila vacía son seguros")
    local conditional={hand={"shared_magic"},context={kind="magic",character="eris"},energy=4,finished=false}
    check(not Cards.canPlay(conditional,1),"Carta exclusiva exige acompañante correcto")
    conditional.context.character="sylphiette"
    check(Cards.canPlay(conditional,1),"Carta exclusiva disponible con su acompañante")
    local a=Cards.preview({hand={"listen"},context={kind="conversation",character="sylphiette"}},1)
    local b=Cards.preview({hand={"listen"},context={kind="conversation",character="eris"}},1)
    check(a.chemistry>b.chemistry,"Preferencias modifican los efectos")
    local fresh=Cards.new(Data.starterDeck,{kind="magic"},function(n) return n end)
    check(fresh.energy==4 and fresh.turn==1 and #fresh.discard==0,"Cada encuentro reinicia mazo y energía")

    -- Every real card must apply exactly once, and inspecting its effect must
    -- leave the encounter untouched. Exercise all three narrative contexts.
    for _,card in ipairs(Data.list) do
        check(card.cost>=0 and card.cost<=2 and card.cost%1==0,"Coste permitido: "..card.id)
        for _,kind in ipairs({"conversation","investigation","magic"}) do
            local deck={}
            local position
            for i,id in ipairs(Data.starterDeck) do deck[i]=id; if id==card.id then position=i end end
            if position then deck[position],deck[10]=deck[10],deck[position] else deck[10]=card.id end
            local context={kind=kind,character=card.exclusive or "roxy"}
            local action=Cards.new(deck,context,function(n) return n end)
            local beforePreview=assert(Json.encode(action))
            local preview=Cards.preview(action,1)
            check(Json.encode(action)==beforePreview,"Vista previa no aplica efectos: "..card.id.."/"..kind)
            check(Cards.canPlay(action,1),"Carta jugable con su acompañante: "..card.id)
            local result=assert(Cards.play(action,1))
            check(action.score==preview.score and result.trust==preview.trust and result.chemistry==preview.chemistry,
                "Efectos aplicados una vez: "..card.id.."/"..kind)
            check(action.energy==4-card.cost and action.turn==2 and #action.log==1 and action.discard[1]==card.id,
                "Una sola acción y un solo pago: "..card.id)
            local snapshot=assert(Json.encode(action))
            for _=1,3 do action=assert(Cards.restore(action,deck,context)) end
            check(Json.encode(action)==snapshot,"Restaurar no duplica efectos: "..card.id.."/"..kind)
        end
    end

    local resting=Cards.new(Data.starterDeck,{kind="magic"},function(n) return n end)
    for turn=1,3 do
        local hand,pile=table.concat(resting.hand,","),table.concat(resting.drawPile,",")
        Cards.pass(resting)
        local snapshot=assert(Json.encode(resting))
        resting=assert(Cards.restore(resting,Data.starterDeck,{kind="magic"}))
        check(Json.encode(resting)==snapshot,"Acción gratuita conserva incluso su registro al continuar")
        check(resting.energy==4 and resting.turn==turn+1 and #resting.log==turn and #resting.discard==0,
            "Acción gratuita gasta solo un turno")
        check(table.concat(resting.hand,",")==hand and table.concat(resting.drawPile,",")==pile,
            "Acción gratuita no roba ni descarta")
    end
    check(resting.finished and not Cards.pass(resting),"Continuar encuentro gratuito terminado no concede otro turno")

    local all=Relationships.new()
    Relationships.apply(all,"sylphiette",{trust=30,chemistry=-2})
    check(all.sylphiette.trust==10 and all.sylphiette.chemistry==0,"Límites de relación")
    Relationships.apply(all,"sylphiette",{chemistry=10})
    check(Relationships.ending(all,"sylphiette",{confession="sylphiette"})=="friendship_sylphiette","Puntos no bastan para romance")
    Relationships.complete(all,"sylphiette","route_conflict")
    Relationships.complete(all,"sylphiette","mirror_truth")
    check(Relationships.ending(all,"sylphiette",{})=="friendship_sylphiette","Confesión debe ser explícita")
    check(Relationships.ending(all,"sylphiette",{confession="sylphiette"})=="romance_sylphiette","Romance con todos los requisitos")
    check(Relationships.ending(all,nil,{})=="independent","Final independiente")
    for _,id in ipairs({"roxy","eris"}) do
        all[id].trust=6; all[id].chemistry=5; all[id].events.route_conflict=true; all[id].events.mirror_truth=true
        check(Relationships.ending(all,id,{confession=id})=="romance_"..id,"Romance "..id)
        check(Relationships.ending(all,id,{})=="friendship_"..id,"Amistad "..id)
    end

    local input={version=1,checkpoint="encounter_roxy",deck={"bad"},day=99,
        relationships={roxy={trust=99,chemistry=-50}},options={volume=20,muted=true},
        events={reunion=true},decisions={companion="roxy",outcome_day1_tutorial="partial"}}
    local valid=Save.validate(input)
    check(valid.day==2 and valid.relationships.roxy.trust==10 and valid.relationships.roxy.chemistry==0,"Normalizar guardado parcial")
    check(#valid.deck==10 and valid.options.volume==1 and valid.options.muted,"Reparar mazo y opciones")
    check(valid.events.reunion and valid.decisions.companion=="roxy","Preservar decisiones y eventos")
    check(not Save.validate({version=99}) and not Save.validate({}),"Rechazar versión desconocida y vacío")
    local chosen=Save.validate({version=1,checkpoint="meet_roxy",decisions={choice_meet_roxy="compare_notes"}})
    check(chosen.checkpoint=="meet_roxy" and chosen.decisions.choice_meet_roxy=="compare_notes","Conservar elección y punto de diálogo")
    local invalidChoice=Save.validate({version=1,checkpoint="meet_roxy",decisions={choice_meet_roxy=true,companion=true}})
    check(invalidChoice.checkpoint=="meet_roxy" and invalidChoice.decisions.choice_meet_roxy==nil and invalidChoice.decisions.companion==nil,"Eliminar tipos inválidos en elecciones")
    local missingCompanion=Save.validate({version=1,checkpoint="seal_result",events={companion_selected=true}})
    check(missingCompanion.checkpoint=="hub" and not missingCompanion.events.companion_selected,"Acompañante ausente se vuelve a elegir")
    local encoded=assert(Json.encode({message="¡Sí, mañana!\n\"Roxy\"",integer=7,flag=false,array={1,2,3}}))
    local decoded=assert(Json.decode(encoded))
    check(decoded.message=="¡Sí, mañana!\n\"Roxy\"" and decoded.array[3]==3 and decoded.flag==false,"JSON conserva español y escapes")
    check(Json.decode('"\\u00f1\\ud83c\\udf1f"')=="ñ🌟","Decodificar Unicode")
    for _,bad in ipairs({'{','{"a":1,}','{"a":1,"a":2}','[1,]','01','1.','1.e3','1e999','"\\uD800"','os.execute("bad")'}) do
        check(Json.decode(bad)==nil,"Rechazar JSON mal formado: "..bad)
    end
    local s=Save.newSession()
    s.checkpoint="day1_tutorial"; s.encounter=Cards.new(s.deck,{kind="magic",character="nanahoshi"},function(n) return n end)
    Cards.play(s.encounter,1)
    local round=Save.validate(assert(Json.decode(assert(Json.encode(s)))))
    check(round.encounter.energy==2 and round.encounter.turn==2 and round.encounter.discard[1]=="earth_barrier","Guardar estado exacto del encuentro")
    local roxySave=Save.newSession()
    roxySave.checkpoint="encounter_roxy"
    roxySave.encounter=Cards.new(roxySave.deck,{kind="investigation",character="roxy"},function(n) return n end)
    Cards.play(roxySave.encounter,2)
    local roxyRestored=Save.validate(roxySave)
    check(roxyRestored.encounter.context.kind=="investigation" and roxyRestored.encounter.score==3,"Restaurar contexto canónico de Roxy")
    local sealSave=Save.newSession()
    sealSave.checkpoint="seal_encounter"; sealSave.decisions.companion="eris"
    sealSave.encounter=Cards.new(sealSave.deck,{kind="magic",character="eris"},function(n) return n end)
    Cards.play(sealSave.encounter,1)
    local sealRestored=Save.validate(sealSave)
    check(sealRestored.encounter.context.kind=="magic" and sealRestored.encounter.score==4,"Restaurar contexto canónico del sello")
    s.encounter.hand[1]=s.encounter.hand[2]
    check(Save.validate(s).encounter==nil,"Rechazar snapshot con cartas duplicadas")

    -- In-memory filesystem: the test never changes a player's actual save.
    local previousLove=love
    local files={}
    love={filesystem={
        getInfo=function(path) if files[path] then return {size=#files[path]} end end,
        read=function(path) return files[path] end,
        write=function(path,data) files[path]=data; return true end,
        remove=function(path) files[path]=nil; return true end,
    }}
    local ok,errorMessage=pcall(function()
        local session=Save.newSession()
        check(Save.write(session),"Guardar nueva partida")
        check(Save.exists() and Save.load().checkpoint=="intro","Continuar partida")
        session.checkpoint="hub"; session.decisions.companion="eris"
        check(Save.write(session),"Guardar segundo checkpoint")
        check(Save.load().checkpoint=="hub","Cargar checkpoint nuevo")
        files[Save.filename]="truncated{"
        local backup,message=Save.load()
        check(backup and backup.checkpoint=="intro" and message~=nil,"Recuperar backup si archivo está truncado")
        local active=Save.newSession()
        active.checkpoint="encounter_roxy"
        active.decisions.choice_meet_roxy="compare_notes"
        active.decisions.roxy_equality="colleagues"
        active.events.choice_meet_roxy=true
        active.relationships.roxy.trust=1
        active.encounter=Cards.new(active.deck,{kind="investigation",character="roxy"},function(n) return n end)
        Cards.pass(active.encounter)
        Cards.play(active.encounter,2)
        local expectedEncounter=assert(Json.encode(active.encounter))
        check(Save.write(active),"Guardar decisión y encuentro con acción gratuita")
        for _=1,3 do
            active=assert(Save.load())
            check(Json.encode(active.encounter)==expectedEncounter,"Carga mantiene mano, pilas, energía, turnos y registro")
            check(active.events.choice_meet_roxy and active.decisions.choice_meet_roxy=="compare_notes"
                and active.decisions.roxy_equality=="colleagues" and active.relationships.roxy.trust==1,
                "Carga conserva decisiones sin anticipar ni duplicar efectos del encuentro")
            check(Save.write(active),"Volver a guardar encuentro restaurado")
        end
        check(Save.writeOptions({volume=0.2,muted=true}),"Guardar opciones")
        local prefs=Save.readOptions()
        check(prefs.volume==0.2 and prefs.muted,"Cargar opciones")
        files[Save.filename]="truncated{"
        files[Save.backup]=nil
        check(Save.load()==nil and not Save.exists(),"Guardado corrupto no provoca cierre")
        love.filesystem.write=function() return false,"sin espacio" end
        check(not Save.write(session),"Propagar error de escritura")
    end)
    love=previousLove
    assert(ok,errorMessage)
    print("OK: "..checked.." comprobaciones de cartas, relaciones, JSON y guardado.")
    return checked
end
return Suite
````

````lua
return function()

    diskSession.encounter=Cards.new(diskSession.deck,{kind="investigation",character="roxy"})
    Cards.pass(diskSession.encounter)
    diskCheck(Save.write(diskSession),"Escritura real de love.filesystem")
    local diskLoaded=assert(Save.load())
    diskCheck(diskLoaded.encounter.turn==2 and diskLoaded.encounter.energy==4,"Roundtrip real de guardado")
    diskCheck(Json.encode(diskLoaded.decisions)==Json.encode(diskSession.decisions),"Decisiones reales conservadas en disco")
    diskCheck(Json.encode(diskLoaded.encounter)==Json.encode(diskSession.encounter),"Encuentro exacto conservado en disco")
    diskCheck(Save.writeOptions({volume=.3,muted=true}),"Escribir opciones reales")
    diskCheck(Save.readOptions().muted==true and Save.readOptions().volume==.3,"Opciones reales en disco")
    local expedition=Save.newSession()
    expedition.day,expedition.checkpoint=3,"day3_forest"
    expedition.decisions.companion,expedition.decisions.day3_companion="roxy","eris"
    expedition.relationships.eris.trust=4
    assert(Progression.choose(expedition,"day3_forest","share_guard"))
    assert(Progression.next(expedition)=="day3_illusion")
    assert(Progression.next(expedition)=="day3_encounter")
    expedition.encounter=Cards.new(expedition.deck,{kind="magic",character="eris"},function(n) return n end)
    assert(Cards.play(expedition.encounter,1))

    local reloaded=assert(Save.load())
    diskCheck(reloaded.checkpoint=="day3_encounter" and reloaded.day==3,"Restaurar día y encuentro nuevos desde disco")
    diskCheck(Json.encode(reloaded.encounter)==Json.encode(expedition.encounter),"Pilas y acción exactas del día tres en disco")
    diskCheck(Json.encode(reloaded.relationships)==Json.encode(expedition.relationships)
        and Json.encode(reloaded.decisions)==Json.encode(expedition.decisions),"Decisiones, compañías y vínculos nuevos en disco")
    print("Filesystem: "..diskChecks.." checks passed in isolated test identity.")
    local old={write=Save.write,load=Save.load,exists=Save.exists,readOptions=Save.readOptions,writeOptions=Save.writeOptions}
    local stored
    Save.write=function(session) stored=assert(Json.encode(assert(Save.validate(session)))); return true end
    Save.load=function() return stored and Save.validate(assert(Json.decode(stored))) or nil end
    Save.exists=function() return stored~=nil end
    Save.readOptions=function() return {volume=.6,muted=false} end
    Save.writeOptions=function() return true end
    local App=require("src.app")
    local app=App.new()
    local count=0
    local function check(ok,msg) count=count+1; assert(ok,msg) end
    local function render(name)
        app:update(1.6)
        -- A dialogue exit can start the next transition during update(). Finish
        -- that curtain before sending the next user action, not its narrative.
        if app.manager.transition>0 then app:update(app.manager.transition) end
        app:draw()
        if name then
            local data=app.canvas:newImageData():encode("png")
            local file=assert(io.open(love.filesystem.getSource().."/tests/artifacts/"..name..".png","wb"))
            file:write(data:getString()); file:close()
        end
    end
    local function captureCanvas(target,name)
        local data=target:newImageData():encode("png")
        local file=assert(io.open(love.filesystem.getSource().."/tests/artifacts/"..name..".png","wb"))
        file:write(data:getString()); file:close()
    end
    local function clickLabel(label)
        render()
        for _,b in ipairs(app.manager.current.buttons) do
            if b.label==label then
                app:mousepressed(app.offsetX+(b.x+b.w/2)*app.scale,app.offsetY+(b.y+b.h/2)*app.scale,1)
                return
            end
        end
        error("No se encontró el botón "..label)
    end
    render("01-menu")
    clickLabel("Nueva partida")
    check(app.session.checkpoint=="intro","Nueva partida desde menú")
    render("02-dialogue")
    local s=app.manager.current
    s.visible=0; s.elapsed=0
    app:keypressed(Controls.advance[1])
    check(s.dialogue.index==1,"Primera pulsación revela sin saltar")
    app:keypressed(Controls.advance[1])
    check(s.dialogue.index==2,"Segunda pulsación avanza una línea")
    local steps=0
    local captured={}
    while app.session.checkpoint~="phase_complete" do
        steps=steps+1
        assert(steps<250,"Posible bloqueo de progresión")
        render()
        s=app.manager.current
        local cp=app.session.checkpoint
        if cp=="phase_complete" then break end -- La salida animada acaba durante render().
        if Story.scenes[cp] then
            s.elapsed=100; s.visible=10000
            if s.dialogue:isLast() and s.scene.choices then
                render()
                clickLabel(s.scene.choices[1].label)
            else app:keypressed(Controls.advance[1]) end
        elseif Story.encounters[cp] then
            if not captured[cp] then
                render(cp=="day1_tutorial" and "03-cards" or nil)
                captured[cp]=true
            end
            local instruction=s.tutorial and s.enc.type~="combat" and Tutorial.instruction(s.tutorial)
            if s.enc.type=="combat" then
                require("tests.combat_visual").drive(s)
            elseif s.enc.finished then
                s:finish()
            elseif instruction and instruction.button then
                local stage=s.tutorial.stage
                clickLabel(instruction.button)
                check(s.tutorial.stage~=stage,"La guía avanza por su botón de instrucción")
            elseif s.phase=="result" then
                app:keypressed("return")
                check(s.phase=="hand","El jugador confirma el resultado antes de otra decisión")
            else
                local idx
                for i in ipairs(s.enc.hand) do if Cards.canPlay(s.enc,i) then idx=i; break end end
                local turn=s.enc.turn
                if s.tutorial and s.tutorial.stage=="free" then
                    app:keypressed("p")
                elseif idx then
                    app:keypressed(tostring(idx))
                    check(s.enc.turn==turn and s.confirmReady,"Seleccionar enseña la vista previa sin consumir turno")
                    app:keypressed("return")
                else app:keypressed("p") end
                check(s.enc.turn==turn+1,"La confirmación aplica exactamente una acción")
                local before=assert(Json.encode(s.enc))
                local tutorialBefore=Json.encode(app.session.tutorial)
                app:overlay("journal"); render()
                app:resume(); render()
                check(Json.encode(app.session.encounter)==before,"Pausa conserva mano, energía y descarte exactos")
                check(Json.encode(app.session.tutorial)==tutorialBefore,"Pausa conserva el paso interactivo de la guía")
                -- La carga normaliza el contexto según la definición narrativa.
                app:continueGame(); render()
                check(Json.encode(app.session.encounter)==before,"Continuar conserva encuentro exacto")
                check(Json.encode(app.session.tutorial)==tutorialBefore,"Continuar conserva la instrucción pendiente")
            end
        elseif cp=="hub" then
            if not captured.hub then render("04-hub"); captured.hub=true end
            local all=true
            for _,place in ipairs(Story.locations) do
                if not app.session.events["meeting_"..place.character] then all=false; break end
            end
            clickLabel(all and "Elegir compañía" or "Visitar")
        else error("Pantalla sin manejador: "..cp) end
    end
    check(app.session.events.seal_memory,"Recorrido completo recupera sello")
    check(app.session.events.tutorial_completed and app.options.tutorialCompleted,"Práctica completada mediante sus acciones reales")
    check(app.session.route==nil,"No hay romance automático")
    render("05-complete")
    app:overlay("journal"); render("06-journal")
    app:overlay("deck"); render("07-deck")
    app:overlay("options"); render("08-options")
    app:overlay("pause"); render()
    local dimensions=love.graphics.getDimensions
    love.graphics.getDimensions=function() return 1600,900 end
    app:resize()
    check(app.scale==2 and app.offsetX==160 and app.offsetY==90,"Escala entera centrada sin deformar")
    check(app:logical(159,90)==nil and app:logical(1440,90)==nil,"Bandas rechazan clics")
    local lx,ly=app:logical(360,290)
    check(lx==100 and ly==100,"Ratón usa la transformación inversa")
    love.graphics.getDimensions=dimensions
    app:resize()
    -- Comprobar también la ventana real, además de la transformación aislada.
    local originalWidth,originalHeight,originalFlags=love.window.getMode()
    for _,size in ipairs({{640,360},{960,540},{1280,720}}) do
        check(love.window.setMode(size[1],size[2],{resizable=true,minwidth=640,minheight=360}),"Cambiar resolución real")
        app:resize()
        local w,h=love.graphics.getDimensions()
        check(app.scale==math.max(1,math.floor(math.min(w/640,h/360))),"Escala entera en ventana real")
        local x,y=app:logical(app.offsetX+320*app.scale,app.offsetY+180*app.scale)
        check(x==320 and y==180,"Mouse centrado en ventana real")
        render()
    end
    app:keypressed("f11")
    check(love.window.getFullscreen(),"F11 activa pantalla completa real")
    check(app.scale>=1 and app.scale%1==0,"Pantalla completa conserva escala entera")
    render()
    app:keypressed("f11")
    check(not love.window.getFullscreen(),"F11 vuelve a ventana")
    check(love.window.setMode(originalWidth,originalHeight,originalFlags),"Restaurar ventana tras pruebas")
    app:resize()
    for id,scene in pairs(Story.scenes) do
        local resolved=require("src.systems.progression").scene(app.session,id)
        for _,line in ipairs(resolved.lines) do
            check(Font.height(line.text,572,1)<=66,"Diálogo cabe en caja: "..id)
        end
        if scene.choices then
            for _,choice in ipairs(scene.choices) do check(Font.height(choice.label,419,1)<=22,"Elección cabe: "..id) end
        end
    end
    -- Galerías de QA: todas las expresiones y cartas, incluidos capítulos futuros.
    love.graphics.push("all")
    local gallery=love.graphics.newCanvas(640,360)
    love.graphics.setCanvas(gallery); love.graphics.origin(); love.graphics.clear(.1,.15,.23,1)
    local Characters=require("src.data.characters")

        local x=14+(i-1)*89
        Font.draw(character.shortName,x,10,{maxWidth=84,align="center"})

            Font.draw(expression,x,96+(j-1)*80,{maxWidth=84,align="center"})
        end

    love.graphics.setCanvas(); captureCanvas(gallery,"09-characters")
    gallery=love.graphics.newCanvas(716,290)

    for i,card in ipairs(require("src.data.cards").list) do

    require("tests.combat_visual").run(app)
````

## tests/manual_deck.lua

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/tests/manual_deck.lua`

````lua
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    local Collection=require("src.screens.collection")
    local Manual=require("src.screens.manual")
    local Guide=require("src.data.manual")
    local Data=require("src.data.cards")
    local Assets=require("src.data.assets")
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local Font=require("src.ui.font")
    local checks=0
    local function check(ok,message) assert(ok,message); checks=checks+1 end
    local session=Save.newSession()
    session.unlocked.self_joke=true; session.unlocked.remember=true
    local original=assert(Json.encode(session))
    check(Collection.canEdit(session),"Deck is editable at a safe checkpoint")
    local draft=assert(Collection.replace(session.deck,1,"remember",session.unlocked))
    check(#draft==10 and draft[1]=="remember" and session.deck[1]=="listen","Replacement produces a ten-card draft without changing campaign")
    check(not Collection.replace(draft,2,"remember",session.unlocked),"Duplicate equip is rejected")
    check(not Collection.replace(draft,2,"combined_spell",session.unlocked),"Locked route card is rejected")
    check(not Collection.replace(draft,0,"self_joke",session.unlocked),"Invalid slot is rejected")
    check(not Collection.replace(draft,1.5,"self_joke",session.unlocked),"Fractional slot is rejected")
    check(Collection.validatePlayableDeck(session.deck,session.unlocked),"Starter deck can reach all implemented social goals")
    check(Collection.validatePlayableDeck(draft,session.unlocked),"Earned-card replacement remains socially viable")
    local allUnlocked={}; for _,card in ipairs(Data.list) do allUnlocked[card.id]=true end
    local unsuitable={"listen","encourage","remember","light_joke","change_subject","self_joke","share_fear","earth_barrier","shared_magic","sword_magic"}
    local valid,reason=Collection.validatePlayableDeck(unsuitable,allUnlocked)
    check(not valid and reason:find("Roxy",1,true),"Reject structurally valid deck unable to meet Roxy's goal")
    check(Collection.bestSocialScore(unsuitable,{kind="investigation",character="roxy"})==3,"Maximum respects route requirements and actual investigation bonuses")
    local repaired=assert(Collection.replace(unsuitable,10,"analyze_runes",allUnlocked))
    check(Collection.validatePlayableDeck(repaired,allUnlocked),"Adding an investigation card repairs the otherwise impossible deck")
    local writes,returns=0,0
    local app={session=session,resources=require("src.systems.resources").new():preload(),
        mouse=function() return nil,nil end,audio={effect=function() end},
        save=function() writes=writes+1; return true end,
        resume=function() returns=returns+1 end}
    local screen=Collection.new(app)
    screen:draw(); screen:keypressed("e")
    check(screen.editing,"Keyboard opens real deck editor")
    check(screen:selectSlot(1) and screen:selectCandidate(3),"Choose equipped slot and unlocked replacement")
    check(screen:replaceSelected() and screen.draft[1]=="remember","Replacement updates draft")
    check(Json.encode(session)==original and writes==0,"Draft does not save or modify campaign")
    screen:keypressed("escape")
    check(not screen.editing and session.deck[1]=="listen","Cancel keeps original deck")
    screen:startEditing(); screen:selectCandidate(3); screen:replaceSelected()
    check(screen:saveDeck() and writes==1 and session.deck[1]=="remember","Explicit save applies replacement once")
    check(not screen:saveDeck() and writes==1,"Repeated save activation cannot save twice")
    local validated=assert(Save.validate(session))
    check(validated.deck[1]=="remember" and #validated.deck==10,"Custom deck survives validated save migration")
    screen:startEditing(); screen:selectCandidate(1); screen:replaceSelected()
    app.save=function() return false end
    check(not screen:saveDeck() and session.deck[1]=="remember","Failed storage preserves equipped deck")
    screen:cancelEditing()
    local previousUnlocks=session.unlocked
    session.unlocked=allUnlocked
    screen:startEditing(); screen.draft=unsuitable
    local beforeRefusal=Json.encode(session.deck)
    check(not screen:saveDeck() and Json.encode(session.deck)==beforeRefusal,"Saving an impossible deck preserves the equipped deck")
    check(screen.message:find("Roxy",1,true),"Editor explains which social encounter is not viable")
    screen:cancelEditing(); session.unlocked=previousUnlocks
    session.encounter={finished=false}
    local ok,reason=screen:startEditing()
    check(not ok and reason:find("Termina",1,true),"Social encounter prevents mid-hand deck changes")
    session.encounter=nil; session.combat={finished=false}
    check(not screen:startEditing(),"Combat prevents mid-hand deck changes")
    session.combat=nil
    screen:startEditing(); screen:draw()
    for _,button in ipairs(screen.buttons) do
        check(button.x>=0 and button.y>=0 and button.x+button.w<=640 and button.y+button.h<=360,"Editor buttons are inside the logical canvas")
    end
    local candidate=screen.candidate
    screen:keypressed("right")
    check(screen.candidate~=candidate,"Keyboard reaches replacement cards")
    screen:draw()
    local candidateButton=screen.buttons[12]
    screen:mousepressed(candidateButton.x+2,candidateButton.y+2,1)
    check(screen.candidate==2,"Mouse selects a replacement card without applying it")
    screen:keypressed("escape")
    local manual=Manual.new(app,function() returns=returns+1 end)
    check(#Guide.scenarios==8 and Manual.pageCount(1)==7 and Manual.pageCount(2)==16,"Manual contains seven characters, sixteen cards and eight unique scenarios")
    local seen={}
    for _,scene in ipairs(Guide.scenarios) do
        local path=Assets.backgrounds[scene.id]
        check(path and not seen[path],"Each scenario uses a different existing PNG")
        seen[path]=true
    end
    local savedSession=assert(Json.encode(session))
    local originalDraw=Font.draw
    local success,err=xpcall(function()
        Font.draw=function(text,x,y,opts)
            opts=opts or {}
            check(y+Font.height(text,opts.maxWidth,opts.scale)<=360,"Manual/editor text stays vertically inside the canvas")
            if opts.maxWidth then check(x+opts.maxWidth<=640,"Manual/editor text stays horizontally inside the canvas") end
            return originalDraw(text,x,y,opts)
        end
        for section=1,5 do
            manual:changeSection(section)
            for page=1,Manual.pageCount(section) do
                manual.page=page; manual:draw()
                check(#manual.buttons==8,"All manual pages retain section and page navigation")
            end
        end
        screen:startEditing()
        for i=1,#Data.list do screen:selectCandidate(i); screen:draw() end
        screen:cancelEditing()
    end,debug.traceback)
    Font.draw=originalDraw
    assert(success,err)
    manual:keypressed("2"); check(manual.section==2 and manual.page==1,"Number key opens card catalogue")
    manual:keypressed("left"); check(manual.page==16,"Catalogue navigation wraps")
    manual:keypressed("right"); check(manual.page==1,"Catalogue navigation returns")
    manual:draw()
    local categories=manual.buttons[4]
    manual:mousepressed(categories.x+2,categories.y+2,1)
    check(manual.section==3,"Mouse selects manual categories")
    manual:keypressed("escape")
    check(returns==1 and Json.encode(session)==savedSession,"Manual exits through callback without modifying campaign")
    print("Manual/deck: "..checks.." checks passed (catalogue, editing, persistence, keyboard and mouse).")
    return checks
````

````lua
-- Ventana de revisión reproducible. Solo se activa con --qa-dialogue y usa
-- una identidad separada; F6 cambia a otro estado de prueba independiente.
local Review={}
function Review.new()
    love.filesystem.setIdentity("cartas_del_destino_manual_review")
    local App=require("src.app")
    local Fixtures=require("tests.dialogue_branching")
    local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
    local Resolver=require("src.systems.dialogue_resolver")
    local Options=require("src.systems.options")
    local Events=require("src.systems.events")
    local cases={
        {"encounter_eris","light_joke"},{"encounter_eris","encourage"},{"encounter_eris","subtle_flirt"},
        {"encounter_roxy","listen"},{"encounter_roxy","light_joke"},{"encounter_roxy","be_honest"},
        {"encounter_sylphiette","encourage"},{"day5_mission_sylphiette","listen","kept"},{"day5_mission_sylphiette","listen","broken"},
        {"encounter_eris",nil,nil,13},{"encounter_eris",nil,nil,29},
        {"encounter_eris",nil,nil,51},{"encounter_eris",nil,nil,83},
        {"day1_tutorial",nil},{"day5_battle_sylphiette",nil},
    }
    local app=App.new(); app.qaCase=0
    app.options=Options.normalize({muted=true,textAnimation=false,reducedMotion=false})
    function app:qaNext()
        self.qaCase=self.qaCase%#cases+1
        local case=cases[self.qaCase]
        local session,def=Fixtures.fixture(case[1])
        if case[3] then
            session.decisions.family_time_outcome=case[3]
            session.events.sylphiette_promised_family_time=true
            session.relationships.sylphiette.promises.family_time=case[3]
        end
        if case[4] then
            session.encounter=Cards.new(session.deck,Resolver.context(session,def),Fixtures.rng(case[4]))
        elseif case[2] then
            for i,id in ipairs(session.deck) do if id==case[2] then table.remove(session.deck,i);break end end
            session.deck[#session.deck+1]=case[2]
            session.encounter=Cards.new(session.deck,Resolver.context(session,def),function(n)return n end)
        else
            Events.apply(session,"qa_fragment",{externalEnergy=20,unlock={"heal","water_projectile","earth_wall"}})
            session.combatDeck={"staff_strike","push","coordinated_attack","heal","earth_wall","water_projectile"}
        end
        session.rewardQueue={}; self.session=session
        self:resume(); self:notify("QA "..self.qaCase.."/"..#cases.." · F6 / clic derecho: siguiente caso")
    end
    app:qaNext()
    return app
end
return Review
````

````lua
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    local R=require("src.systems.relationships")
    local Events=require("src.systems.events")
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")

        check(Events.apply(s,"mission_"..id,{character=id,love=12,trust=12,relationshipEvent="personal_resolution",
            sharedMoment="investigation",critical={id="commitment",value=true},promise={id="return",status="pending"}}),"Misión personal "..id)

    end

    for _,id in ipairs(names) do

        check(s.relationships[id].marriageState=="married","Estado matrimonial inicial")
    end

    local preview=R.preview(custom,"roxy",{love=10,trust=-10})
    check(preview.love==0 and preview.trust==0 and custom.roxy.love==100,"Vista previa respeta límites sin mutar")
    R.apply(custom,"roxy",{love=0/0,trust=math.huge})
    check(custom.roxy.love==100 and custom.roxy.trust==0,"Deltas no finitos ignorados")
    check(Events.apply(s,"starter_test",{starter=true,presenter="nanahoshi"}),"Entrega del mazo inicial")

    check(Events.apply(s,"shared_duty",{batch={{character="sylphiette",love=2,trust=3},
        {character="roxy",love=4,trust=2},{character="eris",love=3,trust=4}},familyEvent="shared_duty"}),"Efectos familiares en lote")
    check(s.relationships.sylphiette.love==67 and s.relationships.roxy.trust==67 and s.relationships.eris.love==68,"Cada esposa recibe su cambio contextual")
    before=Json.encode(s)
    for _=1,20 do check(not Events.apply(s,"shared_duty",{character="eris",love=10,trust=10}),"Repetición no acumula amor") end
    check(Json.encode(s)==before,"Ni historial ni estadísticas se duplican")
    local ok=Events.apply(s,"invalid_batch",{batch={{character="roxy",love=5},{unlock={"nonexistent_card"}}}})
    check(not ok and Json.encode(s)==before,"Lote inválido no aplica un efecto parcial")
    s=round(s)
    check(s.relationships.roxy.love==69 and s.familyEvents.shared_duty,"Persistencia del estado familiar")
    check(#s.journal==5 and #s.rewardQueue==1 and #s.relationships.roxy.history==1,"Historial familiar detallado y animación pendiente sobreviven carga")
    check(s.journal[4].character=="roxy" and s.journal[4].love==4 and s.journal[4].trust==2,"Diario registra los efectos de cada esposa en lotes")

    for _,survivor in ipairs(names) do

                Events.apply(single,"neglect2_"..id,{character=id,love=-15,trust=-15,critical={id="commitment",value=false}})
                Events.apply(single,"farewell_"..id,{character=id,marriageState="separated"})

    end
    local solitary=Save.newSession()
    for _,id in ipairs(names) do
        Events.apply(solitary,"neglect_"..id,{character=id,love=-35,trust=-35,conflict="neglect",critical={id="commitment",value=false}})
        Events.apply(solitary,"separation_"..id,{character=id,marriageState="separated"})
    end

    Events.apply(pair,"explicit_parting",{character="eris",marriageState="separated",decision="residence",value="roxy"})
    check(R.ending(pair.relationships)=="roxy","Acuerdo explícito resuelve la pareja sin elegir un máximo")
    local low=Save.newSession()
    for _,id in ipairs(names) do Events.apply(low,"personal_"..id,{character=id,relationshipEvent="personal_resolution"}) end
    check(R.ending(low.relationships)~="family_united","Eventos sin compromiso explícito no otorgan automáticamente unión")
    local malformed=Save.newSession()
    malformed.relationships.roxy.love=1000; malformed.relationships.eris.trust=-1
    malformed.relationships.sylphiette.love=0/0
    local sanitized=assert(Save.validate(malformed))
    check(sanitized.relationships.roxy.love==100 and sanitized.relationships.eris.trust==0 and sanitized.relationships.sylphiette.love==65,"Carga sanea estadísticas")
    check(Save.validate({version=1,checkpoint="intro"})==nil,"No convierte vínculos v1 en matrimonios silenciosamente")
    check(Save.validate({version=999})==nil,"Versión futura rechazada")
    local damaged=Save.newSession()
    damaged.checkpoint="day1_tutorial"; damaged.events.starter_gift=true
    damaged=assert(Save.validate(damaged))
    check(#damaged.deck==5 and #damaged.combatDeck==5 and #damaged.rewardQueue==0,"Recupera mazos de una entrega ganada sin duplicar premio")
    local missingGift=Save.newSession()
    missingGift.checkpoint="day1_tutorial"; missingGift.decisions.important="remember"
    missingGift=assert(Save.validate(missingGift))
    check(missingGift.checkpoint~="day1_tutorial" and missingGift.decisions.important=="remember" and next(missingGift.unlocked)==nil,"Corrupción sin entrega vuelve al tutorial conservando decisiones y sin inventar cartas")
    local oldLove=love
    local files={}
    local legacy=assert(Json.encode({version=1,day=3,checkpoint="day3_complete",unlocked={listen=true,remember=true,nonexistent=true},options={volume=.35}}))
    files[Save.legacyFilename]=legacy
    love={filesystem={getInfo=function(path) return files[path] and {size=#files[path]} end,
        read=function(path) return files[path] end,write=function(path,data) files[path]=data; return true end,
        remove=function(path) files[path]=nil; return true end}}
    local tested,err=pcall(function()
        check(Save.legacyInfo().day==3 and not Save.exists(),"Menú distingue guardado legado de campaña nueva")
        check(Save.migrateLegacy(false)==nil,"Cambio de continuidad exige aceptación explícita")
        local imported=assert(Save.migrateLegacy(true))
        check(imported.day==1 and imported.relationships.roxy.love==65 and imported.migration.acceptedContinuity,"Importación comienza nueva historia conocida")
        check(imported.unlocked.remember and not imported.unlocked.nonexistent and imported.options.volume==.35,"Importa colección compatible y configuración")
        check(Save.write(imported),"Escribir migración en archivo separado")
        check(files[Save.legacyFilename]==legacy and files[Save.filename]~=nil,"No sobrescribe el guardado original")
        local loaded=assert(Save.load())
        check(loaded.migration.previousDay==3 and loaded.unlocked.remember,"Metadatos y cartas importados sobreviven")
        check(Save.write(family),"Crear segundo guardado con copia de respaldo")
        files[Save.filename]="{broken"
        local restored,message=Save.load()
        check(restored and restored.migration and message~=nil,"Guardado corrupto recupera respaldo")
        files[Save.backup]=nil
        check(Save.load()==nil,"Corrupción sin respaldo no inventa progreso")
        love.filesystem.write=function() return false,"sin espacio" end
        check(not Save.write(family),"Fallo de escritura se informa")
    end)
    love=oldLove
    assert(tested,err)
    print("Marriages/save v3: "..checked.." checks passed (five endings, decisions, promises, rewards and explicit migration).")
    return checked
end
````

````lua
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    local Animation=require("src.systems.animation")
    local Typewriter=require("src.systems.typewriter")
    local Manager=require("src.core.state_manager")
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local DialogueScreen=require("src.screens.dialogue")
    local utf8=require("utf8")
    local checks=0
    local function check(ok,message) assert(ok,message); checks=checks+1 end
    local function near(a,b) return math.abs(a-b)<.000001 end

    local calls=0
    local tween=Animation.tween({x=3,y=20},{x=100,y=4},.4,{easing="linear",onComplete=function() calls=calls+1 end})
    tween:update(.2)
    check(near(tween.value.x,51.5) and near(tween.value.y,12),"Tween interpola ambas coordenadas")
    check(not tween.done and calls==0,"Tween no termina antes de tiempo")
    tween:update(10)
    check(tween.done and tween.value.x==100 and tween.value.y==4,"Tween termina con valores exactos tras dt grande")
    tween:update(10); tween:finish()
    check(calls==1,"Callback de animación ocurre una sola vez")
    local reduced=Animation.tween({x=0},{x=8},.4,{reducedMotion=true})
    reduced:update(0)
    check(reduced.done and reduced.value.x==8,"Movimiento reducido omite desplazamiento de cartas")
    for name in pairs(Animation.actorNames) do
        local actor=Animation.actor(name)
        actor:update(.1)
        check(actor.value.alpha>=0 and actor.value.alpha<=1,"Alfa de personaje acotada: "..name)
        actor:update(10)
        check(actor.done,"Animación de personaje finita: "..name)
        local x,y,alpha=actor.value.x,actor.value.y,actor.value.alpha
        actor:update(.1)
        check(x==actor.value.x and y==actor.value.y and alpha==actor.value.alpha,"Personaje quieto tras terminar: "..name)
        local still=Animation.actor(name,{reducedMotion=true})
        check(still.done and still.value.x==0 and still.value.y==0,"Personaje sin movimiento por accesibilidad: "..name)
    end

    local text="¡Sí, Rudy! Química, corazón, pingüino y ñ."
    local writer=Typewriter.new(text,{textSpeed=10})
    for i=0,utf8.len(text) do
        local slice=Typewriter.slice(text,i)
        check(utf8.len(slice)==i,"El texto progresivo no corta un punto UTF-8: "..i)
        check(text:sub(1,#slice)==slice,"El fragmento preserva tildes: "..i)
    end
    writer:update(.35)
    check(writer.visible==3 and writer:shown()=="¡Sí","Velocidad configurable cuenta caracteres")
    writer:showAll()
    check(writer:isComplete() and writer:shown()==text,"Primera pulsación puede revelar toda la línea")
    writer:update(0)
    check(writer:shown()==text,"Revelar no se revierte en la siguiente actualización")
    writer:setText("Otra línea",{textAnimation=false,textSpeed=1})
    check(writer:isComplete() and writer:shown()=="Otra línea","Texto sin animación disponible desde el inicio")

    local app={options={}}
    local manager=Manager.new(app)
    local entered,presses,updates=0,0,0
    local first={enter=function() entered=entered+1 end,keypressed=function() presses=presses+1 end,
        mousepressed=function() presses=presses+1 end,update=function(_,dt) updates=updates+dt end}
    local second={enter=function() entered=entered+1 end}
    check(manager:switch(first,{type="fade",duration=.4}),"Solicitar transición acepta escena inicial")
    check(manager.current==first and entered==1,"Escena activa exactamente una vez")
    check(not manager:switch(second),"No permite transiciones simultáneas")
    manager:keypressed("return"); manager:mousepressed(1,1,1)
    check(presses==0,"Entrada bloqueada durante transición")
    manager:update(.2)
    check(updates==0,"No consume texto mientras se oculta por el fundido")
    manager:update(.3)
    check(manager.transition==0 and near(updates,.1),"Transición finaliza y entrega el tiempo restante")
    manager:keypressed("return"); manager:mousepressed(1,1,1)
    check(presses==2 and entered==1,"Entrada restaurada sin reactivar escena")
    for kind in pairs(Manager.transitionTypes) do
        check(manager:switch({enter=function() entered=entered+1 end},{type=kind,duration=.3}),"Transición declarativa: "..kind)
        manager:update(1)
        check(manager.transition==0,"Transición declarativa finita: "..kind)
    end
    app.options.reducedMotion=true
    manager:switch(second,{type="horizontal",duration=.6})
    check(manager.effect.type=="fade" and manager.duration<=.15,"Movimiento reducido reemplaza barrido por fundido corto")
    manager:finishTransition()
    check(not manager:switch(second),"No reactiva la misma instancia de escena")

    local saved,advanced=0,0
    local dialogApp={session=Save.newSession(),options={textSpeed=20,textAnimation=true},
        save=function() saved=saved+1 end,next=function() advanced=advanced+1 end}
    local screen=DialogueScreen.new(dialogApp)
    screen:advance()
    check(screen.dialogue.index==1 and screen:ready(),"Primera pulsación solo revela texto")
    screen:advance()
    check(screen.dialogue.index==2 and not screen:ready() and saved==1,"Segunda pulsación avanza una sola línea")
    local pose=screen.actor.value
    check(pose.alpha==1 and screen.actor.kind=="sad_lower","Rudy ya está en escena y reacciona con preocupación")
    screen:update(1)
    check(screen.actor.done and screen.actor.value.alpha==1,"Entrada de personaje termina")
    screen.dialogue.index=#screen.scene.lines
    screen.writer=Typewriter.new(screen:fullText(),{textAnimation=false})
    screen.visible=screen.writer.length
    screen:advance(); screen:advance()
    check(screen.leaving and advanced==0,"Salida del personaje bloquea la doble pulsación")
    screen:update(.2); screen:update(.2)
    check(advanced==1,"Salida activa el siguiente checkpoint una sola vez")
    print("Motion: "..checks.." checks passed (finite animation, UTF-8, transitions and reduced motion).")
    return checks
end
return Suite
````

## tests/phase2_integration.lua

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/tests/phase2_integration.lua`

````lua
-- Continúa el recorrido real de Fase 1 y vuelve a abrir su guardado de día dos.
local Suite={}
function Suite.run(app)
    local Chapters=require("src.data.chapters")
    local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
    local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local checks,totalSteps=0,0
    local function check(ok,message) assert(ok,message); checks=checks+1 end
    local function encode(value) return assert(Json.encode(value)) end
    local function render(name)
        app:update(1.6)
        if app.manager.transition>0 then app:update(app.manager.transition) end
        app:draw()
        if name then
            local bytes=app.canvas:newImageData():encode("png")
            local file=assert(io.open(love.filesystem.getSource().."/tests/artifacts/"..name..".png","wb"))
            file:write(bytes:getString()); file:close()
        end
    end
    local function click(label,occurrence)
        render()
        occurrence=occurrence or 1
        for _,button in ipairs(app.manager.current.buttons) do
            if button.label==label then
                occurrence=occurrence-1
                if occurrence==0 then
                    app:mousepressed(app.offsetX+(button.x+button.w/2)*app.scale,
                        app.offsetY+(button.y+button.h/2)*app.scale,1)
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        error("Botón no encontrado: "..label)
    end
    check(app.session.checkpoint=="phase_complete","Recorrido original llega al cierre del día dos")
    local legacy=encode(app.session)
    local originalCompanion=app.session.decisions.companion
    local captureNames={day3_intro="11-day3-intro",day3_forest="13-day3-forest",day3_illusion="14-day3-illusion",
        day3_result="16-day3-result",day3_truth="17-day3-truth",day3_return="18-day3-return"}
    local function playDay(companion,index,reload,onlyPass)
        if reload then
            local old=assert(Save.validate(assert(Json.decode(legacy))))
            assert(Save.write(old))
            app.session=nil; app:menu()
            click("Continuar")
            check(app.session.checkpoint=="phase_complete","Continuar un guardado anterior conserva su checkpoint")
        else app:resume() end
        local relationships=encode(app.session.relationships)
        click("Continuar al Día 3")
        check(app.session.checkpoint=="day3_intro" and app.session.day==3,"Resumen permite iniciar Día 3")
        check(encode(app.session.relationships)==relationships,"Continuar no repite premios del día dos")
        local steps,captured=0,{}
        while app.session.checkpoint~="day3_complete" do
            steps=steps+1
            assert(steps<110,"Bloqueo del recorrido gráfico del día tres")
            render()
            local cp=app.session.checkpoint
            if cp=="day3_complete" then break end -- La última salida animada acaba aquí.
            local node=assert(Chapters.get(cp))
            local screen=app.manager.current
            if node.kind=="scene" then
                screen.elapsed,screen.visible=100,10000
                local speaker=screen.dialogue:current().speaker
                local target=(cp=="day3_intro" or cp=="day3_return") and "nanahoshi"
                    or (cp=="day3_truth" and "rudeus" or companion)
                if captureNames[cp] and speaker==target and not captured[cp] then
                    render(captureNames[cp].."-"..companion); captured[cp]=true
                end
                if screen.dialogue:isLast() and screen.scene.choices then
                    render("13b-day3-choice-"..companion)
                    click(screen.scene.choices[reload and 2 or 1].label)
                else app:keypressed("return") end
            elseif node.kind=="hub" then
                render("12-day3-companion-"..companion)
                click("Elegir compañía",index)
                check(app.session.decisions.day3_companion==companion,"Elegir nueva compañía mediante mouse")
                check(app.session.decisions.companion==originalCompanion,"Mantener compañero histórico del día dos")
                check(app.session.route==nil,"Elegir compañía no fija una ruta romántica")
            elseif node.kind=="encounter" then
                if not captured[cp] then render("15-day3-cards-"..companion); captured[cp]=true end
                if screen.enc.type=="combat" then require("tests.combat_visual").drive(screen)
                elseif screen.enc.finished then app:keypressed("return")
                elseif screen.phase=="result" then
                    app:keypressed("return")
                    check(screen.phase=="hand","Confirmar resultado devuelve el control de la mano")
                else
                    local chosen
                    if not onlyPass then
                        for i in ipairs(screen.enc.hand) do if Cards.canPlay(screen.enc,i) then chosen=i; break end end
                    end
                    local turn=screen.enc.turn
                    if chosen then
                        app:keypressed(tostring(chosen))
                        check(screen.enc.turn==turn and screen.confirmReady,"Tecla numérica consulta sin jugar automáticamente")
                        app:keypressed("return")
                    else app:keypressed("p") end
                    check(screen.enc.turn==turn+1,"Cada confirmación o respiro consume exactamente un turno")
                    local before=encode(app.session.encounter)
                    app:overlay("pause"); render(); click("Volver a la historia"); render()
                    check(encode(app.session.encounter)==before,"Pausa restaura el encuentro del día tres")
                    app:continueGame(); render()
                    check(encode(app.session.encounter)==before,"Carga restaura el encuentro del día tres")
                end
            else error("Pantalla no jugable en recorrido: "..cp) end
        end
        render("19-day3-complete-"..companion)
        check(app.session.events.seal_truth and app.session.events.day3_complete,"Día tres termina con Sello de la Verdad")
        check(not Progression.canContinue(app.session),"Resumen terminal no permite entrar al día cuatro")
        for _,button in ipairs(app.manager.current.buttons) do
            check(not button.label:find("Continuar"),"No existe botón hacia capítulo futuro")
        end
        local completed=encode(app.session)
        app:keypressed("return")
        check(encode(app.session)==completed,"Enter en resumen terminal no mueve ni repite efectos")
        app:continueGame(); render()
        check(encode(app.session)==completed,"Cargar el cierre conserva todas las decisiones y relaciones")
        if onlyPass then check(app.session.decisions.outcome_day3_encounter=="partial","Tres respiros permiten completar el resultado parcial") end
        totalSteps=totalSteps+steps
    end
    playDay("roxy",2,false,true)
    playDay("sylphiette",1,true,false)
    playDay("eris",3,true,false)
    print("Day 3 integration: "..checks.." checks passed; "..totalSteps.." screen steps across three companions.")
    return checks,totalSteps
end
return Suite
````

````lua
-- Apariencia reconstruida desde datos narrativos y guardados v3 reales.
-- Las capturas se producen con el renderer de LÖVE, sin alterar los PNG.
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    local Portraits=require("src.systems.portraits")
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local Characters=require("src.data.characters")
    local Assets=require("src.data.assets")
    local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
    local Resources=require("src.systems.resources")
    local Options=require("src.systems.options")
    local checked,captures=0,0
    local function check(value,message) assert(value,message); checked=checked+1 end
    local function encode(value) return assert(Json.encode(value)) end
    local function clone(value) return assert(Json.decode(encode(value))) end
    local function actor(presentation,id)
        for _,entry in ipairs(presentation.cast) do if entry.character==id then return entry end end
    end
    local function appearance(presentation)
        local values={background=presentation.background,cast={}}
        for _,entry in ipairs(presentation.cast) do
            values.cast[#values.cast+1]={character=entry.character,portrait=entry.portrait,
                expression=entry.expression,position=entry.position,visible=entry.visible}
        end
        return encode(values)
    end

    local session=Save.newSession()
    local intro=Progression.scene(session,"intro")
    check(intro.context=="hitogami_dream","El sueño declara el contexto; no se infiere del hablante")
    check(not Characters.byId.rudeus_japones,"La apariencia japonesa no crea una segunda identidad lógica")
    check(not session.relationships.rudeus and not session.relationships.rudeus_japones,"El protagonista no duplica estadísticas matrimoniales")
    local logicalCount=0
    for _,character in ipairs(Characters.list) do if character.id=="rudeus" then logicalCount=logicalCount+1 end end
    check(logicalCount==1,"Existe exactamente una identidad Rudy")
    local before=encode(session)
    local source=encode(intro)
    local expressions={}
    for index,line in ipairs(intro.lines) do
        local resolved=Portraits.resolve(intro,index)
        local rudy=actor(resolved,"rudeus")
        check(resolved.background=="dream","Fondo del sueño en la línea "..index)
        check(rudy and rudy.portrait=="rudeus_japones","Rudy japonés permanece incluso mientras habla otro personaje: "..index)
        expressions[rudy.expression]=true
        for _,entry in ipairs(resolved.cast) do check(Characters.byId[entry.character]~=nil,"Los actores conservan identidades registradas") end
        if line.speaker=="rudeus" and line.expression then
            check(rudy.expression==line.expression,"Expresión declarada de Rudy: "..index)
        end
        session.dialogueIndex=index
        local restored=assert(Save.validate(clone(session)))
        check(appearance(Portraits.resolve(Progression.scene(restored,restored.checkpoint),restored.dialogueIndex))==appearance(resolved),
            "JSON y validación v3 reconstruyen fondo, retratos y expresión: "..index)
    end
    session.dialogueIndex=1
    check(encode(session)==before and encode(intro)==source,"Resolver retratos no modifica la sesión ni los datos narrativos")
    check(expressions.neutral and expressions.worried and expressions.angry,"El sueño presenta neutral, preocupación y enfado")
    local future={context="hitogami_dream",lines={}}
    for _,expression in ipairs({"neutral","happy","worried","angry"}) do
        future.lines[#future.lines+1]={speaker="rudeus",expression=expression,text="Un nuevo encuentro mental."}
        check(actor(Portraits.resolve(future,#future.lines),"rudeus").expression==expression,"Contexto reutilizable conserva expresión "..expression)
    end
    check(Portraits.resolve(future,1).background=="dream" and actor(Portraits.resolve(future,1),"rudeus").portrait=="rudeus_japones",
        "Otro sueño reutiliza contexto, fondo y apariencia sin IDs de escena especiales")
    local explicit={background="home",lines={{speaker="rudeus",portrait="rudeus_japones",expression="happy",text="Apariencia explícita."}}}
    local chosen=actor(Portraits.resolve(explicit,1),"rudeus")
    check(chosen.character=="rudeus" and chosen.portrait=="rudeus_japones" and chosen.expression=="happy","speaker, portrait y expression son independientes")
    local staged={context="hitogami_dream",cast={{character="rudeus",position="left",expression="neutral"},{character="hitogami",position="right",expression="happy"}},
        lines={{speaker="hitogami",text="Escucha.",stage={rudeus={expression="angry",animation="small_shake"}}},

    check(actor(Portraits.resolve(staged,1),"rudeus").animation=="small_shake","Una línea puede animar al oyente por datos")
    check(actor(Portraits.resolve(staged,2),"rudeus").expression=="angry","La expresión del oyente se reconstruye al cargar una línea posterior")
    check(actor(Portraits.resolve(staged,2),"rudeus").animation==nil,"Reconstruir una línea posterior no repite la sacudida anterior")
    staged.lines[3]={speaker="hitogami",text="Hasta pronto.",stage={rudeus={visible=false}}}
    staged.lines[4]={speaker="rudeus",text="Todavía estoy aquí.",stage={rudeus={visible=true}}}

    local memory={background="home",lines={{speaker="hitogami",delivery="memory",text="Rudy recuerda a Hitogami."},

    invalid(function(scene) scene.context="unknown_dream" end,"contexto de apariencia desconocido")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.portraits={rudeus="missing"} end,"retrato desconocido")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.lines[1].portrait="missing" end,"retrato desconocido")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.cast[2].character=scene.cast[1].character end,"identidad duplicada")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.cast[2].position=scene.cast[1].position end,"posición duplicada")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.cast={} end,"requiere uno o dos personajes")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.cast[2].position=false end,"posición visual desconocida")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.cast[1].enterAt=0 end,"línea de entrada visual inválida")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.cast[1].enterAt=#scene.lines+1 end,"línea de entrada visual inválida")

    invalid(function(scene) scene.cast[1].entranceDelay=math.huge end,"demora de entrada visual")

    invalid(function(scene) scene.lines[1].stage={rudeus={visible="yes"}} end,"visibilidad de personaje inválida")
    invalid(function(scene) scene.entranceTransition={type="unknown"} end,"tipo de transición visual desconocido")

    local identity=love.filesystem.getIdentity()
    local originalOptions=Save.readOptions
    local originalInfo=love.filesystem.getInfo
    local originalScene=Progression.scene

    love.filesystem.setIdentity("cartas_del_destino_portraits_tests")

    local ok,err=xpcall(function()
        app=require("src.app").new()

        local function capture(name)
            app.toastTime=0; app:draw()
            local pixels=app.canvas:newImageData()
            local bytes=pixels:encode("png")

        app:update(app.manager.transition)
        app:update(.14)
        local first=app.manager.current
        check(first.actors.hitogami.value.alpha>0 and first.actors.rudeus.value.alpha==0,"Hitogami aparece antes que Rudy")
        capture("hitogami-entry")
        app:update(.28)
        check(first.actors.rudeus.value.alpha>0,"Rudy aparece después de Hitogami")

        settle()
        local relations=encode(app.session.relationships)
        local curse=encode(app.session.curse)
        for index=1,#intro.lines do

            check(app:save(),"Guardar la línea del sueño en disco: "..index)
            app:continueGame(); settle()
            check(appearance(app.manager.current.presentation)==expected,"Continuar restaura la misma composición: "..index)
            check(encode(app.session.relationships)==relations and encode(app.session.curse)==curse,"Guardar/cargar el sueño no cambia vínculos ni maldición")
            if index<#intro.lines then app:keypressed("return"); settle() end
        end
        app:keypressed("return"); app:update(.3)
        check(app.session.checkpoint=="day1_wake" and app.manager.effect.type=="dream","El sueño termina en blanco y entra en el despertar")
        white("dream-white-out")
        settle()
        local awake=app.manager.current.presentation
        check(awake.background=="home" and actor(awake,"rudeus").portrait=="rudeus","Despertar restaura casa y Rudy rubio")

            function fixture:save() return Save.write(self.session) end
            Progression.scene=function(s,id)
                if s==fixture.session then return futureScene end
                return originalScene(s,id)
            end
            local screen=require("src.screens.dialogue").new(fixture)

            return screen,fixture
        end
        local stagedScreen,fixture=futureScreen()
        stagedScreen:update(1)
        check(not actor(stagedScreen.presentation,"rudeus").visible,"Un actor con entrada posterior permanece oculto al comenzar")
        stagedScreen:advance()
        check(stagedScreen.dialogue.index==2 and stagedScreen.actors.rudeus.delay==.35,"La línea de entrada futura inicia su demora declarada")
        stagedScreen:update(.2)
        check(stagedScreen.actors.rudeus.value.alpha==0,"La entrada posterior no aparece antes de vencer la demora")
        check(fixture:save(),"Guardar durante una entrada posterior demorada")
        local restoredStage=futureScreen(assert(Save.load()))
        check(restoredStage.dialogue.index==2 and appearance(restoredStage.presentation)==appearance(stagedScreen.presentation),

        check(restoredStage.actors.rudeus.delay==.35 and restoredStage.actors.rudeus.value.alpha==0,
            "Cargar en la línea de aparición reinicia limpiamente su entrada demorada")
        stagedScreen:update(.2)
        check(stagedScreen.actors.rudeus.value.alpha>0,"La entrada futura comienza cuando termina la demora")
        stagedScreen:update(1)
        local listener=stagedScreen.actors.rudeus
        stagedScreen:advance()
        check(stagedScreen.actors.rudeus==listener and listener.done and listener.value.alpha==1,
            "Un oyente sin cambios conserva su actor y no repite la entrada al cambiar de línea")
        stagedScreen:update(1); stagedScreen:advance(); stagedScreen:update(1)
        check(not actor(stagedScreen.presentation,"rudeus").visible and stagedScreen.actors.rudeus.done,
            "La salida declarativa oculta a Rudy al terminar su animación")
        local requested={}
        local portraitLoader=fixture.resources.getPortrait
        fixture.resources.getPortrait=function(self,id)
            requested[id]=(requested[id] or 0)+1
            return portraitLoader(self,id)
        end
        local function drawStage()
            requested={}
            love.graphics.setCanvas(app.canvas); stagedScreen:draw(); love.graphics.setCanvas()
        end
        drawStage()
        check(requested.hitogami and not requested.rudeus_japones,"El renderer deja de solicitar el sprite del actor oculto")
        local departures=0
        stagedScreen:depart(function() departures=departures+1 end)
        drawStage()
        check(not requested.rudeus_japones and departures==0,"Abandonar la escena no resucita al actor oculto")
        stagedScreen:update(.04); drawStage()
        check(not requested.rudeus_japones,"El actor oculto tampoco reaparece durante el fundido de salida")
        stagedScreen:update(1); stagedScreen:update(1)
        check(departures==1,"La salida termina una sola vez aunque existan actores ya ocultos")

        -- La misma pantalla se dibuja con el recurso provisional si falta el PNG.
        love.filesystem.getInfo=function(path,...)
            if path==Assets.characters.rudeus_japones then return nil end
            return originalInfo(path,...)
        end
        app.resources=Resources.new()
        app.session=Save.newSession(); app.session.dialogueIndex=2
        app:resume(); settle(); capture("missing-png")
        check(app.resources.sources[Assets.characters.rudeus_japones].status=="fallback","El sueño se dibuja completo aun sin el PNG japonés")
        check(#app.resources.warnings==1 and app.resources.warnings[1]:find("rudeus_japones",1,true),"Diagnóstico único identifica el PNG ausente")
        love.filesystem.getInfo=originalInfo
        app.resources=Resources.new():preload()

        app.options=Options.normalize({muted=true,textAnimation=false,reducedMotion=true})
        app.session=Save.newSession(); app:resume()
        check(app.manager.effect.type=="dream" and app.manager.duration<=.15,"Movimiento reducido conserva el blanco del sueño con un fundido breve")
        white("reduced-dream-white")
        settle()
        for _,motion in pairs(app.manager.current.actors) do
            check(motion.done and motion.value.x==0 and motion.value.y==0,"Los dos retratos respetan movimiento reducido")
        end
        check(actor(app.manager.current.presentation,"rudeus").portrait=="rudeus_japones","Accesibilidad conserva apariencia y expresión")

        -- Mismo objeto Resources después de visitar el sueño: no filtra su skin al combate.
        app:startPractice("free"); settle()
        local drawn={}
        local normalPortrait=app.resources.portrait
        app.resources.portrait=function(self,id,...)
            drawn[id]=(drawn[id] or 0)+1
            return normalPortrait(self,id,...)
        end
        app:draw()
        app.resources.portrait=normalPortrait
        check(drawn.rudeus and not drawn.rudeus_japones,"El combate físico dibuja Rudy normal incluso después del sueño")
        app:endPractice()
    end,debug.traceback)
    love.filesystem.getInfo=originalInfo
    Progression.scene=originalScene
    Save.readOptions=originalOptions
    if app and app.audio then app.audio:setContext("menu") end
    love.graphics.setCanvas(); love.graphics.pop()
    love.filesystem.setIdentity(identity)
    assert(ok,err)
    print("Contextual portraits: "..checked.." checks passed; "..captures.." real-renderer captures (dream, expressions, save/load, waking, combat, fallback).")
    return checked
end
return Suite
````
