## tests/relationship_bars.lua

Ruta exacta: `C:/Users/gegdg/Documents/.UVG/Anio6/SegundoSemestre/GameEngine/DateSim/tests/relationship_bars.lua`

````lua
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    local Bars=require("src.ui.relationship_bars")
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local Font=require("src.ui.font")
    local Events=require("src.systems.events")
    local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
    local Resolver=require("src.systems.dialogue_resolver")
    local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
    local Fixtures=require("tests.dialogue_branching")
    local checks,captures=0,0
    local function check(value,message) assert(value,message); checks=checks+1 end
    local function encode(value) return assert(Json.encode(value)) end
    local function near(a,b) return math.abs(a-b)<.001 end
    local sounds={}
    local audio={effect=function(_,name) sounds[#sounds+1]=name end}
    local session=Save.newSession()
    session.relationships.eris.love,session.relationships.eris.trust=98,1
    local bars=Bars.new(session,"eris",{audio=audio})
    check(bars and bars.value.love==98 and bars.value.trust==1,"Valores iniciales matrimoniales definitivos")
    check(not Bars.new(session,"rudeus") and not Bars.new(session,"hitogami") and not Bars.new(session,"rudeus_japones"),"Sin barras ni identidad romántica para Rudy o Hitogami")
    Events.apply(session,"bars_bounds",{character="eris",love=5,trust=-5})
    local committed=encode(session)
    check(bars:apply("bars_bounds",session,{love=5,trust=-5},"Una respuesta sincera, pero brusca."),"Un evento confirmado inicia el feedback")
    check(bars.target.love==100 and bars.target.trust==0 and bars.value.love==98,"El destino lógico queda aplicado antes de animar")
    check(bars:feedback().deltas.love==2 and bars:feedback().deltas.trust==-1,"El feedback usa los deltas reales recortados")
    bars:update(.3)
    check(near(bars.value.love,99) and near(bars.value.trust,.5),"La interpolación alcanza el punto medio a 0.3 segundos")
    bars:update(.3)
    check(bars.value.love==100 and bars.value.trust==0 and bars.tween==nil,"La interpolación termina exactamente a 0.6 segundos")
    check(encode(session)==committed,"La presentación nunca escribe en el estado lógico")
    check(not bars:apply("bars_bounds",session) and #sounds==1 and sounds[1]=="negative","Un evento repetido no repite ni feedback ni sonido")
    local loaded=Bars.new(session,"eris",{audio=audio})
    check(not loaded:apply("bars_bounds",session) and loaded.notifications==0 and not loaded:feedback(),"Cargar un evento histórico no reproduce sus efectos visuales")
    check(not bars:apply("no_change",session) and #sounds==1,"Un delta cero no inventa corazones ni sonidos")
    local original=bars:layout({x=80,y=100,w=64,h=64,width=116,alpha=.5})
    local moved=bars:layout({x=85,y=94,w=64,h=64,width=116,alpha=.5})
    check(moved.x-original.x==5 and moved.y-original.y==-6 and moved.alpha==.5,"Las barras siguen posición y alfa reales del retrato")
    check(original.y+original.h==96 and original.portrait.y==100,"La placa queda por encima del rostro con cuatro píxeles de separación")
    local nana=Bars.new(session,"nanahoshi",{audio=audio,reducedMotion=true})
    check(nana.fields[1].key=="trust" and nana.fields[2].key=="interest" and nana.value.love==nil,"Nanahoshi usa confianza e interés separados del matrimonio")
    local oldNana=nana.target.interest
    session.affinities.nanahoshi.interest=oldNana+3
    nana:apply("nana_bars",session,{interest=3},"La propuesta ayuda a investigar.")
    check(nana.value.interest==oldNana+3 and nana:feedback().deltas.interest==3,"Movimiento reducido muestra el valor definitivo sin desplazamiento")
    local invalid=Save.newSession(); invalid.relationships.eris.love=0/0; invalid.relationships.eris.trust=math.huge
    local sanitized=Bars.new(invalid,"eris")
    check(sanitized.value.love==0 and sanitized.value.trust==0,"Números no finitos nunca deforman las barras")
    for id,node in pairs(require("src.data.dialogue").nodes) do
        if node.text then check(Font.height(node.text,462)<=33,"Briefing y continuación caben junto al retrato: "..id) end
    end
    for id,step in pairs(require("src.systems.tutorial").instructions) do
        check(Font.height(step.text,462)<=44,"La guía cabe en el briefing de ancho462: "..id)
    end

    local identity=love.filesystem.getIdentity()
    local originalOptions,originalFont,originalScene=Save.readOptions,Font.draw,Progression.scene
    love.filesystem.setIdentity("cartas_del_destino_relationship_ui_tests")
    Save.readOptions=function() return {muted=true,textAnimation=false,reducedMotion=false} end
    love.graphics.push("all")
    local ok,err=xpcall(function()
        local app=require("src.app").new()
        app.mouse=function() return nil,nil end
        local rendered={}
        Font.draw=function(value,...)
            rendered[#rendered+1]=tostring(value)
            return originalFont(value,...)
        end
        local function draw()
            app.toastTime=0; rendered={}; app:draw(); return table.concat(rendered,"\n")
        end
        local function capture(name)
            draw(); local pixels=app.canvas:newImageData(); local bytes=pixels:encode("png")
            local file=assert(io.open(love.filesystem.getSource().."/tests/artifacts/relationship-"..name..".png","wb"))
            file:write(bytes:getString()); file:close(); bytes:release(); pixels:release(); captures=captures+1
        end
        local function settle()
            if app.manager.transition>0 then app:update(app.manager.transition) end
            app:update(2); draw()
        end
        -- Componente dibujado por LÖVE: signos exactos y términos adecuados.
        love.graphics.setCanvas(app.canvas); rendered={}
        bars:draw({x=40,y=94,w=64,h=64,width=116})
        local signed=table.concat(rendered,"\n")
        check(signed:find("+2",1,true) and signed:find("-1",1,true),"El renderer conserva los signos del incremento y descenso reales")
        rendered={}; nana:draw({x=180,y=94,w=64,h=64,width=116})
        local affinityText=table.concat(rendered,"\n")
        check(affinityText:find("Confianza",1,true) and affinityText:find("Interés",1,true) and not affinityText:find("Amor",1,true),"El renderer de Nanahoshi no muestra amor")
        love.graphics.setCanvas()
        local function encounter(card,character)
            local checkpoint=character=="nanahoshi" and "day1_tutorial" or "encounter_eris"
            local current,definition=Fixtures.fixture(checkpoint,{"listen","be_honest","encourage","light_joke","subtle_flirt"})
            for i,id in ipairs(current.deck) do if id==card then table.remove(current.deck,i); break end end
            current.deck[#current.deck+1]=card
            local context
            if character=="nanahoshi" then
                definition.kind,definition.character="conversation","nanahoshi"
                context=Resolver.context(current,definition,"nanahoshi_test"); context.socialTutorial=true
            else context=Resolver.context(current,definition) end
            current.encounter=Cards.new(current.deck,context,function(n) return n end)
            app.session=current; app:resume(); settle()
            local screen=app.manager.current
            check(screen.enc.hand[1]==card and screen.relationshipBars.character==character,"Fixture social y barras de la interlocutora correctas")
            sounds={}; app.audio.effect=audio.effect
            -- audio.effect uses the live sounds upvalue, without playing hardware audio.
            local before=encode(app.session.relationships)
            screen:select(1); screen:act(1); app:update(.3)
            check(screen.relationshipBars.notifications==0 and encode(app.session.relationships)==before,"La carta en vuelo no anuncia ni aplica cambios")
            for _,sound in ipairs(sounds) do check(sound~="positive" and sound~="negative","Sin sonido de resultado durante la carta") end
            app:update(2)
            check(screen:responseLine().speaker=="rudeus" and screen.relationshipBars.notifications==0,"La frase de Rudy mantiene el feedback pendiente")
            local seenPortrait
            local originalPortrait=app.resources.portrait
            app.resources.portrait=function(self,id,...)
                seenPortrait=id; return originalPortrait(self,id,...)
            end
            draw(); app.resources.portrait=originalPortrait
            check(seenPortrait==character,"Durante la frase de Rudy permanece la interlocutora, no sus barras sobre Rudy")
            local box=screen.relationshipBars.lastBounds
            check(box.x>=0 and box.x+box.w<=135 and box.y>=38 and box.y+box.h<box.portrait.y,"La placa cabe entre cabecera, retrato y diálogo")
            capture(character.."-"..card.."-rudy")
            screen:acknowledge()
            local result=screen.enc.log[1]
            check(result.applied and screen.relationshipBars.notifications==1,"La reacción aplica y anuncia una vez el cambio")
            local actual=screen.relationshipBars:feedback().deltas
            check(actual.trust==result.actualTrust and (character=="nanahoshi" and actual.interest==result.actualInterest or character~="nanahoshi" and actual.love==result.actualLove),"Deltas flotantes iguales a los persistidos")
            local effects=0; for _,sound in ipairs(sounds) do if sound=="positive" or sound=="negative" then effects=effects+1 end end
            check(effects==1,"Un único sonido de resultado después de commit")
            screen:showResponse(); screen:history(); screen:history()
            check(screen.relationshipBars.notifications==1,"Reabrir historial o mostrar la reacción no duplica efectos")
            app:update(.2); capture(character.."-"..card.."-reaction")
            local bounds=screen.relationshipBars.lastBounds
            check(bounds.portrait.x==40+math.floor(screen.actor.value.x) and bounds.portrait.y==94+math.floor(screen.actor.value.y),"La barra sigue la sacudida o el salto real del retrato")
            local saved=assert(Save.load())
            check(saved.events[require("src.systems.dialogue_memory").key(screen.enc.context.sceneId,1)],"El cambio ya está guardado durante la animación")
            app:continueGame(); settle(); screen=app.manager.current
            check(screen.relationshipBars.notifications==0 and not screen.relationshipBars:feedback(),"Cargar la reacción muestra valores finales sin repetir feedback")
            local actualValues=Bars.read(app.session,character)
            for key,value in pairs(actualValues) do check(screen.relationshipBars.value[key]==value,"Valor final exacto al cargar: "..key) end
            local logicalBefore=encode({app.session.relationships,app.session.affinities})
            local last=#screen.enc.log[1].sequence
            for _=screen.enc.reactionIndex,last do screen:acknowledge() end
            check(encode({app.session.relationships,app.session.affinities})==logicalBefore and screen.relationshipBars.notifications==0,
                "Continuar rápidamente la secuencia cargada no vuelve a aplicar ni anunciar el cambio")
            return screen
        end
        encounter("light_joke","eris")
        encounter("encourage","eris")
        encounter("listen","nanahoshi")

        local synthetic={title="Conversación de prueba",background="home",lines={
            {speaker="roxy",expression="happy",text="Podemos revisar juntas las notas."},
            {speaker="rudeus",expression="neutral",delivery="enchanted",text="Empecemos por el primer símbolo."},
        }}
        app.session=Save.newSession(); app.session.checkpoint="day1_warning"
        Progression.scene=function() return synthetic end
        local screen=require("src.screens.dialogue").new(app)
        app.manager.current=screen; app.manager.transition=0; screen:update(2); draw()
        local box=screen.relationshipBars.roxy.lastBounds
        check(box and box.y>=38 and box.y+box.h<box.portrait.y and box.portrait.y+box.portrait.h<=227,"Diálogo: barras sobre retrato sin invadir la caja de texto")
        screen:advance(); screen:update(.2); draw()
        check(screen.presentation.cast[1].character=="roxy" and screen.dialogue:current().speaker=="rudeus","Diálogo single conserva la interlocutora durante la respuesta de Rudy")
        capture("dialogue-roxy")
        app.session.dialogueIndex=2
        local loadedScreen=require("src.screens.dialogue").new(app)
        check(loadedScreen.presentation.cast[1].character=="roxy","Cargar en la respuesta reconstruye la interlocutora persistente")
        synthetic.cast={{character="roxy",position="left"},{character="eris",position="right"}}
        app.session.dialogueIndex=1; screen=require("src.screens.dialogue").new(app)
        app.manager.current=screen; screen:update(2); draw()
        check(screen.relationshipBars.roxy.lastBounds.x==39 and screen.relationshipBars.eris.lastBounds.x==473,"Reparto explícito ancla cada barra a su propio retrato")
        capture("dialogue-cast")
        Progression.scene=originalScene
        app.session=Save.newSession(); app:resume(); settle(); draw()
        local dream=app.manager.current
        check(not dream.relationshipBars.roxy.lastBounds and not dream.relationshipBars.eris.lastBounds and not dream.relationshipBars.nanahoshi.lastBounds,"El sueño de Hitogami no muestra barras ajenas")
        capture("dream-no-bars")
    end,debug.traceback)
    Save.readOptions,Font.draw,Progression.scene=originalOptions,originalFont,originalScene
    love.graphics.setCanvas(); love.graphics.pop(); love.filesystem.setIdentity(identity)
    assert(ok,err)
    Suite.report={checks=checks,captures=captures}
    print("Relationship bars: "..checks.." checks; "..captures.." real-renderer captures; anchors, real deltas, one-time feedback and save/restore.")
    return checks
end
return Suite
````

````lua
        resources=Resources.new()
        resources:getBackground("unknown_scene")
        check(#resources.warnings==1 and resources.sources["unmapped:background:unknown_scene"].status=="fallback",
            "Un ID no registrado se diagnostica sin fingir un escenario definitivo")
    end,debug.traceback)
    love.filesystem.getInfo,love.graphics.newImage,love.graphics.draw=originalInfo,originalImage,originalDraw
    love.graphics.setCanvas(); love.graphics.pop()
    assert(ok,err)
    print("Resources: "..count.." checks passed (all mapped PNGs, mappings, expressions, transparency and diagnosed fallbacks).")
    return count
end
return Suite
````

## tests/restructure_integration.lua

````lua
-- Entrada humana a las pantallas reales; renderiza y guarda en identidad aislada.
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    love.math.setRandomSeed(20261120)
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local Chapters=require("src.data.chapters")
    local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
    local Cards=require("src.systems.cards")
    local Combat=require("src.systems.combat")
    local Tutorial=require("src.systems.tutorial")
    local Font=require("src.ui.font")
    local checked=0
    local function check(ok,msg) assert(ok,msg); checked=checked+1 end
    local disk=Save.newSession()
    require("src.systems.events").apply(disk,"starter_gift",{starter=true})
    check(Save.write(disk),"Guardar entrega real en disco")
    local reloaded=assert(Save.load())
    check(#reloaded.rewardQueue==1 and #reloaded.deck==5 and #reloaded.combatDeck==5,"Mazos y entrega pendientes persisten en disco")
    local old={write=Save.write,load=Save.load,exists=Save.exists,readOptions=Save.readOptions,writeOptions=Save.writeOptions,legacyInfo=Save.legacyInfo}
    local stored
    Save.write=function(s) stored=assert(Json.encode(assert(Save.validate(s)))); return true end
    Save.load=function() return stored and Save.validate(assert(Json.decode(stored))) or nil end
    Save.exists=function() return stored~=nil end
    Save.legacyInfo=function() return nil end
    Save.readOptions=function() return {muted=true,textAnimation=false,reducedMotion=false} end
    Save.writeOptions=function() return true end
    local app=require("src.app").new()
    local captures={}
    local function settle()
        app:update(2)
        if app.manager.transition>0 then app:update(2) end
        app:draw()
    end
    local function capture(name)
        if captures[name] then return end; captures[name]=true
        app.toastTime=0; app:draw()
        local bytes=app.canvas:newImageData():encode("png")
        local f=assert(io.open(love.filesystem.getSource().."/tests/artifacts/v2-"..name..".png","wb"))
        f:write(bytes:getString()); f:close()
    end
    local function click(label)
        app:draw()
        for _,b in ipairs(app.manager.current.buttons) do if b.label==label and not b.disabled then
            app:mousepressed(app.offsetX+(b.x+b.w/2)*app.scale,app.offsetY+(b.y+b.h/2)*app.scale,1); return
        end end
        error("Botón no disponible: "..label)
    end
    settle(); capture("menu"); click("Nueva partida"); settle()
    check(app.session.checkpoint=="intro" and #app.session.deck==0,"Inicio casado sin cartas antes de Nanahoshi")
    local steps=0
    while app.session.checkpoint~="campaign_complete" do
        steps=steps+1; check(steps<1000,"Campaña jugable sin bloqueo: "..app.session.checkpoint)
        settle()
        local s=app.manager.current
        local cp=app.session.checkpoint
        local node=Chapters.get(cp)
        if cp=="campaign_complete" then break end
        if s.kind=="reward" then
            capture("reward"); s:continue()
        elseif s.pendingDeparture or s.leaving then
            check(true,"La entrada espera al feedback y a la salida de la escena")
        elseif s.kind=="training_result" then
            capture("training-result-"..s.result.id);s:advance()
        elseif s.kind=="document" then
            capture("letter-"..s.phase); s:interact()
        elseif node.kind=="scene" then
            capture("day"..node.day)
            if s.dialogue:isLast() and s:ready() and s.scene.choices and #s.scene.choices>0 then
                for _,b in ipairs(s.buttons) do if b.y>=126 and b.y<227 then check(b.y+b.h<=227,"Las opciones no se solapan con el diálogo") end end
                click(s.scene.choices[1].label)
            else s:advance() end
        elseif node.kind=="hub" then
            local companions=Progression.availableCompanions(app.session)
            if #companions>0 then click("Elegir compañía") else click("Visitar") end
        elseif node.kind=="encounter" then
            if s.enc.type=="combat" then
                capture("combat-"..s.enc.enemy.id)
                check(not s.enc.finished or s.enc.outcome=="victory" or s.enc.training,"Política de prueba no debe perder: "..cp)
                if not s:busy() and not s.enc.finished and s.enc.training and Combat.canBasic(s.enc,"counter") then
                    s:basic("counter")
                elseif not s:busy() and not s.enc.finished and s.enc.training and s.enc.enemy.intent.kind=="attack"
                    and s.enc.enemy.intent.damage>=6 and Combat.canBasic(s.enc,"defend") then
                    s:basic("defend")
                elseif not s:busy() and not s.enc.finished and s.enc.companion and Combat.canTactic(s.enc,"coordinate") then
                    s:tactic("coordinate")
                else require("tests.combat_visual").drive(s) end
            else
                local instruction=s.tutorial and Tutorial.instruction(s.tutorial)
                if s.enc.finished then s:finish()
                elseif instruction and instruction.button then click(instruction.button)
                elseif s.phase=="result" then s:acknowledge()
                elseif s.tutorial and s.tutorial.stage=="free" then s:keypressed("p")
                else
                    local index,best
                    for i in ipairs(s.enc.hand) do if Cards.canPlay(s.enc,i) then
                        local p=Cards.preview(s.enc,i)
                        if not best or p.score>best then index,best=i,p.score end
                    end end
                    if index then s:keypressed(tostring(index)); s:keypressed("return") else s:keypressed("p") end
                end
            end
        elseif node.kind=="summary" then check(Progression.canContinue(app.session),"Resumen intermedio continúa"); app:next()
        else error("Pantalla sin manejador "..cp) end
    end
    settle(); capture("ending-family")
    check(Progression.summary(app.session).endingId=="family_united","Recorrido gráfico completo llega al final familiar")
    app:save(); local roundtrip=assert(Save.load())
    check(Json.encode(roundtrip.relationships)==Json.encode(app.session.relationships),"Matrimonios exactos después del epílogo")
    check(Json.encode(roundtrip.unlocked)==Json.encode(app.session.unlocked),"Colección exacta después del epílogo")
    local family=app.session
    for endingId,snapshot in pairs(require("tests.campaign").completed or {}) do
        app.session=assert(Save.validate(snapshot)); app.session.rewardQueue={}; app:resume(); settle()
        check(Progression.summary(app.session).endingId==endingId,"Epílogo gráfico coincide con decisiones: "..endingId)
        capture("ending-"..endingId)
    end
    app.session=family; app:resume(); settle()
    app:overlay("journal"); settle(); capture("journal"); click("Historial"); settle(); capture("history")
    app:overlay("deck"); settle(); capture("collection"); click("Combate"); settle(); capture("combat-deck")
    local editor=app.manager.current
    local previous=Json.encode(app.session.combatDeck)
    editor.draft[1]=false
    check(not editor:saveDeck(),"Editor rechaza mazo incompleto")
    check(Json.encode(app.session.combatDeck)==previous,"Borrador inválido no altera mazo persistido")
    editor.draft={}; for i,id in ipairs(app.session.combatDeck) do editor.draft[i]=id end
    check(editor:saveDeck(),"Editor guarda mazo válido")
    app:manual(); settle(); capture("manual-history")
    local manual=app.manager.current
    for section=1,7 do
        manual:changeSection(section)
        for page=1,require("src.screens.manual").pageCount(section) do manual.page=page; app:draw() end
    end
    check(true,"Todas las páginas del manual se renderizan")
    app:resume(); app:startPractice("free"); settle()
    check(app.practice and app.session.combat,"Práctica crea combate aislado")
    local saved=stored; app:save(); app:endPractice()
    check(stored==saved,"Práctica nunca sobrescribe campaña")
    local beforeLegacy=Save.legacyInfo
    Save.legacyInfo=function() return {day=3,checkpoint="day3_complete"} end
    local beforeExists=Save.exists; Save.exists=function() return false end
    app:menu(); settle(); click("Importar campaña anterior"); settle(); capture("legacy-consent")
    check(app.manager.current.legacyConfirm==true,"Importar exige aceptación explícita de la continuidad")
    click("Cancelar"); check(app.session==family,"Cancelar importación conserva la campaña")
    Save.legacyInfo=beforeLegacy; Save.exists=beforeExists; app:resume(); settle()
    for id,node in pairs(Chapters.checkpoints) do
        if node.kind=="scene" then
            local scene=Progression.scene(app.session,id)
            for _,line in ipairs(scene.lines) do check(Font.height(line.text,572)<=66,"Texto cabe: "..id) end
            for _,choice in ipairs(scene.choices or {}) do check(Font.height(choice.label,419)<=22,"Opción cabe: "..id) end
        end
    end
    -- Revisa además las cinco composiciones finales con las fixtures completas
    -- generadas por el recorrido lógico, cuando la suite las exporta.
    local finals=require("src.data.endings").list
    for _,ending in ipairs(finals) do
        check(Font.height(ending.body,418)<=66,"Cuerpo de epílogo cabe: "..ending.id)
        check(Font.height(ending.footer,418)<=55,"Epílogo cabe: "..ending.id)
    end
    require("tests.combat_visual").run(app)
    require("tests.combat_integration").run(app)
    for key,value in pairs(old) do Save[key]=value end
    print("Campaign UI: "..checked.." checks; "..steps.." screen steps; real-renderer captures in tests/artifacts/v2-*.png.")
    return checked
end
return Suite
````

````lua
-- Pruebas puras Lua: no leen ni escriben la partida real.
local Suite = {}

function Suite.run()
    local Story = require("src.data.story")
    local Characters = require("src.data.characters")
    local Dialogue = require("src.systems.dialogue")
    local Progression = require("src.systems.progression")
    local Events = require("src.systems.events")
    local Relationships = require("src.systems.relationships")
    local Save = require("src.systems.save")
    local Json = require("src.systems.json")
    local Cards = require("src.systems.cards")
    local checked = 0
    local function check(condition, message)
        assert(condition, message)
        checked = checked + 1
    end
    local function roundtrip(session)
        return assert(Save.validate(assert(Json.decode(assert(Json.encode(session))))))
    end
    local function nextTo(session, expected, result)
        local nextId, err = Progression.next(session, session.checkpoint, result)
        check(nextId == expected, "Avance a " .. expected .. ": " .. tostring(err))
        check(session.dialogueIndex == 1 and session.encounter == nil, "Limpiar estado de pantalla anterior")
        return roundtrip(session)
    end

    local session = Save.newSession()
    local expressions = {neutral=true, happy=true, worried=true, angry=true}
    for id in pairs(Story.scenes) do
        local scene = Progression.scene(session, id)
        check(scene and #scene.lines > 0, "Escena no vacía: " .. id)
        local dialogue = Dialogue.new(scene, 1)
        check(dialogue:current() == scene.lines[1], "Primera línea: " .. id)
        for i = 1, #scene.lines - 1 do
            check(not dialogue:advance() and dialogue.index == i + 1, "Una línea por avance: " .. id)
        end
        check(dialogue:isLast() and dialogue:advance() and dialogue:advance(), "Final estable: " .. id)
        check(Dialogue.new(scene, -200).index == 1, "Limitar índice inferior")
        check(Dialogue.new(scene, 200).index == #scene.lines, "Limitar índice superior")
        for _, line in ipairs(scene.lines) do
            check(line.speaker == "narrator" or Characters.byId[line.speaker], "Personaje conocido: " .. id)
            check(expressions[line.expression], "Expresión conocida: " .. id)
            check(not line.text:find("{"), "Sustituciones resueltas: " .. id)
        end
    end
    check(not pcall(Dialogue.new, {lines={}}), "Rechazar escena vacía")
    check(not Progression.visit(session, "roxy"), "No visitar durante introducción")
    check(not Progression.selectCompanion(session, "roxy"), "No elegir compañero antes de las visitas")

    -- Recorrido independiente para cada compañero y cada tipo de resultado.
    for _, companion in ipairs({"sylphiette", "roxy", "eris"}) do
        for _, score in ipairs({0, 8}) do
            session = Save.newSession()
            session = nextTo(session, "day1_tutorial")
            session = nextTo(session, "day1_result", {score=score, trust=9, chemistry=9})
            check(session.relationships[companion].trust == 0, "Tutorial no afecta relaciones ajenas")
            check(session.decisions.outcome_day1_tutorial == (score >= 5 and "success" or "partial"), "Resultado del tutorial")
            session = nextTo(session, "day1_close")
            check(session.unlocked.self_joke, "Desbloquear Reírse de uno mismo")
            session = nextTo(session, "hub")
            check(session.day == 2 and #Progression.availableCompanions(session) == 0, "Inicio de día dos")
            check(not Progression.selectCompanion(session, companion), "No saltar reencuentros")
            for _, character in ipairs({"eris", "sylphiette", "roxy"}) do
                check(Progression.visit(session, character) == "meet_" .. character, "Visita en orden libre")
                local checkpoint = session.checkpoint
                check(not Progression.next(session), "Requerir elección explícita")
                check(not Progression.choose(session, checkpoint, "missing"), "Rechazar elección desconocida")
                local choices = Story.scenes[checkpoint].choices
                local selected = choices[1]
                check(Progression.choose(session, checkpoint, selected.id), "Aplicar elección")
                check(Progression.choose(session, checkpoint, selected.id), "Repetir misma elección es idempotente")
                check(not Progression.choose(session, checkpoint, choices[2].id), "No sustituir elección confirmada")
                check(session.relationships[character].trust == 1, "Puntos de elección una sola vez")
                session = roundtrip(session)
                check(Progression.scene(session, checkpoint).choices == nil, "Al cargar elección confirmada se permite continuar")
                check(Progression.scene(session, checkpoint).lines[#Story.scenes[checkpoint].lines], "Conservar líneas al ocultar opciones")
                session = nextTo(session, "encounter_" .. character)
                local context = Progression.encounter(session, session.checkpoint)
                session.encounter = Cards.new(session.deck, context, function(n) return n end)
                Cards.pass(session.encounter)
                local saved = roundtrip(session)
                check(saved.encounter and saved.encounter.turn == 2, "Restaurar encuentro a mitad")
                check(saved.encounter.context.kind == context.kind and saved.encounter.context.character == character,
                    "Guardar no cambia contexto del encuentro")
                session = nextTo(session, "result_" .. character, {score=score, trust=3, chemistry=2})
                check(session.relationships[character].trust == 4, "Aplicar deltas al completar encuentro")
                check(session.relationships[character].chemistry == 2, "Aplicar química del encuentro")
                check(not Progression.next(session, "encounter_" .. character, {score=8, trust=3}), "No repetir resultado desde pantalla antigua")
                local resultScene = Progression.scene(session, session.checkpoint)
                check(resultScene.lines[1].text == Story.scenes[session.checkpoint].resultLines[score >= 5 and "success" or "partial"].text,
                    "Diálogo refleja éxito o avance parcial")
                session = nextTo(session, "hub")
                check(session.relationships[character].events.reunion, "Registrar evento del personaje")
                check(not Progression.visit(session, character), "No repetir reencuentro terminado")
            end
            check(session.unlocked.remember and #Progression.availableCompanions(session) == 3, "Desbloquear recuerdo y salida a ruinas")
            check(not Progression.selectCompanion(session, "unknown"), "Rechazar compañero desconocido")
            check(Progression.selectCompanion(session, companion) == "seal_intro", "Elegir compañero explícitamente")
            check(session.decisions.companion == companion and session.route == nil, "Compañero todavía no es ruta romántica")
            session = roundtrip(session)
            local seal = Progression.scene(session, "seal_intro")
            check(seal.lines[3].speaker == companion and seal.lines[3].text == Story.companionAdvice[companion], "Variante del consejo del compañero")
            session = nextTo(session, "seal_encounter")
            local context = Progression.encounter(session, "seal_encounter")
            check(context.character == companion and context.kind == "magic", "Contexto mágico con compañero")
            session.encounter = Cards.new(session.deck, context, function(n) return n end)
            Cards.pass(session.encounter)
            session = roundtrip(session)
            check(session.encounter and session.encounter.context.kind == "magic", "Conservar contexto mágico del sello al guardar")
            session = nextTo(session, "seal_result", {score=score, trust=1, chemistry=0})
            local result = Progression.scene(session, "seal_result")
            check(result.lines[3].speaker == companion and result.lines[3].text == Story.companionMemory[companion], "Variante del recuerdo del compañero")
            session = nextTo(session, "day2_close")
            check(session.events.seal_memory and session.relationships[companion].events.memory_seal, "Obtener sello incluso con cero puntos")
            check(session.relationships[companion].trust == 6, "Puntos totales del compañero")
            check(not Events.apply(session, "seal_memory", {character=companion, trust=8}), "Sello idempotente")
            check(session.relationships[companion].trust == 6, "No duplicar puntos del sello")
            session = nextTo(session, "phase_complete")
            check(session.events.phase1_complete and session.day == 2, "Terminar contenido exactamente en día dos")
            check(Relationships.ending(session.relationships, session.route, session.decisions) == "independent", "No asignar romance al terminar Fase 1")
        end
    end

    local invalid = Save.validate({version=1, checkpoint="missing", dialogueIndex=999})
    check(invalid and invalid.checkpoint == "intro", "Recuperar checkpoint desconocido")
    check(Dialogue.new(Progression.scene(invalid, invalid.checkpoint), invalid.dialogueIndex):current(), "Índice inválido no bloquea diálogo")
    local partial = Save.validate({version=1, checkpoint="seal_encounter", events={companion_selected=true}})
    check(partial and partial.checkpoint == "hub" and not partial.decisions.companion, "Volver al mapa si se perdió el compañero")
    check(not partial.events.companion_selected, "Permitir nueva selección tras guardado incompleto")
    partial.events.meeting_sylphiette, partial.events.meeting_roxy, partial.events.meeting_eris = true, true, true
    check(Progression.selectCompanion(partial, "eris") == "seal_intro" and partial.decisions.companion == "eris", "Reparar elección de compañero")
    local lostChoice = Save.newSession()
    lostChoice.day, lostChoice.checkpoint = 2, "meet_roxy"
    lostChoice.events.choice_meet_roxy = true
    lostChoice.relationships.roxy.trust = 4
    check(Progression.choose(lostChoice, "meet_roxy", "compare_notes"), "Recuperar decisión perdida con evento persistido")
    check(lostChoice.relationships.roxy.trust == 4, "Recuperar decisión sin volver a aplicar puntos")
    check(Progression.next(lostChoice) == "encounter_roxy", "Continuar después de recuperar elección")

    -- A completed encounter can be saved before confirming its result. The
    -- restored actions, including the free action, grant their effects once.
    local resumed=Save.newSession()
    resumed.day,resumed.checkpoint=2,"meet_roxy"
    check(Progression.choose(resumed,"meet_roxy","compare_notes"),"Elegir antes del encuentro real")
    check(Progression.next(resumed)=="encounter_roxy","Abrir encuentro real")
    resumed.encounter=Cards.new(resumed.deck,{kind="investigation",character="roxy"},function(n) return n end)
    Cards.play(resumed.encounter,2)
    resumed=roundtrip(resumed)
    Cards.pass(resumed.encounter)
    resumed=roundtrip(resumed)
    Cards.play(resumed.encounter,2)
    resumed=roundtrip(resumed)
    check(resumed.encounter.finished and #resumed.encounter.log==3,"Cargar encuentro finalizado antes del resultado")
    check(resumed.relationships.roxy.trust==1 and resumed.relationships.roxy.chemistry==0,
        "Guardar acciones no aplica todavía los vínculos")
    local result={score=resumed.encounter.score,trust=0,chemistry=0}
    for _,entry in ipairs(resumed.encounter.log) do
        result.trust=result.trust+entry.trust
        result.chemistry=result.chemistry+entry.chemistry
    end
    check(Progression.next(resumed,"encounter_roxy",result)=="result_roxy","Confirmar resultado restaurado")
    check(resumed.relationships.roxy.trust==1+result.trust and resumed.relationships.roxy.chemistry==result.chemistry,
        "Aplicar exactamente los vínculos registrados")
    resumed=roundtrip(resumed)
    local afterResult=assert(Json.encode(resumed.relationships))
    check(not Progression.next(resumed,"encounter_roxy",result),"Rechazar confirmación repetida tras cargar")
    check(Json.encode(resumed.relationships)==afterResult,"Confirmación repetida no duplica vínculos")
    check(Progression.next(resumed)=="hub" and resumed.events.meeting_roxy,"Volver al mapa tras encuentro restaurado")

    print("OK: " .. checked .. " comprobaciones de narrativa, progresión y carga intermedia.")
    return checked
end

return Suite
````

## tests/training.lua

````lua
local Suite={}
function Suite.solve(enc,mode)
local Combat=require("src.systems.combat")
local Training=require("src.systems.training")
    local safety=0
    while not enc.finished do
        safety=safety+1;assert(safety<100,"Duelo finito")
        if mode=="win" then
            local incoming=enc.enemy.intent.kind=="attack" and enc.enemy.intent.damage*(enc.enemy.intent.hits or 1) or 0
            if incoming>=6 then Combat.basic(enc,"defend") end
            while not enc.finished do
                local chosen,score
                for index,id in ipairs(enc.hand) do if Combat.canPlay(enc,index) then
                    local e=Combat.card(id).effects
                    local value=(e.damage or 0)+math.min(e.heal or 0,enc.player.maxHp-enc.player.hp)+
                        math.min(e.shield or 0,math.max(0,incoming-enc.player.shield))*.5
                    if not score or value>score then chosen,score=index,value end
                end end
                if chosen then Combat.play(enc,chosen) else break end
            end
        elseif mode=="honor" then
            local chosen,value
            for index,id in ipairs(enc.hand) do if Combat.canPlay(enc,index) then
                local c=Combat.card(id)
                if (c.effects.damage or 0)>0 and (not value or c.effects.damage<value) then chosen,value=index,c.effects.damage end
            end end
            if chosen then Combat.play(enc,chosen) end
            if enc.turn%3==0 then Combat.basic(enc,"dodge") end
        elseif mode=="honest" then
            while not enc.finished do
                local chosen,value
                for index,id in ipairs(enc.hand) do if Combat.canPlay(enc,index) then
                    local c=Combat.card(id)
                    if (c.hpCost or 0)>0 and (not value or c.hpCost>value) then chosen,value=index,c.hpCost end
                end end
                if chosen then Combat.play(enc,chosen) else break end
            end
        end
        if not enc.finished then Combat.endTurn(enc) end
    end
    return assert(Training.evaluate(enc))
end
function Suite.run()
    local Combat=require("src.systems.combat")
    local Training=require("src.systems.training")
    local Config=require("src.data.training")
    local Techniques=require("src.data.combat_cards")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local checks=0
    local function check(value,message) checks=checks+1;assert(value,message) end
    local function encoded(value) return assert(Json.encode(value)) end
    local function clone(value) return assert(Json.decode(encoded(value))) end
    local late={"staff_strike","simple_cut","stone_throw","push","coordinated_attack",
        "water_projectile","arcane_guard","heavy_spell","swamp","heal"}
    local function context(deck,extra)
        local c={enemyId="eris_training",day=5,combatDeck=deck or late,
            curse={active=true,manaBlocked=true},externalEnergy=12}
        for key,value in pairs(extra or {}) do c[key]=value end
        return c
    end
    local function create(deck,seed,extra)
        local c=context(deck,extra)
        return Combat.new({},c,function() return seed or 17 end),c
    end
    local function verify(enc,c,label)
        local restored=Combat.restore(clone(enc),{},c)
        check(restored and encoded(restored.training)==encoded(enc.training),"Replay de métricas: "..label)
        check(restored and encoded(restored.hand)==encoded(enc.hand) and restored.randomState==enc.randomState,"Mano y azar del duelo: "..label)
    end
    local finish=Suite.solve

    local base,c=create(nil,17,{character="eris"})
    check(base.enemy.training and base.enemy.nonlethal and base.enemy.character=="eris" and base.enemy.portrait=="eris","Eris es el oponente y usa su identidad/retrato existentes")
    check(not base.companion and Training.evaluate(base)==nil,"No aparece una segunda Eris aliada ni se evalúa antes de terminar")
    check(base.enemy.maxHp==42 and base.maxTurns==18,"Resistencia y límite declarados, sin escalado automático")
    verify(base,c,"apertura")
    check(not Combat.canBasic(base,"counter"),"No hay contraataque sin una apertura defensiva real")
    assert(Combat.basic(base,"dodge"));assert(Combat.endTurn(base))
    check(base.training.metrics.successfulDodges==1 and base.training.metrics.dodgedDamage==3,"Una esquiva efectiva registra solo el daño evitado")
    check(base.training.metrics.blockedAttacks==1 and base.training.metrics.blockedDamage==3 and base.training.metrics.damageReceived==3,"Bloqueos, resistencia perdida e intenciones coinciden")
    verify(base,c,"esquiva")
    check(Combat.canBasic(base,"counter"),"La esquiva efectiva habilita contraataque en el turno siguiente")
    local enemyBefore=base.enemy.hp
    assert(Combat.basic(base,"counter"))
    check(base.enemy.hp==enemyBefore-5 and base.training.metrics.attacksAttempted==1 and base.training.metrics.tacticalActions==2,
        "El contraataque cuesta una acción y cuenta como ataque táctico de bastón")
    check(not Combat.canBasic(base,"counter"),"La apertura no concede dos contraataques")
    verify(base,c,"contraataque")
    local altered=clone(base);altered.training.metrics.damageDealt=999
    check(not Combat.restore(altered,{},c),"Las métricas guardadas no se aceptan sin replay")
    local covered,coveredContext=create(Techniques.starterDeck,17,{tutorial=true})
    for index,id in ipairs(covered.hand) do if id=="push" then assert(Combat.play(covered,index));break end end
    assert(Combat.basic(covered,"defend"));assert(Combat.basic(covered,"dodge"));assert(Combat.endTurn(covered))
    check(covered.training.metrics.blockedDamage==6 and covered.training.metrics.successfulDodges==0,
        "Esquivar sin necesitar el escudo adicional no fabrica una esquiva efectiva")
    verify(covered,coveredContext,"esquiva redundante")

    local outcomes={}
    for _,case in ipairs({
        {mode="win",want="victory",deck=late,love=8,trust=6},
        {mode="honor",want="honorable_defeat",deck=Techniques.starterDeck,love=4,trust=3},
        {mode="idle",want="suspected_throw",deck=Techniques.starterDeck,love=-10,trust=-8},
        {mode="honest",want="honest_defeat",deck={"quick_study","mana_spark","simple_cut","staff_strike","stone_throw"},love=1,trust=1},
    }) do
        local enc,ctx=create(case.deck,17)
        local result=finish(enc,case.mode)
        check(result.id==case.want,"Resultado legal "..case.mode..": esperado "..case.want..", recibido "..result.id)
        check(result.love==case.love and result.trust==case.trust,"Efectos configurados: "..case.want)
        check(result.nonlethal and result.metrics.winner==result.winner,"Todos los resultados son ejercicios no letales")
        check(#enc.relationshipEvents==0,"El motor no aplica relaciones ni duplica recompensas")
        check(encoded(result)==encoded(enc.trainingResult),"La evaluación y el resultado almacenado coinciden")
        verify(enc,ctx,case.want)
        local retry=Combat.retry(enc)
        check(retry.training.metrics.attacksAttempted==0 and retry.trainingResult==nil and encoded(retry.initial)==encoded(enc.initial),"Reintento limpio y mismo reparto: "..case.want)
        if enc.outcome=="defeat" then check(enc.cause:find("sin heridas",1,true),"La derrota no mata a Rudy") end
        outcomes[case.want]=result
    end
    check(outcomes.honest_defeat.metrics.turns<5 and outcomes.honest_defeat.metrics.attacksAttempted>0,"Una derrota rápida con intentos reales no se acusa de abandono")
    check(outcomes.suspected_throw.metrics.avoidableEmptyTurns>=3 and outcomes.suspected_throw.metrics.missedOpportunities>=3,"La sospecha necesita varias señales repetidas, no solamente daño bajo")
    local dry,dryContext=create({"magic_bolt","water_projectile","heal","arcane_guard","focus"},91,{externalEnergy=0})
    local noResources=finish(dry,"idle")
    check(noResources.id=="honest_defeat" and noResources.metrics.missedOpportunities==0,"Una mano sin ataques pagables no se considera dejarse ganar")
    verify(dry,dryContext,"sin energía")

    for seed=1,8 do
        local enc,ctx=create(late,seed*4729)
        check(finish(enc,"win").id=="victory","Rudy puede ganar legalmente mediante estrategia, semilla "..seed)
        verify(enc,ctx,"victoria "..seed)
    end
    -- Objetivo alternativo de tres impactos: configurable sin otra pantalla.
    local previous=Config.eris.victory.kind
    Config.eris.victory.kind="hits"
    local ok,err=xpcall(function()
        local enc=create(late,31)
        local result=finish(enc,"win")
        check(result.id=="victory" and result.metrics.validHits>=3,"El objetivo alternativo acepta tres impactos válidos")
    end,debug.traceback)
    Config.eris.victory.kind=previous
    assert(ok,err)
    print("Eris training: "..checks.." checks; four legal outcomes, nonlethal resistance, measured effort, seeded victories and replay.")
    return checks
end
return Suite
````

````lua
-- Resultados de combates legales en la App real y guardado en disco aislado.
local Suite={}
function Suite.run()
    local Save=require("src.systems.save")
    local Events=require("src.systems.events")
    local Combat=require("src.systems.combat")
    local Training=require("src.systems.training")
    local Result=require("src.systems.training_result")
    local Progression=require("src.systems.progression")
    local Dialogue=require("src.data.training_dialogue")
    local Font=require("src.ui.font")
    local Options=require("src.systems.options")
    local Json=require("src.systems.json")
    local Techniques=require("src.data.combat_cards")
    local Solver=require("tests.training")
    local checks,captures=0,0
    local function check(value,message) checks=checks+1;assert(value,message) end
    local function encode(value) return assert(Json.encode(value)) end
    local function clone(value) return assert(Json.decode(encode(value))) end
    local late={"staff_strike","simple_cut","stone_throw","push","coordinated_attack",
        "water_projectile","arcane_guard","heavy_spell","swamp","heal"}
    local identity=love.filesystem.getIdentity()
    local originalOptions,originalFont=Save.readOptions,Font.draw
    local app,drawn
    love.filesystem.setIdentity("cartas_del_destino_training_tests")
    Save.readOptions=function() return {muted=true,textAnimation=false,reducedMotion=false} end
    love.graphics.push("all")
    local ok,err=xpcall(function()
        app=require("src.app").new();app.mouse=function() return nil,nil end
        Font.draw=function(text,x,y,options)
            if drawn then drawn[#drawn+1]={text=tostring(text),x=x,y=y,options=options or {}} end
            return originalFont(text,x,y,options)
        end
        local function draw()
            drawn={};app.toastTime=0;app:draw();return drawn
        end
        local function settle()
            if app.manager.transition>0 then app:update(app.manager.transition) end
            app:update(2);draw()
        end
        local function capture(name)
            draw();local pixels=app.canvas:newImageData();local png=pixels:encode("png")
            local file=assert(io.open(love.filesystem.getSource().."/tests/artifacts/training-"..name..".png","wb"))
            file:write(png:getString());file:close();pixels:release();png:release();captures=captures+1
        end
        local function click(label)
            draw()
            for _,button in ipairs(app.manager.current.buttons) do
                if button.label==label and not button.disabled then
                    app:mousepressed(app.offsetX+(button.x+button.w/2)*app.scale,app.offsetY+(button.y+button.h/2)*app.scale,1)
                    return
                end
            end
            error("Botón de entrenamiento no disponible: "..label)
        end
        local function layout(screen)
            local calls=draw();local found={}
            for _,entry in ipairs(calls) do
                local height=Font.height(entry.text,entry.options.maxWidth,entry.options.scale)
                if entry.x==24 and entry.y>=65 and entry.y<=178 then
                    check(entry.y+height<=215,"Texto de métricas y evaluación cabe en su panel: "..entry.text)
                end
                if entry.x==24 and entry.y==249 then check(entry.y+height<=306,"La reacción no invade el resultado aplicado") end
                for _,label in ipairs({"Ganador:","Ataques:","Puntos causados:","Bloqueos:","Esquivas efectivas:","Turnos sin actuar:","Aperturas desaprovechadas:"}) do
                    if entry.text:find(label,1,true) then found[label]=true end
                end
            end
            for _,label in ipairs({"Ganador:","Ataques:","Puntos causados:","Bloqueos:","Esquivas efectivas:","Turnos sin actuar:","Aperturas desaprovechadas:"}) do
                check(found[label],"Métrica visible: "..label)
            end
            local bounds=screen.bars.lastBounds
            check(bounds and bounds.y+bounds.h<bounds.portrait.y and bounds.x>=328 and bounds.x+bounds.w<=632,"Barras sobre Eris sin invadir métricas ni retrato")
        end
        local function fixture(mode,deck,prior,checkpoint)
            local session=prior and clone(prior) or Save.newSession()
            if not prior then Events.apply(session,"starter_gift",{starter=true}) end
            Events.apply(session,"training_test_resources_"..(checkpoint or "day5"),{externalEnergy=12,unlock=deck})
            session.checkpoint=checkpoint or "day5_eris_duel"
            session.day=require("src.data.chapters").get(session.checkpoint).day
            session.rewardQueue={};session.events.tutorial_completed=true;session.encounter=nil;session.trainingReview=nil
            session.combatDeck=clone(deck)
            local def=assert(Progression.encounter(session,session.checkpoint))
            session.combat=Combat.new(session.deck,{character=def.character,enemyId=def.enemyId,day=session.day,
                difficulty=def.difficulty,tutorial=def.tutorial,tacticalContext=def.tacticalContext,
                combatDeck=deck,unlocked=session.unlocked,curse=session.curse,externalEnergy=session.externalEnergy},function() return 17 end)
            Solver.solve(session.combat,mode)
            return session
        end
        local function review(session,name,expected,reduced)
            app.options=Options.normalize({muted=true,textAnimation=false,reducedMotion=reduced==true})
            app.session=session
            local before=clone(session.relationships.eris)
            local combatBefore=encode(session.combat)
            local resistanceText=true
            for _,entry in ipairs(session.combat.log) do for _,event in ipairs(entry.events or {}) do
                if event.kind=="damage" and not event.text:find("resistencia perdida",1,true) then resistanceText=false end
            end end
            check(resistanceText,"El historial de entrenamiento describe resistencia, sin heridas letales")
            check(not Progression.finishCombat(session,session.combat),"No se omite la reacción para cobrar o avanzar")
            check(app:save(),"Guardar combate terminado antes de la reacción")
            app:continueGame();settle()
            local screen=app.manager.current
            check(screen.kind=="training_result" and screen.result.id==expected,"La App abre resultado real: "..name)
            check(app.audio.context=="training" and app.audio.current and app.audio.current.source,"Cargar el resultado restaura música de entrenamiento real")
            check(encode(app.session.combat)==combatBefore,"Cargar conserva combate y todas sus métricas")
            check(not app.session.events[Result.key(app.session.checkpoint)] and app.session.relationships.eris.love==before.love,
                "Cargar antes de la reacción no adelanta puntos")
            layout(screen);capture(name.."-before")
            while not screen.line.apply do
                if screen.page%2==1 then click("Escuchar [Enter]") else app:keypressed("return") end
                screen=app.manager.current
                if not screen.line.apply then
                    app:update(.2);check(app:save(),"Guardar una línea intermedia")
                    local page=screen.page;app:continueGame();settle();screen=app.manager.current
                    check(screen.page==page and not app.session.events[Result.key(app.session.checkpoint)],"La página intermedia se restaura sin aplicar")
                end
            end
            local checkpoint=app.session.checkpoint
            local record=assert(app.session.trainingResults[checkpoint])
            local current=app.session.relationships.eris
            local dl,dt=current.love-before.love,current.trust-before.trust
            check(record.actualLove==dl and record.actualTrust==dt,"Deltas aplicados exactos y sujetos al máximo/mínimo")
            check(encode(record.metrics)==encode(Training.evaluate(app.session.combat).metrics),"Registro conserva todas las métricas, incluido ganador")
            local feedback=screen.bars:feedback()
            check(feedback and feedback.deltas.love==dl and feedback.deltas.trust==dt,"Feedback muestra cambios reales, no bonificaciones nominales")
            if reduced then check(screen.bars.value.love==current.love and screen.bars.value.trust==current.trust,"Movimiento reducido actualiza barras inmediatamente")
            else
                check(screen.bars.value.love==before.love,"La barra empieza en el valor anterior")
                app:update(.2)
                check(screen.bars.value.love~=before.love and math.abs(screen.bars.value.love-current.love)>.01,"La barra interpola durante la reacción")
            end
            layout(screen);capture(name.."-applied")
            local relationSnapshot=encode(app.session.relationships)
            local journalSize=#app.session.journal
            local _,applied=Result.commit(app.session,app.session.combat)
            check(applied==false and encode(app.session.relationships)==relationSnapshot and #app.session.journal==journalSize,"Repetir confirmación no duplica puntos ni memoria")
            screen:showLine()
            check(screen.bars.notifications==1,"Redibujar o reabrir la misma línea no repite feedback")
            app:update(1.3)
            check(not screen.bars:feedback() and screen.bars.value.love==current.love,"El texto flotante termina y la barra converge")
            check(app:save(),"Guardar tras la reacción aplicada")
            app:continueGame();settle();screen=app.manager.current
            check(screen.line.apply and screen.bars.notifications==0 and not screen.bars:feedback(),"Cargar la reacción aplicada no reanima ni repite efectos")
            check(encode(app.session.relationships)==relationSnapshot,"Cargar conserva relaciones exactas")
            layout(screen);capture(name.."-restored")
            click("Continuar historia [Enter]");settle()
            check(app.session.checkpoint~=checkpoint and not app.session.combat and not app.session.trainingReview,"Victoria o derrota continúan la historia sin reintento forzado")
            check(not app.session.events["combat_reward_"..checkpoint],"El entrenamiento no entrega premios normales de combate")
            return clone(app.session)
        end

        local cases={
            {mode="win",id="victory",deck=late,love=98,trust=99},
            {mode="honor",id="honorable_defeat",deck=Techniques.starterDeck},
            {mode="idle",id="suspected_throw",deck=Techniques.starterDeck,love=4,trust=3},
            {mode="honest",id="honest_defeat",deck={"quick_study","mana_spark","simple_cut","staff_strike","stone_throw"}},
        }
        local histories={}
        for _,case in ipairs(cases) do
            local s=fixture(case.mode,case.deck)
            if case.love then s.relationships.eris.love=case.love;s.relationships.eris.trust=case.trust;s.relationships.eris.chemistry=case.love end
            histories[case.id]=review(s,case.id,case.id)
            local scene=Progression.scene(histories[case.id],"day5_training_reflection")
            check(scene.lines[1].expression==({victory="happy",honorable_defeat="happy",suspected_throw="angry",honest_defeat="neutral"})[case.id],
                "La conversación posterior recuerda el resultado "..case.id)
        end
        local s=fixture("win",late)
        review(s,"reduced-motion","victory",true)

        -- Una disculpa abre la revancha; el esfuerzo posterior repara el conflicto,
        -- conservando los dos resultados. No se fabrican métricas de ninguno.
        local prior=histories.suspected_throw
        check(prior.relationships.eris.pendingConflicts.training_effort,"El abandono aparente deja un conflicto real")
        check(Progression.choose(prior,"day5_training_reflection","apologize"),"La disculpa es una decisión jugable")
        prior.checkpoint="day6_intro";prior.day=6;prior.dialogueIndex=1
        check(Progression.next(prior)=="day6_eris_rematch_offer","La memoria desbloquea la oferta del día seis")
        check(Progression.choose(prior,prior.checkpoint,"accept") and Progression.next(prior)=="day6_eris_rematch","Aceptar conduce al nuevo duelo")
        local repeated=fixture("win",late,prior,"day6_eris_rematch")
        local repaired=review(repeated,"reconciled","victory")
        check(repaired.events.eris_training_reconciled and not repaired.relationships.eris.pendingConflicts.training_effort,"Esfuerzo tras disculpa reconcilia sin borrar la memoria")
        check(repaired.trainingResults.day5_eris_duel.id=="suspected_throw" and repaired.trainingResults.day6_eris_rematch.id=="victory","Ambas experiencias permanecen guardadas")
        local saved=assert(Save.validate(clone(repaired)))
        check(saved.events.eris_training_reconciled and saved.trainingResults.day5_eris_duel.id=="suspected_throw","Guardar conserva reconciliación y antecedente")
    end,debug.traceback)
    Save.readOptions=originalOptions;Font.draw=originalFont
    if app and app.audio then app.audio:setContext("menu") end
    love.graphics.setCanvas();love.graphics.pop();love.filesystem.setIdentity(identity)
    assert(ok,err)
    print("Training integration: "..checks.." checks; "..captures.." real-renderer captures (four legal outcomes, capped deltas, bars, disk replay, future memory and reconciliation).")
    return checks
end
return Suite
````

````lua
-- Ejecutar dentro de LÖVE. Usa las pantallas reales con guardado en memoria.

function Suite.run()

    end

    for name,region in pairs(CardView.regions) do

                active={x=x,y=y,w=region.w,h=region.h,inside=true,pixels=0}
                bounds[key]=active

            love.graphics.rectangle=function(mode,x,y,w,h,...)
                if active then

            end
            local index={}; for i,kind in ipairs(order) do index[kind]=i end
            check(index.base<index.frame and index.frame<index.name and index.name<index.icon and index.icon<index.cost,
                "Capas: pergamino, marco, nombre, icono, coste: "..card.id)

    Font.draw,love.graphics.rectangle=originalDraw,originalRectangle

    Save.load=function() return stored and Save.validate(assert(Json.decode(stored))) end
    Save.exists=function() return stored~=nil end
    Save.readOptions=function() return {volume=.6,muted=false} end
    Save.writeOptions=function() return true end
    ok,err=xpcall(function()
        local app=require("src.app").new()
        local mx,my
        app.mouse=function() return mx,my end
        local function render(dt) app:update(dt or 1.6); app:draw() end
        local function click(x,y)
            app:mousepressed(app.offsetX+x*app.scale,app.offsetY+y*app.scale,1)
        end
        render()
        app:keypressed("tab")
        app:keypressed("down")
        check(app.manager.current.buttons[app.manager.current.keyboardFocus].label=="Práctica: social y combate",
            "Teclado del menú salta Continuar deshabilitado")
        app:keypressed("down"); app:keypressed("down")
        app:keypressed("return")
        check(app.manager.current.kind=="options","Enter abre opción enfocada")
        render()
        app:keypressed("escape")
        render()
        app:keypressed("tab")
        app:keypressed("return")
        check(app.session and app.session.checkpoint=="intro","Nueva partida accesible por teclado")
        app:keypressed("return")
        click(100,300)
        check(app.session.dialogueIndex==1 and app.manager.current.visible==0,
            "Entrada repetida durante transición no salta texto nuevo")

        app.session=Save.newSession()
        app.session.day,app.session.checkpoint=2,"encounter_roxy"
        -- Two legal cards costing two leave the third turn with no energy.
        app.session.deck[9]="combined_spell"
        app.session.unlocked.combined_spell=true
        app.session.encounter=Cards.new(app.session.deck,{kind="investigation",character="roxy"},function(n) return n end)
        app:resume()
        mx,my=341,220
        render()
        local screen=app.manager.current
        check(screen.selected==3,"Ratón selecciona tercera carta para ver detalles")
        app:keypressed("left")
        app:draw()
        check(screen.selected==2,"Ratón inmóvil no deshace selección de teclado")
        app:keypressed("left")
        app:keypressed("return")
        check(screen.enc.turn==2 and screen.enc.energy==2 and screen.enc.discard[1]=="earth_barrier",
            "Enter juega carta seleccionada una vez")
        app:keypressed("return")
        click(153,209)
        check(screen.enc.turn==2 and #screen.enc.discard==1,"Doble entrada de teclado/ratón no juega carta recién robada")
        render()
        check(screen.phase=="result" and not screen:busy(),"La animación termina mostrando el resultado antes del próximo turno")
        app:keypressed("return")
        check(screen.phase=="hand" and screen.enc.turn==2,"Confirmar resultado vuelve a la mano sin aplicar otra carta")
        render()
        click(153,209)
        check(screen.enc.turn==2 and screen.confirmReady,"Clic en carta consulta su efecto antes de consumir energía")
        app:draw()
        local playButton
        for _,button in ipairs(screen.buttons) do if button.label=="Jugar carta [Enter]" then playButton=button end end
        check(playButton~=nil,"Confirmación de carta tiene un botón real")
        click(playButton.x+4,playButton.y+4)
        check(screen.enc.turn==3 and screen.enc.energy==0 and screen.enc.discard[2]=="combined_spell",
            "Ratón selecciona y confirma una carta respetando su coste")
        render()
        app:keypressed("return")
        render()
        local textSeen={}
        Font.draw=function(text,...)
            textSeen[text]=true
            return originalDraw(text,...)
        end
        app:draw()
        Font.draw=originalDraw
        check(textSeen["[1] NO DISP."] and textSeen["No hay energía suficiente."],
            "Carta sin energía informa disponibilidad y motivo")
        local before=assert(Json.encode(screen.enc))
        click(153,209)
        app:keypressed("return")
        check(Json.encode(screen.enc)==before,"Carta deshabilitada no consume turno ni cambia pilas")
        app:keypressed("right")
        app:keypressed("right")
        app:keypressed("return")
        check(screen.enc.finished and screen.enc.energy==0 and screen.enc.discard[3]=="admit_error",
            "Carta de coste cero disponible al agotarse energía")
        render()
        app:overlay("deck")
        mx,my=nil,nil
        render()
        screen=app.manager.current
        app:keypressed("tab")
        app:keypressed("down")
        app:keypressed("down")
        app:keypressed("return")
        check(screen.selected==2,"Colección permite inspeccionar cartas con teclado")
        app:draw()
        local lockedRow
        for _,button in ipairs(screen.buttons) do if button.cardIndex==16 then lockedRow=button end end
        check(lockedRow~=nil,"Carta futura presente en el grupo de bloqueadas")
        click(lockedRow.x+4,lockedRow.y+4)
        check(screen.selected==16,"Colección permite inspeccionar una carta futura bloqueada")
        app:draw()
    end,debug.traceback)
    Font.draw=originalDraw
    for key,value in pairs(old) do Save[key]=value end
    love.audio.setVolume(volume)
    assert(ok,err)
    print("OK: "..checked.." comprobaciones de composición de cartas, márgenes e interacción.")
    return checked
end

return Suite
````

````python
"""Genera una entrega con la ruta y el contenido íntegro de cada archivo de texto."""
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
destination = root / "docs" / "CODIGO_COMPLETO.md"
extensions = {".lua": "lua", ".ps1": "powershell", ".py": "python", ".md": "markdown"}
files = sorted(p for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file()
               and (p.suffix in extensions or p.name in {".gitignore", ".gitkeep"}) and p != destination
               and not any(part in {".git", ".tmp", "dist", ".codex", ".agents", "sprite_sources", "artifacts"} for part in p.relative_to(root).parts))
chunks = ["# Código completo del proyecto\n\n"
          "Este documento contiene las rutas y el contenido completo de los archivos de texto del proyecto. "
          "Los archivos reales ya están creados; no es necesario copiarlos desde aquí. "
          "Los PNG del juego están en assets/ y los editables ASE en sprite_sources/; "
          "los archivos binarios no se incluyen en este documento. "
          "Esta versión comprende siete días, cinco finales matrimoniales, colección progresiva, "
          "la maldición de Rudy, retratos contextuales, conversaciones ramificadas escritas, memoria de promesas, "
          "cartas parlantes, barras animadas, afinidad de Nanahoshi, entrenamiento con Eris, "
          "dificultad por día, energía externa, compañeras, guardado v3, animaciones y audio sintetizado.\n\n"
          f"Raíz del proyecto: `{root.as_posix()}`\n"]
for path in files:
    content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    fence = "`" * max(4, max((len(s) for s in content.split() if set(s) == {"`"}), default=0) + 1)
    chunks.append(f"\n## {path.relative_to(root).as_posix()}\n\nRuta exacta: `{path.as_posix()}`\n\n"
                  f"{fence}{extensions.get(path.suffix, 'text')}\n{content.rstrip()}\n{fence}\n")
destination.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
destination.write_text("".join(chunks), encoding="utf-8")
print(f"Exportados {len(files)} archivos: {destination}")
````
